First, the framework learns class-conditional temporal and spectral characteristics of the measured structural responses. It uses conditional generative adversarial network training and Monte Carlo dropout uncertainty quantification as a Bayesian approximation. This step enables stochastic signal synthesis and uncertainty quantification. Second, the generated responses are rigorously compared against experimental measurements across time, frequency, uncertainty, variability, and feature domains to assess physical realism, statistical consistency, and distributional fidelity. Finally, the synthetic data are evaluated to determine whether they should be incorporated into a supervised damage classification workflow. The framework is validated on the full-scale benchmark dataset from a BAE Systems Hawk T1A aircraft tested at the University of Sheffield's Structural Dynamics Laboratory for Verification and Validation. The test involves acceleration, fibre Bragg grating strain, and nonlinear dynamic response measurements. The results demonstrate that the model accurately captures dominant structural dynamics, it guides on signal use for classification improvement based on uncertainty characteristics, and it provides meaningful uncertainty estimates linked to signal complexity and excitation characteristics. Importantly, the framework offers a realistic generative modelling plan as a robust digital twin component for data-driven structural health monitoring, supporting resilient decision-making for condition assessment in safety-critical aerospace systems.

</details>


### [159] [CF-NODE: Counterfactual Spatial Node Intervention for Test-Time Adaptation Under Domain Shift, Evaluated Across Five Diabetic Retinopathy Datasets](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22437)
*Sabarish G,Deepak Parashar*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: CF-NODE是一种用于跨域糖尿病视网膜病变（DR）分级的反事实测试时自适应（TTA）框架。它通过干预模型内部空间节点的证据，衡量预测的稳定性来校准分级结果，无需目标域数据或模型更新，可在五个外部DR数据集上独立处理每张图像。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的基于熵最小化或批量信息积累的TTA方法在临床图像独立到达时可能强化错误预测，且源训练模型在不同相机、诊所和人群间泛化能力急剧下降。

Method: CF-NODE通过模型注意力、特征幅值和节点集相似度对内部空间节点排序，逐步抑制高排序节点，利用分级响应稳定性对预测等级分布进行有界校准；采用几何视图与固定源先验，完全冻结模型且无需目标域信息或模型更新。

Result: 在五个外部DR数据集的重复种子评估中，CF-NODE在AUC和宏F1上均优于TENT、EATA、SAR和T3A，对目标域AUC均有提升，且对每个DR严重程度等级的识别更为均衡。

Conclusion: 反事实干预敏感性为单张临床图像推理提供了一致且可部署的领域鲁棒性，验证了反事实TTA在跨域DR分级中的有效性。

Abstract: Automated fundus-based diabetic retinopathy (DR) grading can substantially expand screening capacity, but source-trained models degrade sharply across different cameras, clinics, and patient populations. Existing test-time adaptation methods depend on entropy minimization or target information accumulated from image batches and streams. These mechanisms can reinforce confidently incorrect predictions and break down when clinical images arrive independently. We introduce CF-NODE, a novel counterfactual test-time adaptation framework for cross- domain DR grading. Instead of trusting prediction confidence or estimating a target distribution, CF-NODE asks how each prediction responds under a controlled intervention on the evidence supporting it. CF-NODE ranks internal spatial nodes using model-derived attention, feature magnitude, and node-set similarity, progressively attenuates the highest-ranked nodes, and uses the stability of the resulting expected-grade response to apply a bounded calibration of the predicted grade distribution. The framework is fully frozen and adapts every image independently using only geometric views and a fixed source-derived prior, requiring no target-derived information or model updates. We evaluate CF-NODE on five external DR datasets under repeated-seed evaluation against TENT, EATA, SAR, and T3A. CF-NODE outperforms all four methods with statistically significant improvements over the second-best method, improves AUC on every target domain, and attains the highest average AUC and macro-F1, delivering stronger grade discrimination together with more balanced recognition across DR severity levels. These results demonstrate that counterfactual intervention sensitivity provides consistent and deployment-ready domain robustness for single-image clinical inference.

</details>


### [160] [Rank Measures of Fine-Tuning Updates Need a Noise Baseline](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22438)
*Muhammad Usman Altaf*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文系统比较了用于描述微调更新矩阵的五种秩度量（阈值计数、90%能量秩、熵有效秩、参与比、稳定秩），指出仅报告数值而缺乏随机基线会导致对"对齐是否浅层"的错误推断；计数类度量将更新描述为"几乎满秩"，而稳定秩则将其置于远低于噪声的水平——两者都对，因为更新具有少量强方向加长尾。对齐训练（SFT/DPO）相对于Wikipedia、代码甚至乱序文本并无特殊谱形，且Wu等人(2025)的"后训练浅层"论断及其Timber编辑在受控实验中无显著效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 近期多项研究（Biderman 2024、Mukherjee 2025、Wu 2025）通过权重更新 ΔW 或权重矩阵 W 的秩度量来推断"对齐是浅层/局部的"。但这些度量单独报告数值，未与随机基线对比，导致结论（如"后训练不改变有效秩"等同于"对齐浅层"）可能误导。本文质疑这一方法论：秩度量本身是否需要噪声参照？对齐内容是否真的在权重中留下独特印记？

Method: (1) 自行微调 Qwen2.5-0.5B 与 SmolLM2-360M 四个数据集：SFT（Alpaca）、Wikipedia（wikitext-103）、Python代码、词序打乱的WikiText；并附加DPO与"偏好半随机交换"对照；fp32主权重+bf16计算+8-bit AdamW。(2) 测量五种秩度量：阈值计数 ρ₀.₀₁、90%能量秩、熵有效秩eRank、参与比、稳定秩。(3) 以随机初始化差与同形高斯矩阵作噪声基线；以预训练权重W作"更难"参照；以无对齐内容的匹配微调作内容控制。(4) 评估13对已发布模型（≤8B，含OLMo 2的SFT/DPO/RL三阶段）的更新。(5) 案例研究：在Qwen3-0.6B上重现Wu等(2025)的实验——以eRank(ΔW)为截断的"Timber"编辑——并与稳定秩截断、整体均匀缩放对比，在GSM8k与GPQA-Diamond上测试。

Result: (1) 计数度量压缩了与噪声的差距：阈值计数仅将更新置于噪声下方2-5%，eRank和90%能量秩12-35%，参与比约50%，稳定秩78-94%。(2) 更新具有少量强方向加长尾：Qwen SFT更新顶方向持有4.2%能量（噪声0.6%），其余能量分散于长尾。(3) 对齐训练并不特殊：在Qwen上SFT稳定秩0.097与Wikipedia(0.093)、代码(0.094)几乎相同；DPO与"交换偏好"对照的更新谱形与方向一致（重叠0.27 vs. 同种子0.28）；词序打乱的乱文给出最集中的更新。(4) 13对已发布模型保持相同模式，但bf16舍入会膨胀小更新的阈值计数（Qwen2.5-1.5B和OLMo DPO/RL阶段分别有14%、39%、52%条目恰为零）。(5) 案例研究：a) 与真实更新同规模的随机更新几乎不改变eRank(W)（变化≤0.5%），但将Qwen3-0.6B GSM8K从59.5%降至4-6%——故eRank(W)不变不能区分"浅层"与"破坏性"；b) Timber的eRank截断编辑仅修改1.1%的能量，在GSM8k与GPQA-Diamond上无可测效应，而整体均匀缩放0.75即得+3.4 pass@1的增益。

Conclusion: 关于权重更新秩度量的方法论修正：(a) 任何秩度量都应报告同形随机矩阵的对应值作基线；(b) 计数度量与稳定秩描述同一矩阵的不同属性——"几乎满秩"与"高度集中"同时为真；(c) 形态是对所有微调过程（含乱序文本）的共有属性，并非对齐的特征；(d) eRank(W)训练前后几乎不变并不证明后训练浅层——同样大小的随机更新也几乎不改变eRank(W)却摧毁模型；(e) Wu等(2025)的Timber编辑中起作用的并非频谱截断，而是缩放本身。实际建议：报告度量必附噪声基线；检查低精度存储是否抹去小更新；验证两个检查点确为同一祖先；关于对齐的声明须以无对齐内容的匹配微调作控制。

Abstract: Studies of what fine-tuning does to a language model often summarise the weight update $\Delta W$ by its rank. We compare the rank measures used for this against the same measures on a random matrix of the same shape, and against two harder references: the pretrained weights, and matched fine-tunes without alignment content. Measures that count directions put our fine-tuning updates only a little below noise; stable rank, computed from the same singular values, puts them far below. Both are right: an update has a few strong directions on top of a long tail. The pattern holds for thirteen released pairs up to 8B parameters, and it is not a mark of alignment: with training held fixed, instruction data does not stand out from Wikipedia or code, DPO gives the same update whether its preference labels are real or half swapped at random (one model, modest preference strength), and scrambled text gives the most concentrated update of all. Applied to a recent claim that post-training is superficial because the effective rank of the weights barely changes, the baselines show that a random update of the same size leaves that rank almost unchanged while wrecking the model, and that an edit built on the effective rank of the update has no measurable effect in our tests. Rank measures of weight updates need a noise baseline, and claims about alignment need a control without alignment content.

</details>


### [161] [Lean4AgenticRL: Advancing Agentic RL with Verifiable Multi-level Process Rewards](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22448)
*Ruida Wang,Gerald Friedland,Tong Zhang,Chris Kong*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 Lean4AgenticRL 框架，首次将多层次过程奖励（高层结果奖励、中层工作流阶段奖励、低层工具调用奖励）统一在 Lean4 形式化验证体系中，用于开放域智能体强化学习。通过 Problem-Specific Workflow (PSWF) 系统结合规划-执行范式，并设计 workflow-stage-normalized GRPO 算法，训练出 LAR-9B/27B 模型，在 SWE-Bench-Verified 与 TerminalBench 上显著超越同规模基线模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前智能体强化学习主要依赖高层结果奖励，无法区分长轨迹中有用与冗余/错误的中间步骤；现有过程奖励多聚焦低层工具调用，缺乏对工作流整体进展的监督，导致训练效率受限。

Method: （1）PSWF 系统：采用 plan-then-execute，LLM 先探索环境生成问题特定工作流，再执行该工作流；（2）工作流形式化：将自然语言 PSWF 转化为 Lean4 中带前置/后置谓词的阶段图，并基于此对执行轨迹进行阶段分割；（3）多层次奖励标注：高层 α（验证器结果奖励）、中层 β（阶段完成后置条件验证）、低层 γ（防奖励 hack 的符号谓词，仅惩罚违规）；（4）workflow-stage-normalized GRPO：按工作流阶段做组内归一化计算优势，避免跨步骤比较无意义问题。

Result: LAR-27B 在 SWE-Bench-Verified 达 84.2%、TerminalBench-2.1 达 77.3%；LAR-9B/27B 平均超出基模型 9.89%、超出同规模次优模型 5.07%；消融表明去掉 γ 奖励性能下降 6.6%，去掉 PSWF 下降 1.6%；相比纯结果奖励 GRPO，训练更稳定且效率更高。

Conclusion: 该工作首次将 Lean4 依值类型形式化语言引入开放域智能体 RL 的多层次奖励设计中，扩展了 Lean4Agent 框架从固定工作流到通用 harness，提升了训练信号密度与稳定性，并有效抑制奖励 hack，为形式化方法与现代 RL 范式的融合提供了统一框架。

Abstract: Enhancing the agentic capabilities of Large Language Models (LLMs) to tackle complex software engineering (SWE) and general terminal-usage problems is a pressing challenge. Current state-of-the-art LLMs often go through large-scale agentic Reinforcement Learning (RL). However, they mostly rely on high-level outcome rewards, with minimal consideration of low-level toolcall and mid-level workflow-stage rewards, which makes the training less effective. To overcome this limitation, we propose **Lean4AgenticRL**, which, to the best of our knowledge, is the first framework that grounds multi-level process rewards in the unified Lean4 formalization schema for open-ended agentic RL. **Lean4AgenticRL** first builds a *problem-specific workflow* system that balances the agent's own capability and controllability during execution, laying the foundation for further verification. Subsequently, our workflow formalization and multi-level reward annotation methods enable agent behavior verification within a general harness system. It provides multi-level rewards to support more effective agentic RL with the workflow-stage-normalized GRPO algorithm. Using **Lean4AgenticRL**, we train **LAR-9B/27B**, a family of models with enhanced agentic capability. Extensive experiments indicate that our model outperforms the leading model of similar size. **LAR-27B** achieves **77.3%** on TerminalBench-2.1. On average, our models outperform the base model by **9.89%** and surpass the second-best model of comparable size we know by **5.07%**. These results indicate the potential of integrating formal methods in enhancing open-ended agentic RL.

</details>


### [162] [Generative Value Classifier](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22497)
*Alexander Swerdlow,Perry Dong,Chelsea Finn*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Generative Value Classifier (GVC) 提出了一种新的 Q-learning 框架，通过学习返回条件下的动作生成模型 p(a|s,z) 和返回先验 p(z|s)，利用贝叶斯定理反推 p(z|s,a)，从而以生成式方式隐式建模回报分布，并辅以值锚定损失对齐 TD 目标。在 RoboMimic 在线 RL 及 OGBench 离线/离线到在线任务上优于现有判别式及分布式 RL 方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统 Q-learning 仅以标量或分布式回报作为监督信号，忽略了动作本身提供的额外监督信息，导致在稀疏奖励场景下价值函数学习效率低下。GVC 利用动作作为监督信号，将"给定状态-动作预测回报"的判别式问题转化为"给定状态-回报预测动作可能性"的生成式问题。

Method: 核心方法包括：1) 回报条件动作模型 p_θ(a|s,z) 和回报先验 p_ψ(z|s) 两个组件，通过贝叶斯规则结合得到 Q(s,a)；2) 使用流匹配 (flow matching) 误差作为似然代理；3) 混合生成-判别目标：生成式流损失 + 回报先验分类损失 + 值锚定 (TD 目标平方误差)；4) 推理时采用 best-of-N 动作选择。

Result: 在 RoboMimic 四项在线任务（特别是 Tool Hang 任务）上显著优于 QC、RLPD、IDQL 等基线；在 OGBench 35 个离线任务上 6/7 领域领先 BFN，平均超过 Value Flows 8 分；离线到在线 RL 中 6 个任务全部接近最优，平均成功率从 67.1% 提升到 98.9%。消融实验表明生成式监督贡献约一半性能增益，值锚定不可或缺。

Conclusion: GVC 通过将生成式似然引入价值函数学习，开辟了利用动作本身作为监督的新方向，在样本效率上显著优于判别式及分布式 RL 方法，但代价是更高的实现复杂度和计算开销（每更新约 15.6ms，与 Value Flows 的 13.5ms 相当）。

Abstract: Q-learning is premised on learning a function to predict the value of a state-action pair, with the goal of using such a function to guide policy improvement. Most approaches learn this function from scratch using scalar or distributional return targets. This discriminative approach leaves another source of supervision for learning representations unused: the actions themselves. Rather than directly predict the return of a state-action pair, we ask the reverse question: how likely is the action under each possible return? This perspective provides a critic whose generative component is a return-conditioned policy, which can share the actor's architecture. Training this policy supervises the critic with every action rather than with returns alone, and a squared-error loss anchors the critic's Q-value to the bootstrapped target. We evaluate our approach on both offline and online RL tasks and show gains over leading discriminative methods, including distributional RL methods.

</details>


### [163] [Predicting Privileged Information Effectiveness for On-Policy Self-Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22512)
*Kaijian Zou,Emiliano Penaloza,MohammadHossein Rezaei,Anisha Gunjal,Mohit Raghavendra,Lu Wang,Yunzhong He,Anas Mahmoud*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文系统研究了特权信息（PI）在多轮智能体场景中对在线自蒸馏（OPSD）训练的影响，覆盖16种PI配置、3个基准和3个学生模型，并提出了两个基于KL的离线评估指标来在训练前预测PI有效性，其中误差步KL对比（Δd⁻_err）能更稳定地追踪训练后性能，并可用于逐任务PI选择；最终与GRPO结合后可超越强GRPO基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 先前OPSD研究将PI视为固定设计选择，忽略了PI内容、来源及学生模型的影响，且缺乏训练前评估PI有效性的可靠离线指标；多轮智能体任务中PI形式多样，理解其作用对实际应用至关重要。

Method: 系统评估16种PI配置（4种轨迹格式：Action/Action+Obs./Action+Thou./Action+Obs.+Thou.；3种提示格式：Summary/Skill/Checklist；多种来源GLM-5.2、Qwen3.7-Plus、自生成），在ALFWorld、AppWorld、τ²-retail三个基准上训练Qwen3-4B-Instruct、Qwen3-4B-Thinking、Qwen3-30B-A3B-Instruct；提出采样token反向KL（D）和误差步KL对比（Δd⁻_err）作为离线评估指标；通过ALFWorld-Passcode受控实验验证信息泄露问题；并将OPSD与GRPO以加权优势方式结合。

Result: 信息密集的轨迹PI（含观测和思考）通常优于压缩提示；Skill（技能）是最强的提示格式；更强的生成器（GLM-5.2 vs Qwen3.7-Plus）产生更有效的PI；思考模型获益不稳定；PI效用指标因信息泄露而失真（学生可直接复制关键动作或跳过工具调用）；D在9个设置中8个与训练后性能正相关但无法指示方向；Δd⁻_err在所有9个设置中均正相关（ρ=0.10-0.94），按Δd⁻_err逐任务选择PI在候选差异大时优于随机选择；OPSD+GRPO（λ=0.99）在ALFWorld达95.13（vs GRPO基线84.96），AppWorld达43.90（vs 42.91），τ²-retail达55.04（vs 48.27）；但PI加速早期学习后可能成为干扰。

Conclusion: 有效的PI需提供超越正确答案的上下文（环境观测、错误分析、可复用策略），其效果取决于内容、来源与学生模型的匹配；PI效用因信息泄露不可靠，KL类指标（尤其Δd⁻_err）能在训练前可靠评估和选择PI；将高质量PI与GRPO加权组合可优于纯GRPO，但静态PI后期可能冗余，需自适应调度。

Abstract: On-policy self-distillation (OPSD) enables large language models (LLMs) to learn from privileged information (PI) without a separate teacher model. However, prior work largely treats PI as a fixed design choice, leaving the effects of its content and construction poorly understood. This challenge is particularly important in multi-turn agentic settings, where trajectories contain actions, observations, and reasoning that can be transformed into PI in many ways. We systematically evaluate 16 PI configurations across three multi-turn agentic benchmarks and three student models that vary in scale and reasoning mode. We find that PI effectiveness depends on its content, generation source, and the student model. Information-dense trajectories and PI produced by more capable generators generally yield larger gains, whereas thinking models benefit less consistently. To assess PI before training, we compare PI utility with two KL-based metrics: sampled-token reverse KL ($D$) and error-step KL contrast ($\Delta d^{-}_{\mathrm{err}}$). The KL-based metrics track post-training performance more consistently than PI utility, which can be distorted by information leakage. Empirically, selecting each task's PI by $\Delta d^{-}_{\mathrm{err}}$ also improves post-training performance over random selection, most when the PI candidates differ widely. Finally, effective PI remains beneficial when combined with GRPO, allowing the combined objective to outperform a strong GRPO baseline. Overall, our results provide practical guidance for constructing and evaluating PI in OPSD training.

</details>


### [164] [Learning smooth dynamics via Kinematic Interpolants](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22519)
*Yiheng,Jiang,Youssef Marzouk,Avishek Joey Bose,Aram-Alexandre Pooladian*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出Kinematic Interpolants (KI)框架,将随机插值方法扩展到相空间中的二阶动力学建模,能够从多时刻位置-速度快照数据中无仿真地学习加速度场,并在多个科学数据集上以显著更低的训练成本取得更优的动力学重建效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 从实验观测数据推断非线性动力学是一个基础性问题。仅靠位置观测存在本质歧义(例如旋转对称动力学仅凭位置快照难以区分),而科学观测越来越多地包含速度信息(单细胞RNA速度、海洋浮标表面流速、鸟类群追踪等)。然而,如何以可扩展、无需仿真且无多余近似的方式将这些丰富信息融入二阶动力学模型,仍是一个困难挑战。

Method: 方法核心包括:(1) 在相空间中构造运动学一致的插值路径,采用三次Hermite多项式作为均值路径(保证端点位置与速度约束),并叠加结构化噪声协方差(支持常数型与"桥"型两种噪声调度);(2) 通过对插值路径求时间二阶导,获得闭式加速度目标;(3) 提出条件加速度场(Proposition 1),证明其生成的二阶动力学能够严格保持插值器在各时刻的边际分布;(4) 设计无仿真训练算法,通过最小二乘回归直接学习加速度网络,无需先学习参考场或先估算缺失速度;(5) 拓展到随机动力学,通过学习速度得分函数实现可调扩散调度下的随机采样;(6) 采用基于运动学最优传输的端点配对耦合。

Result: 实验部分在三个科学数据集上验证:(1) 墨西哥湾海洋涡旋(GoM):KI在插值任务上显著优于WLM等基线,大涡旋预测从t_0和t_9出发时精度分别提升约14%和超过55%;(2) Boids鸟群运动:稠密条件下KI较WLM快约100倍、较Curly-FM快约7倍,稀疏条件下分别快13倍和5倍,且插值误差最低;(3) 小鼠红系分化(Mouse Erythroid):在2D UMAP、20D和50D PCA表征下,KI-const与KI-bridge均取得最低W₂距离。整体而言,KI在重建精度与训练成本上同时具备优势。

Conclusion: Kinematic Interpolants提供了一个灵活且统一的二阶动力学学习框架,通过对加速度场的直接无仿真回归,有效利用了相空间位置-速度观测信息。理论方面保证学到的动力学精确再现观测边际,方法上支持多种噪声调度与确定性/随机性采样。实验表明该框架在多种科学场景中以更低训练成本实现更优重建。未来工作可融合物理先验、研究时间无关加速度场以提升外推能力,并探索超越三次Hermite的均值插值路径与可学习噪声调度。

Abstract: Inferring dynamics from real-world experimental data is inherently ambiguous, as many plausible dynamical systems can explain the same positional observations at measurement times. For higher fidelity modeling of applications ranging from single-cell RNA to vortex dynamics and even flocking of birds, scientific observables increasingly also include velocity estimates that serve to resolve this issue. However, incorporating this rich information in a scalable manner, free of simulation or unnecessary approximations, has remained a difficult challenge. In this paper, we introduce Kinematic Interpolants (KI), a novel framework that extends the seminal methodology of stochastic interpolants to infer nonlinear dynamics across multiple snapshots in phase space, i.e., observables with position and velocity measurements. Empirically, we demonstrate that across several scientific datasets, KI achieves superior reconstruction of the underlying dynamics compared to existing baselines while requiring only a fraction of the training time.

</details>


### [165] [Don't Retrain, Remix: Adaptation of Web Agents using Mixture Hypernetworks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22539)
*Md Farhan Ishmam,Minh Pham Dinh,Kenneth Marino*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出WebMix，一种用于网页智能体（web agent）的混合超网络（mixture hypernetwork），通过组合已有的低秩适配器（LoRA）来适配未见过的网页界面，无需在目标界面上进行梯度更新或使用目标演示数据。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有针对小型开源网页智能体的微调方法对界面变化极为脆弱——每当遇到新网站或网站改版，都需要新的演示数据和新的适配器进行重新训练。然而，不同界面之间存在可迁移的共享操作（如搜索、过滤、分页等），且收集网页演示成本高昂。问题的核心在于：智能体是否能够利用其在已学习界面上获得的知识，通过探索和组合（而非重新训练）来适应新界面。

Method: WebMix由三个核心组件构成：（1）适配器库（adapter bank）：为每个源界面训练一个LoRA适配器，并在训练时通过KL锚定项（k3估计器）限制其偏离其他源界面的距离；（2）侦察智能体（scout）：对未见界面进行有界探索，由探索器收集记录，书写器将记录提炼为遵循固定模式（七段式）的接口手册（interface manual），再由冻结的句子编码器（BGE-large-en-v1.5）将其编码为向量表示h_v；（3）路由器（router）：一个小型两层MLP（隐藏宽度256，约0.26M参数），将h_v映射为库内各适配器的混合系数c_v，用于通过因子拼接方式组合LoRA权重更新。训练分两阶段：先在源演示数据上以SFT+KL锚定损失训练各适配器（β=1.0），再冻结适配器库，通过池化源语料的行为克隆损失训练路由器。适配阶段对未见界面进行一次侦察后，通过路由器单次前向传播即可生成标准LoRA适配器。

Result: 在TimeWarp和WebArena-Lite-v2两个基准上对Qwen-3.5 4B和Llama-3.1 8B进行评估：在TimeWarp域迁移（domain transfer）中，Qwen平均提升8.3个百分点、Llama平均提升7.5个百分点，Qwen在未见News域上达到56.1%成功率（较迁移LoRA提升10.6个百分点），且达到与直接在目标域训练的专业模型（LoRA (in)）相当的平均性能；在已见界面上同样保持优势（如WebArena-Lite-v2上Qwen总体42.4%，较LoRA(all)提升4.3个百分点）。设计消融实验表明：从直接权重生成（T2L）切换到库组合再引入侦察，每步都带来显著提升；侦察任务数n=1最优；KL锚定权重β=1.0最佳；库内域适配器近乎正交（余弦相似度＜0.16），路由器倾向于从相邻版本中构建未见版本（如v1 hold-out时v2占81%、v3占17%）。理论上通过定理1将保留风险分解为路由项和逼近项，并证明库的扩张不会增加最优可达风险（推论2）。

Conclusion: WebMix通过一次性探索和库组合实现了小型开源网页智能体对未见界面的高效适配，无需目标演示数据或目标上的梯度更新，可在实际场景中替代针对每个新网站的重新训练。该工作证明了在源界面数据上学习"如何适配"（即学习适配规则）比直接学习每个目标界面的参数更具数据效率，并为适配器混合方法提供了理论分析框架。

Abstract: The web is not static or uniform. Websites that serve the same purpose can look and navigate very differently. Even within a single site, successive redesigns can change how familiar features are presented and accessed. Humans adapt to this by recognizing familiar interaction patterns and reusing what they already know. We give web agents a similar ability with WebMix, a mixture hypernetwork that adapts them to unseen interfaces by composing previously trained low-rank adapters. WebMix begins with a bank of adapters trained on source interfaces. At deployment, a scout agent explores the target interface and summarizes its observations into a compact manual. A lightweight router uses this manual to predict mixing coefficients over the adapter bank, which combine the existing adapters into a new one for inference. Adapting to a new interface takes only a scouting run and a forward pass, without gradient updates on the target. With Qwen and Llama models, we evaluate domain transfer on TimeWarp and WebArena-Lite-v2, and version transfer on TimeWarp. In all three settings, WebMix matches or outperforms in-context learning and LoRA baselines, often matching the average success of specialists trained directly on those interfaces. On TimeWarp domain transfer, it gains about 8 percentage points on average over the best baseline with both models. These gains do not come at the cost of seen interfaces, where WebMix keeps its lead, and extend to version transfer. Adapting to a new interface can therefore rely on exploration and composition instead of retraining.

</details>


### [166] [On the SPOT: Enhancing Speculative Decoding for Diffusion Language Models via Commit-Order Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22543)
*Eliezer Shlomi,Eliron Rahimi,Avi Mendelson,Chaim Baskin*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: SPOT是一种针对扩散语言模型(DLM)的推测解码方法，通过学习"提交顺序"（commit-order）而非token本身来构建多步草稿树，并使用共享Gumbel噪声耦合验证来保持目标分布的精确性。在六个DLM上实现最高6.8倍目标前向次数减少和3.2倍吞吐量提升，且草稿器可在不同模型间零成本迁移。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩散语言模型(DLM)在并行文本生成中面临速度-质量权衡：精确解码每轮只能填充一个mask位置，而多token解码方案会损失质量。标准自回归推测解码不能直接迁移到DLM，因为DLM同时需要决定"写什么"和"写到哪里"。论文发现真正瓶颈是提交顺序预测而非token预测，因为陈旧分布的argmax token在92-100%位置已正确，但陈旧置信度排序对下一个提交位置的预测准确率在第9个block下降到3%。

Method: SPOT (Speculating Positions Order Trajectory) 包含两个核心组件：(1) 草稿器——一个仅0.62M参数的三层Transformer编码器，仅读取目标模型的陈旧输出分布(每个mask位置的top-32概率及统计量)预测下一个提交位置q_φ(s|y)，通过前缀条件递归构建草稿树，使用DDTree按前缀质量做层批最优优先搜索；(2) 验证器——在T=0时采用状态相等验证(Proposition 1)，在T>0时采用耦合噪声匹配验证(共享Gumbel噪声表，使目标转换在条件化噪声下确定性，Proposition 2证明保持目标分布)。两个Proposition分别用归纳法和三步边际化证明精确性。

Result: 在SDAR-8B上：目标前向次数减少3.2-4.7×(D=8)至4.1-6.8×(D=20)；吞吐量达无草稿解码的2.0-2.7×(D=8)；比Spiffy校准草稿图少15-35%前向、吞吐量为其1.1-1.5×。T=1采样下保持分布精确性。在T=1生成长度512时SPOT-γ达3.23×吞吐。在SDAR-4B、SDAR-1.7B、LLaDA2.0-mini上一致获胜；在LLaDA-8B、Dream-7B(全注意力目标，使用近似前缀缓存)上无重训练零成本迁移。预算D=6是SDAR-8B上吞吐最优，SPOT-γ通过引入前缀质量阈值γ使吞吐对预算D平坦化。

Conclusion: SPOT确立了"提交顺序预测"作为DLM推测解码的关键瓶颈与基础：0.62M参数的轻量级顺序模型加上耦合噪声验证，在六个DLM上以lossless方式显著加速解码(最高6.8×前向减少、3.2×吞吐)，并实现跨模型零成本迁移。主要限制包括宽块验证成本成为瓶颈、双向注意力下精确树打包未解决、低接受率任务增益缩小、T≥2时T=0训练的顺序模型逊于噪声感知排序。

Abstract: Diffusion language models (DLMs) promise parallel text generation, but in practice face an unresolved speed-quality trade-off. Exact decoding fills in only one masked position per model pass, while faster multi-token decoding schemes are lossy. Speculative decoding is the standard lossless acceleration for autoregressive models. However, it does not transfer directly to DLMs, which must choose both what to generate and where. We show that this order is the missing piece: the model's own predictions from the previous pass already give the right token at 92-100% of positions, but not which position comes next. Based on this observation, we introduce Speculating Positions Order Trajectory (SPOT), which learns to predict this order. A 0.62M-parameter model reads only the target's output distributions and proposes a tree of candidate continuations, and the target verifies all of them in a single pass by checking whether each equals its own next state. On the verification side, our analysis shows that prior block-diffusion verification approaches either assume $T=0$ or a sequential proposal interface. To support tree-based speculation at any temperature, we propose using coupled-noise match verification for diffusion blocks, following shared-Gumbel-noise coupling approaches. Our comprehensive experiments show that SPOT cuts target passes by up to 6.8x and reaches up to 3.2x the throughput of standard decoding, beating the calibrated and training-free drafting baselines in every task and budget at $T=0$ and $T=1$. In addition, we show that the learned drafter transfers across models, demonstrating successful transfer across six different DLMs. Project page: this https URL

</details>


### [167] [Deterministic Bounds on Accuracy and Stability of Metric-Space Regression and Classification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22564)
*Nina Maria Gottschling,Jakob Gawlikowski,Michele Caprio*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种几何框架，通过"平均核大小"（average kernel size）这一概念，为度量空间中的回归和分类问题提供可计算的、确定性的、非渐近的精度和误差边界。该边界独立于具体的预测模型类别，能够在训练前从数据集本身量化输入-目标关系的固有模糊性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机器学习方法在处理含噪声数据集时面临三个核心挑战：(i) 输入与目标之间的非唯一对应关系（任意不确定性）；(ii) 缺乏可计算的、模型无关的有限数据集精度边界；(iii) 表达能力强的模型可以拟合训练数据但无法消除固有模糊性。现有方法（如VC维、Rademacher复杂度）通常依赖特定模型类别或采样假设，无法直接从有限数据集计算。

Method: 方法核心是定义可行集（feasible sets）和平均核大小：1) 给定数据集，通过输入距离阈值τ_X和目标距离阈值τ_Y构建可行集F_x，其中包含所有与输入x"不可区分"的合法目标；2) 算法1从数据集中采样锚点并构造有限可行集；3) 定义平均核大小为可行集内目标的加权平均成对距离；4) 主要理论结果：定理2.9给出回归误差的确定性边界[K/2, K]，其中K是平均核大小；推论2.11给出分类精度边界[1-K, 1-K/2]；5) 概率扩展：命题2.17证明在欧几里得平方损失下，分布版本等于√2倍贝叶斯RMSE；6) 命题2.18证明在模糊尺度以下训练必然导致严格正泛化差距。

Result: 实验在表格回归（Energy Efficiency、Concrete Strength、Critical Heat Flux）、图像回归（Tropical Cyclone）和图像分类（MNIST、CIFAR-10、RESISC45、EUROSAT）数据集上验证。关键结果：1) 边界在不同数据集上都是非平凡的；2) 与基准模型性能具有数值可比性；3) 合成实验验证了精度-稳定性权衡——超过平均核大小边界的模型保持较低的Lipschitz常数；4) 增加输入/目标噪声时，平均核大小单调增加；5) 添加标签噪声时，准确度边界下移，与模型性能下降一致。

Conclusion: 该框架提供了一种模型独立的数据评估工具，能够在模型选择和训练前量化预测任务的固有难度。边界是数据集、输入伪度量、目标度量和阈值选择的三元组函数，并非数据集的内在属性。未来工作包括任务相关的伪度量设计和连接理想采样理论与有限样本构造的一致性分析。

Abstract: Data-driven approaches often face ambiguity in datasets due to sensor or target noise, insufficient information, and noise in the input data. While best-fit machine learning methods can accommodate such noise through uncertainty estimates, they are prone to overfitting and it is challenging to quantify ambiguity of the relation between inputs and targets. We introduce a geometric framework that quantifies this ambiguity through the average kernel size, computed with data-dependent, i.e. model-independent, feasible sets derived from worst-case input and target noise. The framework provides computable, deterministic, non-asymptotic bounds on the best achievable empirical error and accuracy for a finite, constructed dataset, independent of the predictive model class, and applies to regression and classification with pseudo-metric input spaces and metric target spaces. The ambiguity of the input-target relation implies three consequences: an empirical error floor, an accuracy-stability trade-off, and, under standard probabilistic assumptions, a strictly positive distribution-training error gap when training below the accuracy bounds. Under standard Borel assumptions for Euclidean norms, the distributional analogue of the average kernel size is related to Bayes risk as it reduces to the optimal distribution root-mean-squared error times the square root of two. Experiments spanning tabular regression, image regression and classification datasets yield nontrivial bounds on the best achievable empirical error and accuracy on a constructed dataset, alongside descriptive comparisons with model performance on the original datasets. The bounds provide a computable, model-independent reference scale on the constructed dataset and comparisons with model performance on the original dataset are descriptive.

</details>


### [168] [Coverage Cliffs in Off-Policy Quantile Certification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22565)
*Pauline Bourigault,Emmanuelle Bourigault*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究如何利用上下文赌博机的离线日志数据来认证（certify）从同一数据中选出的策略在某一上尾分位数上的安全性。核心贡献是提出 TailCert 程序，构造 PAC-Bayes Bernstein 下置信包络以认证后验分布的合并 p 分位数上界；同时在一个稀有事显式模型上严格证明：仅保留联合加权 CDF 指示器这一信息削减会引入不可避免的 order-p/u 样本复杂度惩罚，而通过额外保留动作计数或权重总和无需新数据即可恢复完整日志的认证能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在部署基于 LLM 的路由策略前，运营方通常需要统计证据证明至少 99% 的请求成本低于某预算。但当候选策略是从同一份日志中选出时，传统的离线策略评估方法在有限样本和"赢家诅咒"下可能产生误导性安全声明。本文要厘清日志中应保留哪些摘要信息才能在面对上尾分位数约束时既有效又省样本，从而改变部署决策。

Method: 方法包含三个层面：1）构造 TailCert 程序，对预先声明的阈值网格上的目标 CDF 建立 PAC-Bayes Bernstein 下置信包络，同步覆盖所有依赖数据的后验分布，取首次穿越 p 的阈值为合并 p 分位数上界（原子点处亦有效）；2）建立稀有事信息族：每个候选有专属动作、被对数概率记录、二元结果；通过 KL/Fano 测试-下界和经验 Bernstein 上界，获得完整日志需要 n≥Wu·H/(16γ²) 以及联合 CDF 削减需要 n≥Wp·H/(8γ²) 的匹配阶；3）修复方案：在二进制模型中证明 (N,S) 充分，在一般候选中通过额外保留权重总和 S_{W,j} 和 Q_{W,j} 精确恢复 Huang et al. (2022b) 的 Exc-EB 证书。

Result: 理论结果：定理 1 给出了完整日志和 CDF 削减的认证代价的紧匹配上下界，差距为 order p/u；当相对裕度 γ=cu 时，全数据成本增长为 1/u、CDF 削减为 1/u²。命题 1 证明在二进制模型中动作计数恢复充分性。定理 2（共享动作）放宽到共享动作的候选并证明在该族上界与下界仍然一致。实验结果：RouterBench 上 p=0.95 时 Exc-EB 需 1.9k 日志达 90% 认证率，而 CDF-EB 需 26.7k（提升 14×），p=0.99 时 Exc-Bet 需 6.9k 而 CDF-EB 在 300k 内未达标；严格 CDF/计数比率从 p=0.90 的 3.6× 增长到 p=0.99 的 61.5×，与预测的 order p/u 一致。98,000 推理生成研究、125 路 5 动作路由和持有基准 GSM8K+MATH 验证全部确认了相同模式，p=0.90 时 Exc-Bet 在 4.3k 认证、CDF-EB 在 46k。

Conclusion: 本文得出以下核心结论：1）保留日志为联合 CDF 指示器的信息还原是真实存在的样本复杂度悬崖，而非可被更精炼的置信不等式消除；2）简单的存储规则——额外保留 S_{W,j} 和 Q_{W,j}——无需新结果即可恢复与原始日志相当的认证能力，因此可能改变部署哪些路由器；3）赢家诅咒使得朴素重用或忽略搜索/调优惩罚的方法在小候选数量时也可能发生 10–100% 的错误认证率；4）尾部感知日志设计可减少 2.3–6× 所需样本，但收益取决于边界项与证书。设计意义在于：监测管道应在丢弃请求级日志之前决定保留哪些汇总，对于固定候选和阈值网格，每候选两个归一化总量就足以恢复 Exc-EB。

Abstract: We study when logged contextual-bandit data can certify an upper tail quantile for a policy selected from the same sample. We construct a PAC-Bayes Bernstein lower-confidence envelope for the target cumulative distribution function (CDF), simultaneous over a predeclared threshold grid and all data-dependent posteriors. The resulting procedure, TailCert, uses the envelope's first crossing of level p to return an atom-safe upper confidence bound on the selected posterior's pooled p-quantile (or inconclusive). It can also be used to select a policy under a certified tail constraint. The concentration ingredients are standard; the main theoretical contribution is a matched finite-class certification boundary comparing full logs with their joint weighted CDF indicators at a fixed threshold. On an explicit rare-action class, the required sample size grows linearly with the overlap factor W, logarithmically with policy-search and confidence complexity, and quadratically with the inverse CDF safety margin; the upper and lower bounds agree up to constants in the stated regime. On this class, the CDF reduction hides which actions exceeded the budget; retaining action counts restores the full-log rate. Simulations verify the predicted search-complexity shift, winner's-curse failure of naive reuse, and the power cost of splitting.

</details>


### [169] [Structure-Aware Spatial Kernels for Gaussian Process Distributed Port-Hamiltonian Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22575)
*Tianyi Yang,Thomas Beckers*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文针对高斯过程分布式端口-哈密顿系统（GP-dPHS）在空间异构系统中标准平稳核效率低下的问题，提出了一种结构感知核设计框架。该方法通过去除不相关状态坐标并利用张量积协方差解耦状态与空间依赖，使定性空间异构知识能够通过选择合适的空间核直接融入协方差设计，同时保留端口-哈密顿物理结构。在具有周期、平滑变化和半分段刚度分布的非线性弦上的数值实验表明，结构解耦持续改善重构精度，而与刚度分布匹配的空间核在力场和轨迹重构上带来显著增益。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准GP-dPHS使用平方指数（RBF）等平稳核进行学习，但此类核仅依赖输入间的几何距离相似度，无法有效利用已知输入不变性，也难以反映空间异构系统中结构化的空间依赖关系。这在软体机器人、多材料复合结构等具有周期性、分段性或有限光滑性空间变化的应用中尤其突出。已有方法需要异构剖面的解析描述才能构造合适的核，但实际应用中往往仅有定性结构信息可用。

Method: 方法包含三个核心组件：(1) 结构解耦（Structural Decoupling, SD）——基于哈密顿密度关于各标量状态分量的可分性假设（假设3），从各effort分量的GP输入中移除不相关状态坐标；(2) 张量积协方差——通过乘积核 k_i((x_i, z), (x_i', z')) = k_{x_i}(x_i, x_i') · k_z(z, z') 将剩余状态依赖与空间依赖解耦，实现架构模块化设计；(3) 空间核选择——根据定性空间结构信息，从周期性核、Matérn-5/2核（编码有限光滑性）和变点核（混合两个区域协方差以编码不同空间区域之间的过渡）中选取合适核，无需剖面的解析描述。核超参数通过最小化负对数边际似然进行优化。

Result: 在一维非线性弦（L=10，含四阶应变硬化项和局部化周期性电机激励）的数值实验中，使用2%时空样本进行空间分层采样训练。对三种异构剖面（周期、C²凸块、半分段刚度）比较了三种配置：RBF基线、SD-RBF（仅结构解耦）和SD-matched（结构解耦+匹配空间核）。结果显示：(1) 结构解耦（SD-RBF相比RBF）使所有异构剖面的应变、位移和能量误差均下降，位移误差分别下降约43.6%、39.6%和17.1%，且curl RMSE降低一至两个数量级；(2) 匹配空间核带来更大增益：SD-Per.（周期）、SD-Mat.（C²凸块）和SD-CP（半分段）的位移误差相比基线分别下降约98.3%、91.3%和93.2%，相比SD-RBF分别下降96.9%、85.6%和91.8%，同时力场RMSE也最低。变点核的过渡位置和尺度参数对初始化不敏感。

Conclusion: 该工作为GP-dPHS的空间异构系统建模引入了一种系统化、模块化的核设计框架。结构解耦结合已知输入不变性与定性空间知识，能够直接融入协方差设计，同时保留底层端口-哈密顿物理结构，无需异构剖面的解析描述。数值实验证实：利用已知输入不变性始终带来改善，而与剖面结构匹配的空间核则产生实质性的额外增益。结构感知核设计被证明是利用GP-dPHS空间先验知识的有效机制，向更高维度和实验系统扩展是未来有前景的方向。

Abstract: Gaussian process distributed port-Hamiltonian systems (GP-dPHS) enable data-driven modeling of distributed dynamical systems while preserving their physical structure. However, standard stationary kernels can be inefficient for spatially heterogeneous systems because they neither exploit known input invariances nor reflect structured spatial dependencies. We address this limitation with a structure-aware kernel design that removes irrelevant state coordinates and decouples state and spatial dependencies through a tensor-product covariance. This modular construction allows qualitative knowledge of spatial heterogeneity to be incorporated by selecting an appropriate spatial kernel without requiring an analytical description of the underlying profile. Numerical experiments on a nonlinear string with periodic, smoothly varying, and semi-piecewise stiffness profiles demonstrate that structural decoupling consistently improves reconstruction accuracy, while profile-matched spatial kernels yield substantially larger gains in force-field and trajectory reconstruction.

</details>


### [170] [Noise-Robust Forced Alignment for Spontaneous Speech](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22583)
*Laurin Wagner,Mario Zusag*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 针对自发、含噪语音，提出基于 WavLM 特征 + GMM-HMM 的强制对齐器。通过显式建模 fillers/非词汇发声事件、噪声配对 LDA 投影以及逐字转录语料自举训练，在 Buckeye 和 FluencyBank 上分别将词边界 MAE 降至 20.6 ms 和 76.9 ms，较最强基线降低 19% 和 17%，并将灾难性错误率降低 2.7 倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有强制对齐器在真实世界自发、含噪语音上退化严重：MFCC 前端噪声鲁棒性差、对 fillers、笑声、断词等非词汇/非流畅现象建模不足，且训练标注多非逐字（verbatim），导致词边界错误传播到下游应用（临床语音生物标志、语料构建、字幕、语音编辑等）。

Method: 1) 数据：收集 149 小时逐字标注的自发+朗读语音（ICSI/AMI/NSC/DisfluencySpeech/CommonVoice/VCTK/LibriSpeech），并在 LibriSpeech 的静音段插入 VocalSound/Nonspeech7k 的发声事件以扩充训练集；2) 音素化：espeak-ng + 39 音素清单 + 显式 fillers（[UH]/[UM]）+ 12 个非词汇发声事件单元；3) 特征：冻结 WavLM-Large 第 22 层（20 ms 步长）→ 10 ms 插值 → PCA 降至 39 维；4) 模型：经典 Kaldi GMM-HMM（单音素→三音素，2500 leaves/6000 Gaussians），无说话人自适应；5) 噪声鲁棒：LDA 在干净+加噪（5–15 dB MUSAN music）配对特征上拟合，使 Fisher 准则折叠噪声变化。

Result: 在 Buckeye（对话）和 FluencyBank（口吃）上词边界 MAE 分别为 20.6/76.9 ms，比十种基线中最强分别低 19%/17%；灾难性错位（>200 ms）比 MFA 最佳模型少 2.7 倍；笑声相邻词错误率减半（107.8→52.8 ms）；在 0 dB SNR 高斯噪声下 Buckeye MAE 仅 96 ms，远优于 MFA（298–2020 ms）和 WhisperX（2721 ms）。

Conclusion: 通过逐字训练数据、自监督语音特征与显式发声事件建模相结合，重新激活经典 GMM-HMM 对齐器，在自发/含噪语音上建立新的 SOTA，为下游临床、字幕、语音编辑等时序敏感任务提供更可靠的边界标签。

Abstract: We show that forced aligners degrade on spontaneous, noisy real-world speech, and that fillers, laughter, and disfluencies corrupt word boundaries, impacting many downstream applications. We revisit the classical GMM-HMM aligner with upsampled WavLM features instead of MFCCs, explicit phone units for fillers and non-lexical vocal events trained on verbatim-annotated spontaneous speech, and a discriminative projection fitted on clean and noise-corrupted feature pairs to improve robustness. The pipeline is self-bootstrapped from 149h of curated audio without manual or external boundary targets. On conversational (Buckeye) and disfluent (FluencyBank) speech it reaches word-boundary MAEs of 20.6 and 76.9ms, 19% and 17% lower than the strongest of ten baselines. Catastrophic misalignments (>200ms) are 2.7 times rarer than Montreal Forced Aligners (MFA) best model even after widening MFA's search beam, which we show removes a large pruning artifact from its conversational error; event units halve the error next to laughter, while being meaningfully more robust than existing aligners.

</details>


### [171] [Initiating Removal from Operational Symptoms in Federated Vehicular Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22584)
*Zihao Ding,Jun Huang,Qiang Duan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文针对车联网联邦学习中"故障贡献仅以延迟操作症状显现"的场景，提出ATONE（聚合时运行证据效应中和）方法，将联邦遗忘内嵌于聚合过程本身，通过子空间投影、反向传播评分和双层校正机制，无需存储历史检查点即可从症状推断并清除有害贡献。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统联邦遗忘（FU）假设删除请求明确指定待遗忘的目标（车辆、轮次、数据），但联网车辆场景中，有害贡献仅以延迟的操作症状（如近距离险情）呈现，无法追溯到具体车辆或轮次，且聚合已将故障扩散至整个车队。现有防御方法（鲁棒聚合、异常检测、后溯源）均无法解决"症状不点名"这一核心问题。

Method: ATONE包含三个模块：(1) 运行证据聚合——将日常驾驶误差和上报症状投影到由最近q个全局增量张成的证据子空间V[t]中，形成q维证据向量d[t]；(2) 残差传播与评分——利用从增量差分估计的曲率传播算子M[τ]，通过一次反向传播计算所有贡献u的残存活量z_u[t]，并以〈d[t], z_u[t]〉作为评分；(3) 双层校正——每轮在聚合规则中加抑制项抑制可疑贡献（第一层）；当评分超阈值κ时，经一轮探针确认后精确消除贡献（第二层），将残差分解为"未动部分"和"折扣部分"分别处理。理论上证明了传播算子即子空间内训练曲率、反向与正向评分一致、消除操作在子空间外训练平坦时精确。

Result: 在Foggy Cityscapes、ACDC、BDD100K三个驾驶数据集及物理测试床上（MentorPi机器人车+Raspberry Pi 5），ATONE在9种设置中的8种上比最强基线（FedEditor）减少43%至61%的残余危害H̄，效用指标（FmIoU、RmIoU、TmIoU）保持在完全重训练Retrain的0.36分以内；归因准确率Top-1比FLForensics高11.9至17.6个点；反应延迟最多5.7轮（基线为12.3至36.7轮）；计算时间和上行带宽显著低于FLTracer等追踪方法；车队规模扩展至200辆时评分时间仍低于6ms。

Conclusion: ATONE成功将联邦遗忘从"事后处理"转变为"聚合规则内置项"，无需存储历史模型或更新即可从延迟症状中推断并消除有害贡献，在残余危害、效用保持、归因准确率、反应延迟和计算成本五个维度均优于现有方法，为车联网联邦学习的安全遗忘问题提供了实用解决方案。

Abstract: Connected vehicles train a driving model through federated learning (FL) and drive with it, so a faulty contribution often surfaces only as a delayed symptom on the road. Federated unlearning (FU) assumes that a removal request names what to forget. A symptom names no vehicle or round, and aggregation has already spread its cause across the fleet. We propose \underline{A}ggregation-\underline{T}ime \underline{O}perational-evidence \underline{N}eutralization of \underline{E}ffects (\method{}), which makes unlearning a term of the FL aggregation rule. \method{} projects everyday driving errors and reported symptoms onto a subspace spanned by recent global increments. It propagates the surviving effect of every contribution with curvature estimated from these increments and scores all contributions in one backward pass. A two-tier correction suppresses suspected effects in every round and eliminates confirmed ones after a one-round probe. We prove that backward scoring matches forward scoring and that the elimination is exact when training is flat outside the subspace. On three driving datasets, \method{} leaves 43\% to 61\% less residual harm than the strongest baseline in eight of nine settings while staying within 0.36 points of full retraining in utility.

</details>


### [172] [Flat Loss, Evolving Features: Grokking in Modular Addition](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22593)
*Akash Kumar,Karthik Sankaranarayanan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究模加（modular addition）任务中"扁平损失下的特征演化"现象——证明与实验表明，在训练交叉熵（cross-entropy, CE）损失保持相对平坦的正值水平期间，网络的隐藏层特征仍可继续演化，测试集准确率从零恢复到很高水平，而训练准确率保持100%。核心反驳了"训练损失平台意味着学习停滞"的直觉。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在模块加法（grokking）现象中，网络早已拟合训练集，但泛化（held-out accuracy）迟迟才出现。研究动机在于回答以下开放问题：一个已经拟合训练数据的网络，能否在训练交叉熵保持相对平坦（正值水平）的窗口中，继续演化隐藏特征并恢复对未见输入的预测能力？这挑战了"训练损失平台意味着学习停滞"的传统解读。

Method: 方法部分包含两个有限窗口定理（Theorem 4.1 和 Theorem 4.2）的严格证明以及广泛的实验验证。理论部分：1) 一层 ReLU 网络采用 supported-Polar 隐藏更新、归一化输出层更新与权重衰减，在特定初始化与训练划分下，从正定初值集合出发，证明平坦 CE、隐藏特征中的 Fourier 比例 A_H 持续增益、以及从零到 100% 的测试准确率三者可在同一有限窗口共存；2) 随机划分下，可在任意小的正损失水平下证明上述共存，并证明 "refit-first recovery"（基于训练特征的 ridge 回归读出器先于网络头部恢复泛化）。实验部分：在 iid 初始化下一层 ReLU 网络、深层（2-5 层）ReLU 网络、以及一层 Transformer 中验证该现象，使用预锁定窗口与预注册评估准则。

Result: 主要实验结果：在 p=31、宽度512的一层 ReLU 网络中，预锁定窗口 [4500,12000] 内，20 次运行均保持 100% 训练准确率，CE 变化在 6.33%–7.81%（10% 容差内），A_H 从约 0.02 增至 0.12，测试准确率从 0% 升至 91.7%–98.4%，且训练数据上的 ridge 回归读出器在每次运行中先于网络头部达到 90% 测试准确率。深层网络（D=3,4,5，p=31）在预注册主端点下分别通过 40/40、39/40、38/40 次运行。一层 Transformer 在 p=89,113 下通过 10/10 运行，但两层 Transformer 在所有尝试的设置下均未通过——保持上升的 CE 直至测试准确率上升后开始翻转训练对。p=23 的预注册测试中，恢复至 50% 测试准确率在 20/20 运行中确认。

Conclusion: 本文结论为：在交叉熵损失衡量的是置信度而非正确性的条件下，已经拟合训练集的网络仍可在训练 CE 看似平坦的正值水平上继续学习。"训练损失的平坦平台"不必然等同于"学习停滞"——表征诊断（如 Fourier 比例或训练读出器）可揭示损失所掩盖的进展。理论在一层网络构造初始化集合内成立，实验在 iid 初始化、深层网络及一层 Transformer 中扩展了这些观察。然而理论仍有明显局限：Theorem 4.1 仅构造性地给出初始化区域、头步与衰减容许量，并未证明如何从 iid 权重到达这些区域；量化这些邻域与速率、标定 Theorem 4.2 的素数阈值、允许训练-激活的记忆副本等是自然的后续步骤。深层网络配置依赖超参数搜索；一层 Transformer 行为依赖于缓慢衰减的输出增益——这些情况都缺乏理论保证。

Abstract: Can a network keep learning while its training cross-entropy stays nearly flat at a positive level? We show that it can. On modular addition, a standard testbed for grokking, ReLU networks trained with supported-Polar hidden updates, normalized output-layer updates and weight decay can keep 100% training accuracy while their hidden features change and held-out accuracy rises from zero to above 90%, at relatively flat training cross-entropy. Correct classification need not minimize cross-entropy, which still depends on prediction confidence. We prove this coexistence for one-hidden-layer networks in two finite-window theorems from constructed initializations: one gives a constant gain in the Fourier fraction of the hidden features, and the other holds at arbitrarily low positive loss, where a readout refitted on the training data generalizes before the network. Experiments from random initialization show the same coexistence on a window fixed in advance, and in deeper networks held-out accuracy also rises over post-hoc windows with a net increase in training cross-entropy. With a last-layer rate set per training fraction and head decay scaled with the prime, deeper networks at p=47 and 61 meet a criterion on post-hoc windows, fixed in advance, in nearly all fresh runs. A one-block transformer trained with the same updates and a slowly decaying output gain keeps every training pair correct at every logged checkpoint while its training cross-entropy rises and its held-out accuracy approaches one; with two blocks this holds through the held-out rise, after which training pairs begin to flip. A plateau in training loss need not be a plateau in learning. Code: this https URL .

</details>


### [173] [Diagnosing GNN Failure Modes with Layer-Wise Probe Entropy](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22595)
*Shanzi Bao,Mar Gonzàlez I Català,Pietro Liò*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种名为"逐层探针熵"(Layer-Wise Probe Entropy)的GNN事后诊断方法,通过冻结训练好的GNN,为每一层拟合独立线性探针,追踪探针准确率和归一化预测熵的层间变化。该方法能够区分有益、中性和有害的平滑,并通过比较浅层和深层模型的熵退化起始点,有效区分异质性下的结构性失配和过度深度导致的过度平滑这两种GNN主要失效模式。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的GNN诊断方法主要评估最终层输出,无法揭示任务相关信息如何在消息传递过程中演变。更关键的是,当GNN性能下降时,无法区分两种本质不同的失效模式:(1)过度深度导致的过度平滑,(2)异质性图上的结构性失配(低通聚合从第一层就产生负面影响)。这两种失效需要不同的补救措施——前者需限制传播深度,后者需改变聚合算子。现有几何度量(如Dirichlet能量、MAD)虽能识别表示变得相似,却无法判断平滑对任务性能是有益、有害还是中性。

Method: 1. **核心诊断方法**:训练完成后冻结GNN,为每一层(包括输入表示)独立拟合线性探针,定义**归一化探针熵** H̃_k(v) = -(1/log C) Σ p_c^(k)(v) log p_c^(k)(v),记录每层的探针准确率A_k和测试节点平均熵H̄_k。2. **对照诊断**:尺度归一化Dirichlet能量(光滑Rayleigh商)、全局MAD(节点表示间平均余弦距离)、组距离比R_Group(使用训练标签的类别间/类别内距离比)。3. **实验设计**:Q1——12个真实数据集(同质性与异质性)上训练4层GCN和GAT;Q2——使用GraphUniverse生成不同同质性水平的控制图(高h=0.865,中h=0.512,低h=0.110),在D∈{2,4,6,8,10,12,16,20}深度上独立训练。4. **失效起点分析**:通过比较浅层(D=4)与深层(D=10)模型中熵退化的起始层判断失效模式。5. **可靠性分析**:逐节点计算熵与真类负对数概率之间的Spearman相关性,评估节点级熵-置信度对齐程度。

Result: **Q1结果**:在24个数据集-架构设置中,探针熵与探针准确率变化的相关性最强(Pearson r=-0.67, 95% CI [-0.86,-0.34];Spearman ρ=-0.71, 95% CI [-0.89,-0.26]),Dirichlet能量和MAD的置信区间包含零。探针熵能清晰区分Cora(有益平滑)、Amazon-Ratings(中性)、Roman-Empire(有害平滑),而几何度量在三种情况下均显示相似的下降趋势。**Q2结果**:低同质性下,无论浅层还是深层模型,熵均从第一层就上升(80/80次运行),表示结构性失配;高同质性下,浅层模型降低熵,但深度模型(D≥6后)在第一层后熵上升,伴随最终精度下降,表示过度深度导致的过度平滑。该模式在8种深度和GCN/GAT中均成立。**局限性**:在异质性下,逐节点熵-置信度Spearman对齐显著减弱(同质性下ρ̄≈0.63,异质性下ρ̄≈0.13-0.19),低同质性控制图中4层GCN的ρ̄甚至为-0.10,表明节点级使用需谨慎。

Conclusion: 层间探针熵轨迹是一种有效的GNN消息传递事后诊断工具,能够区分有益、中性和有害平滑,并通过浅层与深层模型的失效起点对比区分结构性失配与过度深度过度平滑。该方法优于Dirichlet能量和MAD等现有几何度量(后者仅反映表示平滑,不反映对预测的影响)。未来工作包括:扩展到更多架构和任务;结合固定表示维度进行秩基诊断对比;利用熵轨迹指导自适应深度选择和早退机制;探索在线训练探针(stop-gradient)以追踪训练过程中的表示演变。在异质性图中,基于熵的诊断应在目标图设置下进行验证,因为节点级熵-置信度对齐可能减弱甚至变为负。

Abstract: Graph neural networks (GNNs) are typically evaluated only at their final layer, obscuring how task-relevant information evolves during message passing. We introduce a post-hoc diagnostic that freezes a trained GNN, fits an independent linear probe to each layer, and tracks probe accuracy alongside normalized predictive entropy. Across real and synthetic graph settings, layer-wise probe entropy distinguishes beneficial, neutral, and harmful smoothing, a capability not demonstrated by existing geometric measures. Moreover, by comparing shallow and deep models, we show that the onset of entropy degradation separates the two main GNN failure modes: structural mismatch under heterophily, which appears from the earliest layers even in shallow models, and excessive-depth oversmoothing, which emerges only as propagation depth increases. These results establish probe-entropy trajectories as a tool for analyzing information flow in GNNs and motivate future work on adaptive depth selection and early-exit mechanisms.

</details>


### [174] [Rarity of Singletons Matters & Supplementary Materials](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22604)
*Pragatheeswaran Vipulanandan,Kamal Premaratne,Dilip Sarkar*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Estimating missing-mass and unseen-species counts from finite samples relies heavily on rare-event occupancy statistics, particularly singletons. In small-sample regimes, these statistics can be highly variable, making classical estimators sensitive to sampling fluctuations and potentially unreliable. We propose a fragility-aware (FA) framework that explicitly quantifies this sensitivity and adaptively regularizes conventional missing-mass and unseen-species estimators. Using singleton-based fragility measures derived from probability mass and occupancy counts, we formulate an entropy--Kullback--Leibler (KL) optimization that adjusts the reliance on base estimates according to their fragility. The resulting objectives are strictly concave, admit unique closed-form solutions, and require no Poissonization or asymptotic approximations. The framework provides a lightweight correction to classical estimators, including Good--Turing and Good--Toulmin, while reducing reliance on potentially unstable rare-event statistics. Across 360 experimental configurations spanning synthetic distributions and real-world language corpora, our method remains competitive in stable regimes while improving estimation accuracy and stability in fragmented, long-tailed, and small-sample settings. The findings demonstrate that accounting for the fragility of rare observations can improve the reliability of inference about unobserved species and their associated probability mass.

### [175] [Noise-shaped Sampling and Annealing for Scalable On-the-edge Training of Binary and Ternary AI Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22621)
*Zihao Chen,Zhili Xiao,Rui-Jie Zhu,Yipeng Wang,Jason Eshraghian,Shantanu Chakrabartty*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 ΣΔ-Sampler，一种将随机采样退火嵌入一阶 ΣΔ 噪声整形回路的优化器，用于在离散权重（二值/三值）空间直接训练神经网络。它利用二值/三值网络训练损失与高阶 Ising 模型能量之间的结构等价性，通过噪声整形把量化噪声、高阶挫败和小批次采样噪声推到低频适应带之外，使离散权重更新沿平滑下降轨迹推进。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有低比特网络训练（如 STE 量化感知训练）存在两个根本问题：(1) STE 仍需维护全精度潜变量权重和 AdamW 一阶/二阶矩，无法获得训练时内存优势；(2) Ising 求解器虽天然适合离散空间，但其目标是固定能量函数的基态，而深度学习目标是在未见数据上的泛化，二者存在根本矛盾。本文旨在弥合 Ising 求解器与离散网络训练之间的"动力学差距"（稳定性 vs. 可扩展性）与"目标差距"（基态 vs. 泛化），同时实现端侧大模型训练。

Method: 核心方法 ΣΔ-Sampler 包括：(1) 通过 Walsh-Fourier 分解严格证明离散网络训练损失等价于多层高阶 Ising 哈密顿量之和；(2) 设计一阶 ΣΔ 噪声整形回路：积分器状态 ωⁿ = ωⁿ⁻¹ + gⁿ - βⁿ⊙dⁿ⁻¹，以离散采样器 P(ωⁿ, Tⁿ) 作为有噪量化器在内部执行 Boltzmann 接受；(3) 三值权值通过 Wᵢ = Wᵢᵒⁿ - Wᵢᵒᶠ 分解为两个 {0,1} 组件共享积分器；(4) 在 log 域梯度统计上施加自适应阈值 + 自动增益控制 (AGC)，将坐标分为确定性下降集与随机探索集；(5) 采用 1/n 快速冷却温度调度 Tⁿ = T₀/(T₀+n/τ)；(6) 推导噪声传递函数 NTF(z) = 1 - z⁻¹，量化证明带内噪声降低约 (γₐ/γₛ)² 倍。

Result: 在 planted QUBO 基准 (D=100) 上 1000 步内精确恢复全局最优，PCA 轨迹显示连贯宏观步进，功率谱呈现典型 V 形噪声整形特征；CIFAR-10 上 13M 参数三值 VGG-8 取得 92.20% 精度（达全精度 92.88% 的 99.3%），相比 TWN 提速 14-15 倍；ImageNet-1k 三值 ResNet-18 取得 Top-1 61.65%、Top-5 83.81%，距 TWN 基线 0.15%/0.39%，距全精度 3.75%/2.95%；类增量持续学习中离线类别精度得以保留；MatMul-free LLM 扩展至 2.7B 参数（93.9% 三值化），继续预训练上优于 STE 匹配基线；训练时静态内存减少 50% 以上（2.7B 模型节省 58.7%，即 20.3 GB），DRAM 事务减少最多约 24,600 倍（4 个数量级）。

Conclusion: ΣΔ-Sampler 通过一阶 ΣΔ 噪声整形将等温退火从串行 Ising 求解器范式转化为可扩展的并行离散优化器，全程在离散参数空间操作、无需潜变量复本或 AdamW 矩状态，从而同时实现：(1) 与 STE 接近的精度（CV/持续学习/LLM 继续训练均验证）；(2) 训练内存和带宽的数个数量级降低，适合端侧 on-the-edge 大模型微调；(3) 相比单翻转/并行翻转模拟退火的稳定性与收敛性。局限：缺乏有界支撑下的 FSA 收敛性理论保证；激活仍为连续；权重更新流量为分析映射而非真实硬件计数器测量；类增量场景中三值权重高度依赖残差连接。

Abstract: The training loss of binary and ternary neural networks, expanded as a multilinear polynomial over the discrete weights, is structurally equivalent to the energy of a hierarchical high-order Ising model. We exploit this equivalence to apply Ising solvers to discrete-weight network training, while accounting for a fundamental difference in objectives: an Ising solver seeks the ground state of a fixed energy function, whereas training seeks solutions that generalize to unseen data. Our key contribution is $\Sigma\Delta$-Sampler, an optimizer that reconciles these objectives by embedding a stochastic sampling-and-annealing step as a noisy quantizer inside a first-order $\Sigma\Delta$ noise-shaping loop. The loop pushes noise from weight quantization, high-order frustration, and mini-batch sampling out of the low-frequency adaptation band, so that discrete weight updates follow the smooth descent trajectories embedded in the rugged loss landscape. We validate the framework on a planted quadratic unconstrained binary optimization (QUBO) benchmark with a known minimizer; on CIFAR-10, where a $13$M-parameter ternary model comes within $1\%$ of full-precision accuracy; on ImageNet-1k, where a ternary ResNet-18 comes within $0.4\%$ Top-5 accuracy of a ternary baseline; on class-incremental continual learning, where prior-task accuracy is preserved; and on MatMul-free language models up to $2.7$B parameters, where it outperforms a straight-through-estimator baseline under matched continued pre-training. Compared with standard quantization-aware training, $\Sigma\Delta$-Sampler reduces the training memory footprint by over $50\%$, delivers an order-of-magnitude speed-up, and reduces weight-update memory traffic by four orders of magnitude, making it attractive for on-device training and fine-tuning of large binary and ternary models.

</details>


### [176] [Understanding Stability of Outer Nesterov Momentum on Stochastic Pseudo-Gradients](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22623)
*Nishant Sharma,Laura Gomezjurado Gonzalez,Ganesh Talluri,Sarath Chandar,Hiroki Naganuma*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文研究分布式训练中两阶段优化器（内层SGD + 外层Nesterov动量）的均方稳定性，推导出精确的稳定性判据，揭示了外层动量、局部步数、批量大小和worker数量之间的相互影响，并提出了一种基于共享minibatch扰动的实测方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 分布式训练中通信成本高昂，实践中常用两阶段优化（多次内层SGD后用Nesterov动量做外层更新），但其稳定性受外层动量、局部步数K、内层批量大小b和worker数W的复杂交互影响，缺乏理论指导，超参数常通过调参确定。

Method: 对随机二次损失建立模型，将K步内层SGD视为一个随机"块算子"D_K作用于误差，推导均方稳定性判据 ρ(L_K)<1，其中L_K是二阶矩映射。通过分解为均值条件和噪声预算 ρ(V_K ∘ G_α,β) < 1，给出4个推论：(i) β增大使噪声预算缩小；(ii) 存在内层批量阈值b_c，大于此值时增加K可扩大稳定区域，反之缩小；(iii) 多个worker平均可扩大稳定区，但所需worker数可随K指数增长；(iv) 固定总批量时拆分给多worker不能改善稳定性。通过"共享minibatch扰动"在网络checkpoint上实测放大率A_β来验证。

Result: 理论结果：(1) 定理1给出精确均方稳定性判据；(2) 命题2证明外层动量β单调缩小噪声预算；(3) 命题3证明存在内层批量阈值b_c决定长块稳定性；(4) 推论4证明worker平均仅缩小方差，但所需数量可随K指数增长；(5) 命题5证明固定总批量时拆分不能改善稳定性。实验验证：在CIFAR-10上的MLP和ResNet-20、Pythia语言模型（70m-1b参数）的checkpoint上进行测试，通过共享minibatch扰动测量放大率A_β，结果与四个推论的预测趋势一致；不稳定设置会导致训练损失显著上升（spread cost）。

Conclusion: 该工作为两阶段优化器的超参数选择提供了基于均方稳定性的理论指导：(1) 内层轨迹等价于一个随机块算子；(2) 稳定性由噪声是否在外层步设置的噪声预算内决定；(3) 内层批量大小b_c是决定长块稳定性的关键阈值；(4) 增加worker数不能替代增大内层批量；(5) 共享minibatch扰动是一种实用工具，可在不依赖极小值的情况下在checkpoint处评估稳定性。局限：分析仅针对SGD内层步骤，未涵盖AdamW/Muon等自适应内层优化器；分析关注稳定性而非收敛速率，且无法捕捉长期从局部不稳定中恢复的现象。

Abstract: Large neural networks are commonly trained across many workers, and communication between them is a major cost. Workers therefore take several local optimization steps before sending their net parameter displacements, or pseudo-gradients, to an outer optimizer, which often applies Nesterov momentum. We study how the outer momentum, the number of local steps and the averaging over workers control the training dynamics, and in particular their stability. For random quadratics, we derive an exact mean-square stability criterion in any dimension, which reveals that the inner batch size determines whether increasing the number of local steps eventually stabilizes or destabilizes the outer iteration. Moreover, while averaging the pseudo-gradients of independent workers can make larger outer momentum values admissible, the number of workers required for stability can grow exponentially with the number of local steps. Finally, we show that the mean-square dynamics governing stability can be probed directly at intermediate neural-network checkpoints using shared-minibatch perturbations. We test our theoretical findings across networks, and measure their consequences for training loss.

</details>


### [177] [Alert-List Concordance for Evaluating Imputation Strategies in ICU Sepsis Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22635)
*Priyanka Siddappa,Muntaqim Ahmed Raju,Shifat Haider Al Amin,Ruizhe Ma*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出"警报列表一致性"(alert-list concordance)这一新评估指标,用于揭示临床预测中缺失值填补策略对被预警患者群体的影响。研究发现,虽然九种填补策略加一种原生缺失值处理的 XGBoost 流水线在患者级 AUROC 上差异极小(22/28 对配对的差异不显著且最大仅 0.011),但其产生的 top-10% 高风险患者列表的 Jaccard 重叠率却仅 0.518–0.750;ForwardFill 作为异常值,虽然判别力更高,但与其他方法的列表重叠率最低(0.40–0.45),意味着在 100 张床位、10% 警报率的 ICU 中,仅改变填补方式就会使约 4/10 的被警报患者发生变化。这一分层结构在医院系统层面和六种患者级聚合规则下均保持稳健。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 临床脓毒症预警系统的实际输出是被标记的患者名单,而非一个排序。然而填补策略的选择普遍基于重建误差或聚合判别指标(如 AUROC),这些指标对患者间排序不变,因此无法揭示不同流水线是否标记了同一批患者,尤其在 ICU 数据频繁且结构化缺失(MNAR)的场景下,填补值的差异可能决定哪些病人进入警报名单,直接影响预后研究和公平性审计。

Method: 在 PhysioNet/CinC 2019 数据集(40,336 名患者,71.9% 缺失率)上,固定 XGBoost 配置和 Platt 校准,逐一评估九种填补策略(Mean、ForwardFill/LOCF、MICE、DAE、MAE、MIDA、SAITS、BRITS、GRU-D)和 XGBoost 原生缺失值处理基线。提出主要结局指标"警报列表一致性":在固定 top-k% 警报率下,用 Jaccard 相似度比较两两流水线标记的患者集合,以患者级 bootstrap 置信区间评估。辅以 AUROC、AUPRC、Brier、ECE、precision@k、recall@k 及管道运行时间,并按医院系统和六种聚合规则做稳健性检验,最后用 Kruskal-Wallis 与 Dunn 检验刻画分歧患者的临床特征。

Result: 1) 聚合判别:八种重建型方法的 AUROC 跨度仅 0.011,ForwardFill 与 XGBoostNative 略高(Bonferroni 校正后 22/28 重建方法对差异不显著);2) 警报列表:重建方法两两 Jaccard 0.518–0.750,ForwardFill 对其他方法的 Jaccard 仅 0.40–0.45;分层结构(ForwardFill / XGBoostNative / 重建方法三组)在两所医院和六种聚合规则下均稳健;3) 分歧集中于非脓毒症患者(阳性病例 Jaccard 高于全体);4) 仅被 ForwardFill 标记的患者警报更晚(领先标签时刻中位 5h,而一致警报患者 22–26h);5) 深度填补器在判别上未胜过均值填补,且顺序实现(SARTS/BRITS/GRU-D)耗时是均值的 5–12 倍。

Conclusion: 聚合判别指标相等并不意味着操作等价——填补策略选择可在 AUROC 几乎不变的前提下显著改变被警报的患者集合。警报列表一致性应作为评估任何流水线变更的标准补充指标。对于采用行级树分类器且缺失率极高的数据,均值填补是高效的基线选择;ForwardFill 标记的人群在临床上系统性地不同且警报更晚,需以队列特异性理由加以论证。该分析可推广至任何按固定比例预警的预测系统,并可用于人口学分层上的公平性审计。

Abstract: Preprocessing is an under-measured reliability risk in clinical prediction: a model can keep a similar AUROC and still change who receives an alert. Imputation quality is commonly evaluated using reconstruction error or aggregate discrimination, neither of which directly measures agreement on which patients are flagged. At a matched alert rate, pipelines with similar aggregate performance can produce different patient lists. This question is especially relevant under the frequent, structured missingness of real ICU records. We therefore introduce alert-list concordance, which asks whether two pipelines identify the same high-risk patients, measured by the Jaccard similarity of their top-k% alert sets with patient-level bootstrap confidence intervals. On PhysioNet/CinC 2019 (40,336 patients, 71.9% missingness), we compare nine imputation strategies and a native-missingness baseline using a fixed XGBoost configuration, fitted and Platt-calibrated separately for each strategy. After Bonferroni correction, 22 of the 28 reconstruction-method pairs showed no statistically significant difference in patient-level AUROC, yet their alert lists overlap at Jaccard 0.518 to 0.750. Similar aggregate discrimination can therefore accompany different patient selections. ForwardFill is a separate outlier, pairing higher discrimination with the lowest overlap in the matrix, 0.40 to 0.45. The broad pattern holds within each hospital system and under six patient-level aggregation rules. At the row level, eight of ten methods fall within an AUROC range of 0.011. In this row-level pipeline, deep imputers did not outperform mean imputation on discrimination, and the sequential implementations cost 5 to 12 times mean imputation in total pipeline wall-clock time on our hardware.

</details>


### [178] [The Ephemeral Cost of Switching Optimizers Across LLM Training Stages](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22650)
*Xinyu Zhao,Davis Wertheimer,Ashutosh Sharma,Rameswar Panda,Paul Pu Liang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文系统研究了在LLM训练各阶段（预训练、持续预训练、SFT）间切换AdamW与Muon优化器是否带来性能损失。通过在1.2B Llama-3模型上对两种优化器更新比例进行插值实验，并在开源模型（Llama-2-7B、Qwen2.5-7B、Qwen3系列至14B）上验证SFT阶段的表现，发现切换优化器几乎不存在"性能代价"，最终表现主要由各阶段优化器独立效应决定，SFT阶段使用更多Muon更新通常能提升下游性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 先前研究提示在预训练与后续训练阶段间切换优化器（特别是AdamW与Muon）可能产生性能损失，源于正则化效应或隐式偏置的差异。然而缺乏系统性研究：该损失是仅限于特定任务微调的"遗忘代价"，还是广泛影响最终基准性能的"性能代价"。本文旨在分离优化器切换效应与各优化器独立效应，明确这一现象的真实规模。

Method: 核心方法是将AdamW/Muon的二值选择松弛为连续失配度，通过以概率p∈{0,0.1,0.25,0.5,0.75,0.9,1}在每步独立选择Muon或AdamW更新，构建混合优化器。在1.2B Llama-3模型上于1×与8× Chinchilla数据规模进行三阶段（PT-CPT-SFT）的交叉实验，并采用ANOVA式分解将性能拆分为行效应（PT优化器）、列效应（post-training优化器）和交互项γ_ij。通过双因素方差分解隔离优化器匹配的交互效应。此外在Llama-2-7B、Qwen2.5-7B、Qwen3-4B/8B/14B等AdamW预训练的开源模型上对比Tulu-3 SFT表现。采用基于RMS更新尺度的学习率统一化处理，并独立为每个设置调优学习率。

Result: 主要结果：(1) 性能分解显示PT-SFT交互效应小且无一致模式，AdamW/AdamW残差为-0.2，Muon/Muon为+0.2，远小于SFT优化器主效应(-0.9至+0.7)；(2) 继续预训练中匹配优化器的优势在调优学习率后消失；(3) 优化器一致性可减少SFT后的遗忘，但遗忘减少并不转化为下游基准提升；(4) SFT阶段Muon更新比例越高，最终基准性能越好，无论预训练优化器如何；(5) Llama-2-7B、Qwen2.5-7B、Qwen3系列在AdamW预训练下，Muon用于SFT在5个设置中有4个获得更高均值（除Llama-2-7B外差距较小），Muon与AdamW保持竞争力；(6) 1.2B模型在8× Chinchilla下两优化器差距可忽略，表明规模可能影响SFT优化器偏好。

Conclusion: 结论：LLM训练阶段间切换优化器并不产生显著的"性能代价"，最终表现主要受各阶段所用优化器的独立效应影响，而非是否匹配。优化器一致性可降低预训练分布遗忘并便于超参数迁移，但这些收益并不体现在通用任务SFT的最终基准性能上。在1.2B规模，SFT阶段增加Muon更新比例普遍改善下游性能，且Muon对AdamW预训练模型（包括Llama和Qwen系列高达14B）仍是可行的后训练优化器。因此，后训练优化器选择可基本独立于预训练优化器决定。

Abstract: Recent work suggests that switching optimizers between pretraining and subsequent training stages incurs a performance cost, but systematic investigation of this phenomenon is lacking. We study the mismatch between AdamW and Muon optimizers by pretraining 1.2B Llama-3 models from scratch while varying the proportion of updates taken with each optimizer, and similarly interpolating between the two optimizers during continued pretraining and supervised fine-tuning (SFT). Surprisingly, we find little evidence of a meaningful optimizer mismatch penalty: final performance is largely explained by the independent effects of the pretraining and post-training optimizers, with downstream performance generally improving as the proportion of Muon updates during SFT increases. Although matching the pretraining optimizer can reduce forgetting during SFT, this does not translate into improved final benchmark performance. We further evaluate AdamW and Muon for task-general SFT of open-weight models, across the Llama and Qwen families up to 14B parameters, where Muon remains competitive with AdamW, despite these models having been pretrained with AdamW. Together, our results suggest that the choice of optimizer for post-training can be made largely independently of the optimizer used during pretraining.

</details>


### [179] [Edit Discovery in Human-AI Interactions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22661)
*Alireza Mirrokni,Shayan Kiyani,George Pappas,Hamed Hassani*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了"编辑发现优化"(EDO)框架及其在线算法EDIT，用于在预算受限的编辑资源下选择最可能需要修正的人机交互样本，以最大化发现需要编辑的交互同时控制不必要的确认。EDIT通过自适应编辑分数、确认控制阈值和成本感知选择规则实现分布无关的在线约束保证，在多个推理与事实问答基准上优于直接LLM批量选择。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在大量人机交互场景中，并非所有AI响应都令人满意，但调用编辑（人工专家或更强AI系统）成本高昂。需要在不预先知道编辑结果的情况下，决定哪些交互应送交编辑以发现可改进之处，同时在控制确认负担与编辑成本预算的前提下，最小化漏检的可编辑交互。

Method: 1) 将问题建模为编辑发现优化（EDO）：最小化跳过交互中的Type-II错误（漏检编辑率），约束Type-I错误（选中交互中的确认率）与编辑成本预算；2) 理论证明最优总体策略为编辑后验概率上的成本调整阈值；3) 提出EDIT在线算法，包括参数化编辑分数η̃_θ、自适应确认控制阈值α_t、批量成本乘子β_t，每轮用选中样本的交叉熵损失梯度更新分数参数；4) 证明预算每轮满足，平均Type-I错误受限于ε加上随轮数T消失的有限项，无需分布假设。

Result: 在MATH-500、MMLU-Pro、PopQA、GPQA四个基准上以Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct（及Qwen3-32B）为响应模型进行评估。EDIT-REP（基于MiniLM表征+在线逻辑回归探针）在Type-II错误上优于LLM-Select直接批量选择基线，同时保持可靠的Type-I行为与预算约束；编辑分数质量对发现效果影响显著，Qwen3-4B表征进一步降低Type-II错误；响应长度相关成本与分布偏移实验均验证了EDIT的成本感知阈值结构的有效性；人类审计（200样本）确认基准派生编辑标签与人类判断吻合度达96.5%。

Conclusion: EDIT将编辑发现任务解耦为：编辑分数、在线确认控制、预算分配，并通过理论保证与实证验证了该模块化设计的有效性。显示在分布无关、部分反馈的在线条件下可有效控制确认率并满足成本预算，分数质量（尤其是表征学习）是效率的关键。更强的编辑预测器可在不改变在线控制规则的前提下集成。局限在于实验使用基准正确性代替大规模人工编辑，且未评估发现编辑的下游模型改进效果。

Abstract: Human-AI interactions are becoming a rich source of data for improving AI systems: while many model responses are already satisfactory, others expose failures that could become valuable supervision if identified and corrected. We study this setting through the notion of an editor: a more capable evaluation process that can inspect a response and either confirm it or modify it, but whose invocation is costly. The editor may be a human expert, a stronger AI system, or the same model equipped with additional computation, context, tools, or information. The key challenge is to decide which interactions to send to the editor before knowing whether an edit will actually be made, since invoking the editor itself consumes limited resources such as expert time, inference cost, latency, or tool-use overhead. We formulate this problem as Edit Discovery Optimization (EDO), which seeks to minimize edit opportunities missed among skipped interactions while controlling unnecessary confirmations and respecting an editor-cost budget. We characterize the population-optimal policy and show that it takes the form of a cost-adjusted threshold on the posterior probability of an edit. Building on this structure, we develop EDIT (Edit Discovery via Iterative Thresholding), an online algorithm for the partial-feedback setting in which edit labels are revealed only for selected interactions. EDIT combines an adaptive edit score, a confirmation-control threshold, and a cost-aware selection rule; it satisfies the editor budget at every round and controls the average confirmation rate up to a vanishing finite-horizon term, without distributional assumptions on the interaction stream. Across four reasoning and factual question-answering benchmarks, EDIT achieves a better trade-off between editor cost, Type-I error, and Type-II error than direct LLM-based batch selection.

</details>


### [180] [Chance-Constrained Personalized LLM Routing with Online Preference Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22695)
*Ameya Anjarlekar,Rasoul Etesami,R Srikant*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究个性化大语言模型路由问题，将其建模为带机会约束的上下文老虎机，提出一种原对偶GLM-UCB算法，在学习用户偏好的同时最小化推理成本，并保证已实现累积满意度满足高概率质量约束。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 不同用户对同一请求可能偏好不同模型，且偏好未知需在线学习；同时实际部署中需保证已实现满意度不低于目标的概率不低于1-δ，而非仅控制期望值。现有路由方法无法同时实现在线学习、个性化和可靠性保证。

Method: 提出Primal-Dual GLM-UCB算法：1)使用正则化逻辑回归估计用户偏好参数θ*；2)基于GLM-UCB构建乐观满意度上置信界；3)维护非负虚拟满意度队列λ_t作为对偶变量，平衡成本和已实现满意度；4)引入安全缓冲ρ处理期望与实现差距。设定步长η和ρ均为O(1/√T)。

Result: 主要理论结果(Theorem 5.4)证明：在大样本逻辑偏好模型和严格可行性条件下，算法在T足够大时以至少1-δ的概率满足累积机会约束，且相对于最优平稳随机上下文oracle的期望累积成本遗憾为Õ((d+√log(4/δ))√T / (κ(1-ξ)ε))，为次线性遗憾。数值实验包括：合成实验、5个LLM的真实路由案例、个性化对比和有限时域扩展性测试，均验证了算法满足约束且成本低于基线。

Conclusion: 该框架首次在LLM路由中同时实现在线学习、个性化和高概率满意度约束三种特性。算法通过原对偶机制结合乐观偏好学习和满意度赤字队列，达成次线性成本遗憾。框架可推广至在线广告、云服务选择等带可靠性需求的在线模型选择问题。未来方向包括非平稳用户偏好和上下文依赖的回退保证。

Abstract: We study personalized LLM routing, where a router selects among heterogeneous models with different costs and capabilities. The router must minimize cumulative inference cost while ensuring reliable realized response quality, even though user preferences are unknown and must be learned from feedback during deployment. We formulate this problem as a constrained contextual bandit and develop an algorithm that learns preferences while balancing cost and quality. Under a logistic preference model and a strict-feasibility condition, we establish sublinear expected cost regret relative to an optimal stationary randomized contextual oracle and a high-probability guarantee on realized cumulative satisfaction. The framework extends beyond LLM routing to broader online model-selection problems with reliability requirements.

</details>


### [181] [Normalizing Flow Maps](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22711)
*Francesco M. Ruscio,Timothy James Hitge,Fred Zhangzhi Peng,Danyal Rehman,Zander W. Blasingame,Nicholas M. Boffi,Michael M. Bronstein,Alexander Tong,Avishek Joey Bose*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出Normalizing Flow Maps (NFM)，一类精确可逆的生成模型，统一了流映射的少步采样能力与标准化流的可精确似然评估特性，并在图像生成、Boltzmann生成器采样及RLHF后训练中取得最先进性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现先进的扩散模型和流匹配模型在采样效率上存在推理成本高的问题（需数值积分）且难以精确评估样本似然；而传统标准化流虽然提供精确似然但通常需要噪声注入的MLE训练，牺牲了干净样本的似然访问能力，同时少步生成能力有限。该研究旨在统一两类方法的优势。

Method: NFM是一族联合参数化的两时间微分同胚映射f^θ_{s,t}，学习随机插值下的生成传输。论文提出三种参数化方式：(A)双时条件、(B)去噪器形式、(C)门控双时条件。基于流映射一致性条件推导两类训练目标：1)逐点匹配(NFM-R)，利用欧拉一致性构建ℓ2回归自蒸馏损失，直接控制2-Wasserstein距离；2)分布匹配(NFM-D)，通过KL散度匹配推前分布与边际，通过条件KL上界边际KL。理论证明了单时NFM-D对端点分布的控制、两时扩展使用冻结单时模型作为代理源密度。

Result: 在CIFAR-10上，NFM-R以噪声退火和FP64推理实现FID 3.87，FLD 7.00（可逆NF中最低）；ImageNet-64上NFM-R FID 3.60（127M参数，优于466M参数的TARFlow）。Boltzmann生成器任务中，NFM-D在Chignolin（10残基）实现E-W2 3.42（SMC），超越SBG并接近自回归ArBG；在可迁移肽生成（4AA和8AA）上NFM-D以118M参数超越288M的Prose，在六个指标中五个取得最佳。支持基于似然的RLHF后训练，RL对齐后图像生成质量明显提升（优于best-of-N和SMC基线）。

Conclusion: NFM成功统一了标准化流的精确似然评估和流映射的少步采样能力，在图像生成中超越现有NF方法（兼顾样本质量与可逆性），在分子平衡采样中建立新的最先进水平，并使基于似然的RLHF后训练成为可能。然而NFM-R易出现数值不可逆问题（需FP64和噪声退火缓解），这突显了设计同时兼具逐点和分布一致性的训练方案的重要性。

Abstract: Scalable approaches to learning neural dynamical systems have placed diffusion, flow matching, and few-step generators in flow maps at the forefront of generative modeling. Such state-of-the-art models have limited access to explicit model densities despite evolving from classical generative modeling approaches that leveraged tractable likelihoods, e.g., Normalizing Flows and Autoregressive models. In this paper, we combine these threads of few-step generation and tractable sample likelihoods and introduce Normalizing Flow Maps (NFM), a class of exactly invertible pushforward maps that generalizes normalizing flows and flow maps. More precisely, NFMs learn the integrator of an underlying dynamical system, but crucially, they provide efficient exact likelihood evaluation by construction. To enable scalable training of NFMs, we derive two complementary axes of consistency inherent to NFMs that yield (self) distillation objectives: (1) pointwise matching, which unlocks $\ell_2$-based flow-map style regression losses, and (2) distributional matching, which matches pushforward distributions to the marginals of a prescribed forward process. On conditional image generation on CIFAR-10 and ImageNet-64, NFMs achieve state-of-the-art sample quality among parameter-matched normalizing flows, while supporting likelihood-based RLHF. For equilibrium sampling in Boltzmann Generators, NFMs outperform prior state-of-the-art normalizing flows on both single-system and transferable peptide benchmarks.

</details>


### [182] [Spectral Limits of Polynomial Graph Filters on the Long-Range Ising Model Benchmark](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22713)
*Amin Najafgholizadeh,Mohsen Afsharchi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文分析了长程伊辛模型基准(LRIM)上图多项式滤波器的谱极限,证明基于邻接矩阵多项式的读出器存在不可消除的误差下界(由谱水平集上的目标变化引起),并证明带步幅的扩张卷积网络能同时满足分离偏移和覆盖整个晶格两大需求,在多个规模上匹配或超越现有最优方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有图数据集无法明确衡量任务对长程信息的依赖程度。LRIM基准通过构造保证长程依赖性,但目前发布的图网络模型表现远低于理论上限,且缺乏对其失败原因的系统分析。作者希望揭示多项式谱滤波器在该任务上的根本性局限,并探索能够突破这些局限的架构。

Method: 1) 将LRIM标签表达为算子形式 y_i = s_i·(J*s)_i,通过傅里叶方法验证与官方数据吻合;2) 证明命题1:任何以邻接矩阵多项式为滤波器的读出器,因目标函数沿谱水平集变化而存在解析可计算的误差下界;3) 引理1证明在L为2的幂次时,非零μ水平集为单元素轨道,误差完全来自μ=0水平集;4) 设计步幅滤波器基(细粒度偏移+5×5模板+步幅倍增的层级结构),通过最小二乘拟合到耦合核或训练标签;5) 训练扩张CNN(扩张率倍增至L/4)、Fourier神经算子(FNO)、门控图网络等标准架构进行实证比较。

Result: 1) 误差下界在1024节点处为-2.7,五个规模介于-2.5至-3.5;2) 步幅滤波器(约50-100系数)在1024节点测试误差达-6.6至-7.6,比最佳已发布网络低52倍;3) 扩张CNN在256节点超过最佳已发表结果0.26,1024节点匹配(差距0.01在种子方差内),在4096以上规模提供首个in-domain结果;4) FNO因截断高频模式,随晶格增大从-4.5降至+0.5,保留所有模式可恢复大部分差距;5) 门控图网络虽非线性不受下界限制,但仍落后扩张CNN;6) 多项式谱网络适配版的得分与最佳多项式滤波器的闭式解吻合至0.1个数量级以内。

Conclusion: LRIM目标为单二次卷积,要求滤波器必须:1) 分离邻接矩阵聚合的偏移(任何邻接多项式均无法满足);2) 在全晶格分辨率下覆盖耦合核。步幅滤波器以数十系数即可同时满足。已发表谱网络表现与其多项式度数的最优值一致。扩张卷积网络在两个耦合、两个有in-domain结果的规模上均匹配或超越最佳图网络。门控图网络虽覆盖晶格且不受下界限制,仍落后于扩张CNN。所有训练网络的误差仍比直接拟合到标签的步幅滤波器高数个数量级。

Abstract: The Long-Range Ising Model benchmark (LRIM) guarantees long-range dependence by construction: each label is the node's spin times the spin field convolved with a power-law coupling, so any model's distance from the target is measurable. We prove that a readout whose filter is a polynomial in the adjacency, the linear core of isotropic message passing and spectral graph networks, leaves an error floor that no degree lowers, because the target varies along a level set of the spectrum on which every such filter is constant. Computed exactly, the floor and the best filter of each degree predict two spectral networks adapted from published architectures to within a tenth of a decade. A filter escapes the floor only if it weighs separately the offsets the adjacency lumps together, and must still resolve the coupling across the whole lattice. A strided filter of about fifty coefficients does both: fitted to the training labels, its test error is 52 times below the best published network's. A dilated convolutional network beats the best published result at 256 nodes, matches it at 1,024, and gives the first in-domain results at the three larger sizes, while a Fourier neural operator with its standard modes falls further behind as the lattice grows. At its standard budget the dilated network stays two to four orders of magnitude short of a larger strided filter fitted to the labels. The analysis carries over to the benchmark's second coupling.

</details>


### [183] [Native Geometry vs. Linear Recoverability: How Alignment Changes Platonic Scaling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22749)
*Angus Hoy,Austin Lutterbach,Jasper Chong,Aman Kumar,Michael J. Smith*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究更大模型是否学习到越来越相似的表征(柏拉图表征假设 PRH)。作者区分"原生余弦几何"(无对齐下的近邻结构)和"线性可恢复性"(监督线性映射后的对应关系)。在五个模型族、Legacy Survey 与 HSC 两套天文嵌入对上,发现 Ridge 对齐显著增强了模型规模与跨数据集邻域对应之间的尺度关系——五个族中全部为正向,且在两侧独立 PCA 到 256 维后仍存在。学到的映射强烈各向异性,且 SAE/BSF 稀疏特征并不优于稠密特征对齐。结论:模型规模更明显改善线性可恢复性,而非原生余弦邻域对应,且并未确立共享原生度量几何的收敛。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: PRH 预测更大模型表征趋于相似,但"相似"既可指原生几何上的相似,也可指可通过监督映射恢复的对应关系。已有工作未严格区分二者;此外,更大模型常具更宽嵌入,使对齐空间更大,可能构成混淆因素。本文用两个不同巡天(Legacy Survey、HSC)的匹配嵌入作为测试平台,系统区分原生余弦几何与线性可恢复性两种收敛含义,并考察稀疏特征是否暴露出更多共享结构。

Method: (1) 数据:UniverseTBD Legacy↔HSC 匹配嵌入,n=16,384,五个模型族(AstroPTv2、ConvNeXtv2、DINOv2、ViT、I-JEPA)共 16 个规模档。(2) 衡量量:互 k 近邻重叠 Mk,k=10(mKNN@10),训练/测试冻结划分(13,107/3,277),测试专用邻居池,chance≈0.0031。(3) 条件:Dense(原生)、Dense+Ridge(岭回归仿射对齐)、SAE+Ridge/BSF+Ridge(稀疏特征上同样岭回归)。(4) 统计量:每个族拟合 mKNN~log10P 的 OLS 斜率 β,以 ΔβF=β(Dense+Ridge)-β(Dense) 表征斜率放大,T=五族均值;并用符号检验、自举、对应洗牌零假设等。(5) 几何诊断:对 A_eff 做 SVD,定义 A_log=std(log s_i)、f90_anis;截断 SVD 分析 mKNN 增益所需奇异方向比例。(6) 控制实验:两侧独立 PCA 到 256 维;去除平移 b_eff;同数据集跨模型配对;SAE TopK 灵敏度;无配对的 DualEncoder 瓶颈对照。

Result: (1) Legacy→HSC 下,Dense+Ridge 将 mKNN@10 从 0.022 提升至 0.042(约 13× chance),五族 ΔβF 全部为正,T=0.00721(p_sign=0.031,p_perm≈0.005,自举 95% CI [0.0034,0.0111])。(2) 两侧独立 PCA 至 256 维后 T256=0.00864(全 5/5 族仍正),排除"更宽嵌入提供更多坐标"。(3) A_eff 强烈各向异性(A_log 在 1.76–3.15),且距最近相似变换很远(D_sim≈0.88–0.91);但仅约 4.8% 的奇异方向可恢复 90% 的 Dense+Ridge mKNN 增益,功能上低维。(4) 去除平移后 η_A 中位 0.99,斜率放大几乎不变(T_A=0.00854 仍 5/5 正),效应主要来自 A_eff 的各向异性线性形变,而非截距。(5) SAE+Ridge/BSF+Ridge 均低于 Dense+Ridge(差 0.0085/0.0062),稀疏特征不带来优势。(6) 反向 HSC→Legacy 较弱且异质(T=0.00447,4/5 族正),可恢复性具方向性。(7) 结果在 α∈{0.01,0.1,1,10,100}、k∈{5,10,25,50}、SAE TopK∈{10,20,40} 下稳定。限制:配对 Ridge 监督、五个族、一个天文设置、单次冻结划分;绝对 mKNN 仍低,可能需更大规模或局部仿射映射以逼近真实关系。

Conclusion: (1) 表征收敛的表象依赖比较所用的变换类:原生余弦对应随规模仅弱增长,而监督仿射/Ridge 对齐下规模—对应关系更强(T=0.00721,5/5 族正)且在固定独立 PCA 维数下存活(T256=0.00864)。(2) 学到的映射远非等比缩放正交阵,而是各向异性的,且 mKNN 增益的功能支撑子空间显著小于其光谱各向异性所暗示的维度。(3) SAE/BSF 在监督对齐下不优于稠密特征,稀疏化无助于揭示更多跨巡天共有结构。(4) 总体而言:模型规模的提升更明显地增强了监督下的线性可恢复性,而非原生余弦近邻对应,亦未确立共享的原生度量几何收敛;两空间可能只是对同一物理对象的不同"视角",需要一个学到的变换将其中一种映射为另一种。

Abstract: Do larger models learn increasingly similar representations of the same world? The Platonic Representation Hypothesis (PRH) predicts that they should, but similar can mean native cosine geometry---nearest-neighbour structure induced by cosine similarity before any learned alignment---or linear recoverability: correspondence revealed by a supervised linear map. Using matched Legacy Survey and Hyper Suprime-Cam (HSC) embeddings across five model families, we find that Ridge alignment strengthens the relationship between model size and cross-dataset neighbourhood correspondence relative to native cosine geometry. The effect appears in all five families and persists when both representations are reduced to dimension, so it is not simply that wider embeddings give alignment more dimensions to work with. The learned maps remain far from rotations or uniform scaling, and Sparse Autoencoder (SAE) and Block-Sparse Featuriser (BSF) features give no advantage over the same alignment applied to dense embeddings. Model scale thus improves linear recoverability more clearly than native cosine-neighbourhood correspondence, without establishing convergence toward a shared native metric geometry.

</details>


### [184] [Refusal Is Not Robustness: Measuring Harmful Reachability in Autoregressive Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22754)
*Parv Kapoor,Teresa Fortes,Claudia Mamede,Rui Abreu,Jonathan Aldrich,Eunsuk Kang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出"有界续写分析"(Bounded Continuation Analysis, BCA),一种基于概率模型检查的LLM安全评估方法。它通过构建有界续写树、计算有害可及性,揭示采样安全响应背后隐藏的有害概率质量,弥补传统ASR(攻击成功率)仅评估采样输出的局限。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM越狱安全评估主要依赖ASR,但该指标只关注采样输出,无法揭示模型生成分布中隐藏的有害行为概率。论文提出"分布脆弱性"概念:相同的观察拒绝可能掩盖截然不同的底层有害质量,需要一种能直接测量生成过程分布的方法。

Method: 1. 将自回归生成建模为token前缀上的离散时间马尔可夫链(DTMC);2. 采用α-k有界策略(借鉴LLMChecker)构建有限深度的续写树,保留高概率分支;3. 使用语义有害评估器标注叶节点,通过精确的稀疏反向归纳计算有限视野的有害可及概率P[F harm];4. 扩展为生成攻击易感性(GAS),跟踪在攻击者查询预算增加过程中有害质量如何演变;5. 将BCA集成到PAIR和TAP自适应红队搜索中,作为剪枝信号。实现采用广度优先GPU批处理推理,将顺序推理轮次从O(k^L)降为O(L),保持O(k^L)的最坏树规模。

Result: 在4个指令调优LLM和JailbreakBench的100个有害行为上的实验表明:(1)所有模型greedy ASR均为0%,但GAS@0揭示了跨两个数量级的隐藏有害质量差异(如Mistral-7B为0.211,而Llama-3.1-8B仅为0.002);(2)在18模板攻击下,经验ASR对三个模型饱和于100%,而GAS@18仍能区分它们;(3)有界有害可及性与独立采样的经验ASR呈显著正相关(Spearman ρ在0.534-0.733之间),Top-1提升达2.56×-7.43×;(4)BCA引导和判定器引导的自适应搜索发现部分不重叠的越狱,并集将部署覆盖率提升至51.7%-81.7%;(5)BCA引导搜索保持以结果为基础的选取仍可恢复部署性能。

Conclusion: BCA/GAS提供了衡量LLM生成过程中有害可达性的形式化概率工具,补充而非替代ASR。该方法将传统ASR仅评估输出,推进到审视整个生成分布,从而暴露表面上相同拒绝下隐藏的本质安全差异,且分布引导与结果引导的搜索具有互补性,为安全诊断和红队资源分配提供实用信号。

Abstract: LLM safety evaluations via jailbreaking typically index on attack success rate (ASR): whether a generated response violates safeguards. However, ASR only evaluates sampled outputs and provides little information on the underlying generation process. Autoregressive language models define distributions over possible outputs, and a sampled refusal can coexist with substantial probability mass on harmful generation paths. We study this hidden structure through bounded continuation analysis (BCA), which models autoregressive generation as a stochastic process over token prefixes and computes the finite-horizon probability that generation reaches a harmful continuation. BCA constructs a bounded continuation tree, labels terminal continuations with a semantic harm evaluator, and estimates harmful reachability using exact probabilistic model checking. BCA complements ASR by measuring how much harmful behavior remains accessible beneath a sampled safe response. This makes it useful for distinguishing models that look identical under measured ASR values, and allocating red-team effort toward regions of the generation process with greater hidden risk. Across four instruction-tuned LLMs and 100 JailbreakBench behaviors, we show that BCA effectively quantifies hidden harmful behavior and provides a useful signal to guide red teaming.

</details>


### [185] [Acquisition Function-Guided Generation for Bayesian Optimization over Discrete Spaces](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22763)
*Tommaso Ancilli,Thomas Wedenig,Henry Moss,Robert Peharz*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出AFGG（采集函数引导生成）方法，将贝叶斯优化中的离散设计空间搜索问题，转化为从一个由采集函数tilted的预训练生成模型分布中进行采样的过程。通过在生成模型的连续空间中构造扩散桥（diffusion bridge），恢复出用于引导采样的梯度信息，使代理模型和采集函数能够直接作用于原始离散设计空间。该方法可实例化为分类扩散模型和自回归标准化流两种骨干网络，并在25个分子设计基准任务中取得了领先性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在离散空间（如分子SMILES/SELFIES字符串）中进行贝叶斯优化面临两大核心挑战：（1）有效设计在组合空间中稀疏分布；（2）采集函数最大化缺乏可用的梯度信息。现有潜在空间贝叶斯优化（LSBO）方法通过在生成模型的潜在空间中进行优化，虽缓解了上述问题，但难以直接利用数据空间中的领域知识（如分子领域的Tanimoto核等归纳偏置），且潜在空间需同时服务于生成质量和优化目标，易在小数据场景下过拟合。本文旨在解耦这两个角色：使用冻结的预训练生成模型捕捉有效设计的稀疏结构，同时在数据空间中维护代理模型和采集函数。

Method: AFGG的核心思想是将BO内循环从采集函数最大化转为从tilted分布 P*(w) ∝ P_θ(w)·ℓ(w) 采样。该tilted分布结合了预训练生成模型P_θ和采集函数ℓ。由于直接在离散空间采样困难，方法通过在生成模型的连续嵌入空间中构造扩散桥（diffusion bridge）平滑该tilted分布。关键理论结果表明：对于高斯核平滑，引导项（guidance term）的梯度可化简为acquisition-weighted后验均值与普通后验均值之差（tilted mean difference），无需对采集函数进行微分。方法在两种骨干网络上实例化：（1）CDCD（分类扩散模型）：在嵌入空间中操作，学习得分和逐位置后验；（2）SeqFlow（自回归标准化流）：在流潜空间中操作，利用高斯共轭性获得精确后验。两者均通过自归一化重要性采样（SNIS）估计tilted均值，并实现了信任域机制以初始化采样轨迹。

Result: 在25个PMO分子优化基准测试上（涵盖GuacaMol和TDC任务），使用序贯设置（10个初始点+300次oracle调用）和批处理设置（100个初始点+500次oracle调用，每批5个）：（1）AFGG-CDCD变体性能与领先BO方法相当；（2）AFGG-SeqFlow变体在大多数基准上达到了最先进（SOTA）性能，并在其余任务上具有强竞争力；（3）消融研究证实：引导机制至关重要（λ=0时性能下降）；SNIS优于REINFORCE估计器；EI优于PI和UCB；候选池大小为10时达到性能与成本的良好平衡。（4）无条件样本质量分析显示SeqFlow的FCD分数（6.02）远低于CDCD（20.99），表明更好的生成先验直接带来更优的优化性能。

Conclusion: AFGG通过将采集函数最大化重新定义为从acquisition-tilted生成分布中采样，并利用扩散桥在生成模型的连续空间中恢复引导梯度，实现了一种新颖的BO框架：生成器在BO过程中始终冻结，采集函数仅需非负且可逐点评估。实验证明该方法在分子设计任务中具有领先性能，且方法性能直接依赖于底层生成模型的质量。未来工作方向包括将AFGG应用于蛋白质基础模型作为冻结骨干，主要挑战在于高效近似引导所需的后验分布 p(x|z_t)。

Abstract: Bayesian optimization (BO) over discrete spaces is challenging due to missing gradients and the sparsity of valid solutions. Latent-space BO sidesteps both issues by fitting a surrogate in the latent space of a generative model, which however substantially complicates the direct incorporation of domain knowledge that is naturally expressed in the original discrete space. In this work, we instead combine a pretrained generative model with a surrogate defined directly in data space, where inductive biases such as domain-specific kernels can be readily incorporated. Rather than maximizing the acquisition function over the discrete design space, our method samples candidates from the generative model under a distribution tilted by the acquisition function. To recover useful gradients for sampling, we embed this tilted distribution into a diffusion bridge that yields a smooth, posterior-averaged acquisition function. This leads to \emph{acquisition function guided generation} (AFGG), which we instantiate with a categorical diffusion model and an autoregressive normalizing flow. Across a broad suite of molecular benchmarks, the diffusion model variant performs on par with leading BO methods, while the flow model variant outperforms state-of-the-art methods in most cases and remains highly competitive otherwise. Our implementation is available at this https URL .

</details>


### [186] [Ori: Drift-Aware Streaming $k$-PCA for Very Low-Rank LLM Training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22794)
*Xinyu Luo,Jincheng Zhou,Mengbo Wang,Zilin Shen,Nadia Atallah Lanman,Petros Drineas,Bruno Ribeiro,Brian Bullins*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 Ori，一种基于流式 k-PCA（Oja++）的低秩优化器，通过漂移感知引导策略实现对 LLM 训练中梯度子空间的高效连续跟踪，在极低秩场景下显著缩小与全秩 Adam 的性能差距。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有低秩优化器（如 GaLore 周期性 SVD 重计算、OSD 在子空间流形上做非凸优化）存在"陈旧性惩罚"问题：梯度子空间在训练中持续漂移，但投影器更新频率低或不连续。作者观察到 LLM 梯度子空间并非随机跳跃，而是呈现缓慢稳定的漂移现象，这启发了一种新的连续跟踪范式。

Method: Ori 的核心创新包括三方面：(1) 漂移感知引导机制——用前一步投影器以 Q_init = ρQ_{t-1} + (1-ρ)R 热启动当前步（ρ≈0.99），实现子空间基的跨周期传递；(2) 采用具有 gap-free 收敛保证的 Oja++ 流式 k-PCA 算法作为子空间更新子例程，每步成本仅 O(dk²)，支持高频（每 20 步）更新；(3) 在 Adam 框架下保持一阶/二阶矩在子空间变化间的有效传递。此外，论文将 Ori 思想扩展到 LDAdam 提出 O-LDAdam，用多步随机幂迭代替代单步幂迭代。理论上证明 Oja 在 λ-drift 概念漂移下具有次线性动态遗憾界。

Result: 在 LLaMA 预训练（60M/130M/350M/1B）与 RoBERTa-Base GLUE 微调任务中，Ori 在极低秩条件下表现最优：在 1B LLaMA 预训练（r=128 vs d_model=2048）上将最佳低秩基线与全秩 Adam 的性能差距缩小达 69.3%；在 GLUE 16 个任务/秩组合中取得 10 个最优；O-LDAdam (T=200) 在 r=32 时优于昂贵的 LDAdam (T=1)（困惑度 15.66 vs 20.27）。同时 Ori 是非误差反馈类方法中内存最低、速度最快的（每步更新时间为最低）。

Conclusion: Ori 通过漂移感知流式 k-PCA 成功将周期性"冷重启"或非凸流形优化转变为连续、轻量且理论可分析的高频跟踪，显著推动了极低秩 LLM 训练的实用性边界。其设计原则与误差反馈机制正交，可组合产生更优优化器。

Abstract: A prominent family of low-rank LLM optimizers, pioneered by GaLore, performs gradient-subspace projection: at each step, they project the gradient into a low-dimensional subspace and map the update back to the full model.
