Most existing work either recomputes the gradient subspace at certain intervals, or performs post-hoc adaptation to catch up to the moving subspace. In this work, we explicitly identify in practice the slow, stable manner in which LLM gradient subspaces drift across time. To this end, we propose Ori, a novel low-rank optimizer for training LLMs that captures the shifting principal gradient directions over time to achieve state-of-the-art accuracy under stringent low-rank constraints. Ori employs a streaming $k$-PCA algorithm inspired by Oja++, whose low per-step cost enables high-frequency, on-the-fly subspace tracking. In practice, Ori reduces the performance gap of the state-of-the-art low-rank optimizers to full-rank optimizers by up to 69.3\% on a 1B LLaMA pretraining task, and achieves the best performance on 10 out of 16 task scenarios in Roberta-Base fine-tuning. Together, these contributions allow Ori to further push the performance and efficiency frontiers of gradient-projecting optimizers, narrowing the gap to full-rank training for LLMs. Code can be found at this https URL .

</details>


### [187] [Partial-Revelation Panel Forecasting: Predictive Information Gain, Allocation, and Coarsening-Consistent Operators](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22831)
*Bin Wen,Dai-Qiao Zhang,Tien-Ping Tan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究"部分揭示面板预测"问题，即在已知前一轮对话中k个标注者投票的情况下，预测下一轮完整投票分布。作者将这种跨轮预测信息增益与同条目标注价值区分开来，提出粗化一致性算子家族，并基于Dirichlet-multinomial给出闭式实现。核心信息论结果表明，在总体层面，跨轮揭示的递减量等于条件互信息。实验在IEMOCAP/M3ED/EmoWOZ/EmotionLines四个对话情感语料库上验证发现，冷启动阶段优势显著但部分揭示级增益语料依赖性强；持有评测员的同项验证表明第二/三次附加投票价值递减；CCAR掩码是受控干预而非真实到达过程；一致性是审计属性而非预测改进保证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 主观标注任务通常约定每条目固定标注者数量（如三人），而非通过测量每个附加响应所提供的信息来确定最优标注预算。本文将这一实践问题形式化为预测问题：当部分标注者已提交标签而其余未提交时，预测下一条目完整投票面板的分布，从而将跨轮序贯信息增益与同条目标注价值分开衡量。

Method: 1) 形式化部分揭示面板预测对象：给定k个揭示标注者，预测完整计数分布Q_k(c_t | c̃^(k), r_t)。2) 理论结果：定理1（严格评分规则的揭示单调性）、定理2（揭示递减量等于条件互信息）、命题1（拟合风险分解）。3) 粗化一致性公理：Q_k为Q_n对隐藏完成的边缘化。4) Dirichlet-multinomial闭式实现族：CCPR-J（精确一致）、CCPR-D（部署变体）、CCPR-N（计数不变）、CCPR-S（密度收缩）、CCPR-L（学习补全）。5) 分配策略：贪婪注水法配合目标无关特征回归。

Result: 1) 冷启动(k=0)阶段一致算子全面胜出：IEMOCAP/M3ED/EmoWOZ分别降低NLL 0.422/0.166/0.014 nats，CI均排除零。2) 部分揭示级增益语料依赖：IEMOCAP在k=1/2显著胜出；M3ED差异不显著；EmoWOZ在k=1/2显著但k=3差异微小。3) 同条目持有评测员验证：第一/第二次附加投票分别减少NLL 0.583/0.221（IEMOCAP）、0.578/0.184（M3ED）、0.180/0.069（EmoWOZ）nats。4) 预算模拟：均匀分配在全部15格中相对集中分配有正节省，其中14格显著。5) 自适应分配（CCPR-P）在B=1时恢复回顾特征类裕度的83–93%（IEMOCAP/M3ED），EmoWOZ上无改善。6) 一致性无统一预测优势，k=3在IEMOCAP上+0.021 nats劣势。

Conclusion: 本文形式化了部分揭示面板预测问题，区分了跨轮和同条目两种估计量。跨轮任务在总体上递减量为条件互信息；拟合过程递减量含相邻超额预测风险差。粗化一致性是审计/部署属性而非预测改进保证。均匀分配胜过受测集中策略；目标自由自适应分配仅在行级信号可预测时有效（IEMOCAP/M3ED）。本文明确报告若干负面结果：精确边际训练差于交叉熵替加；Dirichlet优势主要源于似然族而非训练损失；通常oracle基准具有"千里眼"性质使分母过低。本文未声称SOTA，贡献是限定范围的测量框架与可审计的设计原则。

Abstract: We study partial-revelation panel forecasting: given $k$ of $n$ annotator votes on the previous dialogue turn, predict the full count distribution of the next turn's panel. This cross-turn predictive information differs from same-item annotation value. Under any nested revelation mechanism, the population decrement satisfies $V(k)-V(k+1)=I(Y;R_{k+1}\mid X_k)$; a fitted model also contributes adjacent excess-risk differences. Coarsened-completely-at-random (CCAR) masking supplies the exchangeable random-rater interpretation used in our operators. We define coarsening-consistent panel operators with a closed-form Dirichlet-multinomial realization, learned completion, and rater-count transfer. Against per-level lookup, cold-start count negative log-likelihood differences are -0.422/-0.166/-0.014 nats on IEMOCAP/M3ED/EmoWOZ. A held-out rater experiment measures same-item value: first and second additional votes reduce NLL by 0.583/0.221, 0.578/0.184, and 0.180/0.069 nats, respectively. Cross-turn and same-item gains are not interchangeable, and CCAR masks are controlled interventions rather than observed arrival processes. Consistency is auditable but does not guarantee predictive improvement; per-level marginalization can outperform a shared table. Target-free allocation beats uniform only where row-level signal is predictable: at budget one it recovers 83--93% of retrospective feature class headroom on IEMOCAP/M3ED but does not improve EmoWOZ. Gains are modest and corpus-dependent, with several small or null partial-revelation differences. Code and aggregate result artifacts accompany the preprint.

</details>


### [188] [Benchmarking and Enhancing Agentic Causal Discovery](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22846)
*Pingchuan Ma,Rui Ding,Shuai Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出Heuresis基准测试，通过匿名模拟数据和精细的评估协议，解决了现有因果发现LLM智能体基准测试中的名称泄露、数据饱和和不透明三大问题。实验证明GPT-6.1 Sol和Claude Opus 5.5等LLM智能体能够通过证据驱动的细粒度决策真正超越最佳现有算法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有因果发现LLM智能体基准测试存在三大缺陷：① 名称泄露——变量有意义名称时LLM可凭记忆识别结构（如Tübingen仅凭名称即获得99%方向准确率）；② 数据饱和——现有基准数据过于干净，选择更好算法即可填补大部分差距，无法体现智能体内部决策的价值；③ 不透明性——仅评估最终图，无法区分增益来自算法选择还是数据驱动的细粒度分析。

Method: Heuresis的设计包含四项要求：D1匿名变量；D2在算法选择之外保留充足的"修复提升空间"（repair headroom）；D3针对每个参考点分离单一增益；D4分解每个图并记录所有调用。定义了六类机制家族（lg/anm/hetero/wild/mixed/gauntlet），从线性高斯到重尾非线性。提出"选择提升空间"和"修复提升空间"两种headroom，并定义理想oracle（恢复PC所有错误删除的边）。构建智能体框架，提供三级证据工具：图级（算法菜单）、边级（条件独立性测试）、机制级（代码分析）。跟踪每次删除的测试和条件集，可追溯每条恢复边。

Result: 六类家族的oracle F1为0.973-0.986，最佳选择算法F1为0.814-0.934，最大差距达16%。router、CDFM、TabCausal等基线均无法填补差距。GPT-6.1 Sol在六类家族上全部超越最佳选择算法，wild家族上提升14% adj-F1；Claude Opus 5.5在wild上提升7.4%。两个最难家族上，智能体恢复的真边中有三分之一出现在任何算法输出中。在'lg'上，GPT-6.1 Sol在引导与非引导条件间无显著差异，说明其增益不来自PC的删除日志。该增益对提示、目标和token预算均稳健。Proposition 1证明当检验功效低时，仅凭PC记录的p值无法区分错误与正确删除（AUC→0.5）。

Conclusion: 本文将智能体因果发现重新定义为证据驱动的多粒度适应。Heuresis通过匿名化、机制多样化、固定参考点（BCA和oracle）和全过程追踪的协议，能够真正衡量LLM智能体在因果发现任务中"超越算法选择"的细粒度决策能力。实验证明顶级LLM智能体确实能通过自身测试和机制分析填补现有算法留下的差距，且这种增益具有稳健性，不来自简单的算法合并或对PC日志的利用。

Abstract: LLM agents can now run causal discovery algorithms on a dataset and report what comes out. Whether they do more than that, such as noticing where an algorithm went wrong and fixing it with further tests, is hard to tell from current benchmarks. Most of them give the variables meaningful names, and an LLM shown only the names of the Tübingen cause-effect pairs already gets 99% of the directions right. With the names removed, the data are usually clean enough that picking a better algorithm than PC closes most of the gap. We introduce Heuresis, a benchmark of anonymous simulated datasets whose mechanisms range from linear Gaussian to heavy-tailed. For each family of datasets it separates what a better existing algorithm can gain from what only a closer look at the data can gain, and it traces every edge an agent changes. Every family leaves a gap that none of the algorithms, the router and the two causal-discovery foundation models we ran can close, so a score above the best chosen algorithm has to come from using the data. We instantiate the benchmark with an agent harness and three LLMs, GPT-6.1 Sol, Claude Opus 5.5 and Qwen 3.8 Flash. GPT-6.1 Sol surpasses the best chosen algorithm on all six families, by 14% adjacency F1 on the most difficult one, and Claude Opus 5.5 does so by 7.4% there. A third of the true edges the two agents restore on the two hardest families appear in no algorithm's output. The code and data will be publicly released to facilitate future work.

</details>


### [189] [What Accuracy Hides In Learned Transformer Programs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22891)
*Jonathan Lee,Narmeen Oozeer,Philip Quirke*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究Transformer Programs (TP)的评估方法，指出仅依靠token accuracy会掩盖完全输出序列的错误。通过九个算法任务的实验，作者展示了程序检查如何提供超越准确率分数的洞察，并指导训练改进。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有Transformer Programs研究主要使用token accuracy作为评估指标，但高token accuracy可能隐藏完全输出序列的错误。此外，即使在采样测试集上达到完美的序列准确率，仍可能存在训练域内的失败案例。作者希望通过程序检查和形式化验证来揭示这些被掩盖的失败，并利用这些洞察指导训练改进。

Method: 1. 在九个算法任务上评估TP，比较token accuracy与完整序列准确率；2. 使用Transformer Program Verification (TPV)框架和Z3 SMT求解器搜索违反任务规范的反例；3. 通过Python执行提取的程序来确认反例；4. 对histogram和frequency ranking任务进行详细的程序计算分析，追踪失败输入的计算过程；5. 根据诊断结果修改训练数据（例如为histogram添加更大计数的示例，为frequency ranking添加平局计数的示例），然后重新训练完整模型；6. 使用Z3求解器或穷举执行在有界输入域内进行形式化验证；7. 手工构建参考程序以分析架构的表达能力限制。

Result: 1. 多个任务（frequency ranking、addition、addition with hints）的token accuracy远高于序列准确率，表明部分正确的输出不能解决任务；2. 发现histogram程序在采样测试集上达到100%序列准确率，但无法处理"7个4"这种输入，因为训练标签中不包含答案"7"；3. 通过添加包含更大计数的训练示例并重新训练，五个种子的硬神经模型在335,922个输入上全部正确；4. Addition序列准确率从2.73%提升至76.30%，addition with hints从39.66%提升至84.22%；5. Double histogram五个种子中四个在退火过程中从超过99.89%的软准确率下降，只有一个保持100%；6. 从软模型检查点提取的程序准确率显著下降（addition从90.50%降至14.16%）；7. 不同种子间准确率差异显著，例如double histogram在32.0%到100.0%之间变化；8. 频率排序的丰富化训练后，程序仍然会因正确计数贡献错误分类器权重而产生错误答案。

Conclusion: 论文证明了Transformer Programs的程序检查能够提供超越准确率分数的洞察，帮助识别采样测试遗漏的失败并指导训练改进。然而，TP架构和训练过程存在显著限制：(1) 退火到离散选择时准确率可能下降；(2) 某些操作需要许多层或大型查找表；(3) 不同种子之间训练结果差异很大；(4) 即使经过训练数据丰富化，仍存在未解决的错误。研究强调了表达能力、可训练性和可验证性的区别，并指出形式化验证仅限于小输入域。论文的核心贡献在于：(1) 提出基于完整答案和形式化验证器的TP评估方法；(2) 通过程序分析和失败诊断指导训练数据改进；(3) 分析TP训练和架构操作的约束。

Abstract: Transformer Programs (TP) (Friedman et al., 2023) constrain a Transformer's architecture so that its learned computation can be extracted as readable Python code. TP expose learned computations, but token accuracy can hide incorrect complete answers. In this work, we examine how program inspection provides insights beyond accuracy scores and helps guide training. We first evaluated TP on nine algorithmic tasks. We compared token accuracy with accuracy on complete output sequences and checked for failures missed by sampled tests. Further, we assessed training data improvements informed by program inspection and failure analysis, finding gains in sequence accuracy on several tasks. We examined a counting task where a program achieved 100% accuracy on sampled test sequences but failed on another input using the symbols and lengths allowed during training. The program counted correctly, but the required answer was missing from its output labels. After adding training examples with larger counts, the retrained models passed exhaustive evaluation over the bounded domain. In the frequency ranking task, inspection showed how correct counts contributed to incorrect answers in programs trained before and after changes to the training data. Finally, we studied constraints imposed by TP training and operations. The TP training process can lead to accuracy losses late in training. Our reference constructions also show how composing the restricted TP operations can use many layers or large lookup tables.

</details>


### [190] [A Feature Selection Layer Approach for Multi-Class Classification on Neural Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22898)
*João Pedro Silveira e Silva,Márcio Dorn,Bruno Iochins Grisci*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出对神经网络嵌入式特征选择层（FSL）的扩展——Multiple FSL，使其能够在多分类任务中学习标签特定的特征权重。该方法通过为每个标签维护独立的特征门控矩阵，在训练过程中通过梯度下降动态学习每个标签对应的特征重要性，从而同时实现分类和标签级特征归因。实验表明，Multiple FSL在全局特征识别上与既有方法持平，在标签特定特征识别上显著优于现有方法，且无需任何训练后处理。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 深度学习模型在多分类任务中缺乏可解释性，尤其是嵌入式特征加权方法只能学习全局特征重要性向量，无法捕捉不同标签对特征依赖的差异性。现有FSL仅输出单一特征权重向量 w∈ℝᴹ，无法区分对某一标签至关重要但对其他标签为噪声的特征，限制了其在多分类场景下的可解释性。

Method: 提出四种FSL扩展：Listener（被动观察共享权重在单标签训练时的漂移累积标签特定权重）、Residual（引入L×M权重矩阵，通过残差连接到各标签输出端）、Output Aware（训练时利用one-hot标签选择对应权重行，推理时取各行权重之和）、Multiple FSL（为每个标签独立维护特征门控向量 θₗ∈ℝᴹ，通过批处理矩阵运算对每个标签独立前向传播一次，取对应对角元素作为最终预测）。所有扩展采用ℓ₁正则化和ReLU激活，权重初始化为1。

Result: 在合成数据集（XOR、SynthA/B/C）和真实高维微阵列数据集（Liver、Colorectal、Breast、Isolet、Letter Recognition）上的实验表明：Multiple FSL在标签特定特征识别上显著优于Lasso、LIME、DeepSHAP等方法（SynthB上标签特定PIFS分别为0.982/1.0/1.0，SAGE不支持标签特定权重）；在全局特征识别上与Random Forest等方法持平；ECE校准误差（0.042）优于所有对比方法；执行时间（Breast数据集39.89秒）远快于LIME（487秒）和LassoNet（386秒）；GPU内存随标签数线性增长（Letter Recognition上144.8 MB），避免了TabNet在Breast上的二次方级内存爆炸（12 GB）。

Conclusion: Multiple FSL是首个能在训练过程中学习标签特定特征权重的嵌入式方法，证实了嵌入式FSL可以学习标签特定特征相关性（回答核心研究问题）。其优势在于：（1）通用与标签特定特征识别均表现出色；（2）无需训练后处理即可直接提供标签级特征归因；（3）内存占用随标签数线性增长而非特征数二次增长；（4）天然输出良好校准的概率（无需温度缩放）。局限性在于仅适用于表格数据（特征语义固定），依赖底层预测模型的预测能力。未来工作可探索将其应用于预训练模型迁移以及CNN/Transformer架构的集成。

Abstract: In the age of data-driven decision-making, deep learning models have become powerful tools for uncovering patterns and making predictions that influence many aspects of society. However, their broader adoption in scientific and business applications is often limited by a lack of interpretability. Feature weighting methods, which assess the relevance of individual features, are among the most widely studied approaches for improving interpretability. While post hoc techniques have advanced significantly, especially in modeling nuanced relationships between features and labels in multiclass problems, embedded methods typically fall short in this regard. Embedded techniques integrate feature relevance learning directly into the model training process, but they are often unable to capture label-specific relationships. To address the limitation, we propose multiple extensions to the Feature Selection Layer, an embedded feature weighting mechanism for neural networks. Through extensive experimentation, we identify the most effective extension and benchmark it against established feature weighting methods. Our results show that the proposed method matches existing techniques in identifying globally relevant features and outperforms them in capturing label-specific relevance. By leveraging the internal dynamics of the trained neural network, it reveals how individual features contribute to the prediction of specific labels, requiring no post-processing beyond the training process.

</details>


### [191] [Large Diffusion Models Need More Than EMA](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22945)
*Chuyu Hu,Huanran Chen,Shitong Shao,Yinpeng Dong*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文针对大规模扩散模型训练中广泛使用的"恒定学习率+EMA"优化策略提出质疑，通过理论和实验证明EMA并非扩散训练的最优选择，Schedule-Free优化在多个场景下优于EMA+LR衰减。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大规模扩散模型普遍采用恒定学习率与EMA的组合，但该方案是否真正优于LLM训练中常用的学习率衰减和Schedule-Free优化尚不清楚。本文旨在系统比较这三种方差缩减策略，探究EMA是否为扩散训练所必需。

Method: 1) 理论分析：从方差缩减的统一视角分析恒定步长SGD+EMA、LR衰减、Schedule-Free三种策略的收敛性差异；2) 主要实验：使用675M参数的SiT-XL/2+REPA在ImageNet-1K上进行80万步预训练对比；3) 扩展实验：在ReFL和生成器侧DMD中验证Schedule-Free的可迁移性；4) 诊断指标：检查点变异性、参数位移、固定评估目标等。

Result: 1) 理论证明：恒定步长轨迹平均存在固有优化局限，LR衰减和Schedule-Free在非凸条件下可获得消失的平稳性保证；2) 衰减+EMA在5个起点中的4个改善FID-5K但存在时序敏感性；3) Schedule-Free在所有训练阶段一致优于恒定LR+EMA，800k步时FID-50K从2.077降至1.874；4) Schedule-Free显著降低参数变异性同时保持后期优化进展；5) Schedule-Free在ReFL中将HPSv3奖励从6.35提升至9.61；在DMD中仅应用于生成器即可改善FID。

Conclusion: EMA对扩散训练有效但并非不可替代。有效的扩散模型优化需要在方差缩减与持续优化之间取得平衡，单纯追求参数稳定性反而会削弱优化进展。Schedule-Free在保持参数稳定的同时允许持续的大步长优化，是更优的选择。建议在衰减点未知时优先使用Schedule-Free，且可探索更大的基础学习率。

Abstract: Large-scale diffusion models are commonly trained with a constant learning rate (LR) and exponential moving average (EMA), despite the strong performance of LR decay and Schedule-Free optimization in training large language models. We study whether EMA is uniquely suited to diffusion training, or whether stronger alternatives have been underexplored. Our theory shows that averaging a constant-step trajectory has an inherent optimization limitation, whereas LR decay and Schedule-Free optimization admit vanishing stationarity guarantees under standard nonconvex assumptions. Empirically, LR decay and EMA provide complementary benefits: combining decay with EMA further improves the standard baseline at most tested starting points, although the gain remains sensitive to when decay begins. Schedule-Free avoids this timing requirement and consistently outperforms EMA with a constant LR across training stages, achieving both lower fixed-evaluation objectives and better generation quality. Our analysis further shows that all three strategies substantially reduce parameter variability, yet stronger stabilization is not always better: EMA with a constant LR retains comparatively higher parameter variability, while aggressive decay combined with EMA achieves the lowest checkpoint variability but also weakens continued optimization. Schedule-Free substantially reduces parameter variability while preserving more late-stage progress, providing a better balance between parameter stability and continued optimization. Finally, the benefits of Schedule-Free extend beyond pretraining to ReFL and generator-side DMD, demonstrating its transferability across distinct diffusion optimization settings. Overall, our results suggest that large diffusion models need more than parameter averaging alone: effective optimization requires balancing variance reduction with continued optimization.

</details>


### [192] [On the tradeoff between robustness and geometric accuracy in adversarial training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22955)
*Rachel Morris,Ryan Murray,Kerrek Stinson*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文针对非参数二元分类中的对抗训练问题，在无穷数据和有限数据两种设定下，严格证明了对抗分类器与贝叶斯分类器之间的Hausdorff距离可由对抗预算ε最优量化控制。具体地，当贝叶斯分类器边界为局部Lipschitz时，误差为O(√ε)；当边界为局部C^{1,1}正则时，误差改善为O(ε)。该估计维数无关，且对任意范数定义的对抗扰动均成立。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 已有研究（Tsipras、Nakkiran等）表明，在低复杂度假设类（如线性分类器）中，鲁棒性与标准精度之间存在内在矛盾——ε-鲁棒风险与标准风险之和存在下界。本文质疑这一结论的普适性，提出从另一个视角看待：若使用高复杂度（甚至非参数）的假设类，精度损失是否不可避免？本文旨在严格量化对抗训练中几何精度（以Hausdorff距离衡量）相对于对抗预算ε的最优衰减率。

Method: 核心方法为构造"能量竞争者"（energetic competitor）以建立几何障碍（geometric barriers）。具体地：(1) 在连续（无穷数据）设定中，通过挖去一个球B(x*,r)构造分类器A的竞争者A\B^ε，利用一阶必要条件（曲率流形式）和非退化性条件，推导出∂A_ε无法远离∂A_0。高正则情形利用σ-正则集的切向-法向坐标系Ψ选择半径与距离D无关的球。(2) 在有限数据设定中，引入经验竞争者引理（Lemma 6.1），利用Voronoi剖分的几何不等式（Proposition 6.2）控制η-扩大边界，并通过半径平均化论证选择"好半径"以处理经验分布与极限分布之间的偏差。(3) 利用García Trillos-Slepčev的∞-Wasserstein距离估计将连续结果传递到经验设定。

Result: 主要定理（Theorem 2.3与Theorem 2.7）：(1) 低正则情形——若∂A_0局部Lipschitz且密度满足非退化性，则d_{H,K}(A_ε, A_0) ≤ C_0√ε。(2) 高正则情形——若∂A_0进一步σ-正则（即关于范数σ具有C^{1,1}边界），则d_{H,K}(A_ε, A_0) ≤ C_1ε。(3) 在有限数据设定中，当样本量n满足n ≳ ε^{-Cd}（C∈(3/2, 3)，与维数无关）时，上述估计仍以高概率成立。(4) 通过具体例子（截断锥尖、收缩球）证实O(√ε)与O(ε)分别为低、高正则情形下的最优阶。(5) 该结果维数无关，适用于任意范数σ定义的对抗扰动（包括ℓ∞情形）。

Conclusion: 本文建立了对抗训练中最优的鲁棒性-几何精度权衡：只要假设类足够复杂（非参数设定），鲁棒分类器在Hausdorff度量下与贝叶斯分类器的偏差仅为O(√ε)或O(ε)，且精度随贝叶斯边界正则性的提高而严格改善。这与Nakkiran等人的"低复杂度类不兼容性"观点形成互补，证明高复杂度假设类可同时实现鲁棒性与精确几何逼近。结果在连续与经验两方面均严格成立，并具有维数无关性，从而在高维统计语境下具有重要意义。

Abstract: For non-parametric binary classification in the presence of an adversary, we prove an optimal quantitative estimate for adversarial classifiers controlling geometric accuracy, as measured by the Hausdorff distance to the Bayes classifier, in terms or their robustness, as encoded by the adversarial budget $\varepsilon$. This rigorously shows that robust classifiers sacrifice at most $O(\sqrt{\varepsilon})$ or $O(\varepsilon)$ in accuracy, depending on the regularity of the underlying Bayes classifier. In contrast to prior work on the incompatibility of robustness and accuracy over low-complexity hypothesis classes, our work shows that high-complexity hypothesis classes allow for robust classifiers with precisely quantified accuracy. Our results apply for adversaries determined by any norm on Euclidean space and in both the infinite and finite data settings.

</details>


### [193] [Towards Hyperparameter Transfer for Differentially Private Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22976)
*Tianze Wang,Zhiqi Bu,Linjun Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出DP-μP框架，将μP（Maximal Update Parametrization）扩展到差分隐私优化场景，解决了标准μP在DP约束下因高维噪声与低秩梯度谱性质差异而无法零样本迁移超参数的问题。通过理论分析推导了信噪比（SNR）条件与谱缩放规则，为DP-SGD、DP-Adam和DP-Muon三种优化器提供了逐层学习率缩放法则，实现在MLP、ViT和GPT-2等多种架构上跨模型宽度的零样本学习率迁移。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大规模模型训练中超参数调优计算开销巨大，μP虽能实现零样本超参数迁移，但在差分隐私（DP）场景下因噪声注入和逐样本梯度裁剪导致标准μP失效。隐私保护深度学习中，如何高效地为大型DP模型选择超参数（尤其是学习率）是一个核心挑战。

Method: 1. 谱条件分析：利用随机矩阵理论刻画噪声主导机制下高维Gaussian噪声（全秩）与梯度信号（低秩）的不同谱行为。2. SNR条件推导：在μP框架下推导信噪比条件，确保逐层信号与噪声的比值在代理模型和目标模型间一致。3. 逐层裁剪参数求解：通过联立方程组（式8）确定目标模型的逐层裁剪系数和代理模型的噪声乘子。5. 闭式缩放法则：针对DP-SGD、DP-Adam和DP-Muon三种优化器推导闭式学习率缩放公式（见表1/表2）。

Result: 实验在CIFAR-10/100的MLP与ViT以及Shakespeare字符级GPT-2预训练上进行，隐私预算(ε,δ)=(2,10⁻⁵)。主要结果包括：1) DP-μP实现跨宽度零样本学习率迁移，损失曲线对齐；2) 在MLP上，μP的最优学习率斜率β接近0（-0.05至+0.19），而SP显著漂移（-0.47至-0.52）；3) GPT-2上从76M代理模型迁移至787M目标模型，计算成本减少90.35%，训练时间从30分钟减至11分钟；5) 跨5种seed的测试准确率与逐宽度调优基线相当或更优。

Conclusion: DP-μP是一个理论上严谨且经验验证有效的框架，成功将μP扩展到差分隐私优化。它通过同时满足μP谱条件和SNR条件，实现了在噪声主导的DP训练中跨模型宽度的学习率零样本迁移，显著降低了隐私深度学习中昂贵的超参数搜索成本。局限性包括未处理深度缩放，以及当前分析限于噪声主导机制。

Abstract: Scaling laws and hyperparameter tuning remain central challenges in training large-scale models, particularly under differential privacy (DP), where optimization is further complicated by noise injection and per-sample gradient clipping. While Maximal Update Parametrization ($\mu$P) allows for zero-shot hyperparameter transfer in standard training, we show that it fails under DP constraints due to the distinct spectral properties of high-dimensional noise versus low-rank gradients. In this work, we introduce DP-$\mu$P, a theoretically grounded framework that extends $\mu$P to the privacy-preserving setting. By analyzing the interaction between gradient clipping, noise injection, and feature learning, we derive a Signal-to-Noise Ratio (SNR) condition that governs layer-wise learning rate scaling. Combining this with our proposed spectral scaling formulation, we provide specific scaling rules for DP-SGD, DP-Adam, and DP-Muon optimizers. Empirically, we demonstrate that DP-$\mu$P enables effective zero-shot transfer of learning rates across model widths on diverse architectures (MLP, ViT, GPT-2), matching or exceeding the performance of individually tuned baselines while significantly reducing computational costs.

</details>


### [194] [A Minimal ReLU Classifier on Non-Linearly Separable Data: Convergence and Implicit Bias at and beyond the Edge of Stability](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23007)
*Quan Nguyen,Robin Yadav,Param Mody,Mark Schmidt*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究两神经元ReLU网络在1维非线性可分数据上，使用逻辑损失和任意恒定或自适应增长的步长进行梯度下降时的完整动力学。证明在参数空间中存在一个"活动锥"包含所有完美分类器，并在此锥内推导出损失收敛界和隐式偏差结果：反射后的迭代沿最大间隔方向发散，正交分量收敛于一个非强凸势的唯一极小值。还证明了两步"弹射"现象（损失在一次尖峰后指数级下降）以及一种自适应步长方案可实现O(1/(T log T))的收敛速度，比标准O(1/T)更快。理论结果在更一般的网络上局部成立，并通过MNIST实验验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的大步长梯度下降理论主要局限于线性模型或线性可分数据，无法解释实践中神经网络在违反经典平滑性步长条件时仍能成功优化的现象。需要一个超越线性预测器和可分数据限制的、可精确分析完整GD轨迹的最小神经网络模型。

Method: 方法包括：(1) 构造最小设置——一个两神经元对称ReLU网络在三点1维非线性可分数据集上训练；(2) 识别参数空间中的"活动锥"C，其中训练转化为有效数据集切换的分段逻辑回归；(3) 在活动锥内利用凸扩展和子梯度方法进行分析；(4) 使用Wu et al. (2023) 的正交分量分解方法；(5) 证明GD方向收敛于显式最大间隔向量，正交分量收敛于非强凸势的唯一极小值；(6) 对恒定步长和自适应步长(η_t = κ|w_t|)分别推导有限时间损失界和精确渐近分析；(7) 通过扰动子梯度引理和"弹射"分析处理大步长情况；(8) 将分析扩展到非对称权重设置和MNIST实验验证。

Result: 主要结果：(a) 恒定步长下O((log T)²/T)的平均损失收敛率；(b) 精确隐式偏差：参数渐近为(2,0,-1)log t + 常数 + o(1)，即沿最大间隔向量ϑ̂ = (2,0,-1)发散；(c) 损失tL(θ_t) → 5/η；(d) 分类器学习为f(x) = (2|x|-1)log(ηt) + (1-|x|)log 3 + o(1)；(e) 两步弹射定理：大步长η→∞时L(θ_1)/η → ν > 0，-log L(θ_2)/η → 3ν-1 > 0；(f) 自适应步长η_t = κ|w_t|实现L(θ_t) = 5/(2κt log t)(1+o(1))，比O(1/T)快；(g) 打破对称性的局部收敛结果；(h) MNIST实验验证损失率与理论预测一致。

Conclusion: 该最小ReLU分类器模型为研究大步长和自适应步长下梯度下降在超越线性预测器和可分数据时的行为提供了可处理的理论框架。证明活动锥几何结构是理解非凸非光滑网络中EoS和弹射现象的关键，隐式偏差指向所有候选特征的最大间隔向量而非仅限于活跃特征。所得收敛率O(1/(T log T))优于标准O(1/T)。这为大规模神经网络的优化理论提供了新的精确分析工具。

Abstract: Gradient descent (GD) with large learning rates can successfully optimize neural networks even though classical smoothness-based learning rate conditions are violated. Yet theory for this regime largely covers linear models or linearly separable data. We analyze a minimal setting outside both regimes. Specifically, a two-neuron ReLU network trained with logistic loss on 1D non-linearly separable data. The objective is nonconvex and nonsmooth, and GD exhibits edge-of-stability (EoS) behavior. We identify an active cone in parameter space that contains every perfect classifier, where the problem becomes piecewise logistic regression with a varying effective dataset. Within this cone, we prove a finite-time loss bound for constant learning rates and show that GD converges in direction to an explicit max-margin vector, while the orthogonal component converges to the unique minimizer of a non-strongly convex potential. We further establish catapult results where exponentially small loss is reached after a single loss spike. Furthermore, we propose an adaptive schedule that lets learning rates grow to infinity without leaving the active cone. We prove that this schedule achieves a loss rate of $O(1/(T\log{T})$, which is faster than the standard $O(1/T)$ rate. Our theoretical results extend to local convergence on more general network and are validated on MNIST dataset. Overall, we show that this setup provides a tractable neural-network model for studying large and adaptive step sizes beyond linear predictors and separable data.

</details>


### [195] ["Deep lifts": Neural networks can generalize even with the dumbest optimizer](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23009)
*Sunil Madhow,Yu-Xiang Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究了一个"最笨"的学习规则：从宽度-W深度-D的ReLU网络所有插值训练数据的参数中均匀随机选取一个参数，而非用梯度下降优化。研究证明，如果真实数据生成机制可由更小的w×d的ReLU网络近似，那么这种最笨的随机插值器仍然能够以Õ(wdWD/n)的速率泛化。其核心是提出了"深度提升"（deep lifting）技术：小的见证网络可以通过多种方式"提升"为具有相同函数行为的大型网络，其数量呈指数级增长，从而主导了参数空间中的体积比。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代深度学习泛化能力与经典统计学习理论（SLT）存在矛盾——过参数化网络足以拟合随机标签，但泛化仍然发生。现有研究通常将此归因于优化器的隐式偏好（如低范数、大间隔、平坦解），但作者质疑优化器是否必须是"秘密天才"才能产生泛化。本文旨在通过分析"最笨"的均匀随机插值学习规则，隔离出那些与优化器无关、纯粹由网络架构带来的泛化机制。

Method: 核心方法是"深度提升"（deep lifting）技术，通过引入"结构稳定性"（structured stability）和"扰动稳定性"（disturbance stability）概念：1）将宽度u深度D的稳定见证网络"提升"为宽度W（u<w）深度D的等效参数，通过固定少量参数精确匹配见证网络行为，同时允许大部分参数自由在[-M,M]中选取；2）计算这些"提升"参数的Lebesgue体积，证明其相对于差插值参数集占据优势体积比；3）通过耐性论证建立泛化界。对于含噪声标签的情形，引入了一个"记忆装置"（memorization gadget），利用梯形函数在输入的一阶坐标上局部地拟合损坏标签。

Result: 主要结果包括：1）噪声实现数据情形下，均匀随机插值器以Õ(wdWD/n)速率泛化；2）标签被对抗性损坏m个点时，泛化速率为Õ(W(wD+m)d/n)；3）当损坏率m≍εn时，取得"温和过拟合"风险下界Õ(Wε)；4）对于不可实现真值可利用近似序列获得泛化界；5）Hölder函数达到n^{-β/(β+2p)}的L1速率；6）Barron函数达到最小最大最优的平方L2速率Õ((W/n)^{(p+3)/(2p+3)})，展示了避免维度灾难的能力。所有结果仅依赖架构和见证网络的稳定性，不依赖任何优化器偏好。

Conclusion: 本文表明，过参数化ReLU神经网络的泛化能力可以完全归因于架构性质，而非优化器的秘密天才。证明架构诱导的简单性偏差足以在多种数据生成机制下产生泛化，并且将近似论结果与泛化保证直接联系起来的"深度提升"技术具有独立价值。局限性在于分析的学习规则本身无法实际实现，但由此得出的架构属性（小的稳定见证网络的存在）能够解释实际学习管线的成功，并可能阐明PAC-Bayes边界中压缩性先验的有效性。

Abstract: Given a labeled dataset $\{(x_i, y_i)\}_{i = 1}^n$, consider drawing a parameter vector $\hat{\theta}$ uniformly at random from those that interpolate the data within a width-$W$ depth-$D$ ReLU architecture with continuous weights bounded within $[-M, M]$. We study the generalization properties of $\hat{\theta}$ in the case where the dataset can, in fact, be explained by a smaller $w$-by-$d$ ReLU network. Despite the obliviousness of the selection rule for $\hat{\theta}$, it adaptively generalizes at the rate $\tilde O\left(\frac{wdWD}{n}\right)$, rather than being governed by the VC dimension of the full $W$-by-$D$ hypothesis class. The reason is due to a particular inductive bias in ReLU networks: the $w$-by-$d$ parameter *witnesses* an exponential volume of $W$-by-$D$ interpolating parameters, which dwarfs the volume of poorly generalizing parameters (conditioned on interpolation). We explicitly construct this set of near-equivalent $W$-by-$D$ parameters by a proof technique called *deep lifting*, and then tie the achievable volume to stability properties of the $w$-by-$d$ witness. Examples show that these techniques allow us to convert approximation-theoretic results into generalization guarantees for nonparametric classes. We further show that generalization of uniform-random interpolators can survive label corruptions.

</details>


### [196] [Towards Looped Models Done Right, Part I: Topology, Input Injection, Recurrent-State Design](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23036)
*Benhao Huang,Chufan Shi,Junlin Chen,Shicheng Wen,Zhengzhong Liu,Eric Xing,Xuezhe Ma*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文系统性地解构了循环语言模型的架构设计空间，对比了Ouro和Huginn两大循环模型家族沿三个关键设计轴（迭代包络、输入注入、潜在状态组织）的差异，并通过密集模型与MoE模型的受控实验证明：Huginn风格的前奏-循环-尾声"三明治"架构在推理和上下文任务上优于Ouro的全栈循环架构，且这一优势可迁移到稀疏MoE设置中。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 循环语言模型通过复用Transformer块来以计算换内存，但现有两大代表架构（Ouro和Huginn）在多个设计维度上纠缠在一起，难以归因各自贡献。本文旨在系统解耦这些设计选择，并通过受控实验确定哪些设计原则真正影响性能。

Method: 1. 提出统一的形式化框架：将循环模型分解为三个独立设计轴——迭代包络（前奏P/循环主体R/尾声C的放置与共享方式）、输入注入（每次迭代是否回写输入表征）、潜在状态组织（z₀初始化和单/多状态结构）。2. 在730M参数、336B tokens的密集设置下进行Ouro到Huginn的逐步受控消融实验。3. 将结论迁移到8B/0.8B（8B常驻/0.8B激活）的MoE模型，训练500B tokens，与112层前馈MoE基线对比。4. 通过路由冻结干预实验验证迭代特定的专家选择对性能的因果贡献。

Result: （1）三明治包络架构使MATH500提升12.00分、DROP提升2.61分，显著改善多步推理；（2）输入注入主要提升BBH-CoT（+6.63）、HumanEval+（+5.49）、MBPP+（+4.23）等上下文相关与代码生成任务，但会损害数学推理（MATH500 -3.60）；（3）随机初始化和共享H/L层级状态无一致增益，反而在MATH500上大幅退化（-7.20）。完整Huginn在10项基准上全部优于Ouro。（4）MoE设置下，Huginn MoE在8/10基准上优于Ouro MoE，GSM8K提升4.70、MATH500提升3.60；专家负载更均衡（归一化负载损失1.571 vs 1.899）；使用75%更少的常驻参数即可在DROP/GSM8K上超越、在MATH500上持平112层前馈MoE基线。

Conclusion: Huginn相对Ouro的核心优势来自局部化循环（中间三明治包络）和对上下文输入表征的重复访问，而非随机状态初始化或额外层级状态结构。该结论在密集与MoE两种设置下均成立。MoE设置显著缩小了循环模型与前馈模型的性能差距（从4.96分降至1.71分），且迭代特定的专家路由具有功能性意义——冻结路由身份会使MMLU精度下降11.2分。未来需在更大规模上进行小到大尺度扩展实验、多种子复现，以及在MoE中单独消融各设计轴。

Abstract: Looped language models reuse physical Transformer blocks across logical depth, but established architectures entangle recurrence placement, input injection, and recurrent state organization. We isolate these axes in models trained from scratch at matched parameter scale, logical depth, and token budgets, and then test whether the resulting design principles transfer to resident- and active-parameter-matched Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models. The prelude-recurrent block-coda sandwich architecture consistently improves performance on context extraction and reasoning-intensive tasks. Input injection primarily enhances knowledge retrieval and context utilization, whereas random initialization and separate H/L recurrent states provide mixed or negative returns. Taken together, these results favor the Huginn-style design: at the 730M-parameter and 336B-token scale, the complete Huginn architecture outperforms Ouro across all ten benchmarks. The advantages of Huginn over Ouro transfer to MoE models. At the 8BA0.8B (32BA3B when unrolled) scale trained on 500B tokens, Huginn outperforms Ouro on nearly all benchmarks spanning knowledge, reasoning, and coding, while also exhibiting more balanced expert routing. Under matched training and inference FLOPs, the Huginn-style model uses 75% fewer resident parameters than a 112-layer feedforward MoE baseline. Despite its smaller physical parameters, it outperforms the feedforward baseline on DROP and GSM8K, matches it on MATH500, and remains competitive on the other benchmarks.

</details>


### [197] [GR-OPD: Group-Relative Sequence Credit for On-Policy Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23042)
*Yushu Wang,Renkai Yang,Jingcao Xu,Zili Geng,Haihong Tang,Yaohui Jin,Hao He*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: GR-OPD（Group-Relative On-Policy Distillation）是一种用于大语言模型在线策略蒸馏（OPD）的方法。其核心思想是将token级教师反馈聚合成序列级信用（credit），解耦反馈计算与信用分配。理论上证明，在理想on-policy假设下，将教师-学生对数比的轨迹总和广播到所有响应token上，可获得序列级reverse-KL目标负梯度的无偏估计。实践中通过指数折扣控制反馈范围，并利用同提示词滚动组（rollout group）校准教师指导，保留相对偏好并引入可调控的"集体教师压力"（collective teacher pressure，λ）。在5组Qwen3师生设置与6个数学推理基准上全面优于vanilla OPD，匹配思维模式下提升10.9和11.5个百分点，并能在思维模式不匹配时避免训练崩溃。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有在线策略蒸馏（OPD）采用采样token更新，只为每个动作分配局部反馈（该位置的教师-学生对数比），忽略了早期动作对后续反馈的影响，导致credit assignment受限。特别是在教师与学生思维模式不匹配（如think-Instruct教师蒸馏至Base学生）时，vanilla OPD会出现训练崩溃；而在模式匹配时也存在大量反馈信号未被充分利用的问题。论文观察到：聚合后的教师反馈即使在跨模式设置下也能区分正确与错误回答（AUROC约0.75），表明序列级信息具有独立的教学价值。

Method: 提出GR-OPD，包含四个组件：
1. **学生rollout与教师反馈**：学生采样G个响应，计算每个token的教师-学生对数比 r_{i,t}；
2. **折扣轨迹评分**：用指数折扣γ∈(0,1)（默认0.99）聚合token反馈为单一轨迹分数 S_i^γ，除以累积折扣权重以避免长度偏差；
3. **组校准**：用同提示词组内均值与标准差对分数进行标准化，优势函数 A_i^{γ,λ} = (相对偏好 + λ·组均值) / (组标准差+ε)，其中λ控制保留的"集体教师压力"比例；
4. **轨迹广播与PPO更新**：将单一序列级信用广播给响应中所有token，采用PPO-clip优化。
理论上证明当λ=0、γ=1且无组标准化时，对raw feedback总和的广播是reverse-KL负梯度的无偏估计。γ<1削弱后续反馈权重，λ∈[0,1]调节组均值保留量，二者协同防止长度捷径（length shortcut）和训练崩溃。

Result: 在5组Qwen3师生配对（Base/Base、Instruct-nothink/Instruct-nothink、think-Instruct/Base 跨模式）和6个数学基准（AIME24/25、AMC23、MATH-500、Minerva、OlympiadBench，共1042题）上的macro Avg@K结果：
- **模式匹配**：Base-to-Base从23.333→27.800；4B-Instruct→1.7B-Instruct从34.118→45.066（+10.9）；32B-Instruct→1.7B-Instruct从30.320→41.774（+11.5）；
- **模式不匹配**：vanilla OPD在两组think-Instruct→Base设置下均崩溃（8.449/10.066），GR-OPD稳定训练并达到29.571/24.463；
- **消融实验**：λ=0下训练稳定但提升有限；λ=0.25/.20下持续改进；λ≥0.5导致长度爆炸与奖励崩溃；γ=1（无折扣）下出现长度与分数相关性升高、与验证奖励相关性转负的训练退化现象。归一化集体教师压力代理值在跨模式设置（6.08/7.23）显著大于匹配设置（3.16–3.61），说明压力大小取决于师生兼容性。

Conclusion: GR-OPD通过将token级教师反馈聚合成序列级信用并在同提示词组内校准，实现了在匹配与不匹配思维模式下均稳定有效的在线策略蒸馏。论文的核心贡献在于：（1）理论上建立了轨迹级广播与reverse-KL下降梯度的联系；（2）明确了反馈范围（γ）与集体教师压力（λ）作为两个独立校准旋钮的作用；（3）实证展示了在跨模式蒸馏中避免训练崩溃的可行性。局限：评估限于数学推理与Qwen3模型；λ的最优值依赖师生兼容性，缺乏通用选取准则；序列级单一信用无法区分响应内token间的credit assignment差异。未来工作包括将组结构与GRPO verifier奖励联合优化，以及在序列级信用基础上引入更细粒度的token级信用。

Abstract: On-policy distillation (OPD) provides token-level teacher feedback, yet common sampled-token updates assign credit locally and omit the effects of earlier actions on subsequent feedback. We introduce \method{} (Group-Relative On-Policy Distillation), which decouples feedback computation from credit assignment by aggregating token feedback into calibrated sequence-level credit. We establish a theoretical basis for this approach by showing that, under ideal on-policy assumptions, broadcasting raw summed feedback to every response token yields an unbiased estimate of the negative gradient of the sequence-level reverse-KL objective. To support effective learning in practice, \method{} discounts later feedback that may become less reliable under distribution shift and uses same-prompt rollout groups to calibrate teacher guidance. It preserves relative response preferences while retaining a controlled fraction of the group mean, which we term collective teacher pressure. Across five Qwen3 teacher--student settings and six mathematical reasoning benchmarks, \method{} outperforms vanilla OPD in macro Avg@K in every setting, including gains of 10.9 and 11.5 percentage points in two settings with matched thinking patterns. It also maintains stable training under mismatched thinking patterns, where vanilla OPD collapses. Ablations show that retaining an appropriate amount of collective teacher pressure can improve learning, while excessive collective teacher pressure or an unrestricted feedback horizon can destabilize training.

</details>


### [198] [Where Latents Belong and How They Flow: Joint Identification of Structural Roles](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23074)
*Xintong Li,Kun Zhang,Yujia Zheng*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出了"结构角色"（structural role）的形式化定义，用于刻画动态系统中潜在因子的三种角色——组表达（group expression）、入向影响（incoming influence）、出向影响（outgoing influence）。核心贡献是建立了三者在一个共同置换下的联合可识别性理论，并开发了对应的算法框架 RoleTrace。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在动态系统中，潜在因子可能在不同观测和时间点扮演不同角色。例如群体会议中的一个观点可能仅由部分参与者表达、继承早期讨论的信息并影响后续决策。现有的ICA、非线性ICA、时序因果表征学习等工作分别识别潜在成分、观测侧结构或时序因果结构，但完整刻画潜在因子的"结构角色"仍未解决。核心挑战在于对应问题：三种结构可能在不同置换下被识别，而结构角色需要在同一潜在坐标下对齐才被定义。

Method: 1. 形式化定义三种结构角色：$\mathbb{A}^{(k)}_{t,i}$（在第$k$组中表达）、$\mathbb{B}_{t,i}$（接收时延影响）、$\mathbb{C}_{t,i}$（传递时延影响）。2. 建立可识别性理论：(i) 利用观测映射Jacobian识别组表达（Theorem 3.1）；(ii) 利用转移密度的交叉Hessian矩阵的行/列支撑识别出向和入向时序支撑（Theorem 3.2, Corollary 3.3）；(iii) 通过共同支撑对齐（Lemma 3.4）证明存在一个共同置换$\sigma_t$同时对齐三种结构（Theorem 3.5）。3. 开发RoleTrace算法：使用编码器-解码器学习潜在表示，通过Jacobian和交叉Hessian估计分数，采用Jacobi坐标旋转优化联合稀疏性目标函数，并进行一次转移重拟合。4. 在合成数据和AMI多人会议数据上进行实验验证。

Result: 合成实验：RoleTrace在联合签名恢复上的Joint准确率达到0.854（n=3200），优于ThoughtComm和No-refit（均为0.708），时序角色F1均达0.973。共同对齐比单一角色对齐（Joint准确率0.700/0.475/0.458）显著提高（0.950）。灵敏度分析显示在不同退化路径下性能平滑下降。AMI会议实验：在受限潜在预算（k=4,8,12）下，基于出向角色$\mathbb{C}$的坐标选择优于随机、方差、活跃度等基线，在k=4时达到45.854% vs Random的42.822%。

Conclusion: 论文建立了分组时序观测中潜在结构角色联合可识别性的理论基础，证明在适当结构和变异性条件下，组表达$\mathbb{A}$、入向影响$\mathbb{B}$和出向影响$\mathbb{C}$可在共同置换下被联合识别。RoleTrace框架通过共享潜在坐标系有效地从有限数据中恢复这些结构角色，为理解复杂演化系统中隐藏因素的组织和传播提供了可解释表征基础。理论保证相比现有路径连通性方法更弱，允许具有相同结构签名的坐标间存在置换模糊性。该工作为序列观测中隐藏因子的"位置归属"和"信息流向"的联合识别开辟了新方向。

Abstract: Latent factors in dynamical systems can play different roles across observations and time. For example, an idea in a group meeting may be expressed by only some participants, inherit information from earlier discussions, and shape what is said next. We formalize this notion as the structural role of a latent factor, describing where it is expressed, whether it receives influence from the past, and whether it transmits influence to the future. The main challenge is correspondence, since the three structures may be identified under different permutations, while a structural role is defined only when they are aligned to the same latent coordinate. We show that, under suitable structural and variability conditions, all three roles are jointly identifiable under a common permutation at each time point. Guided by this theory, we develop RoleTrace, a framework that traces structural roles in a shared latent coordinate system. Synthetic experiments validate structural recovery, while experiments on multiparty meetings examine the identified roles in real sequential interactions.

</details>


### [199] [Towards a GraphNARX model for structural dynamics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23103)
*George Tsialiamanis,Keith Worden*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出GraphNARX模型，将图神经网络(GNN)与非线性自回归外生(NARX)模型相结合，用于结构动力学的系统辨识。该模型将结构建模为图，节点编码滞后位移与外力，边编码相邻节点相对位移，并通过预测位移增量实现一阶外推泛化。模型在10自由度质点-弹簧系统上训练，可零样本迁移至20自由度系统，并能通过掩码机制实现虚拟传感。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统NARX模型（如GP-NARX、神经网络NARX）虽具灵活性，但仅能针对单一结构、单一传感器布置进行辨识，缺乏对不同尺寸/自由度结构的尺寸泛化能力。本文旨在通过GNN的局部消息传递机制，引入几何归纳偏置，使模型能够在相同材料、不同尺寸结构间外推，并天然支持基于局部学习的虚拟传感任务，弥补数据驱动模型外推性差的缺陷。

Method: 1. 将离散结构建模为图G=(V,E)：节点特征编码滞后位移{y_t...y_{t-ny}}与外力{x_t...x_{t-nx}}，边特征编码相邻节点相对位移(y^r - y^s)的滞后序列。
2. 采用消息传递GNN架构，包含边更新ϕ^e与节点更新ϕ^v两个模块，聚合函数ρ采用求和。
3. 关键设计：模型预测位移增量Δy_{t+1}，最终输出为ŷ_{t+1}=y_t+Δŷ_{t+1}，避免绝对位移超出网络激活范围。
4. 损失函数采用MSE（系统辨识）或带掩码的MSE（虚拟传感，训练时按Bern(0.5)随机掩码节点）。
5. 边特征不显式编码物理参数（k, c），假设材料相同，使模型可在不同尺寸结构间迁移。

Result: 1. 系统辨识（10-DOF系统）：测试集一步预测NMSE为0.0204%，400步多步预测NMSE低于5%；零样本迁移至20-DOF系统，一步预测NMSE为0.02283%，多步预测误差增长速率略高于10-DOF系统。
2. 虚拟传感：10-DOF系统50%掩码率下，mask=[1,0,1,0,...]对应NMSE为4.99%，60%掩码率对应NMSE为6.36%；迁移至20-DOF系统后，同方案误差分别降至1.93%与2.51%，体现尺寸增大时的插值稳定性优势。
3. 最终结论：GraphNARX兼具尺寸外推与稀疏传感推断能力，但在更复杂的GNN架构、多步损失函数、实验验证等方面仍需深入研究。

Conclusion: GraphNARX通过将GNN的局部学习与NARX的时序建模相融合，成功实现了对相同材料、不同规模结构的外推式系统辨识，并在虚拟传感任务中表现优异，初步验证了图形式归纳偏置对结构动力学辨识的有效性。

Abstract: The current paper introduces the GraphNARX model, a graph-based nonlinear autoregressive exogenous model for structural dynamics. The model is built to account for the geometry of structures and to model dynamic behaviour as the interaction between elements of the structure. Similar to other types of NARX models, GraphNARX is used for system identification. Nodal attributes of the graph encode past displacements and nodal forces, and the output of the model is the next-timestep displacement. The graph formulation of the model allows it to generalise to structures of different dimensions and degrees of freedom. Moreover, because graph-learning is performed locally between the nodes, the GraphNARX model can also learn to infer displacements of nodes for which data are not available, i.e.\ to perform virtual sensing. The proposed model's performance is evaluated in a system-identification framework and a virtual-sensing framework, and achieves good accuracy and exhibits generalisation capabilities to structures of different sizes.

</details>


### [200] [Domain-specific language alignment of multimodal embeddings towards explainable predictions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23110)
*Gabrielė Tijūnaitytė,Thijs L. van der Plas,Mohamed-Bachir Belaid,Rob Knapen,Maciej J. Soja,Ioannis N. Athanasiadis*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种领域特定的语言对齐框架，用于将任何可链接到可解释辅助数据的抽象嵌入空间与语言对齐，并通过在地球嵌入（Earth embeddings）上进行物种分布建模（SDM）验证了其在可解释预测中的有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多模态数据融合为潜在表征后虽提升了下游任务性能，但缺乏可解释性，限制了其在需要可解释模型决策的领域（如物种分布建模）中的应用。现有视觉-语言对齐方法依赖大规模图像-文本配对数据，而多模态嵌入通常缺乏此类标注。

Method: 1）通过captioning函数将可解释的辅助数据转化为多个局部文本描述；2）提出soft contrastive loss（基于高斯核的InfoNCE变体），根据辅助变量相似度对正样本对进行加权；3）提出基于排名的概念检索任务（rank-based concept retrieval），利用辅助数据而非文本描述本身评估对齐质量；4）使用MLP投影网络将AlphaEarth嵌入空间对齐至CLIP文本空间。

Result: 在两个SDM任务（S2BMS和SatBird）上，AlphaEarth嵌入在6/7指标上超越此前的SOTA；语言对齐框架在平均概念检索上优于多个EO视觉-语言基线（如RemoteCLIP、GeoRSCLIP、SkyCLIP、DOFA-CLIP等）；对齐概念可恢复物种-栖息地关联（ρ=0.44），并能将栖息地描述与物种预测相关联。

Conclusion: 研究表明，任何可链接到可解释数据的抽象嵌入空间均可通过本文框架被描述、对齐与评估，从而恢复表征的可解释性，为基于地球嵌入的可解释SDM预测提供了可行路径；但对齐效果受限于文本编码器领域敏感性与辅助变量编码强度，可通过更优的caption设计与文本编码器进一步提升。

Abstract: Multimodal data are commonly fused into latent representations that improve downstream task performance but are not interpretable, limiting their application in domains that require explainable model decisions. Vision-language alignment has made image embeddings interpretable through language, but requires vast image-caption training data. However, captioned data are typically not available for multimodal embeddings, as relevant features cannot directly be observed and annotated from embeddings alone. Here, we propose a framework to language-align any embedding space that can be linked to interpretable auxiliary data. Captioning functions convert auxiliary data into partial captions; a soft contrastive loss weights pairs by the similarity of their properties that each caption describes; and a rank-based concept retrieval task evaluates alignment against the auxiliary data rather than the captions. We apply this framework to multimodal Earth embeddings to facilitate explainable predictions for two species distribution modelling tasks: S2BMS and SatBird. AlphaEarth embeddings beat previous state-of-the-art models on 6/7 metrics, while our framework language-aligns domain-specific concepts of the embedding space, outperforming previous Earth observation vision-language models on average concept retrieval for both datasets. Finally, aligned concepts recover species-habitat associations ($\rho$=0.44) and relate habitat descriptions to species predictions, showing that abstract embeddings can be interrogated in the language of domain experts.

</details>


### [201] [LED: Improving Masked Diffusion Language Models by Lookahead Editing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23122)
*Yuyan Zhou,Zeyuan Yang,Yuxuan Song,Zhicheng Cai,Hongli Yu,Weiying Ma,Hao Zhou,James Kwok*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种名为Lookahead Editing（LED-）的新型解码方法，用于扩散大语言模型（dLLMs）。该方法结合了掩码扩散模型（MDMs）易于优化的优势与统一扩散模型（UDMs）的高表达能力，通过引入一个可重写的提议状态（rewritable proposal state），在每个解码步骤中进行前瞻更新以优化未来预测，从而在保持掩码转换机制的同时实现迭代状态修订。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的扩散大语言模型面临一个核心权衡：掩码扩散模型（MDMs）虽然易于优化，但由于其掩码转换机制缺乏迭代修订能力，计算表达能力较低；而统一扩散模型（UDMs）虽然具有更高的表达能力和允许修订任意迭代能力，但训练难度大。研究动机在于：能否在不牺牲MDMs简单易优化转换机制的情况下，获得UDMs所具备的迭代修订的强表达能力？

Method: 本文提出Lookahead Editing（LED-）方法，其核心是：（1）在掩码扩散解码过程中增加一个可重写的提议状态（rewritable proposal）；（2）在每个解码步骤中，模型先在提议状态中进行若干次前瞻更新（lookahead updates）以迭代优化后续预测；（3）然后再将令牌提交到掩码序列中。该方法通过额外的计算开销来提高表达能力，同时保留了MDMs基于掩码的简单转换机制。研究基于Qwen2.5-7B和Qwen3-8B基础模型进行监督微调（SFT），分别得到LED-7B和LED-8B模型。

Result: 在八个基准测试上的实验结果表明：与标准MDM监督微调相比，LED的SFT平均性能提升分别为+11.4分（LED-7B）和+7.7分（LED-8B）；更重要的是，仅使用SFT（不含持续预训练和强化学习），LED-8B的性能即超过了使用持续预训练、监督微调和强化学习训练的LLaDA2.1-16B Q-mode模型。

Conclusion: 本文提出的LED方法成功解决了扩散大语言模型中优化便利性与计算表达能力之间的权衡问题。通过引入可重写的提议状态和前瞻编辑机制，LED能够在保持掩码扩散模型易于训练优点的同时，获得类似统一扩散模型的迭代修订能力。实验证明，LED是一种有效的策略，能够以更简单的训练流程（无需持续预训练和强化学习）实现更优的性能，为扩散语言模型的进一步发展提供了新的方向。

Abstract: Diffusion large language models (dLLMs) have emerged as a promising alternative to autoregressive language models, enabling non-autoregressive text generation through parallel decoding. Existing dLLMs can be broadly categorized into two families: masked diffusion models (MDMs) and uniform diffusion models (UDMs) In this work, we theoretically show that MDMs are easier to optimize due to their mask-based transition schedule but have lower computational expressivity, whereas UDMs enable iterative state revision and greater expressivity but are substantially harder to train. This trade-off raises a natural question: can we obtain the expressivity of iterative revision without giving up the simple, easy-to-optimize transition schedule of MDMs? Motivated by this analysis, we propose Lookahead Editing (\ours{}), which augments masked diffusion decoding with a rewritable proposal state. At each decoding step, the model performs several lookahead updates to iteratively refine future predictions in this proposal state before committing tokens to the masked sequence. This design introduces a rewritable proposal that uses additional compute to improve expressivity while keeping the simple mask-based transition schedule of MDMs. We fine-tune Qwen2.5-7B and Qwen3-8B to obtain LED-\texttt{7B} and LED-\texttt{8B}, respectively. Across eight benchmarks, LED SFT yields average gains of $+11.4$ and $+7.7$ points over standard MDM SFT. Moreover, using SFT alone, LED-\texttt{8B} outperforms LLaDA2.1-16B Q-mode, which is trained with continued pre-training, supervised fine-tuning, and reinforcement learning.

</details>


### [202] [MetaCurate: Evolving Curation Filters for High-Quality Agentic Coding Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23134)
*Donghoon Kim,Seunghyuk Oh,Kevin Galim,Minseo Kim,Minjae Lee,Younghyun Kim,Wooseok Seo,Hyung Il Koo,Wonjun Kang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: MetaCurate 提出了一种无需训练的框架，通过 LLM 成对比较反馈自动演化出可执行轨迹筛选过滤器（filter），从空白种子出发实现具有竞争力的编码代理轨迹筛选性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 1. 编码代理 SFT 中，轨迹筛选至关重要，但仅凭"成功/失败"标签不足以判断训练价值（成功路径可能含冗余/低效推理；失败路径可能含有用诊断）。2. 现有方法存在两大缺陷：人工编写规则成本高、适用性有限；通过反复训练-评估来优化筛选策略（如 CurateEvo）计算开销巨大（3.5×成本）。3. 缺乏一种无需模型训练的、可扩展且自适应的轨迹筛选方法。

Method: 1. **核心思想**：将筛选过滤器表示为可执行打分程序（rules.py 确定性规则 + rubric.md LLM评分准则 + policy.py 聚合策略），通过成对 LLM 判断（pairwise judge）作为监督信号来演化过滤器。2. **关键设计**：成对判断仅在搜索阶段使用，最终过滤器只需对单条轨迹独立评分即可全池筛选。3. **算法流程**（Algorithm 1）：每轮迭代中，Proposer（GPT-5.6 Sol Pro）根据累积的探索反馈（错排对+判断理由）、准则健康度诊断（死准则/冗余准则）提出候选；Solver（Luna）对候选打分；Judge 仅在候选排序不一致的探索对上仲裁；Promotion 基于固定选择对的二项分布噪声感知提升规则。5. **额外机制**：AB/BA 双序呈现过滤位置偏差；噪声感知提升（fresh draws 复核）；种子对比仅允许 one revision round；空白种子（1条通用准则）vs 人工种子（6条准则）。

Result: **主对比实验**（SWE-bench Verified, Qwen 3.5 9B）：（1）DSv4Pro（4,286 轨迹）：Ours 64.0% > Rule filter/LLM filter 63.1%/62.9% > CurateEvo 62.7% > Random 61.7%；（2）Nemotron v3（17,220 轨迹）：Ours 56.5% > LLM filter 54.8% > Rule filter 54.4% > CurateEvo 53.6% > Random 52.9%。（4）规模迁移：27B 模型上 Ours 74.3% 仍优于其他基线。**消融**：空白种子与人工种子下游性能相当；选择一致性（Selection C）与测试一致性（Test C）同步提升（0.845→0.912 vs 0.830→0.896），表明无明显过拟合；200 轨迹预算下 Ours 60.3% 仍领先；不同 LLM 作为 Judge/Solver 时排名一致性 0.88–0.96。**成本**：CurateEvo 三次评估需 110.2 B200-小时（约 $659），而 MetaCurate 仅用成对比较，搜索成本显著更低。

Conclusion: MetaCurate 验证了成对 LLM 偏好可以指导点式（pointwise）训练数据筛选，无需在搜索循环中进行模型训练。从空白种子自动演化出的过滤器在两个编码轨迹数据集上均达到最高平均下游性能，表明数据筛选本身可在训练前被系统化地检测、修订与验证，为 SFT 轨迹筛选提供了一种实用且可解释的方法。未来工作需进一步分析演化过程中涌现的筛选原则与下游训练结果的关系。

Abstract: Supervised fine-tuning on agent trajectories is an effective way to improve coding agents, but selecting useful training examples requires more than identifying successful runs. A resolved patch may follow inefficient reasoning or unnecessary tool use, while a failed run may still contain useful intermediate steps. Training pipelines therefore rely on rules and qualitative assessments to filter trajectories, yet designing these filters typically requires substantial human expertise, and validating improvements through repeated training and evaluation is expensive. We introduce MetaCurate, a training-free framework that evolves executable trajectory curation filters using pairwise LLM judgments. Disagreements between the filter's rankings and the judge's preferences provide targeted feedback for jointly revising its rules, rubric, and aggregation policy. The resulting filter scores trajectories independently, so pairwise comparisons are required only during search. Starting from a blank filter, MetaCurate autonomously discovers a curation strategy that achieves competitive downstream performance without task-specific handwritten criteria. We validate downstream utility through controlled SFT experiments on our uncurated trajectory pool and the Nemotron v3 SWE dataset, with random selection and hand-authored filtering as baselines. In our experiments, MetaCurate achieves the highest mean SWE-Verified score among the compared methods, including hand-authored rule-based filtering and a training-loop baseline whose search costs 3.5x as much.

</details>


### [203] [Grounded Credit Assignment in Reinforcement Learning for Multi-Turn Search Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23148)
*Qirui Liu,Hao Chen,Yi Wen,Weijie Shi,Yao Zhao,Xianhe Chen,Hao Zhao,Xing Tang,Weihong Luo,Yuyu Luo*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文针对多轮搜索智能体在基于结果奖励的强化学习（如GRPO）中存在的"信用混淆"问题，提出了一种名为Grounded Credit Assignment (GCA) 的方法。GCA通过识别轨迹的可验证子结果（证据检索与答案正确性），将搜索与回答信用分离，并在不超过每个token优势值10%的边界内对功能段施加有符号残差，从而在显著提升准确率的同时大幅改善答案的证据支撑率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: GRPO等仅依赖最终答案正确性的结果奖励方法，将单一标量优势分配给整条轨迹中的所有token。但搜索智能体的轨迹实际上涉及两种能力——检索证据和使用证据。单标量信用无法区分这两种能力的贡献。作者通过"接地差距恒等式"（grounding-gap identity）形式化证明：当智能体依赖参数记忆或滥用证据时，检索命中轨迹的聚合优势可能消失或变为负值，这导致Search-R1虽提升了七个QA基准的准确率，却在Bamboogle上将证据支持的正确答案占比从84.0%降至42.9%。

Method: 1. **诊断与分类**：根据证据命中标志H_i和答案正确性C_i，将轨迹分为A（命中且正确）、B₁（命中但错误）、B₂（命中但超时）、C（未命中且错误）、D（未命中但正确，Retr=1表示语料可被检索）五种类型。2. **功能段分割与路由**：利用首次命中索引将token分为vSearch（首次命中前的有效搜索）、rSearch（后续/冗余搜索）和Ans（最终回答）三段，根据各类型与段组合下的子结果极性确定残差方向P和幅度λ⟨|，例如B₁类型的vSearch获得正残差（保护有效搜索）、Ans获得负残差（抑制错误回答）。3. **有界符号保持残差**：A^token_i,t = Â_i + η·|Â_i|·P·λ·c_i,t，其中η=0.2、λ_max=1、c_max=0.5，保证相对变化κ≤0.10，不改变任何token优势的符号，嵌入GRPO/GSPO的裁剪替代损失中。5. **边际-熵token显著性**：通过采样token的边际（相对top-3竞争者）和top-32归一化熵计算每个token的显著性分数c_i,t，正段偏好"低概率高价值"token，负段偏好"高概率低价值"token。

Result: 在七个QA基准上，GCA相较Search-R1在Qwen2.5-3B上平均EM提升5.70点，在Qwen3-30B-A3B上提升6.30点。证据支持正确答案占比从76.9%升至93.4%。多跳推理基准（Bamboogle、HotpotQA、2Wiki、MuSiQue）上的提升尤为显著，GCA将Bamboogle上的接地率从42.9%恢复至96.0%，MuSiQue从71.8%恢复至98.4%。此外，GCA在BFCL v3函数调用评测中亦保持通用工具使用能力（多轮调用从41.12%提升至44.12%）。消融实验表明首次命中段分割贡献最大，学习路由幅度与固定表相当，且方法对超参数η、λ、c_max在较宽范围内保持稳健。

Conclusion: GCA在不引入额外模型、rollout或训练阶段的前提下，通过基于可验证子结果的有界符号保持残差，有效缓解了结果奖励RL中搜索与回答信用混淆的问题，同时显著提升准确率与答案的证据支撑率。该方法的核心理念——识别各段控制的子结果并按极性路由有界残差——有望迁移到其他可通过证据蕴含判别器或可执行测试验证中间结果的智能体场景。

Abstract: Outcome-reward reinforcement learning such as GRPO gives every token of a search-agent rollout the same advantage, although the rollout exercises two capabilities: finding evidence and using it. We show that accuracy improves without grounding: Search-R1 raises accuracy on all seven QA benchmarks, yet on Bamboogle the evidence-supported share of correct answers falls from 84.0% to 42.9%. We attribute this to GRPO's credit assignment: rollouts that retrieve answer-bearing evidence are favoured in aggregate only in proportion to their accuracy gain over the rest, a grounding gap that answering from memory or misusing evidence shrinks or reverses. To address this, we propose Grounded Credit Assignment (GCA), which uses verifiable sub-outcomes (evidence retrieval and answer correctness) to correct search and answer credit separately: a wrong answer is blamed more than the search that found the evidence, and a correct answer that bypasses retrievable evidence is credited less. Never negative on evidence-finding search, the correction does not shrink with the grounding gap; capped at 10% of each token's advantage, it never overrides the outcome signal. Without extra models, rollouts, or training stages, GCA improves average EM over Search-R1 by 5.7 (Qwen2.5-3B) and 6.3 points (Qwen3-30B-A3B) and raises this share from 76.9% to 93.4%.

</details>


### [204] [Nearly Linear Private Learning of Littlestone Classes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23160)
*Shay Moran,Chao Yan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文针对近似差分隐私下二元分类的Littlestone类PAC学习，将样本复杂度从Littlestone维数d的双指数依赖改进到近乎线性的Õ(d log d)上界，并给出了对子空间指示器的紧线性样本复杂度。核心是提出"结构指数机制"以及基于模型论rank思想的Littlestone类秩构造。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在近似差分隐私（approximate DP）下，二元概念类的可私有PAC学习完全由有限的Littlestone维数刻画。然而样本复杂度对Littlestone维数d的依赖长期较差：从最初的双指数依赖（Bun–Livni–Moran, FOCS 2020）到Õ(d^6)（Ghazi等，STOC 2021）再到Õ(d^5)（Lyu, STOC 2026）。最优样本复杂度与作为通用算法的指数机制原则仍是未解的核心问题。

Method: 提出"结构指数机制"（Structural Exponential Mechanism），放宽经典指数机制要求候选集固定不变的限制，允许与数据相关的候选集，其核心思想是为候选假设赋予一个满足稳定性条件的秩函数（rank）作为结构性奖励。对子空间类，秩自然取为余维数（codimension）。对一般Littlestone类，借鉴模型论（Shelah的2-rank及Malliaris–Shelah稳定性正则性框架），递归定义秩ρ(h)：ρ(h)越大表示在小型labeled集约束下版本空间的Littlestone维数保留越多。构造性质良好的"好族"（good family），并基于"多数派提升秩"（Lemmas 5、8）以及小见证集（Lemma 6）建立版本空间中秩-s候选个数和见证版本空间中的局部计数约束（Lemma 11），将候选结构化以满足机制的四条公理：低敏感度、秩单调性、有界原像和得分保持。

Result: 主要定理（Theorem 1）：对任意Littlestone维数d≥1的非空二元类H，存在(ε,δ)-私有(α,β)-PAC learner，样本复杂度为O(d log(d/(αεδ)) + log(1/β)) / (αε)，固定学习/隐私参数下即Õ(d log d)。该界对仅依赖Littlestone维数的界而言在对数因子内最优。子空间应用（Theorem 3）：对任意域F上维数≤d、ambient维数D的子空间指示类H_{d,D}，给出紧的样本复杂度O(d log(1/(αεδ)) + log(1/β)) / (αε)，完全消除对ambient维数D的依赖，将Kaplan等（STOC 2025）的二次依赖改进为线性。亦得到固定样本数下对线性方程组的私有求解器。范围空间样本计数上界为|Out(S)|≤2[2(d+1)]^d (en/d)^d，预像增长参数B=4(d+1)。

Conclusion: 论文在近似差分隐私的私有PAC学习这一核心问题上取得了关于Littlestone维数依赖的重大进展：通过结构指数机制这一算法核心与一般Littlestone类上的组合rank构造，证明了对数d因子的近乎线性上界Õ(d log d)，对子空间类更进一步得到紧的Õ(d)依赖。该方法依赖于经典指数机制向数据相关候选集的扩展以及连接模型论稳定性理论的组合思想。仍开放的问题是log-star问题：样本复杂度能否以poly(v, log* d)为界（v=VCdim）。

Abstract: Differentially private learning aims to learn from data while protecting individual training examples. For binary classification, finite Littlestone dimension characterizes approximate private PAC learnability (Alon et al., JACM 2022). Understanding how this dimension controls private sample complexity remains a central question. For classes of Littlestone dimension $d$, the first general upper bound was doubly exponential in $d$ (Bun, Livni, and Moran, FOCS 2020). Subsequent work improved this to $\widetilde O(d^6)$ (Ghazi et al., STOC 2021) and then to $\widetilde O(d^5)$ (Lyu, STOC 2026). We prove a nearly linear upper bound of $O(d\log d)$. Our main algorithmic contribution is a structural exponential mechanism for data-dependent candidate sets equipped with a rank satisfying suitable stability conditions. For natural Littlestone classes such as subspace indicators, this rank has a simple geometric interpretation: it is the codimension. This yields a private PAC learner for subspaces of dimension at most $d$ over any field, with tight linear dependence on $d$ and no dependence on the ambient dimension, improving the quadratic dependence of Kaplan et al. (STOC 2025). Our second contribution is combinatorial: drawing on model-theoretic ideas, we construct a suitable rank for general Littlestone classes and establish the counting bounds required by the mechanism.

</details>


### [205] [Structural Affinity: An Algorithm for Coherent Cage-Based Shape Design](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23173)
*Aviraj Newatia,Shengan Yang,Hantao Zhong,Rika Antonova*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出Structural Affinity (SA)算法，通过引入外部笼与均值坐标（MVC）来显式正则化基于笼的形变（CBD）。SA预计算一个亲和力矩阵来耦合内部控制笼的handle运动，能有效减少自相交、网格形变，并在线性复杂度下生成更连贯、规则的几何形状，可应用于形变传递、气动优化、机器人形态共设计等任务。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统基于笼的形变（CBD）中的handle是独立运动的，这导致了形变的局部化和退化（如"尖刺"形状）。现有的拉普拉斯平滑等损失正则化方法作为软约束，难以平衡任务目标与正则化项，需要针对每个任务进行大量的手工调参。因此，本文希望从参数化本身入手，提出一种显式的、对形变搜索空间进行结构性约束的方法，以减少对手工设计正则化损失的依赖。

Method: 核心方法是构建一个外部笼包围内部控制笼。利用均值坐标（MVC）将内部控制笼的顶点绑定到外部笼，从而推导出"结构亲和力"（Structural Affinity）矩阵C来耦合内部控制笼手柄间的位移传播。形变时仅需进行线性复杂度的矩阵乘法即可传播位移。亲和力系数C具有对称、非负且不大于1的特性，可视作外笼MVC权重间的min-pooling（或总变差距离的减函数）。

Result: 在Neural Cages形变传递任务中，移除显式正则化损失后，CBD-SA仍能恢复85-98%的笼规则性增益，重建误差与基线相差在1%以内。在气动优化任务中，CBD-SA在所有受扰初始条件下都获得更低的建模阻力，并降低形变粗糙度。在机器人形态共设计任务中，CBD-SA将抓取小物体的成功率从35.6%提升至87.35%（标称环境），并生成更平滑、更可制造的手指形状。

Conclusion: 结构亲和力是一种从形变参数化本身出发进行正则化的有效方法，可以在显著减少对手工设计的结构损失依赖的前提下，跨多个领域产生更规则和连贯的形变。其效果主要来源于通过外部笼MVC关系引入的几何结构信息，而非简单的硬约束或欧氏平滑。

Abstract: Cage-based deformation (CBD) parametrises 3D geometry through a small set of control handles, effectively enabling a variety of tasks from animation and interactive modelling to tool-based co-design, neural deformation transfer, and aerodynamic shape optimization. Many optimization approaches relying on CBD employ regularisation strategies to reduce the distortion of the deformed mesh by encouraging smooth, regular cage deformations. These techniques offer soft guidance to an optimization algorithm towards desirable deformations, but compete with the task objective rather than changing the deformation parameterization itself. In this work we introduce Structural Affinity for CBD, an explicit regularisation method which enables smooth deformations through control cages by exploiting a two-cage structure to couple cage-handle motion directly. Structural Affinity precomputes an affinity matrix using mean-value coordinates, binding the inner control-cage to a coarser outer-cage. This matrix defines how much a cage handle displacement propagates to neighbouring handles which substantially decreases and often eliminates cage self-intersections, reduces mesh distortion, and adds linear overhead at deformation time. Across robotic control--morphology co-design, source-to-target neural deformation transfer, and aerodynamic wing shape optimization, Structural Affinity produces more regular deformations and substantially reduces reliance on hand-designed structural loss terms. We report consistent gains on three complementary diagnostics: the cotangent Laplacian, a proxy for surface smoothness; cage distortion, capturing whether control handles move coherently; and surface roughness, which measures undesirable oscillation in wing geometry.

</details>


### [206] [Non-Parametric Optimization for Scalable Learning in Stochastic Decision Problems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23204)
*Mohsen Amidzadeh,Lauri Viitasaari,Mario Di Francesco*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文针对时变随机优化（TV-SO）中决策变量为随机过程的问题，基于Malliavin变分法建立了非参数最优性条件，并提出了一种对参数化维度不敏感的可扩展深度学习算法（Stochastic Path Follower, SPF），在最小二乘恢复与逻辑回归等分布漂移任务上优于基于学习和梯度的现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随机优化中决策变量为随机过程（即Wiener函数）时，传统的最优性条件依赖于参数化维度，难以扩展到大模型。同时，时间维度上的目标或约束变化（分布漂移）使得时变确定性优化的非参数方法无法直接推广到随机情形。

Method: 利用Malliavin积分-微分法建立TV-SO的非参数必要最优性条件（推论4.1）：以Malliavin导数替代固定时变情形中的时间导数。然后基于Euler-Maruyama方案通过随机流Γ_{s,t}递归计算Malliavin导数，并构造能量泛函损失L_TV（与参数化维度φ无关）。最后设计SPF算法：仅需模拟维度为n+n²的SDE（而非PDM所需的n+nφ），从而使前向传播对参数化维度不敏感。

Result: 在标量与约束TV-SO基准、含分布漂移的最小二乘恢复（n=10, d=5）和ℓ₂²正则化逻辑回归任务上，SPF在最优性距离和目标次优性两个指标上均优于基于学习的PDM和基于梯度的PSG。在高维最小二乘（n=100, d=50）下，PDM因计算开销过大无法运行，SPF仍显著优于PSG。运行时长随参数化维度φ的变化几乎不变，而PDM呈强依赖关系。在函数型随机优化（F-SO）的概率律追踪任务中，SPF在5个目标分布中的多数上取得最低的平均核Stein散度（KSD）。

Conclusion: 本文填补了随机决策TV-SO非参数理论的空白，证明了基于非参数变分框架的SPF算法在性能和可扩展性上均优于现有SOTA方法。未来工作将聚焦非参数充分条件以及在时间序列预测等任务中的应用拓展。

Abstract: Stochastic optimization (SO) plays a central role in decision-making under uncertainty. Among SO problems, time-varying stochastic optimization (TV-SO) is particularly important due to its applications in adaptive control and machine learning. Non-parametric approaches have been proposed for time-varying deterministic optimization; however, they have not been developed for their stochastic counterparts. This work addresses that gap by developing a stochastic variational framework based on Malliavin calculus. This framework yields non-parametric optimality conditions for SO problems with stochastic decisions and supports the design of a scalable deep-learning algorithm that is insensitive to the parameterization dimension. This algorithm, called the Stochastic Path Follower (SPF), is applied to two important problems under distribution drift, namely least-squares recovery and logistic regression. Experimental results show that the proposed approach outperforms state-of-the-art learning-based and gradient-based methods in both performance and scalability.

</details>


### [207] [Process Reward Modeling with Reliability- and Conservatism-Aware Bayesian Belief](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23223)
*Zhongjian Qiao,Zhixiang Zhou,Jiafei Lyu,Peisong Wang,Qiaosheng Zhang,Siyang Gao,Shuang Qiu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出BayesianPRM，将过程奖励建模为贝叶斯学习框架下的随机变量，通过可靠性感知和保守性感知的两阶段信念更新，同时解决测试时扩展过程中PRM的两种不确定性（PRM不确定性和策略不确定性），在多模态推理基准上取得了更准确的过程奖励估计和更强的测试时扩展性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 过程奖励模型（PRM）在测试时扩展中存在不准确的问题，原因来源于两类不确定性：(1) PRM不确定性（训练数据不足和训练不完美导致的泛化能力受限）；(2) 策略不确定性（标注数据收集所用策略与测试时扩展所用策略不匹配导致的系统性奖励高估）。现有方法无法同时处理这两类不确定性，限制了PRM在测试时扩展中的可靠性。

Method: BayesianPRM将过程奖励视为奖励假设空间中的随机变量并维护其上的贝叶斯信念。由于连续假设空间上的精确贝叶斯推理难以处理，通过奖励集成对假设空间进行离散化，并引入两种互补的信念更新：(1) 可靠性感知信念更新：使用摊销信念网络衡量每个集成成员对监督数据的解释程度，通过ELBO优化；(2) 保守性感知信念校准：向较低奖励重新加权信念以抑制高估。最终过程奖励为可靠性与保守性感知贝叶斯信念的期望。

Result: 在MathVision、MathVerse-VO、MathVista和MMStar四个多模态推理基准上的实验表明，BayesianPRM在Brier Score、Positive Brier Score、ECE和AverageCE四个评估指标上均显著优于Standard PRM、BetaPRM和DreamPRM等基线，平均Brier Score相对Standard PRM降低17.2%、Positive Brier Score降低24.1%、ECE降低27.7%、AverageCE降低19.2%。在Best-of-N和Instance-Adaptive Scaling两种测试时扩展策略下，BayesianPRM均取得了最高的平均准确率。在VisualProcessBench步级错误检测任务上也获得最佳综合表现。消融实验验证了可靠性和保守性两个组件各自的必要性。

Conclusion: BayesianPRM首次将过程奖励建模统一为贝叶斯学习框架，能同时处理PRM不确定性和策略不确定性两大误差来源。通过两阶段信念更新，可靠性感知更新解决PRM泛化能力问题，保守性感知校准抑制奖励高估。在多模态推理基准上显著提升了奖励预测的准确性、可靠性和下游测试时扩展性能，框架具有通用性，可应用于不同rollout骨干模型。

Abstract: Process Reward Models (PRMs) play a central role in test-time scaling for large language model (LLM) reasoning. However, PRMs may provide inaccurate process rewards for test-time scaling, which we identify as arising from two sources of uncertainty: (1) \textit{PRM uncertainty} that arises from insufficient supervision data and imperfect PRM training; and (2) \textit{policy uncertainty} that results from the mismatch between the policy to collect supervision data and the policy for test-time scaling, leading to systematic reward overestimation. Previous studies fail to jointly consider both uncertainties. To bridge this gap, we propose BayesianPRM, which treats the process reward as a random variable within a reward hypothesis space and maintains a Bayesian belief over it. Since exact Bayesian inference over the continuous hypothesis space is generally intractable, we discretize the reward hypothesis space with a reward ensemble and introduce two complementary belief updates, each targeting one source of uncertainty: (1) to address PRM uncertainty, we introduce \textit{reliability-aware belief updating} that measures how well each ensemble member explains the supervision data and updates the belief with an amortized belief network optimized by the evidence lower bound (ELBO); and (2) to tackle policy uncertainty, we propose \textit{conservatism-aware belief calibration} which further reweights the belief toward lower rewards to suppress overestimation. These two updates yield a reliability- and conservatism-aware Bayesian belief, whose expectation determines the process reward. Experiments on multimodal reasoning benchmarks indicate that BayesianPRM consistently yields more accurate process reward estimates while enhancing test-time scaling performance.

</details>


### [208] [Response-Informed Value Estimation for Cost-Aware Multi-Turn LLM Routing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23239)
*Haotian Yan,Jiaqi Liu,Bingyi Jing,Tianjun Yao*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了RIVET框架，用于多轮LLM路由中的成本感知模型选择。其核心创新在于联合训练两个价值估计器：部署时使用的路由价值估计器（RVE，仅依赖预调用信息）和训练时使用的响应知情价值估计器（RIVE，额外观察已执行响应）。通过在训练阶段将已观察到的响应转化为观测协变量，RIVET将响应引起的收益变异从残差噪声中分离出来，证明了这一做法能以1/(1+β)²的因子降低共享表示的渐近估计误差。在MINT基准测试中，RIVET在保持甚至超越最强基线准确率的同时，将调用成本降低了74.7%，且在三个分布外基准上保持了成本优势。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多轮LLM路由面临三大挑战：(1)信用分配延迟，任务成功只在交互结束时揭示，中间决策无标签；(2)反事实评估依赖轨迹，改变某一轮的模型会改变所有后续状态；(3)轨迹收集昂贵，每条轨迹都是一系列付费模型调用。现有的路由器要么为单查询选择模型后停止，要么使用策略梯度训练LLM路由器，均未学习轮级动作价值的离策略方法。论文指出已记录轨迹保留了每轮调用的响应，暴露了最终结果无法看见的轮级价值信号，但现有方法未能利用这一信息。

Method: 论文将多轮LLM路由建模为成本感知的马尔可夫决策过程，奖励为调用成本惩罚与最终任务成功的组合。RIVET包含以下关键技术组件：(1) 共享状态-模型表示 zθ(s_t, m)，由冻结文本编码器和可训练适配器构成，两个估计器共享此表示。(2) RVE (部署时使用) 仅基于状态和候选模型预测未来回报，通过argmax进行路由决策。(3) RIVE (训练时使用) 额外条件于已执行响应o_t，预测相同回报目标。(4) 三阶段训练：a) 基于完整轨迹收益的蒙特卡洛热启动；b) 双DQN目标的离策略Bellman优化，配合CQL正则化；c) 回放锚定的有限在线适配。(5) 通过方差分解证明响应知情辅助学习将响应诱导的收益变异从潜在噪声转化为观测协变量，将表示估计误差的相关分量的渐近方差降低1/(1+β)²。

Result: 在MINT基准测试上，RIVET Online达到87.94%的准确率（超越MTRouter 2.83点），同时将调用成本降低至参考模型的19.9%（较MTRouter降低74.7%）。在三个分布外基准（MuSiQue、DROP、MMLU-Pro）上，RIVET Online均有最低的路由成本并在MMLU-Pro上以92.4%更低的成本匹配MTRouter的准确率。消融实验：移除RIVE或将其响应输入置零均导致准确率下降7.80点，证实增益源于响应信息而非额外的价值头；移除CQL使成本增加116.4%。成本系数λ扫描显示λ=0.05是最佳操作点。路由干预实验表明在59个切换模型的回合中坚持首轮模型会使成功率从50降至43；在46个不切换的回合中强制切换导致成本增加42.9%但仅增加1次成功。

Conclusion: RIVET通过将响应知情信息作为训练时的特权监督而非部署时的额外推理开销，解决了多轮LLM路由中的延迟信用分配问题。其核心贡献在于：将多轮路由转化为带延迟监督的离策略价值学习问题；提出响应知情辅助价值学习，通过共享表示将训练时的响应观察转化为更准确的部署时表示而不改变推理路径；从少量记录语料和有限在线预算出发，在MINT上达到高精度低成本操作点，并在分布外泛化中保持成本优势。论文也指出仍需成本控制的响应探针和匹配的迁移消融来更严格地归因于响应内容。

Abstract: Multi-turn LLM routing selects a model at every turn before its response is available, yet task success is revealed only when the interaction ends, leaving each intermediate choice without a label of its own. Logged trajectories, however, retain the response each call produced, which exposes what each turn required and how well the chosen model served it, evidence that outcomes alone hide. We introduce RIVET (Response-Informed Value Estimation for Turn-Level Routing), which exploits this post-call evidence during training while keeping routing strictly pre-call at deployment. RIVET jointly trains two value estimators over a shared state-model representation: a deployable Routing Value Estimator that scores candidate models from pre-call information, and a training-only Response-Informed Value Estimator that additionally observes the realized response. Conditioning on the response turns response-induced return variation from residual noise into an observed covariate, and we show that this reduces the leading asymptotic estimation error of the shared representation. On the MINT benchmark, RIVET solves more held-out tasks than the strongest multi-turn baseline while using 74.7% less total call cost.

</details>


### [209] [Anisotropic Representation Dynamics in Transformers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23242)
*Nguyen Do,My T. Thai*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一种"混合门控理论"来解释 Transformer 中表示差异的方向依赖性动态（各向异性），将自注意力分解为值传输、查询门控和键门控三种机制，并发展了一套频谱准则来认证、量化和定位置信度切换——即注意力路由将原本因值传输而收缩的表示方向反转为放大的现象。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Transformer 在模型编辑、对抗攻击、表示引导等任务中需要理解哪些扰动方向会被放大或抑制。现有研究多关注灵敏度或坍缩现象，但缺乏对"注意力路由是否会使原本收缩的方向变为放大方向"的机理与判定条件。本文旨在填补这一机制空白。

Method: 1) 将自注意力雅可比矩阵严格分解为值传输 J_T、查询门控 J_Q、键门控 J_K 三项；2) 定义生长算子 G^M = J^⊤MJ - M，并引入表示差异在 M 度量下的方向生长；3) 形式化"门控诱导的制度切换"：在固定路由下收缩但在完整注意力下放大；4) 构造传输-收缩子空间 S 上的白化切换算子 W = C^{-1/2}RC^{-1/2}，证明 λ_max(W) > 1 是存在切换方向的充要谱条件；5) 引入相对切换强度 Γ(v) 和绝对反转严重度 τ(v) 区分两类切换；6) 定义有效切换维度 d_sw = #{i: λ_i(W) > 1} 作为保证每条非零方向都切换的最大子空间维数；7) 在 GPT-2 Medium、Gemma-2-2B、Llama-3.2-1B、Qwen2.5-0.5B 上用 WikiText-2 验证集进行有限前向扰动实验。

Result: 1) 查询门控的输出响应被约束到 W_VO·U_r，其中 U_r 为被注意表示的变化子空间，证明了注意力权重变化并不必然改变输出；2) 在 GPT-2 Medium 第 23 层观察到 47 维的有效切换子空间，认证阈值 τ_cert ≈ 0.967 表明反转可克服约 96.7% 的传输收缩；3) 相对最优方向仅需极弱传输收缩（τ ≈ 0.003）即可通过查询门控翻转，而严重反转方向（τ ≈ 0.967）必须查询-键联合作用才有效，证明二者是不同问题；4) 跨架构跨深度均存在非平凡切换子空间，查询门控主导（约 79-90%），但查询-键联合机制在所有架构中持续出现；5) 频谱引导相对随机搜索在发现严重切换方向上显著更优，并具备摊销计算优势。

Conclusion: 本文提供了 Transformer 注意力动态的机制化和频谱化理解：注意力路由确实可以逆转值传输引起的收缩，且这种逆转可通过充要谱条件直接判定而无需逐方向搜索。提出的相对强度与绝对严重度区分澄清了"切换存在"与"切换实质"的差异。该框架为模型编辑、对抗攻击、表示引导等应用中方向选择提供了理论指导。未来工作将扩展至多层表示动态及其对模型下游行为的影响。

Abstract: Small differences between internal representations can shrink or grow as they pass through a Transformer layer, affecting how information is preserved and how sensitive the model is to perturbations. Yet it remains unclear when changes in attention weights can turn a representation difference that would otherwise shrink into one that grows. We develop a \textbf{Mixture-Gated Theory of Anisotropic Representation Dynamics} that separates self-attention into value transport, query gating, and key gating. Our analysis reveals how the geometry of attended representations constrains gating and how interactions between these mechanisms can reverse contraction induced by value transport. We formalize this phenomenon as gating-induced regime switching, where a representation difference contracts under fixed attention routing but expands under full attention. We derive a necessary and sufficient spectral criterion that certifies the existence or absence of switching and identifies switching directions without exhaustive search. Beyond existence, our theory characterizes maximum relative switching strength, certifies the severity of contraction that gating can overcome, and determines the largest dimension of a subspace in which every nonzero direction switches. Experiments across four Transformer architectures validate these predictions through analytical and finite-forward comparisons, revealing distinct and joint query--key gating mechanisms and nontrivial switching subspaces. Our results provide a mechanistic and spectral understanding of how attention routing can alter local representation dynamics.

</details>


### [210] [FLARE: Physics-Grounded Evaluation of Language-Model Agents for Feeder Restoration with Degraded Observations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23251)
*BHVSP Subrahmanyam,Neeraj Choudhary*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: FLARE 是一个面向配电网故障后恢复（post-isolation feeder restoration）的物理可执行基准，用于评估语言模型智能体在信息不完整、冲突且必须遵守电气约束的条件下做序贯开关决策的能力。该基准包含 800 个交流潮流可行案例，覆盖 5 种观测设置；研究者评估了 5 个指令调优模型共 78,750 个回合。结果显示所有模型中位遗憾为零，但尾部失败严重（P95 遗憾 0.814–1.000）；96.4% 被安全护栏拒绝的动作会引发真实物理违规，凸显必须保留外部安全检查。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 电网调度员在故障后需基于不完整甚至冲突的监测/呼叫/故障指示信息进行序贯决策，并满足交流潮流约束。现有 FLISR 研究与通用语言智能体基准未能同时覆盖"序贯决策 + 物理后果"这一耦合点。论文提出在故障隔离后的恢复阶段，对语言模型智能体的决策流程与物理后果进行可重复的物理基础评估。

Method: 1) 构造 800 个 AC 可行的配电网恢复案例（CIGRE 与 SimBench 网络，德国中压时序运行点，模拟保护动作隔离故障），含 293 feeder-years，覆盖设备故障、第三方损坏与天气事件，并附带 150 例独立集与 3 组 200 例运行偏移集（拓扑、DER 比、负载）。2) 设计 5 种观测设置：clean / sparse / noisy / stale / conflicting，仅改变报告信息、不改变物理状态与 oracle 参考。3) 智能体在 240 分钟时间窗内进行感知、出行、切换操作（4 次合环 3 次分段），候选操作按报告去能量区域排序；闭环前由安全护栏独立检查放射性与故障带电，再做非线性 AC 潮流验证（潮流收敛、线路/变压器负载 ≤100.5%、电压 0.90–1.10 pu）。4) 评分采用类加权可控缺供电能（住宅/混合/商业/工业权重 1/1.5/2/3），正规化遗憾 R(π)=clip[0,1](Cπ−C*)/(C0−C*)。5) 比较基线：no-action、随机可行、贪心、FLISR、信念规划器、部分信息参考与 oracle。

Result: 所有模型中位遗憾为零，但均值遗憾由失败尾部驱动：Llama 3.1-8B 均值 0.124、Mistral Small 24B (4-bit) 0.088、Qwen 2.5-3B 0.148、Qwen 2.5-7B 0.082、Qwen 2.5-14B 0.111；P95 遗憾分别为 1.000/0.969/1.000/0.814/0.873，恢复客户比例 0.892–0.949。最佳 LM（Qwen 7B，均值 0.082）在 noisy 条件下仍优于所有其他模型，但劣于理想 FLISR（0.054）与贪心参考（0.060）。在 conflicting 条件下 Llama 退化最严重（0.065→0.158），Qwen 7B 保持在 0.084–0.089。三个运行偏移（拓扑、DER、负载）的差异均不显著（CI 含 0）。接口诊断显示提示与组件影响因模型而异：仅给 schema 指令使 Qwen 3B 遗憾 +0.668，却使 Llama 8B 下降 -0.049。影子回放显示 15,706 次护栏拒绝中 96.4%（15,142 次）若执行会构成真实物理违规，主要为热过载（8,165 次）。没有任何不安全动作被实际执行，证明护栏而非提案本身保障安全。

Conclusion: FLARE 为配电网后隔离恢复阶段提供了物理可执行、可重复的基准，可定量评估语言模型智能体在序贯决策、有限信息利用与安全约束遵守上的能力。结果说明模型在中位表现良好但尾部失败严重，并且没有任一接口组件对所有模型普遍有益；96.4% 护栏拒绝对应真实物理违规这一事实凸显外部安全检查不可或缺。基准尚不支持自主运行，因其采用平衡正序潮流而非三相不平衡与短路模型。未来工作将扩展至完整 FLISR 流程，引入三相不平衡与保护模型，并基于电力企业数据和人类操作员研究进行验证。

Abstract: Restoring service after distribution-grid faults requires decisions from incomplete and conflicting information while respecting electrical constraints. Addressing this need, we introduce FLARE (Feeder-Level Agent Restoration Evaluation), a physics-grounded benchmark for post-isolation feeder restoration. FLARE con- tains 800 AC-feasible cases across five observation settings and allows agents to gather evidence, evaluate switches, and perform restoration actions under fixed operational limits. We evaluate five instruction-tuned models over 78,750 episodes, including topology, distributed-generation, and loading shifts. Mean normalized regret ranges from 0.082 to 0.148. Although every model has zero median regret, P95 regret ranges from 0.814 to 1.000, revealing an important failure tail. Shadow replay shows that 96.4% of 15,706 guard-rejected actions would have caused a physical violation. FLARE enables reproducible evaluation of language-model based restoration support while emphasizing the need for external safety checks.

</details>


### [211] [Sample, Mix, or Verify? Allocating Test-Time Compute under Imperfect Verifiers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23255)
*Srinivasan Iyengar*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出SPLIT，一种基于小规模标注试点数据的测试时计算分配方法，通过精确的成功公式（考虑任务难度、生成器盲点和验证器相关错误）来规划生成器选择、采样数量和验证预算分配。在7个基准测试、26个模型和6类真实验证器上，SPLIT在未见任务上接近后视最优配置（差距0.02-0.8个百分点），而固定启发式规则在某些场景下损失超过2.5个百分点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 语言模型和智能体通过在推理时采样多个解并由验证器选择来提高准确性，但真实验证器（单元测试、多数投票、LLM裁判、奖励模型）会接受错误答案、拒绝正确答案且错误相关，导致验证后成功率远低于覆盖率。在固定预算下，实践者需要决定采样数量、生成器选择和验证开销分配，而现有方法缺乏指导。固定规则（如"使用最强模型"、"按幂律扩展解和验证"）在不同场景下表现不佳。

Method: 1. 精确成功公式：将成功概率分解为P(存在正确候选)×P(选中|存在)。推导均匀接受选择和top-score选择的精确公式。2. 相关性建模：通过高斯copula建模跨生成器共享盲点，通过候选级倾向建模验证器重复调用的相关性。4. 实证贝叶斯估计：从试点数据估计难度beta先验、跨生成器copula相关和验证器参数（真实正率、假正率、倾向集中度）。5. 规划器：在预算约束下网格搜索最优配置。6. 在线重规划：每个任务更新后验，任务首次接受即停止并将剩余预算分配给未解决任务。

Result: 在7个基准（MATH、CodeContests、HumanEval、MBPP、MATH-500、GPQA、SWE-Bench Verified）、26个模型、175个智能体系统和6类验证器上，SPLIT在未见任务上为最优配置（差距0.02-0.8个百分点）。每个固定规则在某些设置中至少损失2.5个百分点。规划遗憾仅取决于差分而非绝对预测误差。在5种成本定价下遗憾保持在0.62以内。重验证在MATH-500上降低精度上限（多数错误答案欺骗多数裁判），但在GPQA上提高上限。SPLIT作为预测器在验证器限制成功时优于幂律拟合。作为前瞻者，SPLIT在模拟验证器和SWE-Bench Verified上明显优于幂律，在真实测试代码上有小幅但显著优势，在纯覆盖和argmax选择上无优势。

Conclusion: 测试时计算受选择和生成同等限制。一个小的标注试点，通过考虑难度、共享盲点和相关验证器错误的精确成功公式解释，足以决定采样数量、生成器混合和验证程度。在数学、科学QA、代码和智能体上，该决策接近最佳可能，而固定规则可能损失2.5-20个百分点。规划器只需对配置进行排名，因此其遗憾受差分而非绝对预测误差限制，并在多种定价模型下保持近最优。同一模型解释了重验证何时适得其反以及汇总验证器统计为何误导。在线重规划恢复了与后视最佳静态配置的差距。最有用的下一步是测试长相同智能体轮次上的选择，为此作者发布了一个可直接运行的管道。

Abstract: A common way to make language models and agents more accurate is to spend more compute at inference time: generate many candidate solutions and submit the one a verifier prefers. Success then requires that some candidate is correct and that the verifier picks it. The first grows predictably with the number of samples; the second does not, because real verifiers (unit tests, majority votes, LLM judges, reward models) accept wrong answers, reject right ones, and make correlated mistakes. With a fixed budget, a practitioner must decide how many samples to draw, which models to draw them from, and how much to spend on verification, and today these choices are made by rules of thumb. We introduce SPLIT, which makes them from a small labelled pilot. It rests on an exact formula for the probability of submitting a correct answer under accept/reject and top-score selection that accounts for varying task difficulty, blind spots shared across models, and correlated repeated verifier calls. SPLIT fits the formula by empirical Bayes and uses it to plan budgets on unseen tasks. Across seven benchmarks spanning math, science QA, code and software-engineering agents, 26 models, 175 agent systems and six kinds of real verifiers, all from public releases, SPLIT lands within 0.02-0.8 percentage points of the best allocation in hindsight, while every fixed rule we test loses at least 2.5 points in some setting. Regret depends only on how well SPLIT ranks configurations, and it stays near-optimal under compute, price and latency costs and online. The formula also explains when asking more LLM judges lowers precision. As a forecaster far beyond the pilot, SPLIT beats power-law fitting when the verifier caps success, and we report where it loses.

</details>


### [212] [ADT: All-Atom Diffusion Tokenizer for 3D Molecular Structures](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23265)
*Xuantuo Huang,Encheng Su,Aoran Wang,Pan Tan,Shengyong Xu,Yizhou Wang,Chen Tang,Shixiang Tang,Mingxiao Li*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出ADT（全原子扩散分词器），用紧凑离散表示统一小分子和蛋白质3D结构生成：每个原子/残基对应一个结构token，通过扩散解码器缓解量化失真，支持自回归全原子重建与生成。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有分子分词器面临"紧凑表示 vs. 全原子重建"的权衡：原子级token保留细节但序列过长；紧凑的残基级蛋白token通常省略侧链几何。亟需一种统一的离散表示方法，将token粒度与重建分辨率解耦。

Method: ADT采用化学单元级分词策略：小分子每个原子1个token，蛋白质每个残基1个token（含骨架+侧链）。使用FSQ进行离散化，引入互信息正则化器促进码本利用。核心创新是粗到细扩散解码器：从离散token经残基级上下文建模，再扩展为原子级表示。训练目标包括速度预测损失、互信息正则化及蛋白质几何辅助损失（键长、键角、空间冲突、Cα距离）。自回归生成分解为先生成化学序列再生成结构token。

Result: 在QM9小分子重建上RMSD降至0.0343（较CoordToken降低28.2%）；在∇²DFT三个测试集上RMSD降低23.8-25.6%，有效性保持100%。蛋白质全原子重建在CASP14/15上AA-RMSD分别为1.32/1.83Å，TM-score达0.9695/0.9470。自回归生成Valid/Valid/Aug均优于现有离散基线（QM9上Valid=1.00，PB Valid=0.94）。序列条件蛋白质生成（CAMEO22）AA-lDDT=0.543，超越所有DPLM-2后处理变体。消融实验验证联合编码优于单独编码，粗-傅解码中10:2层分配最优。

Conclusion: ADT建立了紧凑结构token作为全原子分子重建与生成的有效离散接口，通过将token粒度与重建分辨率解耦，仅用一个残基级token即可实现高保真全原子蛋白质结构生成，为统一多模态分子建模奠定了基础。

Abstract: Discrete structural tokenization provides a promising route to autoregressive 3D molecular generation. Yet, existing tokenizers face a trade-off between compact representation and all-atom reconstruction: atom-level tokens preserve atomic details but produce long sequences, while compact residue-level protein tokens typically omit side-chain geometry. To overcome this limitation, we propose All-atom Diffusion Tokenizer (ADT), which decouples token granularity from reconstruction resolution. ADT uses one structural token per atom for small molecules and one token per protein residue that jointly represents backbone and side-chain geometry. To mitigate geometric distortion introduced by quantization, we leverage the generative capacity of diffusion models to recover fine-grained atomic geometry beyond deterministic decoding from discrete tokens. Extensive experiments across small molecules and proteins demonstrate that ADT achieves strong reconstruction from compact discrete representations while enabling high-quality autoregressive generation of both small molecules and all-atom protein structures. These results establish compact structural tokens as an effective discrete interface for all-atom molecular reconstruction and generation.

</details>


### [213] [DeDiCa: A Scalable Deconfounding Discrete Causal Generative Model](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23272)
*Kunchangtai Liang,Adrián Javaloy,Antonio Vergari,Isabel Valera*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: DeDiCa是一个面向离散变量的可扩展去混淆因果生成模型，通过将因果贝叶斯网络参数化为张量形式（T-CCBN），实现对隐藏混淆的精确边际化，并支持任意（代理）可识别的干预查询的精确推理。其在ATE估计上与现有最优神经因果生成模型相当，但训练和推理效率高出数个数量级。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有深度因果生成模型（CGMs）虽然灵活但计算复杂，对于具有已知结构和隐藏混淆的离散因果系统，是否真的需要如此复杂的模型？本文旨在探索一种更简单的替代方案，验证经典概率建模结合张量化表示能否在保持精度的同时大幅提升效率。

Method: 1. 提出张量化混杂因果贝叶斯网络（T-CCBN），将离散SCM中的因果机制表示为张量因子（cond factors），通过张量运算（sum-out、product等）实现对隐藏混淆变量Z的精确边际化；2. 基于do-演算定义T-CCBN中的do算子，支持精确干预推理；3. 扩展代理可识别性条件到离散情形，证明了在隐藏混淆下的查询可识别性定理（Thm.1）；4. 使用join tree（联结树）优化推理顺序，将复杂度从O(C^D)降低到O(D·C^W)，其中W为树宽；5. 通过最大似然估计（MLE）从观测数据中学习T-CCBN参数，使用随机梯度下降（SGD）或闭式解。

Result: 在Asia、Sachs、Child、Ecoli70四个半合成数据集上的实验表明：1) DeDiCa在ATE估计上与最优神经因果模型相当或更优；2) 推理速度比基线快2-4个数量级（毫秒级）；3) 在Z可观测设置下，训练速度比基线快几个数量级（CPU训练，秒级甚至亚秒级）；4) 在隐藏混淆设置下，训练时间与最快的CGM基线（DeCaFlow）相当；5) 在估计隐藏混淆器类别数C_Z时接近真实值；6) 相比因果基础模型CausalPFN，DeDiCa在ATE精度上具有竞争力，但推理速度快约6个数量级，并且对相似因果结构具有更一致的鲁棒性。

Conclusion: DeDiCa提供了一种可处理、准确且可扩展的方法，用于在具有隐藏混淆的离散设置中进行因果推断。通过张量化因果贝叶斯网络表示，从观测数据中训练一次即可通过精确概率推理回答任意（代理）可识别的干预查询。经验上，DeDiCa在推理速度上比当前最优CGM快数个数量级，同时在因果结构变化时比因果基础模型更具鲁棒性。未来工作方向包括：1) 改进C_Z估计和张量表示以处理更复杂场景；2) 扩展到部分可识别或不可识别查询及反事实推理；3) 扩展到连续或混合数据类型。

Abstract: We introduce DeDiCa, a practical framework for efficient causal inference with discrete variables and hidden confounding that revisits classical probabilistic modeling through a tensorized parameterization of causal Bayesian networks, enabling tractable inference. Given a causal graph, DeDiCa is trained once on observational data by maximum likelihood, exactly marginalizing over hidden confounders, and can then estimate any (proxy-)identifiable interventional query. Despite this deliberately simple parameterization, DeDiCa matches state-of-the-art neural causal generative models in ATE estimation, while supporting memory-efficient CPU training and exact interventional inference in milliseconds. Compared with causal foundation models, DeDiCa scales more effectively with additional observational samples and achieves competitive accuracy at substantially lower inference time and memory. DeDiCa provides a tractable, accurate, and scalable approach to causal inference in discrete settings with hidden confounding.

</details>


### [214] [Data-Efficient Classifier Pretraining Through Diffusion Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23289)
*Qinyu Li,Yee Whye Teh,Chris Holmes,Joel Jaskari*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了DiffPT，一种基于扩散模型的分类器预训练策略，用于数据有限场景下的小样本学习。该方法通过扩散模型的去噪目标预训练任意分类器骨干网络，然后在同一数据集上进行监督微调，实验中不依赖任何额外的无标签数据。在自然图像（CIFAR-10、Tiny ImageNet）、时间序列（PTB-XL、WISDM）和医学影像（EyePACS、HAM10000）六类数据集上与SimCLR、自编码器、去噪自编码器等方法对比，DiffPT在时间序列和医学影像任务上表现尤为突出，在低数据量设定下整体优于自监督基线，同时计算开销显著低于对比学习方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 深度神经网络在数据稀缺时易过拟合，而现有的自监督方法（SimCLR、DINO）依赖精心设计的数据增强策略，对非自然图像模态（如医学影像、生理信号、表格数据）缺乏标准化方案，且通常需要大规模无标签数据。本文旨在回到传统重建式预训练的思路，利用扩散模型作为通用预训练机制，在没有额外数据的有限域内提升分类器性能。
