Method: DiffPT将分类骨干网络作为扩散U-Net的编码器，利用DDPM的ε预测目标在连续噪声水平上进行预训练（覆盖从轻微扰动到噪声主导的输入），通过轻量解码器和跳跃连接构成U-Net结构。预训练和微调使用完全相同的数据子集（无额外无标签数据），骨干随后在同一数据集上进行监督微调。扩散调度在不同模态间通用，无需领域特定的增强搜索。

Result: 在CIFAR-10和Tiny ImageNet低数据量设定下SimCLR领先，DiffPT居次；但在EyePACS全部数据量设定下DiffPT均获最优AUROC（0.744/0.854/0.946），HAM10000上DiffPT列第二（0.828/0.905）；时间序列任务中DiffPT在50%/100% WISDM（59.81%/74.00%）和5%/10% PTB-XL（0.872/0.881）上均取得最佳性能，仅需分类基线1.24×内存和0.89×吞吐量，而SimCLR和DINO需2×内存和约0.5×吞吐量。DiffPT在目标高度局部化的任务上（EyePACS微动脉瘤等）显著优于依赖多裁剪的SimCLR/DINO。

Conclusion: DiffPT是一种简单有效、数据高效的分类器预训练方法，特别适用于时间序列和医学影像等目标定位局部化、增强策略难以设计的模态，在低数据量场景下稳定优于自监督基线，同时计算成本接近从零训练，远低于对比/自蒸馏方法。扩散模型的连续噪声调度提供了通用且无需领域调优的预训练机制。

Abstract: Machine learning with limited data is susceptible to overfitting, especially with modern deep neural networks. Prior to the introduction of AlexNet, reconstruction-based pretraining with auto-encoder and denoising auto-encoder were found to be beneficial, partially due to the limited size of the training sets at the time. Motivated by these traditional approaches, we propose DiffPT, a simple diffusion modeling approach to pretrain a given classifier backbone for limited domain-specific training data. We experiment on time-series data, standard natural-image benchmarks, and medical imaging datasets, and contrast the diffusion approach to a multitude of modern and traditional un/self-supervised methods. While contrastive pretraining performs better on CIFAR-10 and Tiny ImageNet in low-data regimes, DiffPT is particularly effective on medical imaging and time-series tasks, where it outperforms self-supervised baselines across a range of low-data regimes. Our results suggest that DiffPT is a simple and effective approach for data-efficient classifier pretraining on different modalities.

</details>


### [215] [Untrained CNN and coefficient-space regularization for joint reconstruction in photoacoustic tomography](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23315)
*Alfio Bozi,Anwesa Dey,Souvik Roy*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种用于光声层析成像中初始压力与空间变化声速联合重建的规则化数据驱动框架。该方法结合了小波有限维表示、固定随机卷积神经网络（未训练CNN）生成的非线性特征、Tikhonov正则化最小二乘恢复压力系数，以及学习得到的系数空间先验映射推断平方声速。数值实验表明，在保留测试数据和未见几何结构上均能准确重建，并在10%噪声下保持稳定。相比监督训练CNN方法，未训练CNN方案重建精度更高且计算时间仅需约六分之一。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 光声层析成像中，准确的初始压力重建依赖于声速分布的精确性，而生物组织中声速通常空间变化且未知。现有方法多假设声速已知或使用参数化表示，忽略了完全数据驱动的方案；同时深度神经网络方法依赖大规模训练集且对分布外数据泛化能力有限。这些局限性促使研究固定随机特征表示与显式正则化相结合的重建策略，以同时实现准确、稳定且高效的联合反演。

Method: 方法采用顺序重建策略：首先将初始压力与平方声速表示在有限维Haar小波空间中（N_f=16384, N_q=4096）；然后使用随机生成且固定的卷积核（tanh激活+平均池化）将边界Dirichlet和Neumann测量数据（596×400）映射为固定特征向量z；通过Tikhonov正则化最小二乘（λ_β=100）从特征恢复压力系数β̂；最后利用从训练集学习的仿射系数空间先验γ̂^T=[1, β̂^T]T推断平方声速系数。统计耦合模型包含一个与压力相关的分量和一个独立分量，后者代表了从压力场无法预测的声速变异性。

Result: 在5000个样本（4000训练+1000测试）上，初始压力在测试集上的相对L2误差均值为0.246（R²=0.925），声速误差均值为0.010（R²=0.712）。在1%-10%高斯噪声下，重建指标几乎不变（压力误差从0.24616仅变化至0.24634）。对未见过的几何体（圆盘、高斯、心肺模型）展现出强泛化能力，10%噪声下误差变化极小。相比监督训练CNN（在辅助低分辨率目标上训练），未训练CNN在压力和声速重建误差上均显著更小，且计算时间仅需约1.26小时，是训练CNN（约7.52小时）的六分之一。

Conclusion: 固定随机卷积特征与系数空间正则化相结合，为光声联合反问题提供了一种有效、计算高效且经验稳定的重建策略。该方法无需优化卷积滤波器，避免了监督训练的目标不匹配问题，在分布外泛化和噪声稳定性方面均表现出色。未来工作将研究模型失配的鲁棒性、更真实的声学模型，以及实验与三维光声数据。

Abstract: The joint reconstruction of the initial pressure and spatially varying sound speed in photoacoustic tomography from boundary measurements is considered. A regularized data-driven framework is proposed in which the unknown fields are represented in finite-dimensional wavelet spaces and fixed nonlinear features generated by an untrained convolutional neural network (CNN) are used to reconstruct the initial-pressure coefficients through Tikhonov-regularized least squares. A learned coefficient-space prior is subsequently used to infer the squared sound-speed coefficients. Numerical experiments demonstrate accurate reconstruction on held-out data and strong generalization to previously unseen phantom geometries. The frozen reconstruction map also remains stable under measurement noise not represented during training, with only minor changes in reconstruction accuracy for noise levels up to $10\%$. In comparison with the supervised trained-CNN approach considered in this work, the untrained representation yields substantially smaller reconstruction errors while requiring approximately one-sixth of the computational time. These results demonstrate that fixed random convolutional features combined with regularized coefficient-space learning provide an efficient and robust approach to joint reconstruction in photoacoustic tomography.

</details>


### [216] [Peak-Memory Schedules You Can Trust: Exact Realization, Certified Optimality, and the Limits of Recomputation for Inference](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23328)
*Ivan Fomin,Ivan Koryabkin,Boris Sheludko*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文针对边缘设备实时推理场景的激活内存峰值优化问题，指出当前主流做法（将更好的算子顺序交回编译器并重新生成代码）不可靠，提出"固定wrapper实现"方法直接在已生成程序上置换语句以精确实现建模的峰值；同时给出前向与反向"陷阱"下界及其证书，判定何时调度已最优；最后研究带算子级重计算上限的选择性重计算，给出复杂度刻画。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 边缘设备（手机、助听器、微控制器）上实时推理需在不增加延迟的前提下压缩激活内存。算子顺序与低成本重计算是"时间免费"的内存杠杆，但当前编译器（PyTorch Inductor）将更优顺序重新生成代码后，在54个CPU配置中有22个未达预测峰值、9个反而劣于默认程序，在50个GPU配置中19个变差且改变数值结果，缺乏可信的下界证书，且选择性重计算的代价与极限不清晰。

Method: 1) 固定wrapper实现：剖析生成的wrapper，对每条语句构建精确的根模型（分配大小、瞬态包络、读写效应），在依赖约束下置换语句位置；满足六条契约条件时（区域级效应完整、所有权与完成性如记录、各算子确定性、分配序列如记录、与周围活存无关即"帧条件"、发射不引入其他事件）证明所得峰值与模型峰值逐字节一致并保持位级相同结果。2) 前向与反向"陷阱"下界：分别就任意真理想R取其前沿F(R)中min fv(R)取大、就任意非空理想T取其最大元min qv(T)取大；均可由O(n²)次最小割计算，并都支配经典事件割下界G；给出独立验证器。3) 选择性重计算建模为每算子重计算上限kv，给出：(i) 在固定均匀上限、树宽≤2时峰值可行性仍强NP完备；(ii) 二端串并图、出度≤2、均匀上限2下的最小额外功严格等价0-1背包；(iii) 有界树宽下时间f(t,K,B)·poly(n,L)的精确DP算法，使用完整事件字+典型序约简作为接口。

Result: CPU编译训练：全部78次训练、22次推理运行中固定wrapper实现的预测误差为0字节，输出与梯度与stock程序逐位相同；Transformer enc-dec峰值降低7.6%，多数Transformer类模型1.3–4.7%。CPU推理：22个配置中21个证书证明stock顺序已最优；唯一例外DeepLabV3-ResNet50@512²峰值降10.0%。微控制器级16个模型证书均证明TFLite Micro模型顺序最优，且峰值恰等于单个算子的输入加输出下界，故全张量级重计算无效。GPU（RTX 2080 Ti、CUDA 12.6）：50个配置中逻辑节省与CPU一致，但因CUDA缓存分配器的块大小与历史相关、20 MiB可扩展段吸收改动，块级预测仅在49个中的17个精确；启用"若不优则保持stock"的guard后均不退化，平均节省0.92%。ReDimNet（B0–B6）七个尺寸：顺序均已最优，对stem做一次重计算后峰值降5.2–6.1%，额外MACs≤0.34%，输出逐位相同；B3、B6的贪心arena因碎片未能完全变现。证书：在122个wrapper图上115个（94%）证明找到的顺序最优，16个微控制器类模型全部证明最优；与CP-SAT精确模型一致率91/94，速度更快（中位0.004 s，CP-SAT 0.02 s）。下界比较：800个≤14顶点的随机DAG上相对精确OPT的最大比例1.23（random）至1.50（对抗性爬坡）；反向界在所有in-tree与training形图上均紧。

Conclusion: 将调度落实在已编译程序上的固定wrapper实现在CPU上可逐字节精确、无副作用地实现预测峰值；前向与反向陷阱下界给出多项式时间、独立可验证的最优性证书，使"何时停止调度"可被工程化回答：对绝大多数推理图证书即已说明stock顺序最优，分支网络（DeepLabV3）是少数能通过重排序获益的例外。重计算受限于其本身计算复杂度（强NP难，背包等价），在峰值由单层主导的微控制器模型上无效，但在持有廉价值供后期复用的结构（ReDimNet）上能以极小额外计算获得真实节省。自然的延续是带显式延迟预算与最优性证书的"瓦片级"调度。本文亦指出OPT/max(F,R)是否有界仍为公开问题。

Abstract: Real-time inference on small devices needs low activation memory without extra latency, which makes operator order the most valuable memory lever: it is free in time. We show that the usual way of deploying a better order, handing it back to the compiler and regenerating code, is unreliable. In PyTorch Inductor the regenerated program misses its predicted peak in 22 of 54 CPU configurations. It is worse than the stock program in 9 of them and in 19 of 50 on a GPU, and on the GPU it also changes numerical results. We instead profile the generated program, model its memory exactly from its own statements and their read/write effects, and permute those statements. We prove that this realizes the modeled peak whenever allocation does not depend on history. It does so to the byte, with bitwise-identical results, in all our CPU runs. On the GPU we characterize why the caching allocator breaks the condition. To know when to stop, we give forward and reverse "trap" lower bounds, each computable with $O(n^2)$ minimum cuts. They certify the found order optimal for 94% of held-out wrapper graphs and all 16 microcontroller-class models we study, in under a second. So most inference graphs are already scheduled optimally. Branching networks are the exception, where reordering is free and pays, e.g. 10.0% on DeepLabV3. In compiled training we save up to 7.6%. Beyond the certified optimum we study selective recomputation with per-operator caps. It is strongly NP-hard for every fixed cap even at treewidth two, encodes knapsack exactly on series-parallel graphs, and is solvable exactly on bounded treewidth. It is useless on public tiny models whose peak is a single layer, but on architectures that hold a cheap value for a late reuse it pays: on the public ReDimNet speaker networks, whose order is already optimal, it lowers the peak by 5.2-6.1% at under 0.4% extra MACs, with bitwise-identical outputs.

</details>


### [217] [HiPredict: Predicting the missing HiRISE RED4 spectral channel with machine learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23335)
*Ardan Suphi,Ben Moseley,Gareth S Collins,Valentin T Bickel,Vidhya G Rangarajan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出HiPredict，一种基于U-Net的机器学习框架，用于重建因2023年失效的HiRISE RED4探测器缺失的火星高分辨率图像数据。该模型通过融合IR10/BG12共定位波段、邻接红波段观测和采集元数据，捕捉波段间非线性的时空-光谱关系。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Mars Reconnaissance Orbiter（MRO）上的RED4探测器自2023年起间歇性失效，导致HiRISE相机色红外成像中心出现缺口（地面约500–600 m），使色成像能力减半。现有解决方案SYN4通过对IR10通道进行亮度缩放生成合成红通道，但无法捕获波段间已观测到的非线性关系，精度和应用受限。因此需要一种能够学习非线性时空-光谱关系并准确重建RED4数据的方法。

Method: HiPredict采用残差U-Net架构作为空间头（负责重建高频空间细节），并配合一个独立的亮度校准头（基于局部IR10/BG12均值、邻接探测器校准和元数据，通过可学习残差校正初始校准基线）。模型输入包括三部分：（1）共定位的IR10和BG12波段图像；（2）利用CCD间约48像素重叠拼接的邻接IR10/RED/BG三波段阵列；（3）9项采集元数据变量。训练数据来自约2万次观测，共81,717个256×256像素的patch。损失函数为加权组合（全局L1、均值L1、梯度差损失、局部L1、低频L1）。优化器采用AdamW，恒定学习率1.5e-3，batch size=64。模型约286万参数。

Result: 在23,348个测试样本（3,892次失效前观测）上的评估结果：HiPredict的归一化平均绝对误差（NMAE）为1.11%，显著优于SYN4的3.12%（改进约2.8倍）。SSIM达0.725（高出SYN4约9%），1%容差内像素比例（PWT 1%）约为SYN4的两倍（20.84% vs 11.07%）。在高SYN4误差（>10%）的复杂图像上改进可达7.7倍。下游科学应用评估：在冰撞击坑（10例）上NMAE从9.95%降至1.68%；多边形脊光谱（8例）从5.16%降至1.32；氯化物沉积（8例）从3.03%降至1.37%。深度评估显示，HiPredict可可靠识别水冰像素（基于BG/RED与水冰波段比参数），而SYN4因系统性低估红波段DN值无法实现。SHAP分析表明入射角、航天器高度和方位角是对性能影响最稳健的三项元数据。误差分解显示，剩余残差主要为高频细节（69.6%），可能源于不可恢复的仪器噪声和IR通道分bin效应。

Conclusion: HiPredict成功证明机器学习可用于学习不同波段间的可泛化光谱关系，恢复因老化失效的行星仪器数据。相比SYN4，其在空间结构、辐射精度和光谱保真度方面均有显著提升，能够支持水冰识别等关键科学任务。研究意义超越具体应用——展示机器学习在缓解老化行星任务数据丢失方面的潜力，并为未来仪器设计（如通过ML预测填充全幅三波段色成像）和跨仪器、跨分辨率光谱插值（如构建火星"虚拟卫星"）提供了思路。模型权重、数据集和软件均以开源形式发布。

Abstract: The High Resolution Imaging Science Experiment (HiRISE) onboard the Mars Reconnaissance Orbiter (MRO) acquires imagery of Mars at 25--30 cm/pixel, supporting studies of martian geology, climate history, and landing-site characterization. Its 14-detector focal plane assembly includes several overlapping detectors that enable the acquisition of three-channel colour-infrared images, which are important for identifying compositional variations and studying active surface processes. In 2023, a detector in the center of the focal plane assembly (RED4) began failing intermittently, creating a gap in acquired imagery and reducing the instrument's colour-imaging capability by half. The HiRISE processing pipeline provides a synthetic red (SYN4) channel obtained by linearly scaling the co-located infrared (IR10) channel. However, this approach cannot capture observed non-linear relationships between the colour channels, limiting its accuracy and applicability. Here, we present HiPredict, a machine-learning framework that reconstructs RED4 from co-located IR10 and blue-green (BG12) imagery, neighbouring red-channel observations, and acquisition metadata. The model employs a U-Net architecture to learn non-linear spatiotemporal-spectral relationships between these inputs and is trained on 81,717 training samples, representing 13,625 observations. Evaluated on 23,348 test samples, representing 3,892 pre-failure observations, HiPredict reconstructs RED4 with a Normalised Mean Absolute Error of 1.1%, substantially outperforming SYN4 (3.1%). The reconstructed products improve colour image recovery and more closely represent features of interest such as icy craters, stratigraphy exposed along ridge crests and chloride deposits. We release HiPredict as an open software tool. This work demonstrates the potential of machine learning to mitigate data loss as planetary missions age and naturally degrade.

</details>


### [218] [Minimax-optimal Scaling Laws in Ridge Regression via Transfer Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23337)
*Yalda Shabanzadeh,Diyuan Wu,Marco Mondelli*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究高维线性回归中迁移学习的缩放定律，证明在特定参数范围内，先用源数据做岭回归预训练、再用目标数据以L2正则化微调的两步过程能达到联合使用两个数据集的minimax最优速率，且最优源正则化仅依赖于源数据，具有跨任务的普适性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 预训练模型在下游任务中被广泛复用，但迁移学习相对于单数据集训练在缩放定律上能带来多大性能提升，以及源模型应如何训练以获得这些收益，缺乏系统的理论刻画。现有工作未能明确迁移学习何时能获得严格优于单数据集的速率衰减。

Method: 在高维线性回归框架下，源估计器通过岭回归获得，目标模型以L2距离源估计器为正则化。在模型与协方差偏移下建立目标风险的确定性等价（deterministic equivalent），并在幂律协方差谱和共享回归函数的设定下推导缩放定律。同时将分析推广到以源估计器初始化的一遍随机梯度下降（SGD）。在合成数据、MNIST/CIFAR-10的PCA特征以及GPT-2语言模型上进行实验验证。

Result: 在δ>1且γc<γn<1的参数区间内，迁移学习通过岭回归达到了联合使用两个数据集的minimax最优速率Γ_TL=(δ-1+γn)/δ，且最优源正则化λ_sr≍n_sr^{1-a}仅依赖于源数据，对所有目标任务普适。此外，一遍SGD使用几何学习率调度并以同一源正则化初始化，也达到了相同的minimax最优速率。合成实验和语言模型实验均验证了理论预测。

Conclusion: 该工作系统刻画了高维回归中迁移学习的缩放优势：协方差谱和样本量共同决定何时迁移能严格改善速率衰减，且存在与目标无关的最优源估计器，这一普适性对岭回归和SGD微调均成立。实验表明类似现象可出现在语言模型中，提示理论发现具有一定的普适性。未来方向包括将分析推广到分类以及通过随机特征模型引入模型容量的影响。

Abstract: Pretrained models are often reused across downstream tasks, motivating the question of whether this transfer learning procedure can provide a substantial performance improvement, namely, in terms of the scaling law. We address this question in the prototypical setting of high-dimensional regression, where (i) a pretrained \emph{source} model is trained via ridge regression, and (ii) a fine-tuned \emph{target} model is regularized via the $L_2$ distance from the source estimator. First, we establish a deterministic equivalent for the risk of this two-step procedure under both model and covariance shift. Next, by specializing the deterministic equivalent to a shared regression function and commuting power-law covariance spectra, we identify a regime where the resulting scaling law achieves the minimax-optimal exponent. Notably, in this regime, the optimal source regularization depends on source data only, indicating its universality across all targets. Furthermore, we show that the same optimal rate is achieved by performing the fine-tuning step via one-pass stochastic gradient descent. We support our theoretical analysis via experiments on both synthetic settings and language models.

</details>


### [219] [SETAREH Transform: A Sorting-Assisted Haar-Wavelet Sparsification Method for Approximate Inner-Product Computation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23338)
*Seyed Kamaledin Setarehdan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: SETAREH是一种基于Haar小波变换的稀疏化方法，通过排序和Haar变换重新组织固定权重向量与输入向量的内积计算，使得仅保留少量变换域系数即可高精度近似内积，从而减少高维输入向量的存储、传输和处理开销。SETAREH-5变体在中等保留数量下显著优于SETAREH-3，且该方法特别适用于同一固定权重被多次复用的场景（如边缘推理、分布式计算）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 深度神经网络中，固定权重向量与大量输入向量反复进行内积运算，带来巨大的存储、内存带宽和通信开销，尤其在边缘和分布式环境中。现有模型压缩方法（剪枝、量化、知识蒸馏）主要针对模型参数而非输入数据，因此需要一种能直接减少每次内积所需输入数据量的补充型数据缩减方法。

Method: SETAREH利用内积的排列不变性，对固定权重向量先排序使相似值相邻，再施加正交Haar离散小波变换（HDWT）使能量集中，最后通过截断仅保留前K个变换域系数-输入对来近似内积。SETAREH-3执行一次排序+HDWT+第二次排序；SETAREH-5再增加一轮排序+HDWT。排列与HDWT均为正交操作，故截断前内积完全精确，误差仅来自截断。采用条件中位相对误差（CMRE）作为主要度量，排除最小10% |S|的近零样本。

Result: 合成高斯向量实验（维度1024–65536）显示：K≥30时SETAREH-5在所有维度100%优于SETAREH-3，K=200时误差降低因子达44.9–94.4倍；在N=4096时达到1% CMRE目标，SETAREH-5仅需K=30（CR*=136.53），比SETAREH-3的K=200（CR*=20.48）高约6.67倍压缩。APPA-REAL真实场景（VGG16 fc2 4096维特征+Ridge回归表观年龄估计）中，K=75（1.83%）测试集CMRE=0.133%，K=200（4.88%）CMRE=0.008%。存储分析显示：单输入时SETAREH因排列开销增加约52.7%存储；但M≥2时即开始节省（22.3%），M=1000时节省达97.1%。

Conclusion: SETAREH作为一种结构化数据表示方法，能有效减少重复内积运算中需要存储/传输的输入数据量；其优势在固定权重被大量输入复用的场景下随输入数增加而显著提升。然而，CR*仅为系数级压缩比，未计入排列元数据开销；当前实现未证明可减少算术运算量。实际收益取决于近似精度与排列元数据成本的权衡。未来工作需开发排列元数据的高效编码，并开展硬件感知的端到端延迟、能耗评估。

Abstract: Modern deep learning systems increasingly rely on high-dimensional vector operations, in which large input and parameter vectors are repeatedly stored, transferred, and processed. Although substantial research has focused on reducing neural-network model size through pruning, quantization, knowledge distillation, and efficient architectures, the storage, memory-traffic, and communication costs associated with repeatedly presented high-dimensional input vectors remain important practical considerations, particularly in distributed and edge-computing environments. This paper proposes the SETAREH (Sorting-assisted Energy-concentrating Transform for Approximate Representation using Haar wavelets) transform, a Haar-wavelet-based sparsification approach for approximating the inner product between a fixed high-dimensional coefficient vector and successive input vectors. By applying the same sequence of permutations and Haar transforms to both vectors, SETAREH preserves the exact inner product before truncation. It then retains only a subset of the transformed coefficient-input pairs, reducing their representation cost while introducing a controllable approximation error. To evaluate SETAREH, we consider two complementary experimental settings: a synthetic Gaussian-vector baseline and a real apparent-age estimation task using a convolutional neural network on the APPA-REAL dataset. The results show that SETAREH can approximate the evaluated inner products using substantially fewer transformed coefficient-input pairs than the original vector dimension. The findings support its use as a potential structured data-representation method for repeated inner products with fixed weights, while the practical benefit depends on approximation accuracy and the cost of storing or transmitting permutation metadata.

</details>


### [220] [How Finite-Rank Bottlenecks Shape the Low-Rank Adaptation Landscape](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23343)
*Long Nguyen-Chi,Quynh Nguyen,Thanh Nguyen-Cung,Binh T. Nguyen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文从理论上解释了为什么 LoRA（低秩适应）能够在不进行网络线性化的前提下使用低秩更新。作者提出核心观察：当骨干网络被冻结后，损失函数只能通过冻结激活诱导的有限秩线性映射观察到每个被适应的权重矩阵。借助迹范数正则化与 Barvinok-Pataki 秩界，证明全局极小解的秩由"瓶颈秩"（该线性映射的秩）控制，而非样本量。针对多头注意力，利用 softmax 行不变性与注意力加权后的冻结输出投影，得到更紧的每头秩上界。进一步对因子化 LoRA 带权重衰减的目标，证明在任意小的 PSD 扰动后，几乎所有一阶稳定点都是秩亏的，且扰动后全局极小解对原迹范数问题近似最优。还通过冻结特征的谱结构给出了均匀泛化界。实验在 GLUE 任务上使用 Qwen2.5-1.5B 验证了秩阈值效应。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 LoRA 理论分析主要依赖 NTK 线性化框架，未能从根本上解释为什么低秩更新足以实现参数高效微调。本文希望从损失函数本身的结构出发，回答"在什么条件下正则化微调目标本身就承认低秩全局极小解，以及什么控制了解的秩"这一更结构性的问题。

Method: 核心方法基于一个简单观察：冻结骨干网络后，每个适应块 T 仅通过冻结特征矩阵 H 诱导的有限秩线性映射 Φ(T)=TH 被损失函数观察到。利用迹范数正则化通过 PSD 提升和 Barvinok-Pataki 秩界，证明秩上界 r(r+1)/2 ≤ d_Φ。对于多头注意力，利用两个不变性：(1) 行 softmax 对加性行常数不敏感；(2) 值更新仅在注意力加权与冻结输出投影后被观察到，通过投影压缩获得更紧秩界。对于非凸因子化 LoRA，引入 PSD 扰动并利用维数计数与流形测度零引理，证明一阶稳定点的秩亏排除结果。最后通过迹/谱对偶性获得基于 ‖EH⊤‖₂ 的均匀泛化界。

Result: 主要理论结果包括：(1) 单块定理 4.1：全局极小解秩受瓶颈秩 d_Φ 控制；(2) 多层定理 4.3 及其多头注意力推论 4.4：利用注意力不变性获得逐头 Q/K/V 秩证书；(3) 定理 4.7：因子化 LoRA 在小 PSD 扰动后，一阶稳定点秩亏；(4) 定理 4.10：扰动后全局极小解对原迹范数问题近似最优；(5) 定理 B.5/B.8：基于冻结特征谱结构的均匀泛化界。实验在 GLUE（MNLI/SST-2/RTE）上使用 Qwen2.5-1.5B 验证了预测的秩阈值效应，低于阈值的秩显示出明显较差且不同的收敛轨迹，而达到或超过阈值的秩紧密聚集并接近全微调的最终损失。

Conclusion: 本文识别出 LoRA 通过冻结激活将更新投影到低维子空间而运作的有限秩机制。这一结构使迹范数正则化在所有产生相同观测输出的更新中选择低秩代表，从而无需 NTK 线性化即可获得全局低秩极小解，且秩界由瓶颈维度而非训练参数总量控制。对注意力模块，利用 softmax 行不变性与值投影压缩给出了更紧的每头秩证书。小扰动在非凸 LoRA 中排除满秩稳定点同时保持近似最优性。主要局限性：秩定理保证的是迹范数目标极小解的存在，而非基于梯度的 LoRA 收敛；注意力秩界是后验的；秩亏定理仅为扰动目标的一阶结论；命题 4.9 表明伪局部极小仍可能存在。

Abstract: Low-rank adaptation (LoRA) has become the standard method for parameter-efficient fine-tuning of large pretrained models, yet theoretical explanations for why low-rank updates suffice remain incomplete. Most existing analyses rely on the Neural Tangent Kernel (NTK) regime, which linearizes the network around the pretrained weights. In this work, we take a different approach that requires no linearization: our key observation is that, once the backbone is frozen, the loss sees each adapted weight matrix only through a finite-rank linear map induced by the frozen activations. Trace-norm regularization then forces the optimizer to pick a low-rank matrix among all matrices that produce the same observed output. This yields global minimizers whose ranks are controlled by the rank of this map, which we call the \emph{bottleneck rank}, rather than the sample size. For multi-head attention, we obtain tighter rank upper bounds by exploiting two additional invariances: row-wise softmax is insensitive to additive row constants in the score matrix, and value updates are observable only after attention weighting and frozen output projection. For the factorized LoRA objective with weight decay, we prove a complementary result on the nonconvex side: after an arbitrarily small generic positive semidefinite perturbation, every first-order stationary point is rank-deficient once the LoRA rank exceeds a threshold determined by the bottleneck rank. Finally, we show that global minimizers of the perturbed objective are near-optimal for the original trace-norm problem, and we provide uniform generalization bounds governed by the spectral structure of the frozen features.

</details>


### [221] [RTSM: Adapting Recursive Models to Multivariate Time-Series Classification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23353)
*Georg Tenzing,Anna Tegon,Luca Benini,Thorir Mar Ingolfsson*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出RTSM（Recursive Time-Series Model），将递归推理架构（基于TRM）适配到多元时间序列分类任务。其结合卷积时间分词器、权重共享的单状态递归细化模块和池化分类读出头，在UEA全部30个数据集上达到72.81%的平均准确率，优于17个深度学习基线模型。核心贡献在于识别出时间编码和状态组织是将递归架构适配到时间序列的关键设计选择。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多元时间序列分类（TSC）需要在不同长度的序列中提取时间特征并整合信息。权重共享的递归架构（如HRM、TRM）通过重复使用同一模块实现深度计算而不增加参数量，但如何将其适配到时间序列任务面临两个设计问题：如何表示连续时间输入，以及在输出为单一序列级标签时是否需要双状态结构。

Method: RTSM架构由三部分组成：(1) 卷积时间分词器——使用通道投影、门控残差卷积、密集连接扩张卷积和补丁投影将原始时间序列编码为token；(2) 单状态权重共享细化模块——通过重复应用非因果多头自注意力+SwiGLU MLP的两块模块来更新一个潜在状态y，添加输入token X后再做循环，每个监督步骤包含H=3个循环；(3) 序列级读出头——采用与MambaSL相同的可学习加权池化产生分类logits和终止logit。训练采用TRM的深度监督和正确性终止策略（最多16步），推理使用固定48次细化迭代。参数仅680万，可重复使用48次。

Result: 在UEA全部30个数据集的验证协议下，RTSM达到72.81%平均准确率，为17个评估模型中最高，超过MambaSL（71.21%）1.60个百分点；在MambaSL协议下达到80.82%，超过MambaSL（79.82%）1.00个百分点。在8个数据集的消融中：RTSM分词器优于简单Conv1D嵌入（86.10% vs 84.79%），单状态模型优于双状态变体（86.10% vs 84.98%/84.29%），完整模型比纯分词器分类器高1.31个百分点。推理预算分析显示额外深度仅带来0.23百分点提升，确定性推理优于随机选择策略。

Conclusion: RTSM成功将权重共享递归推理架构适配到多元时间序列分类，通过学习卷积时间分词器、单状态细化和池化读出的组合，在UEA档案上取得竞争性准确率。该架构的核心优势是参数数量独立于计算深度——同一680万参数细化模块可被调用48次（相比独立权重需要3.27亿参数，节省48倍权重存储），这为边缘设备和GPU推理中的权重驻留提供了硬件感知的实现机会。研究还发现，时间编码和状态组织是将递归架构适配到时间序列任务的关键设计选择，而确定性推理在最大预算下优于测试的随机选择策略。

Abstract: Accurate multivariate time-series classification requires extracting temporal features and integrating information across a sequence. Weight-tied refinement offers a way to repeatedly process these features without allocating new parameters at each stage. Applying this principle to time series requires choosing both a temporal representation and a latent-state organization suited to classification. We introduce the Recursive Time-Series Model (RTSM), which combines a learned convolutional temporal tokenizer, single-state weight-tied refinement, and a pooled classification readout. Across all 30 UEA datasets, RTSM achieves 72.81% mean accuracy under validation-based configuration and checkpoint selection, the highest observed mean among the 17 evaluated deep-learning models and 1.60 percentage points above MambaSL. Ablations on eight datasets favor the proposed tokenizer over a simple convolutional embedding and the single-state model over the tested two-state variants. The complete classifier reaches 86.10% mean accuracy versus 84.79% for a separately trained tokenizer-only classifier. These findings identify temporal encoding and state organization as key design choices for adapting recursive architectures to time series. The resulting classifier combines competitive accuracy with a shared refinement module whose parameter count is independent of computational depth.

</details>


### [222] [Forecasting Voltage Time Series under Anomalies Using a WGAN Model With Lipschitz Control and Progressive Kernel Critic Strategy](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23394)
*Najmieh Sadat Safarabadi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出WGAN-CLP模型，融合渐进式Lipschitz惩罚与自适应Transformative Kernel Critic，用于高维、非平稳电压时间序列的递归预测与异常鲁棒建模，并在多源PMU数据集上进行系统验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 针对高维时间序列递归预测中误差累积与概念漂移问题，以及经典GAN在序列任务中的训练不稳定与模式崩溃，提出一种兼具稳定性与时序依赖建模能力的生成式预测方法。

Method: Wasserstein GAN框架 + 渐进式Lipschitz正则（PL）动态约束 + 自适应Transformative Kernel Critic（自适应核评估器）+ Type Transfer Triple Data Learning特征变换 + EMD数据分解；评价指标包括MSE、KL、Wasserstein距离、FID、JS散度与鲁棒性指标。

Result: M4b（AK-LP, τ=0.95）在Fidelity98.9%、KL降低74.6%、Wasserstein距离降低73.2%、FID降低77.7%、收敛速度提升60%（38 epoch）等指标上全面优于WGAN-WC/WGAN-GP等基线，并在异常子集上保持94.2%的鲁棒性（MSE仅增加75%）。

Conclusion: 自适应核与渐进Lipschitz约束有效稳定了WGAN训练、改善了时序依赖建模，使合成数据具备高保真度与异常鲁棒性，适用于电网监控的合成数据生成与下游任务预训练，但跨域（不同采样频率）泛化仍需域适应策略。

Abstract: In time-series forecasting tasks, the use of recursive forecasting on high-dimensional data substantially increases the complexity of the prediction process. The main challenge is that long-term dynamics becomes harder to model, since the sequences show greater temporal variability. To counteract this limitation and improve the modeling of long-term dynamics, and more importantly, address high-dimensional recursive forecasting, this paper uses a Wasserstein GAN equipped with a progressive Lipschitz penalty and an adaptive kernel. This model is capable of taking a window of the data stream and forecasting the next values, subsequently reconstructing the time-series stream and dynamically adapting its kernel to each new window. The proopsed model is a deep learning framework based on a Wasserstein GAN (WGAN-CLP) with an adaptive kernel to model alterations in streaming voltage time series. To establish the methodological foundation, we review the WGAN-LP formulation another variant model in this class and extend its framework through an adaptive kernel critic model. We then evaluate this extended model using power ratios, correlation coefficient (CC), and relative root mean squared error (RRMSE). The experimental results demonstrate that the proposed model outperforms benchmark methods in both accuracy and robustness. The evaluation shows promising performance of the WGAN-CLP with an adaptive kernel framework in forecasting sequence alterations across the voltage and energy time-series datasets.

</details>


### [223] [Contracting with an Agent under Model Mismatch](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23402)
*Elif Yılmaz,Jakub Tłuczek,Victor Villin,Christos Dimitrakakis*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文研究了主从马尔可夫决策过程（PAMDP）中，当智能体（agent）持有与环境真实转移模型不一致的错位信念（misspecified beliefs）时的合同设计问题。作者提出了一种基于贝叶斯学习的框架，通过反推归纳法和线性规划求解最小支付合同，并分析候选模型集选择对学习过程的影响。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在传统PAMDP设定中，假设委托方（principal）和智能体共享同一转移模型。但在现实中，智能体往往基于对环境的不准确认知做出决策，导致系统性次优行为。忽视这种信念错位会使委托方设计出次优合同，甚至导致合同被拒绝。因此，需要探索能够应对模型错位的合同设计机制，特别在人机协作场景中尤为重要。

Method: 1. **完全信息下的最优解**：基于反推归纳法和线性规划，在已知智能体转移模型 µᴬ 的情况下，求解每个状态-动作对的最小支付合同，确保激励相容性（IC）和有限责任（LL）约束。终端步 H 通过最小化 µᴾ 加权的合同支付求解，逐步反推至初始步。
2. **贝叶斯学习框架**：委托方持有真实转移模型 µᴬ，但对智能体模型存在不确定性，假设其能访问有限候选模型集 ℳ。委托方保持后验分布 Pₜ，通过观察轨迹 ξₜ（包含状态、动作、下一状态），使用贝叶斯规则更新后验。由于状态转移由真实动力学 µᴬ 决定，观测到的转移对区分智能体模型帮助有限，因此对数似然基于智能体在给定模型下的诱导策略概率计算。
3. **候选模型集构建**：通过以 (εµᴬ + (1-ε)µᴾ) 为中心的狄利克雷分布采样生成候选模型，控制参数 ε 调节模型集的偏向。
4. **实验设置**：|𝒮|=5，|𝒜|=3，T=200 episode，奖励和成本从 [0,1] 随机采样，合同支付约束在 [0,2]。评估指标包括：累积遗憾（regret）、KL 散度估计精度、合同 MSE。

Result: 1. **模型错位对合同的影响**（图2）：当委托方和智能体持有相同信念时，委托方可以以较低合同支付诱导期望行为；存在信念错位时，委托方需提供更高支付以弥补模型差异。但智能体基于错位模型高估自身收益，按真实动力学评估时实际收益低于预期。委托方则在真实动力学下实现了更高效用。
2. **候选模型集的影响**（图3、4、5）：当候选模型集包含智能体真实模型 µᴬ 时，只要交互步数 H 足够，后验分布能收敛到 µᴬ，KL 散度和合同距离均收敛，遗憾降低。当模型集不含 µᴬ 时，使用玻尔兹曼 softmax 策略更新后验，KL 散度不再收敛，但遗憾仍能反映学习效果，且包含更接近 µᴬ 的模型的集合（Set 1、2）始终带来更低遗憾。
3. **关键发现**：准确学习智能体动力学对有效合同设计至关重要；学习模型上的细微差异可能导致合同支付和委托方损失的显著变化；遗憾是衡量学习效果更具信息量的指标。

Conclusion: 本文提出了PAMDP中应对智能体错位信念的合同设计框架，通过贝叶斯学习估计智能体转移模型来近似最优合同。理论贡献在于对信念错位下合同设计最优解的重新公式化。实验验证了所提方法的有效性，并揭示了候选模型集选择对学习动态和合同性能的影响。未来工作方向包括：（1）将分析扩展到连续模型空间；（2）探讨利用合同设计本身来推断智能体错位信念；（3）建立学习框架的理论保证；（4）扩展到委托方无法直接观察智能体动作的情形。

Abstract: In the classical principal-agent setting, the principal delegates some task to the agent, who receives a payment conditioned on the outcome of the task, which in turn benefits the principal. To align their objectives, the principal designs a contract that incentivizes the agent to take actions beneficial to the principal. In practice, however, the agent may act under misspecified beliefs about the underlying environment, leading to systematically suboptimal decisions. In this work, we study this problem through a principal-agent Markov Decision Process (PAMDP), in which the principal repeatedly interacts with an agent whose transition model may differ from the true environment dynamics. The principal has access to the true transition model and designs contracts that account for the agent's belief and incentives. We characterize contract design under model mismatch and develop a framework that enables the principal to induce desirable long-term benefits even though the agent has a potentially inaccurate understanding of the environment.

</details>


### [224] [Information Estimation with Discrete Diffusion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23404)
*Alberto Foresti,Giulio Franzese,Pietro Michiardi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出InfoSEDD，一种基于离散扩散的信息论估计方法，利用连续时间马尔可夫链(CTMC)理论计算KL散度，用于高维离散数据的互信息(MI)和熵估计，无需将离散数据嵌入连续空间。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的信息论估计方法在处理高维离散数据时面临挑战：传统方法依赖将离散数据嵌入连续空间并使用针对连续分布设计的神经估计器，这一"嵌入技巧"需要针对特定应用的工程设计，且在高维场景下性能下降。需要一种原生支持离散数据、可利用现有离散扩散模型预训练成果的MI和熵估计方法。

Method: InfoSEDD基于连续时间马尔可夫链(CTMC)框架和Dynkin公式推导KL散度的估计公式(方程5)。设计两种变体：InfoSEDD-j(联合法，利用KL[p_{XY}||m_{XY}])和InfoSEDD-c(条件法，利用E[KL[p_{Y|X}||p_Y]])。关键技术包括：(1)采用吸收态(absorbing state)的转移矩阵Q^{tok}_t=σ(t)Q^{tok}_{absorb}，使得单个联合分布训练的评分模型可同时获得边际评分(方程6)；(2)利用稀疏速率矩阵，仅考虑Hamming距离为1的序列转换，降低计算复杂度；(3)基于DWDSE损失训练评分网络。理论分析给出了估计误差上界(方程7)，包含估计误差(与评分误差成线性关系)和截断偏差(随时间指数衰减)两部分。还扩展了熵估计器InfoSEDD-h。

Result: 在高维合成基准测试中(MI从10到50，维度D从10到50)，InfoSEDD在所有设定下均显著优于竞争对手(NWJ、kl-dime、hd-dime、gan-dime、MINDE、MINE、SMILE)，在MI=50, D=50时估计47.77±1.18 (真实值50)，而多数竞争方法估计值远低于真实值。在极端维度场景(D=1024)下，竞争方法MI估计全部崩溃为0，而InfoSEDD仍给出0.53 (真实值0.5)。文本摘要任务中，使用SummEval数据集，InfoSEDD-c在一致性(correlation)指标上与人类评分的Pearson相关性达0.740，Kendall's Tau达0.505，显著优于所有竞争方法，且无需学习额外的嵌入模型。基因组应用中，在human vs worm分类一致性测试中，InfoSEDD-c最接近基于分类器的参考MI值；在Arabidopsis thaliana启动子TATA-box基序识别中，InfoSEDD能准确定位基序位置(-39到-26区域)，且对相关基序具有鲁棒性。Ising模型熵估计中，InfoSEDD在低温(大KL散度)场景下表现优异。InfoSEDD还具有更低的内存占用和更快的收敛速度。

Conclusion: InfoSEDD是一种可扩展、一致且准确的离散数据信息论度量估计方法，能够有效估计高维离散数据的互信息和熵，克服了传统"嵌入技巧"的局限性。其理论保证(估计误差界)表明该方法是具有指数衰减偏差的一致估计器。该方法可无缝集成预训练离散扩散模型，在文本摘要模型选择、基因组基序发现、Ising模型熵估计等任务中展现出实用价值，为离散数据的信息论分析提供了新工具。未来可扩展至混合连续/离散数据的场景。

Abstract: Information-theoretic measures, such as Mutual Information (MI), play a crucial role in understanding non-linear relationships between random variables and are widely used across scientific disciplines. Yet, their use on real-world discrete data remains challenging. Existing methods typically rely on embedding discrete data into a continuous space and apply neural estimators originally designed for continuous distributions. This process requires careful engineering for both the embedding model and estimator architecture, but suffers from issues related to high data dimensionality. In this work, we introduce InfoSEDD, a discrete diffusion-based approach that bridges information-theoretic estimation and generative modeling such that they can be used to compute Kullback-Leibler divergences. Backed by Continuous Time Markov Chains theory principles, the design of InfoSEDD is lightweight and scalable and allows seamless integration with pretrained models. We showcase the versatility of our approach through applications on motif discovery in genetic promoter data, semantic-aware model selection in text summarization, and entropy estimation in Ising models. Finally, we construct consistency tests on real-world textual and genomics data. Our experiments demonstrate that InfoSEDD outperforms alternatives that rely on the "embedding trick". Our results position InfoSEDD as a robust and scalable tool for information-theoretic analysis of discrete data.

</details>


### [225] [Residual Stochastic Concept Bottleneck Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23421)
*Stephen Marcou,Mateo Espinosa Zarlenga,Sonia Laguna,Moritz Vandenhirtz,Julia E. Vogt,Mateja Jamnik*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出Res-SCBM（残差随机概念瓶颈模型），通过多元高斯分布联合建模概念与残差变量，使干预通过高斯条件化传播到统计依赖的残差变量，在概念不完整场景下兼顾预测性能与可干预性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统概念瓶颈模型（CBM）受限于概念不完整性，即预定义概念集无法覆盖所有任务相关信息；引入非约束残差通道可缓解此问题，但会导致残差通路不透明、容易泄露信息，且干预残差时通常不更新相关变量，削弱干预效果。

Method: 将概念logits与残差logits联合建模为多元高斯分布，学习概念-残差跨协方差结构；测试时通过高斯条件化将干预传播到统计依赖的残差变量；训练目标包括基础损失（概念预测+任务+稀疏精度正则）与干预感知损失（干预概念后仍保持任务预测性能）。

Result: 在四个数据集（CUB、CUB-Incomplete、AwA2、AwA2-Incomplete）上，Res-SCBM在不完整概念任务上相比非泄露基线（Hard CBM、SCBM）提升超过23个百分点，接近甚至超过高容量CEM；同时保持对概念干预的响应性；当残差维度增至500时，干预感知训练对保持可干预性尤为关键。

Conclusion: Res-SCBM通过联合高斯建模使额外残差容量与有效概念干预得以兼容，为现实不完整设定下既可预测又可干预的概念模型迈进一步。

Abstract: Concept-based models (CMs) learn human-interpretable intermediate representations that enable users to understand the model's reasoning and steer its predictions through test-time concept interventions. However, in realistic settings, their performance can be limited by concept incompleteness, where the training concepts fail to capture all task-relevant information. Adding an unconstrained residual pathway to the model's predictive process can overcome the consequences of incompleteness. However, this introduces an inscrutable, leak-prone prediction pathway that may weaken concept interventions, as these often leave residual variables unchanged. To address this limitation, we introduce Residual Stochastic Concept Bottleneck Models (Res-SCBMs), a family of concept-based models that jointly model concept and residual variables through a multivariate Gaussian distribution. Res-SCBMs learn a covariance structure that explicitly captures dependencies between the known concepts and learnt residual variables, allowing interventions to propagate to statistically dependent residual variables through Gaussian conditioning. This extends the intervention capabilities of previous CMs without requiring concept completeness during training. Our results show that, across multiple concept-incomplete benchmarks, Res-SCBMs improve predictive performance over competing baselines while retaining effective test-time concept interventions.

</details>


### [226] [Bridging Compressed Communication and Local Steps via Spectral Method in Federated Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23434)
*Dmitriy Bystrov,George Chirkov,Daniil Medyakov,Dmitry Bylinkin,Aleksandr Beznosikov*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出FedCALM系列算法，是首个在联邦学习中同时支持Muon谱优化器、通信压缩和本地步的谱联邦学习方法，证明了在无有界异质性条件下的收敛性，并在图像和语言任务上验证了优越性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 联邦学习面临通信瓶颈的两大根源：通信频率和单次消息规模。Muon等谱优化器在集中式训练中显著优于Adam类方法，但现有将Muon迁移到联邦学习的尝试无法同时支持通信压缩和本地步这两大核心技术，且依赖有界异质性假设。

Method: 提出FedCALM-D（确定性）和FedCALM（含动量的随机版本），整合三项关键技术：(1) 采用SCAFFOLD的控制变量来应对无界数据异质性下的本地步漂移问题；(2) 对模型更新使用Error Feedback压缩，对控制变量使用EF21压缩，采用双重压缩策略；(3) 用Newton-Schulz迭代近似LMO算子实现谱优化。证明中在核范数下的收敛速率，消除了有界异质性假设。

Result: 在CIFAR-10（ResNet-18）的异质和病理分布上，FedCALM在通信比特维度上始终优于SCAFCOM、FedMuon、EF21-Muon和LocalSGD基线，例如在异质分布Top1%压缩下达到0.814准确率，远超SCAFCOM的0.460和EF21-Muon的0.374。在GLUE基准的SST-2任务（LoRA微调RoBERTa）上也表现强劲。消融实验显示方法对Newton-Schulz步数q具有稳定性。理论分析给出与SCAFCOM匹配的非凸收敛阶：确定性O(β²ΔL*/ε²(1-ε_q)²)，随机版本O(β²ΔL*/ε²(1-ε_q)² + ρ²σ²β/(Mε⁴(1-ε_q)⁴))。

Conclusion: FedCALM是首个在联邦学习中同时实现Muon式LMO更新、通信压缩和本地步的谱方法，且不依赖有界异质性假设。该工作弥合了谱优化与高效联邦学习核心通信技术之间的差距，在通信效率上取得了SOTA表现，具有重要的理论和应用价值。

Abstract: Federated Learning (FL) enables collaborative training of complex models across large-scale networks of edge devices while keeping data localized. However, data heterogeneity and high communication overhead remain fundamental bottlenecks. Recently, the spectral optimizer Muon has demonstrated remarkable advantages over Adam-like methods in centralized training. While recent efforts have attempted to transition Muon to FL, naive integrations into traditional architectures fail short. Crucially, existing approaches do not support the the communication compression and local steps --- the two foundational techniques of efficient FL. To address this limitation, we introduce a novel spectral FL method that utilizes both local updates and compression. We establish rigorous convergence guarantees under mild assumptions, notably eliminating the restrictive bounded heterogeneity condition. Empirical evaluation on standard image classification benchmarks validates the efficiency and robustness of our approach.

</details>


### [227] [Regularized free deconvolution for spectral repair of resampling distortion in high-dimensional particle filters](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23448)
*Deming Song,Chi-Kin Lam,Kefeng Li,Hui Yu,Xilin Li,Huagang Lin*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文针对粒子滤波器中高维重采样对集合协方差谱的可计算畸变，提出基于正则化自由反卷积的谱修复方法。通过将正向谱定律扩展到随机重要性权重（条件于权重与实际后代计数），构建正则化反卷积估计器，证明其一致性及显式误差预算，并设计仅作为Metropolis预条件器使用以保持目标不变性的机制。预注册仿真显示谱误差降低一个数量级，预条件器恢复约90%的各向异性oracle采样效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 高维粒子滤波器中重采样导致权重退化，但同时会以可计算方式扭曲集合协方差谱。本文研究逆问题：从观测权重和经验谱恢复重采样前谱，且不引入目标偏差。现有文献缺乏对此畸变的可逆修复及认证机制。

Method: 1. 证明正向谱定律在条件于权重及实际后代计数（而非仅权重）时可适用于随机重要性权重；2. 构建正则化自由反卷积估计器（最小距离+Tikhonov正则化），证明一致性与显式局部误差预算；3. 推导模型失配的可计算前向残差证书；4. 将修复谱仅用作Metropolis预条件器，保证目标不变性；5. 在标量稳定动力学下推导几何可和的完整循环误差递归；6. 推导监督放弃的几何负载成本定律。

Result: EXP-1：W1误差从无修正的0.769降至oracle的0.060、条件plug-in的0.058、实现plug-in的0.034。EXP-2：失配证书在错误机制（p=3.5×10⁻¹⁸）和强相关粒子（p=4.4×10⁻¹⁶）下正确触发，在低秩内生权重下保持静默。EXP-3：完整循环误差从0.698降至0.058；强制放弃实验中聚集在horizon末尾的6次放弃导致中位误差0.631，而均匀分布仅0.244（p=9.5×10⁻⁷），验证放弃成本取决于何时而非多少次。表1：各向异性体制下提升预条件器使后验kappa从42.4降至5.6，最慢方向ESS/step从3.26×10⁻⁴升至8.72×10⁻⁴（恢复oracle效率的~90%），目标位移不被拒绝（p=0.059）。

Conclusion: 在显式可识别和外生权重体制下，重采样引起的谱畸变可被正则化反卷积局部反演，具有显式误差预算与失配诊断。修复谱仅用作Metropolis预条件器以保持目标不变性。标量稳定动力学下完整循环误差预算几何可和，认证界下降至分辨率底层。监督放弃非保守而是可行性约束下的最优行动。贡献：识别条件对象（权重联合实现后代计数）、带误差预算的正则化反演、认证且目标保持的用途。

Abstract: Resampling is the standard remedy for weight degeneracy in particle filters, but in high dimensions it distorts the spectrum of the ensemble covariance in a way that is computable from the importance weights. This paper studies the inverse problem: recovering the pre-resampling spectrum from the observed weights and the empirical spectrum alone, and using it without biasing the filter. We first show that the forward spectral law extends to random importance weights once one conditions on the weights together with the realized offspring counts, rather than on the weights alone. We then construct a regularized free-deconvolution estimator, prove its consistency with an explicit error budget at a fixed resolution scale, and certify model mismatch through a computable forward residual. The repaired spectrum enters the filter only as the preconditioner of a Metropolis-adjusted rejuvenation move, so that spectral error affects mixing efficiency but not the invariant target. For the full filtering cycle, we derive a geometrically summable error recursion under stable scalar dynamics and an explicit law for the cost of abstaining from repair. Pre-registered simulations show that the inversion reduces the spectral error by an order of magnitude, that the corrected preconditioner recovers about 90% of the oracle's sampling efficiency in an anisotropic regime, and that the cost of abstention depends on when abstentions occur rather than on how many. The repair recovers eigenvalue laws, not eigenvectors, and is certified only within an explicitly stated exogenous-weight regime.

</details>


### [228] [Predictable Scaling: Efficient Model Exploration via Scaling-Law Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23453)
*Aishwarya Wesanekar,Sheng-Tao Yang,Jiawei Zhang,Flavio Sales Truzzi,Chen Chen,Nader Beigiparast,Shengyuan Huang,Roshanak Zilouchian Moghaddam,Vitor Cid,Colin Clement,Vinayak Thapliyal,Sebastian Ament,Jihao Andreas Lin,Vincent Huang,Kai Han,Boyi Jiang,Wenlin Chen,Chaorong Chen,Ashwin Kumar,Maximilian Balandat,David Eriksson,Yifei Zhang,Pan Zhong*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出了Predictable Scaling (PS)框架，通过缩放定律预测来高效评估推荐模型假设变更，减少79-88%的计算量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 工业推荐系统中，评估候选模型变更需要完整的训练运行，消耗大量GPU时间，严重限制了可探索的假设空间。现有scaling laws主要针对同构LLM架构，未被利用于推荐系统中假设级性能差异的预测。

Method: PS框架包含：(1)六种可组合的缩放函数沿不同资源轴降低计算量（DD数据降采样、HSR哈希表缩减、ES嵌入缩放、FS特征剪枝、WAS整体架构缩放、DS深度缩减）；(2)三种预测策略——原始代理、线性回归和经验高斯过程(EGP)——将缩放后的性能差距外推到全规模；(3)基于基准语料库的预算最优代理选择算法。核心思想是预测假设相对于基线的相对性能差距Δ_i = (ℓ_i - ℓ_0)/ℓ_0，而非绝对性能。

Result: 在两个工业级排序模型上：TS-1（任务特定模型）和FM-1（基础模型，约35×TS-1 FLOPs）实现79-88%的计算量减少；EGP对TS-1实现15%的相对MAE改善，对FM-1实现57-67%的MAE改善；在可操作假设中达到完美的秩保持（ρ=1.0）；在Criteo公开数据集上的四个模型（DLRM、DeepFM、xDeepFM、DCN-v2）验证了框架的可泛化性。

Conclusion: PS通过利用相对性能差距的规律性，成功从小型代理预测全规模模型性能。即使最简单的原始代理也能达到噪声底层的预测精度；EGP在模型复杂度增加时价值更大。关键发现：不同架构需要不同的缩放配置（无单一最优函数），紧密耦合的架构（如DCN-v2的cross-network）较难缩放，嵌入缩放(ES)在公开模型上普遍表现不佳，DD的可靠性是数据规模依赖性的。

Abstract: Evaluating candidate changes (hypotheses) to recommendation models requires full-scale training runs consuming thousands of GPU-hours, severely limiting the hypothesis space engineers can feasibly explore. We introduce Predictable Scaling (PS), a systematic framework that exploits empirically verified regularity conditions to predict full-scale model performance from small-scale proxies. PS constructs scaled-down variants via composable scaling functions along distinct resource axes, and projects metrics to the target scale via curve fitting with calibrated uncertainty estimates. We compare three prediction strategies of increasing expressiveness: even the simplest (raw proxy) achieves prediction error within the empirical noise floor of repeated-run variance; the most expressive (Gaussian Process) provides an indicative 15% relative MAE improvement and calibrated uncertainty. Evaluation on two ranking models of increasing complexity---a task-specific model and a foundation model---demonstrates that PS correctly ranks actionable hypotheses across diverse hypothesis types at 79-88% compute reductions.

</details>


### [229] [Uncertainty-aware AI-enabled framework for predicting hydrogen dispersion in confined spaces to enhance operator situational awareness](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23515)
*Niclas Flehmig,Mary Ann Lundteigen,Shen Yin*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种面向海事氢气加注密闭空间的两阶段、不确定性感知的人工智能框架。第一阶段利用多层感知机（MLP）集成在泄漏发生后10秒内根据早期传感器读数估计未知泄漏率；第二阶段采用加性高斯过程（GP）回归预测未来时间步的氢气浓度场及其校准置信区间。该系统被设计为决策支持工具，符合ISO/IEC TR 5469标准，使用级别为"D"，与独立的紧急停车系统（ESD）分离，以增强操作员情境感知能力而不部署安全功能。在开源受限空间氢气释放数据集上验证：泄漏率估计MAE为0.052 g/s，浓度预测MAE约为0.0176（接近传感器精度±0.01），NLL为-1.5340，具有良好校准的不确定性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 海事氢气加注过程存在严重安全隐患：氢气分子最小、易泄漏、爆炸极限宽（4–75%）、无色无味易燃，传统传感器无预测能力，而CFD模拟耗时数小时，无法实时响应。当前紧急停车系统（ESD）在达到燃烧下限（LFL）时才触发，具有破坏性。亟需一种实时、能在LFL到达前预警氢气积聚的早期预警系统，以支持操作员部署预防性措施，避免运营中断和事故。现有AI研究多基于开放环境CFD数据，缺乏对受限空间、实验数据、不确定性量化及系统安全集成的研究。

Method: 1. 系统设计：基于ISO/IEC TR 5469将AI系统分类为使用级别"D"，结合输入保留器（input guard）、AI监控组件、操作员监督和投票组件，与独立ESD隔离。借鉴"proven-in-use"概念，将训练数据集定义为运行包络。2. 数据处理：使用开源受限通道氢气释放数据集（22次实验+10次CFD模拟，5.8米长开口矩形通道，29个XEN-5320传感器），剔除空闲时段（约182,000样本），按0.009阈值区分暴露/未暴露传感器，对暴露数据进行对数变换使其近似高斯分布。3. 第一阶段：MLP集成（7个独立初始化网络，3层，ReLU激活，Dropout=0.2），输入为87个对数变换传感器值（29传感器×3时间步）+ 15维时空特征向量，输出泄漏率；使用留一实验交叉验证，加权采样应对分布偏斜。4. 第二阶段：加性高斯过程回归，采用5维输入[t, m̂, x, y, z]的加性核结构（31个候选交互项），通过分析学习输出尺度筛选出12个主导项构建"轻量核"；对比VNNGP与SVGP近似方法，对比高斯似然与Beta似然；选择SVGP（6000次迭代点，Beta似然）作为最终Stage2回归器。5. 评估方式：留一交叉验证，按场景分割训练/测试，使用MAE、RMSE和负对数似然（NLL）评估预测精度和不确定性校准。

Result: 1. 泄漏率估计：MLP集成MAE=0.052 g/s，RMSE=0.111 g/s，对中低泄漏（<0.7 g/s）可靠，高泄漏（>1.0 g/s）因数据稀疏存在严重低估。2. 浓度预报：最终SVGP（Beta似然，M=6000）测试集MAE=0.0176，RMSE=0.0226，NLL=-1.5340，接近传感器精度0.01。Beta似然模型比高斯似然模型校准更好（NLL差异达14个量级），在m̂≈1.0 g/s外推区给出更宽合理区间。3. 校准：95%预测区间经验覆盖率99.0%，99%区间覆盖率99.3%，PIT集中于0.51，存在轻微过度覆盖。4. 端到端：使用MLP估计的泄漏率替代真实值时，MAE从0.0176增至0.0249，误差传播可控。5. 核结构：12项加性核提供最佳空间降维和泄漏率交互；时间项影响较弱，符合准稳态。

Conclusion: 本文提出的两阶段框架能在秒级时间尺度（预测速度为秒级，远快于CFD的数小时）提供实时、概率化的氢气扩散预测，增强操作员情境感知能力，从被动响应转向主动安全屏障管理。GP不确定性量化使操作员能区分可信预测与训练数据外推。框架设计符合ISO/IEC TR 5469使用级别"D"，独立ESD作为终极安全层，AI仅作咨询。局限包括：单一理想化几何形状、泄漏率分布偏斜、Stage 1在高泄漏率下的低估可能传播至Stage 2导致危险低估。论文贡献在于：1）首个集成泄漏率估计与GP浓度预报并提供校准不确定性的方法；2）符合ISO/IEC TR 5469的AI安全相关系统初步设计。未来工作需在真实船舶几何形状上验证，通过主动学习或目标CFD增强扩展数据集，量化与降阶CFD的对比基准，并实施输入保留器、AI监控组件及"proven-in-use"概念的扩展操作验证。

Abstract: We present a two-stage AI-enabled framework for enhancing operator situational awareness during compressed hydrogen bunkering in maritime confined spaces. In the event of a leak, the framework first estimates the unknown leakage rate from early sensor readings and then forecasts how the hydrogen cloud will disperse over the next time steps, providing operators with a predicted concentration map together with confidence bounds. The framework is based on two independent AI models building one AI system. The AI system is designed as a decision-support tool. It augments sensor readings, and thus enhances operator situational awareness and supports decision-making. This enables preventive safety barriers to be deployed before hazardous concentrations are reached, while an independent emergency shutdown system remains the ultimate safety layer. The system design incorporates safeguards to ensure the AI system operates within its competence envelope. Trained and tested on an open dataset of confined-space hydrogen releases, the framework achieves a mean absolute error of $0.052$~g/s in leakage-rate estimation and $\approx0.018$ in hydrogen-concentration prediction, approaching the sensor precision bound of $\pm0.01$. The hydrogen-concentration prediction provides well-calibrated uncertainty estimates that allow operators to judge the reliability of each forecast. These results suggest that the framework may provide early information about hazardous concentration build-up, potentially supporting preventive actions by operators.

</details>


### [230] [Out of Support, Not Out of Reach: In-Context Learning with Unsupported Instructions and Composed Tasks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23528)
*Xuhan Tong,Yuchen Zeng,Jiawei Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文针对上下文学习（ICL）在预训练支持之外的两种分布偏移（指令级与任务级），提出了一个统一的理论框架。首先证明当目标任务在预训练中受支持时，无论指令是支持的或采用固定/重复的不支持形式，演示都能以指数速率识别该任务；对于持续变化的指令，证明无无条件收敛保证。其次，将该框架拓展至预训练任务集之外的零先验长视距任务：通过将任务分解为预训练的子任务并逐步执行，标准累积误差界直接适用。实验验证了演示证据率、一致/变化指令不匹配的灵敏度差异，以及代理分解质量对多步执行的影响。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有ICL理论主要将演示解释为识别预训练中已表示的潜在任务，未能处理指令或目标任务落在预训练支持之外的两种常见分布偏移。需要一个能同时涵盖指令级与任务级支持缺失的统一分析框架。

Method: 在贝叶斯潜在任务框架下，分离七种提示格式（基于指令支持性与放置方式）。对受支持指令给出标准指数收敛界；对单次/重复的不支持指令，通过Transformer解析诱导的有限链延拓保持指数率；对每次都不相同的指令给出有/无收敛的双向条件。将该视角沿中间状态轨迹应用于K步长视距任务，逐步累加βₖe^(-αₖN)形式的支持子任务误差和模型传输误差εₘ⁽ᵏ⁾(N)。

Result: 理论上：(1) 支持指令下，演示似然比以2⁻¹min κₜ为指数速率收敛；(2) 共享模板的不支持指令在固定有限链延拓Ω₀下保持同一速率β̇e^(-αN)；(3) 变化的不支持指令仅在证据率α超过平均延续代价时收敛；(4) 分解任务下，实际模型误差上界为∑ₖ[βₖe^(-αₖN)+εₘ⁽ᵏ⁾(N)]。实验上：(a) 识别性演示池在Sports和People任务上比歧义性池精度高2-3倍；(b) Qwen3上运算符一致但错误时灵敏度随演示数下降，不一致时保持不稳定；(c) Llama3.2-3B代理在分布内子任务下7位数加法性能大幅提升，分布外子任务下比直接预测更差；(d) 控制实验显示在N=64时受支持智能体执行误差从0.456降至0.0078，直接ICL始终≈0.96。

Conclusion: 本文明确了演示、指令与任务分解在何种条件下能支撑ICL扩展至预训练支持之外。指令层面：固定延续代价是N无关的，可被累积的演示证据主导；指令不断变化时该代价随之累积。任务层面：长视距目标不必作为单一潜在任务被选择，只要能被分解为受支持的子任务序列即可，每步的识别与传输误差按标准方式累加。分解质量（每步是否受支持且可识别）是决定最终性能的关键瓶颈。

Abstract: In-Context Learning (ICL) enables pretrained LLMs to adapt to downstream tasks from a small set of input-output demonstrations, without parameter updates. Yet existing theory primarily explains ICL as identifying a latent task already represented in pretraining, leaving unclear whether ICL can succeed when either the instruction or the target task falls outside the pretraining support. We develop a theoretical framework under mild assumptions that separates these two forms of distribution shift. For target tasks represented in pretraining, we show that demonstrations can identify the task and reduce sensitivity to pretrain-supported prompt templates as their number increases. For an unsupported instruction, we show that under a fixed model-induced reference extension, demonstration evidence can dominate an $N$-independent instruction shift while preserving the exponential identification rate. We then use the same ICL framework as an interpretive lens for long-horizon target tasks that are not represented in pretraining but admit a plan that decomposes them into pretraining-supported subtasks. Applying the supported-task analysis step by step yields a standard accumulated-error bound and clarifies how invoking familiar subtasks along an intermediate-state trajectory can avoid directly selecting the unsupported complete task. Together, our results characterize when demonstrations, instructions, and task decomposition can support ICL beyond the corresponding pretraining supports.

</details>


### [231] [Beyond Expected Values: Risk-Sensitive Planning with Distributional Monte-Carlo Tree Search](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23565)
*Quynh Trinh,Trung Nguyen,Nam Nguyen,Tuan Dam*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了两种分布式的蒙特卡洛树搜索算法CATSO和PATSO，专门用于求解以条件风险价值(CVaR)为目标的有限深度风险敏感规划问题。两种算法在Q边维护经验回报分布律（分别采用Dirichlet分类原子和自适应粒子表示），而V节点保持标量，用访问加权的子Q边CVaR均值进行回溯。理论上证明在n次模拟后根节点值误差达到O(n^{-1/2})量级，匹配了标量MCTS的收敛速度，并提供对应的风险敏感简单遗憾界。实验表明在均值最优与CVaR最优不同的随机规划基准上，两种方法均能改善尾部回报、降低灾难性事件发生率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统MCTS（如UCT、AlphaZero）在Q边只存储标量均值估计，无法区分均值相同但下尾表现差异巨大的动作，因此在自动驾驶、医疗、金融等安全关键领域中表现不佳。当规划目标为CVaR等尾部风险度量时，标量MCTS抹去了对风险敏感的分布信息，导致选择均值最优但下尾危险的动作。

Method: CATSO用固定的有序网格上的Dirichlet分类分布表示Q边回报律，PATSO用自适应权重粒子表示；两者均通过对Q边律做Dirichlet Thompson采样并取CVaR加多项式乐观奖励来选动作；V节点保持标量，通过访问加权平均子动作Q边的CVaR分数进行回溯，避免了分布卷积。

Result: 理论证明了固定网格CATSO和无上限PATSO的有限深度嵌套CVaR目标根值误差为O(n^{-1/2})，并给出对数下界的最优拉臂次数；离散偏差和Wasserstein压缩偏差被明确量化。在五个随机基准（自动驾驶、两层风险宝藏、风险捷径格子世界、博彩游戏、守卫迷宫）上的实验显示CVaR遗憾值、下尾回报与灾难性事件计数均优于标量UCT/MaxUCT/PowerUCT基线，同时保持期望回报竞争力。

Conclusion: 通过在Q边保留分布信息而在V节点保留标量，可以构建既具有有限样本收敛保证又保持尾部风险的MCTS算法。CATSO和PATSO在均值最优与CVaR最优不一致的环境中表现良好，二者在精度和内存之间提供互补的权衡：CATSO适合网格精细的稳定分布，PATSO适合稀疏多模分布。未来方向包括完全分布式的V节点、自适应风险水平、学习模型动力学以及部分可观测或连续控制设定下的推广。

Abstract: Monte-Carlo Tree Search (MCTS) typically stores only scalar mean estimates, which makes it poorly suited for tail-risk objectives such as conditional value-at-risk (CVaR). We introduce Categorical Thompson Sampling with Optimism (CATSO) and Particle Thompson Sampling with Optimism (PATSO), two distributional MCTS algorithms that maintain finite-support empirical backup laws at Q-edges. CATSO represents Q-edge laws with categorical atoms and Dirichlet Thompson sampling, while PATSO represents them with adaptive particles. Both algorithms select actions using the CVaR of a Thompson-sampled Q-edge law plus a polynomial optimism bonus, and propagate scalar continuation values through visit-weighted averages of child Q-edge CVaR scores. For the finite-depth nested CVaR planning target, we prove an $O(n^{-1/2})$ bound on the root value error after $n$ rollouts, which upper-bounds the risk-sensitive simple regret. CATSO adds a fixed-grid discretization bias, while capped PATSO adds a tunable Wasserstein compression bias. Experiments on stochastic planning benchmarks show that distributional Q-edges improve lower-tail return and reduce catastrophic outcomes when mean-optimal and risk-sensitive behavior differ.

</details>


### [232] [BMuon: Budgeting Muon's Spectral Geometry for Structured Compressibility](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23571)
*Rida Assalouh,Tom Jacobs,Rebekka Burkholz,Yani Ioannou,Umut Şimşekli*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出Budget Muon (BMuon)，通过在Muon的谱范数几何中引入全局MLP隐藏通道分配预算（由可解释参数K控制），将Muon的优化性能与结构化可压缩性相统一。理论证明其诱导的范数族Ω_{α,K}在Muon与结构化稀疏几何之间插值，并在线性双因子模型中保证最小代价分解在预算稀缺时达到宽度最小。实践上使用Minorize-辛烷化算法近似精确分配问题，在CIFAR-100、ImageNet-1K ViT-S/16和FineWeb上训练的1B参数LLaMA风格模型上均验证了BMuon在结构化MLP通道剪枝下的稳健性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Muon作为新兴的神经网络优化器，在谱范数几何下表现出强大的训练效率，但作者发现Muon训练的Transformer在训练后MLP隐藏通道结构化剪枝时性能急剧下降（如ViT-S/16在ImageNet-1K上仅30%剪枝后精度从75.23%降至3.17%），表明Muon的谱几何本身不鼓励结构化可压缩性。如何修改Muon的优化几何以同时获得训练效率和结构化可压缩性是核心问题。

Method: BMuon在Muon的谱范数约束中按通道对角重新加权，并在所有MLP块的所有隐藏通道之间共享单一全局预算K（分配之和等于K），分配权重μ∈[0,1]^N通过解决联合oracle问题获得：max_μ max_Δ ⟨M, Δ⟩，其中Δ∈A_α(μ)是通道加权后的谱范数约束集。理论上，BMuon等价于Ω_{α,K}范数下的最速下降，该范数族在α=0或K=N时退化为Muon，在α=K=1时退化为耦合组ℓ1几何。实践中，通过Minorize-辛烷化算法构建紧密代理函数得到近似分配更新（公式8），配合一截惩罚项ε防止分配退化。

Result: 在CIFAR-100 ViT上，BMuon在80% MLP通道剪枝后保留70.57%准确率（使用μ排序），而Muon降至1.93%、Muon+Group-Lasso降至6.01%、NuMuon降至3.84%。在ImageNet-1K ViT-S/16上，BMuon在70%剪枝后保留74.08%（剪枝前74.17%），而Muon已降至0.185%；渐进式剪枝90%/95%下BMuon-μ比Muon-mag在两种数据集上分别高出3.80/4.80和3.80/5.80个百分点。在FineWeb训练的1B LLaMA风格模型上，BMuon在80%剪枝后保持12.85-12.86的验证困惑度（剪枝前12.84），而Muon已激增至2486-5290。BMuon的复杂度几乎与Muon相同（ImageNet上92.5 vs 91.9秒/epoch，LLaMA上4858 vs 4918毫秒/步，差异在种子波动范围内）。

Conclusion: BMuon通过将全局隐藏通道预算融入Muon的谱范数更新几何，成功统一了Muon的优化性能和结构化可压缩性。理论证明其诱导范数族在Muon与结构化稀疏几何之间连续插值，并在线性双因子模型中证明最小代价分解在足够稀缺的预算下必须具有最小宽度。实证验证了该方法在视觉和语言Transformer上对结构化MLP通道剪枝的稳健性，学习到的分配本身也是有效的通道重要性指标，并能发现优于均匀宽度架构的非均匀架构。可压缩性与密集模型性能之间的权衡，以及超出MLP通道的全局预算扩展是未来工作的方向。

Abstract: Muon has emerged as a strong optimizer for neural network training and admits an interpretation as steepest descent under a spectral-norm geometry. Yet we find that Muon-trained Transformers can degrade sharply when their MLP hidden channels are pruned after training. To reconcile Muon's optimization performance with structured compressibility, we introduce Budget Muon (BMuon), which modifies Muon's spectral geometry so that hidden channels across blocks compete for a shared allocation budget. The resulting oracle is exactly normalized steepest descent under a family of norms that interpolate between Muon's geometry and structured sparse geometries. Our principal sparsity control is an interpretable global channel-allocation budget, rather than a setting-dependent sparsity-penalty coefficient. For linear factorization models, we show that Muon admits minimum-cost exact representations with redundant hidden width, whereas under the BMuon oracle geometry and a sufficiently scarce budget, every minimum-cost representation is width-minimal. For practical training, we derive a minorization-maximization surrogate for the exact allocation problem. On ImageNet-1K with ViT-S/16, BMuon improves over Muon under gradual structured MLP pruning, and its learned allocations provide a more effective pruning criterion than weight magnitude. On a 1B-parameter LLaMA-style model trained on FineWeb, BMuon improves over Muon under post-training MLP channel pruning.

</details>


### [233] [Boundary Detection for High-Dimensional Point Clouds](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23590)
*Abigail Hickok,Valerio Galanti,Osama Al Dalahmah,Andrew J. Blumberg*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了两种用于高维点云边界检测的新方法：超平面（HP）法和方向均匀性（DU）法。HP法先做局部降维再拟合分离超平面，依赖于可靠的内在维数估计；DU法通过度量邻域方向的均匀性来识别边界点，在含噪条件下更稳健。两种方法不仅给出逐点的边界分数，还能估计每个边界点的法向量。作者用合成数据和两个真实应用验证了方法的有效性：通过空间转录组数据识别肿瘤边界，以及分析LLM激活几何中字符计数流形的边界。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 已有边界检测方法通常依赖"边界点密度较低"的假设，在数据密度非均匀或环境维数较高时表现较差；同时，大多方法只能给出边界分数，无法提供法向量信息，且在高维噪声环境下的鲁棒性不足。实际应用中（如空间转录组数据中肿瘤边界的识别以及LLM激活几何分析）需要既准确又能估计法向量的边界检测工具。

Method: （1）HP法：对每个点的k近邻做局部PCA降维，然后求解约束优化问题 max Σ z_i·w, ‖w‖=1，得到解析解 w = Σz_i/‖Σz_i‖，计算位于该超平面正侧的邻居比例作为边界分数；（2）DU法：计算局部邻域向量的归一化均值 v_i，以及邻居的归一化向量 v_j，用 (1/k³) Σ v_i·v_j 作为边界分数，并通过邻居间的对齐消除加噪后的虚假边界信号。两者均可从优化解中提取法向量。作者还用Chebyshev、Berry-Esseen等工具证明：当点来自均匀球/半球时，HP得分在内部分别集中在1/2和1附近，给出依赖于维数n与邻域大小k的收敛界。

Result: 在合成数据上，HP与DU在非均匀密度、复杂几何、高环境维数（嵌入ℝ^15）、高斯噪声、及高内在维数（n维球）条件下均显著优于BORDER、RU、BP、CO、BEPS、LoDD等已有方法；DU整体表现最稳，HP在已知维数时最准且法向量精度最高。在空间转录组数据中，HP和DU能在不使用细胞标签的情况下识别胶质母细胞瘤Mes/Pro状态的过渡边界；在Pythia-2.8B和Llama-3.1-8B第4层残差激活中，两种方法都能正确标定字符计数流形的真实边界，且法向量方向符合内指的几何直觉。

Conclusion: 两种新方法扩展了流形假设到"带边界流形"的场景，HP在能可靠估计内在维数时为首选，DU在噪声较大或维数难以估计时更稳健，并为边界点提供法向量估计，在多种合成与真实高维带噪数据集上均优于现有方法。

Abstract: We introduce two new methods for boundary detection in high-dimensional point cloud data, intended to work in situations with non-uniform density, high ambient dimension, and substantial noise. Our first method fits a separating hyperplane on local neighborhoods after doing local dimension reduction---this method works best when one can reliably estimate the intrinsic dimension of the data. Our second method measures the directional uniformity of local neighborhoods, and has the best overall performance on synthetic data. In addition to pointwise numerical boundary scores, our algorithms yield an estimated normal vector at each boundary point. We validate our methodology on synthetic data as well as two real examples: we analyze spatial transcriptomics data, where we show that we can detect the boundary of a tumor, and we also study LLM activation geometry.

</details>


### [234] [When Magnitude Suffices: Reconstructing Time-Domain-Gated Microwave Signals Without Phase on a Thoracic Phantom](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23608)
*Maciej Cichoń,Patrycja Gołaś,Maksymilian Bartosik,Angelika Walczak,Agata Bielecka-Dąbrowa,Maciej Ślot*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Time-domain gating separates the arrivals that form a microwave S-parameter measurement. It requires the measurement of complex values, so this application almost always uses a vector network analyzer (VNA). We show that, on one calibrated measurement configuration, the gated magnitude the VNA would give can be reconstructed from a magnitude-only sweep of a spectrum analyzer with a tracking generator (SA). We select the gate center for separability of the measured states, correct each instrument once by a per-bin subtraction of a reference state, and train a fully connected network on sweeps from both instruments. The test object is a torso phantom with lung-shaped compartments whose filling takes eleven dielectric states, each held out in turn. On $S_{11}$ the reconstruction from SA input reaches a shape error of 0.08 dB$^2$ with a state ordering of 0.81. This matches the reconstruction from VNA input. On $S_{21}$ it reaches 0.82 dB$^2$ and keeps the ordered groups of the states. An explicit phase prediction performs much worse, because gating needs the phase to about 0.2 rad RMS. Across eleven measurement configurations the dependence of phase on magnitude is strong for reflection and weak for transmission. This explains the difference between $S_{11}$ and $S_{21}$. Where the magnitude carries enough of the phase, a scalar instrument gives the gated response without any phase measurement after installation. On the open UM-BMID breast data set, with whole phantoms held out, the shape error of the network is 30 percent lower than that of a per-bin linear map.

### [235] [How Many, but How Sure? Class Competition as a Confidence Proxy in Multi-Class Density-Based Counting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23611)
*Villanelle O'Reilly,Georgios Leontidis,Marc Hanheide*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Multi-class density estimators can count objects in crowded scenes, but their class-wise outputs offer no indication of how reliably density mass has been allocated. We introduce a training-free confidence proxy based on local competition between the strongest class channels. The resulting prominence measure requires only the predicted density maps, with no retraining or access to model internals. We test whether residual competition is diagnostic of cross-class leakage by attenuating contested density at inference time. On DSACA predictions for the Hicks et al. dataset, this reduces overall MAE from 0.920 to 0.846, suggesting that class competition contains useful information about count reliability.

### [236] [The Sign Code: The Hidden Binary Nature of Deep Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23616)
*Niclas Göring,Shuofeng Zhang,Roi Holtzman,Yoonsoo Nam,Ard A. Louis*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Every neuron in a trained network outputs a number that can be separated into its sign (positive or negative) and its magnitude (absolute size). We call the set of all neuron signs the \textit{sign code}. This raises a key question: does classification depend more on the sign code or on the magnitudes? For overparameterized vision classifiers with sign-preserving activations, the answer is overwhelmingly the sign code. A $k$-nearest neighbor classifier operating only on this binary sign code achieves accuracy comparable to the full model across different architectures, activation functions, and datasets. Moreover, replacing all magnitudes in every layer with random noise while keeping the original signs barely changes residual network performance. In contrast, flipping just 20\% of the signs reduces accuracy to chance. Models generalize well when same-class inputs share similar sign codes. When this overlap is disrupted by a regularizer, training accuracy remains high, but test performance collapses. A margin decomposition helps explain these results: the sign-only contribution to each logit grows as $\sqrt{d}$ in network width, dominating the magnitude residual. The natural unit of analysis for these networks may not be through their continuous weight space but instead through their discrete sign codes.

Abstract: Every neuron in a trained network outputs a number that can be separated into its sign (positive or negative) and its magnitude (absolute size). We call the set of all neuron signs the \textit{sign code}. This raises a key question: does classification depend more on the sign code or on the magnitudes? For overparameterized vision classifiers with sign-preserving activations, the answer is overwhelmingly the sign code. A $k$-nearest neighbor classifier operating only on this binary sign code achieves accuracy comparable to the full model across different architectures, activation functions, and datasets. Moreover, replacing all magnitudes in every layer with random noise while keeping the original signs barely changes residual network performance. In contrast, flipping just 20\% of the signs reduces accuracy to chance. Models generalize well when same-class inputs share similar sign codes. When this overlap is disrupted by a regularizer, training accuracy remains high, but test performance collapses. A margin decomposition helps explain these results: the sign-only contribution to each logit grows as $\sqrt{d}$ in network width, dominating the magnitude residual. The natural unit of analysis for these networks may not be through their continuous weight space but instead through their discrete sign codes.

</details>


### [237] [ThetreStageAI: Multi-View Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Structured Bengali Theatre Production Planning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23618)
*Md. Mehedi Hasan Naeem,Mst. Kamrunnahar Ruma,Shakila Sultana,Nafiza Anjum,Nasreen Jannatun Nemu,Md. Sujan Ali*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Staging a theatre performance requires coordinating dialogue, actor movement, stage directions, lighting focus, cue timing, and equipment constraints within the same production plan. This work presents ThetreStageAI, a retrieval augmented framework for structured Bengali theatre production planning. Rather than retrieving from one mixed corpus, the system maintains separate scene, actor-blocking, and lighting views. Bengali text is embedded with BGE-M3 and indexed in view-specific Qdrant collections. Retrieved references are combined with a production brief and passed to Gemini, which generates schema-constrained JSON containing characters, scenes, dialogue, stage directions, blocking, lighting, and optional sound cues. Structural and semantic checks are applied before acceptance, with at most one constrained repair attempt. We also construct a human-guided, LLM-assisted synthetic dataset of 500 short Bengali theatre records that expands to 1,500 retrieval documents. Dataset diagnostics confirm consistent identifiers and valid lighting fields while also revealing substantial dialogue repetition. A paired camera-ready evaluation compares single-combined and full multi-view retrieval under matched settings. The source code, dataset, and evaluation materials are publicly available.

### [238] [GRAFT-EEG: Gauge-Aware Physical Field Transport for Cross-Dataset Motor-Imagery EEG](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23620)
*Ying Zhou,Mengting Liu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Cross-dataset EEG decoding often treats montage, reference, and active-sensor changes as representation shift, although they also alter the observation operator. We study target-statistics-blind transfer: fitting receives no target signal, label, or empirical statistic, and electrode coordinates only instantiate a fixed prediction operator. method removes the active-set common-reference gauge and transports each native mask through a template motor leadfield. A source-fitted spectral classifier anchors the decision; a bounded state-space-model (SSM) residual is secondary. We establish restricted identifiability and an operator-perturbation bound. Across five leave-one-dataset-out targets (253 participants), dynamic method achieved 60.865% equal-target balanced accuracy versus 52.684% for strict-clean 5/5 BIOT (hierarchical difference +8.182 points; 95% CI +6.382 to +10.196; positive in every target). On four EEGPT-clean targets, the descriptive means were 61.520% and 59.057%. In four post-hoc exact same-parent tests, FULL exceeded coordinate-basis, matched-spectrum, row-shuffled, and wrong-anatomy controls by 9.959, 9.698, 11.241, and 3.985 points, respectively (all 95% CIs excluded zero; Holm-adjusted P<0.001). A separate 60-participant same-paradigm evaluation retained a positive physical-operator contrast (+4.029 points; +2.338 to +5.773), whereas dynamic--static was inconclusive; its preregistered status is partial confirmation rather than unrestricted external validation. The SSM added +1.059 points (+0.013 to +1.892). Claims remain bounded to five binary motor-imagery domains and the tested operators.

### [239] [Deconstructing Multi-Task Active Learning: The Paradox of Gradient Conflict and Orthogonal Decomposition](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23623)
*Juho Jung,Seongjae Kang,Jinyoung Han*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Existing multi-task active learning (MTL-AL) methods predominantly rely on linear scalarization of heterogeneous objectives such as uncertainty, diversity, and gradient conflict. We argue that this entangled formulation is fundamentally limited, as linear combination fails to capture Pareto-optimal trade-offs under conflicting objectives. We propose a shift from combination to deconstruction and introduce a principled framework that rethinks MTL-AL along three orthogonal dimensions. First, we identify the Conflict Paradox: although the optimization literature treats gradient conflict as interference to be suppressed, penalizing conflict when ranking candidates is measurably worse than not scoring it at all. We therefore decouple the two concerns: the acquisition function does not score conflict, and the resulting interference is resolved by gradient surgery during training. Second, we introduce Orthogonal Decomposition, separating acquisition into Informativeness and Exploration. This two-stage process, informativeness filtering followed by coverage maximization, prevents "diversity dilution" by excluding uninformative outliers before enforcing diversity. Third, we propose Cross-Task Mutual Information (CTMI), a covariance-based statistic of cross-task dependency computed from MC-dropout task entropies. Extensive experiments on COCO, Cityscapes, and NYUv2, including comparisons against recent MTL-AL and data-selection baselines, demonstrate consistent improvements over state-of-the-art methods, highlighting that structural rethinking of acquisition yields larger gains than incremental heuristic design. Code is available at this https URL .

### [240] [Deep LLM layers expose passage-level context in EEG during silent reading](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23638)
*Ingo Marquardt,Anthilia Alchanat,Priyanka Jain*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: In a previous report we showed that a decoder can recover open-vocabulary word-level information from 19-channel EEG recorded during silent reading, by aligning short EEG windows with hidden-state embeddings of the presented word taken from a large language model (LLM). That analysis contrasted two of the model's 33 layers: the context-free input embedding and one mid-depth layer. Here we ask how EEG-decodable structure is distributed over the full depth of the language model. We trained one decoder per layer of Llama-3.1-8B, with and without a causal transformer over the sequence of EEG windows. We distinguish word-level decodability from a context-tracking component. Word-level decodability peaks in early layers and declines steadily towards the last layer. In contrast, the context-tracking component of the retrieval gain rises with depth, both with and without a causal transformer. Unexpectedly, a decoder that sees a single 0.5-s window at a time tracks the text passage too. Two new controls dissect this component. A target-geometry control, a synthetic predictor made of the true target plus noise calibrated to each decoder's word-level accuracy, shows that context tracking is not a by-product of word decoding and target geometry. A control that permutes predictions across runs from either the same or from different sessions shows that most of the observed context-tracking is not caused by an EEG recording session signature. Instead, context tracking mostly follows the text. A single EEG window therefore carries passage-level information that a contextual target can absorb. The results locate word identity in the early layers of the language model, discourse state in the deeper layers, and make the choice of target layer a design dial for EEG language decoders.

### [241] [No-Regret Language Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23641)
*Jiaxun Li,Vinod Raman,Ambuj Tewari*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: We introduce no-regret generation, which requires a generator to make a sublinear number of mistakes uniformly over all demonstration sequences and compatible target languages. We also formulate an agnostic variant that allows arbitrary demonstrations that may not be compatible with any languages. For both settings, we introduce tree-based mistake-forcing dimensions that exactly characterize finite-horizon minimax complexity and establish necessary and sufficient conditions for no-regret generation. Our characterizations reveal a rich spectrum of generation rates: up to constant rescaling, every admissible nondecreasing profile is attainable in both the realizable and agnostic settings. Finally, we connect generation complexity to online prediction: for language classes of finite Littlestone dimension \(d\), we obtain realizable mistake bounds of \(O(d\log(1+T/d))\) and agnostic regret bounds of \(O(\sqrt{dT\log(1+T/d)})\). The realizable bound is optimal up to universal constants.

### [242] [JAXtari: High-Throughput and Easy-to-Modify Arcade Learning Environment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23650)
*Quentin Delfosse,Raban Emunds,Paul Seitz,Sebastian Wette,Jannis Blüml,Daniel Kirn,Dominik Mandok,Kristian Kersting*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: The Arcade Learning Environment (ALE) has been a cornerstone of Deep Reinforcement Learning research, providing a standardized benchmark for evaluating general agents. However, its lack of native support for object-extraction and environment modification restricts research into evaluating whether agents learn robust causal models or rely on brittle visual heuristics. Furthermore, the ALE's dependence on CPU-based emulation creates a significant bottleneck in modern GPU-accelerated training pipelines, limiting both experimental scale and iteration frequency. In this work, we introduce JAXtari, an open-source, high-performance reimplementation of Atari 2600 environments. By leveraging massive GPU parallelization, JAXtari allows PPO agents to finish training on 100M environment steps on a single A100-GPU in under an hour. Beyond speed, it provides object-centric observations and a flexible modification system, allowing researchers to, e.g. develop neuro-symbolic methods or discover novel shortcuts and subsequently train and adapt their agents rapidly, sometimes in only minutes.

### [243] [TriRouter: Sparse-to-Dense Electrode-Space Routing for Robust EEG Motor Imagery Decoding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23665)
*Ying Zhou,Yaoxin,Mengting Liu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Motor imagery brain-computer interfaces require reliable decoding from multichannel EEG, but practical acquisition often yields sparse or corrupted electrode montages. We propose TriRouter, an electrode-space routing framework with discriminative-preservation, mask-robustness, and latent-compensation paths. A validation-calibrated router uses observable channel availability to allocate path contributions, preserving complete-channel discrimination while increasing representation recovery under severe missingness. In BNCI2014-001, TriRouter outperforms standard public backbones and a dynamic-spatial-filtering corrupted-EEG baseline. It improves accuracy over the strongest corrupted-EEG baseline by 3.68, 4.02, and 6.46 percentage points at nominal 25%, 50%, and 75% missing settings, and remains effective under structured regional missingness and additional low-channel dataset evaluation.

### [244] [Equivalence testing and run-count design for stochastic machine-learning experiments](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23700)
*Dmytro Knopov,Nadiya Shvai*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Claims that two training methods perform equally well often rest on a non-significant difference between two or three runs per method. We develop a protocol, with its power theory, for certifying practical equivalence in per-run metrics such as the AUROC (area under the receiver operating characteristic curve). It rests on a two-level (seed x item) variance model separating between-run dispersion from item-level noise. Equivalence within a pre-specified margin is tested by two one-sided tests (TOST), equivalently by a confidence interval inside the margin; a two-level bootstrap covers composite statistics. A closed-form formula converts a margin and a target power into runs per method; its shifted-t refinement is calibrated against the realised two-level process. Simulations on a 270-cell grid and under non-Gaussian seed laws confirm the formula within its design-relevant range, from five runs per method. For four published runs of a joint energy-based model, the failure to certify equivalence was largely decided by design: with the variance calibrated to those runs, two per method certify with probability near three per cent, whereas certifying 0.01 AUROC at 80 per cent power needs twelve even under exact equality. A second case study on a thousand-seed CIFAR-10 zoo and the MultiBERTs checks the formula against real seed laws (within 0.05 in that range) and resolves comparisons that two or three runs leave undecided. In a two-stage design (pilot, then formula), our experiments suggest that an upper confidence bound on the pilot variance substantially reduces the undersizing seen with its point estimate.

### [245] [Blitz: Accelerating the Diffusion Modules of AlphaFold3 and Boltz-2](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23703)
*Vinay Saji Mathew,Soundar Kumara,Gretta Kellogg,William K. M. Lai*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Diffusion-based protein structure prediction models produce all-atom structures in about 200 denoising steps, and that cost has driven a number of few-step samplers. We present Blitz, a few-step distillation framework that uses a geometric noise schedule to distribute steps more evenly across noise scales, then learns those updates through multistep consistency training. Physical steering and target-free candidate selection help reduce the remaining geometric defects at inference. We apply Blitz to AlphaFold 3 and Boltz-2, reducing denoising from 200 steps to eight. Because published few-step results use different benchmarks and scoring procedures, we compare both distilled models with their teachers and other few-step methods under a common evaluation protocol covering structural accuracy, interface quality, ligand placement, and stereochemical validity. Blitz retains teacher-level structural accuracy, with AF3-Blitz outperforming all evaluated few-step baselines and exceeding its teacher on several accuracy metrics.

### [246] [Tool Recommendation for Multi-Step Agents: Finding Every Tool a Task Needs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23707)
*Sam Partee,River Stevens,Thierry Damiba,Valerie Fanelle*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: A multi-step agent task fails when a single tool it needs is missing, yet the tools an agent may need are too many to list: the roughly 8,200 tools on the platform we study have definitions that together exceed the context window of any model we evaluate. We present Tool Recommendation, a deployed system that gives an agent all of them, hundreds of times more than a typical MCP server exposes, through a fixed interface of three tools. It runs at the gateway between agent and tools, executing every call under the end user's own credentials and checking it against the user's consent for each service and the tools the agent may use. We evaluate it on both a public retrieval benchmark and billed end-to-end session cost. On ToolRet, Tool Recommendation places every tool a query needs in the top ten 57% more often than BM25, a lexical ranking that commercial tool search offers, and compares favorably with published systems up to nine times its size. In paired multi-step workflows, its first recommendation covered every required tool in 93% of Codex sessions, and against a fixed list of 100 tools it cut input tokens by 17% with Codex and 40% with Claude Code and the total bill in all 14 runs, by up to 40%, with no change in task completion.

### [247] [Escaping Parameter Space: Tight Generalization Bounds via Representation Quality](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23729)
*Niclas Göring,Shuofeng Zhang,Branton DeMoss,Ard A. Louis*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: We derive a tight generalization bound for deterministic neural We derive a tight generalization bound for deterministic neural networks based on their last hidden layer representations. By evaluating representation quality with a parameter-free $k$-nearest-neighbor ($k$-NN) classifier, our certificate avoids traditional parameter-space complexity measures, KL divergences to a posterior, weight norms, and compression. The bound is tight: trained from scratch, it reaches an 8.0 percentage point gap to test error on CIFAR-10 (ResNet-18) and yields the first non-vacuous certificates we are aware of on CIFAR-100; with frozen DINOv2 representations, it certifies at 1.4\% on CIFAR-10 and 23.1\% on 1,000-class ImageNet. It decomposes additively into three empirical, independently measurable quantities: local class geometry ($k$-NN decoder error), decoder-network agreement, and training stability. This allows the bound to act as a diagnostic tool: we demonstrate that actively destroying local class geometry eliminates generalization while leaving dataset memorization intact, identifying class geometry as a causally relevant mechanism for generalization. Finally, we show that learned representations are significantly less sensitive to weight noise than linear readouts, suggesting why parameter-space certificates often struggle to remain tight.
