Motivation: 当前主流编码智能体（如 Claude Code、Codex CLI）使用执行沙箱配合交互式审批机制防御 prompt injection，但为减少审批疲劳（approval fatigue）引入的可复用 allow-rule 机制本身存在新风险：审批边界由上下文塑造的权限请求决定，攻击者可借良性任务之机诱导用户批准过度宽松的规则，从而在后续任务中绕过人工监督。

Method: 提出两阶段自动化评估框架：（1）**权限获取（Permission Acquisition）**：基于闭环 LLM 优化器（Planner + Builder + Proxy + Critic 四组件迭代搜索仓库配置），评估对抗性仓库上下文能否在良性任务执行期间诱发目标可复用权限规则请求；并以 Permission Capability Coverage（PCC，5 类共 100 个测试用例）量化被获取权限的语义覆盖范围。（2）**权限复用（Authority Reuse）**：以阶段一获取的权限集为前提，设计"自然衔接"的工作流，将智能体引入恶意执行路径，并评判（i）对抗目标是否实际达成，（ii）是否触发额外审批提示。实验在 Codex CLI（gpt-5.6-luna、gpt-5.6-sol）和 Claude Code（haiku-4.5、sonnet-5）四种生产平台配置上进行评估，对比 Direct Request / Direct Injection / IssueTrojanBench 等基线。

Result: （1）阶段一：跨四种智能体配置，攻击框架在 58% 的实验实例中成功诱发目标可复用规则，PCC 均值在 0.48–0.61 范围，显著优于 Direct Request 基线；尤其在高度对齐的 Claude sonnet-5 上，目标可达性从 1/25 提升至 9/25。（2）阶段二：在共享的阶段一合格实例上，条件性恶意目标静默完成率达 81.0%（47/58）；在 Codex gpt-5.6-luna 上达到 100%（17/17），远超 IssueTrojanBench（5/17）和 Direct Injection（0/17），且大多数成功显式匹配阶段一获取的权限前缀（prefix-attributed），证明权限被跨阶段实际复用。（3）机制洞察：a) Codex 沿行为历史抽象权限、Claude Code 沿静态命令语法抽象权限，二者沿正交维度泛化；b) 智能体遵循数据流/控制流依赖而非语义叙述，需把目标操作设为执行图上的必经节点（dominator）；c) 强模型（sonnet-5）会主动绕开非支配性攻击步骤，需要消除路径冗余。

Conclusion: 研究暴露了上下文相关审批在缺乏不可变权限上限（immutable authority ceiling）时的根本性盲区：当依赖上下文的权限被持久化为脱离语境的句法规则时，会引发类似经典"权限再委托（permission re-delegation）"的脆弱性——其中执行沙箱本身成为 confused deputy。结论强调，安全的审批机制需同时评估被提议权限的范围（scope）及其批准后的下游后果，并建议采用类似 CapScope 在读取不可信上下文前预先确定不可变权限上限的防御设计。

Abstract: Coding agents use execution harnesses to constrain the consequences of prompt injection by enforcing permission boundaries. These systems deterministically intercept any out-of-sandbox action and prompt the user for approval. To reduce approval fatigue, users can approve allow-rules proposed by the agent, after which any future action matching the rule is allowed without a prompt. In this work, we show that this mechanism introduces a new risk: untrusted context can influence the permissions presented for approval, with consequences extending beyond the immediate task. We investigate privilege escalation targeting this permission-update process. Specifically, adversarial context planted in a repository can reliably steer an agent performing a routine task into requesting a plausibly justified, yet dangerously broad allow-rule. If the user approves the request, the saved rule can effectively blind the harness, enabling adversaries to execute malicious actions that would otherwise require approval, without triggering human oversight. Across production platforms, including Claude Code and Codex CLI, we demonstrate that agents successfully elicit the target allow-rules in 58% of experimental instances. Once acquired, these rules exhibit a massive semantic blast radius, covering 56.9% of category-specific capability test cases. To further quantify the downstream risk, we show that conditional on rule approval, our exploit achieves verified, silent goal completion in 47 of the 58 eligible instances (81.0%), undermining the safety promise of human-in-the-loop oversight.

</details>


### [329] [GOLD: Geometric Optimized Latent Diffusion for Structure-Aware RNA Inverse Folding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22992)
*Qi Si,Xuyang Liu,Penglei Wang,Shuo Su,Limei Han,Mengzhu Li,Xin Guo,Yuan Qi,Yuan Cheng*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: GOLD提出了一种几何感知的潜在扩散框架，用于RNA反向折叠。其核心是将离散序列与连续侧链扭转角映射到统一的SO(2)等变潜在空间，并通过无训练的梯度引导采样机制（拓扑配对能量+空间碰撞能量）提升结构合理性，在序列恢复、二级结构有效性和3D可折叠性上达到SOTA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有RNA反向折叠方法通常仅在3D骨架条件下生成1D离散序列，忽略了侧链方向等连续几何信息，导致生成的序列常出现空间碰撞问题，限制结构稳定性。

Method: 1) GeoVAE：通过SO(2)旋转感知层将离散序列与连续糖苷键角χ统一映射到潜在流形，并结合RNA-FM语义对齐；2) 潜在扩散模型（DiT+GVP骨架条件）在该连续空间进行扩散生成；3) 双引导采样：通过可微StructureBuilder将序列概率与角度重建为3D坐标，从拓扑配对能量和范德华碰撞能量计算解析梯度，反向传播引导去噪过程。

Result: 在GOLD Benchmark（7583/1144/598）和CASP15 OOD测试集上，序列恢复、二级结构恢复和RhoFold/AlphaFold3的RMSD均全面优于PiFold、RDesign、gRNAde、RiboDiffusion和SOLD等基线；消融实验验证了SO(2)融合、统一潜在流形、基础模型对齐和双引导机制的独立贡献。

Conclusion: 通过将序列与侧链几何显式耦合到统一SO(2)等变潜在空间，并采用无训练的物理梯度引导，GOLD有效弥合了离散序列与连续3D结构之间的模态鸿沟，实现了物理一致且可泛化的RNA反向折叠；局限在于物理梯度计算增加推理耗时，且固定骨架设定限制了对柔性骨架的建模。

Abstract: Designing RNA sequences that fold into specific 3D structures is a fundamental challenge in therapeutics. Current RNA inverse folding methods typically condition on 3D backbone coordinates but the generation is limited to 1D discrete sequences. This ignores the continuous side-chain orientations, which are essential for overall structural stability. To address this issue, we explicitly introduce side-chain geometry into the RNA generative process. Unlike co-design frameworks that diffuse across separate raw spaces, we propose Geometric Optimized Latent Diffusion (\textbf{GOLD}), which project sequence and structure into a unified latent manifold. GOLD employs a novel GeoVAE to elegantly integrate discrete RNA sequences with continuous side-chain angles. By mapping these modalities into a single, smooth latent manifold, GOLD naturally facilitates a synergistic co-diffusion process. To enhance structural validity, we further introduce a training-free, gradient-guided sampling mechanism. By decoding the generated sequence probabilities and side-chain geometries into structures during the sampling process, we compute analytical gradients from physical constraints. This dynamic feedback actively guides the generated sequence to a physically stable state. Extensive experiments validate the superiority of GOLD, achieving state-of-the-art performance across sequence recovery, secondary structure validity, and 3D foldability metrics. Our code and data are publicly available at this https URL .

</details>


### [330] [Efficient CPU-GPU collaborative MoE inference via Adaptive Expert Assignment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23006)
*Wenhui Lv,Yunming Liao,Hongli Xu,Yang Xu,Junhao Cheng*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出Apex系统，通过自适应专家分配在CPU-GPU协同执行中优化内存受限的MoE推理。其核心思想是根据专家的token负载和运行时速率，动态决定将哪些未命中的专家转移到GPU执行、哪些保留在CPU执行，以平衡两条并行路径的延迟。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: MoE模型专家参数总量巨大，无法全部驻留在GPU内存中，必须依赖专家卸载。现有方案存在两类瓶颈：(1)纯GPU执行需要通过PCIe传输缺失专家，开销可达GPU计算的13倍以上；(2)CPU-GPU协同执行将所有缺失专家在CPU上计算，但CPU计算吞吐量通常比GPU低一个数量级，导致CPU成为关键路径瓶颈。两者都将缺失专家一视同仁，忽略了专家间token负载的不均衡性。

Method: Apex系统包含四个组件：(1) 推测性排序器(Speculative Ranker)——利用当前层注意力输出预测下一层激活专家并排序；(2) 传输控制器(Transfer Controller)——结合精确分配和推测分配，基于在线观测的CPU/GPU/传输速率，扫描所有可能的传输数量p，选择使两条路径延迟最大值最小化的方案；(3) 推理引擎(Inference Engine)——按计划分组token并合并CPU/GPU输出；(4) 专家池管理器(Expert Pool Manager)——基于指数衰减的token负载效用进行驱逐。精确分配通过求解 argmin_p max{T_CPU(p), T_transfer(G)+T_GPU} 来平衡路径。

Result: 在三个MoE模型(Qwen3.5-35B-A3B、Qwen3-Next-80B-A3B、GLM-4.5-Air)上评估，相比最强基线：预填充速度平均提升31.2%，最高提升51.9%；解码吞吐量平均提升31.1%，最高提升39.5%。在不同GPU专家池容量(0.5G₀至1.5G₀)和不同批量大小(1至32)下均保持优势。消融实验表明精确分配(EA)和推测分配(SA)互补：仅SA提升16.8%，仅EA提升24.7%，两者结合提升42.7%。

Conclusion: Apex证明了在运行时基于专家token负载和实测速率动态平衡专家传输与CPU计算，可有效减少内存受限MoE推理的关键路径延迟。该方法在不同GPU内存预算下均稳健，适用于大规模MoE模型的私有化/本地化部署场景。

Abstract: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models reduce inference computation through sparse expert activation, but their large expert memory footprint often exceeds GPU capacity, making expert offloading necessary for memory-constrained inference. However, existing systems typically handle GPU-missed experts by either transferring them to the GPU, incurring substantial PCIe transfer latency, or executing them on the CPU, making the slower CPU computation the bottleneck. To address these limitations, we present \method, a CPU-GPU collaborative MoE inference system that adaptively assigns these missed experts to the CPU or GPU for efficient execution. By exploiting differences in expert token-loads, \method selectively transfers high-load experts to the GPU while executing low-load experts on the CPU. To minimize inference latency, \method adaptively adjusts expert assignments to balance the CPU computation path against the GPU transfer-and-computation path, allowing both execution paths to complete as early as possible. Extensive experiments on three representative MoE LLMs show that \method improves prefill speed by up to 51.9\% and decode throughput by up to 39.5\% over the strongest baseline across the evaluated batch sizes, with consistent gains under different GPU-memory budgets.

</details>


### [331] [Adaptation of Computer Use Agents to New Software with User Manuals](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23012)
*Chulhoon Yoon,Kyungri Park,Jinyeong Yun,Daeyun Jeong,Sukmin Yun,Woohwan Jung*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出MAGE框架，利用用户手册作为程序性知识来源，通过检索增强规划（RAP）和基于GRPO的策略优化（PO），在推理和训练两个阶段同时提升计算机使用代理（CUAs）适应新软件的能力，无需人工演示数据。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有CUAs在未见过的应用程序上性能下降，且依赖昂贵的人工标注数据进行适配。GUI任务具有长视野特性，重要功能常隐藏在菜单、对话框中，强化学习难以收集足够的成功轨迹。用户手册包含丰富的操作流程知识，但现有方法仅在推理时利用外部知识，未解决策略适配问题。

Method: 提出MAGE（Manual-augmented computer use AGent Execution and learning）框架，包含两个核心组件：（1）检索增强规划（RAP）：利用Qwen3-Embedding编码手册段落，基于余弦相似度检索Top-K相关段落，由多模态LLM生成任务特定的执行计划；（2）基于GRPO的策略优化：从手册自动生成setup-main任务-计划对，在目标GUI环境中执行生成轨迹，使用VLM评估器（仅基于最后5张截图）分配成功奖励，并加入步效率奖励，采用轮式训练策略重用已有数据。

Result: 在OSWorld基准的5个应用（Calc、Impress、Writer、GIMP、VSCode）和新增的Slack测试集（30个任务）上评估，使用UI-TARS-1.5和EvoCUA两个骨干模型。MAGE在所有应用上均取得统计显著的改进（p<0.001），Slack上提升最大（UI-TARS-1.5提升22.66%p）。消融研究表明RAP单独贡献11.06%p，PO在此基础上再贡献8.51%p。平均适配成本：46.62小时+37.83美元API费用。

Conclusion: MAGE证明了程序性文档可同时作为执行时规划和训练时监督的可扩展来源，通过统一的框架设计有效减少了对人工演示的依赖，为CUAs适配新应用提供了低成本的解决方案。

Abstract: Recent advances in multimodal foundation models have significantly improved the ability to operate real-world software through graphical user interfaces (GUIs) using visual observations and natural language instructions. However, maintaining strong performance on unseen applications remains challenging, as practical tasks often require long-horizon procedural knowledge and application-specific operation patterns. In addition, constructing executable tasks and collecting corresponding trajectories for training still heavily rely on human-annotated data, incurring substantial cost. In this paper, we propose MAGE (Manual-augmented computer use AGent Execution and learning), a framework that leverages user manuals as a scalable source of procedural knowledge to improve both inference and training. During execution, MAGE retrieves task-relevant manual content and uses a planner to generate explicit procedural guidance for CUAs. To further account for the discrepancies between manuals and actual GUI environments, such as version differences or user settings, MAGE also adapts the agent policy through environment interaction. During training, MAGE converts manuals into executable task-plan pairs and uses the plans to guide environment rollouts toward task-relevant states; the resulting trajectories are then used to optimize the policy without human-authored demonstrations. This unified design enables effective utilization of manuals for both task execution and training, reducing reliance on human-authored training data. Experimental results across six applications demonstrate improvements in task success rates over strong baselines, highlighting the effectiveness of manual-guided planning and policy adaptation in new software environments. We provide the code and reproduction scripts at this https URL .

</details>


### [332] [Causal Value Attribution of Marketing Labels in LLM-Generated Ads: A Deconfounder Approach](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23025)
*Danhong You,Wei Jiang,Zhiqiang,Zheng*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本研究提出D-VAE（去混淆变分自编码器）框架，用于在LLM介导的生成式营销场景中，对驱动AI输出的专家标注技能进行因果效应估计与价值评估。该框架通过去混淆器与因果表示学习识别技能配置，并给出基于PAC的遗漏变量偏差界限，最终在广告创意优化中实现与人类专家无显著差异的效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI生成内容日趋商品化，价值重心正从最终产出上移至上游用于引导LLM生成的专业知识（专家标注技能）。现有组织缺乏对这种专业知识进行估值并识别哪些技能或配置因果性提升绩效的方法。尤其在LLM介导的随机性、高维标签交互与多模态混淆下，技能对结果的因果效应难以识别。

Method: 提出D-VAE（Deconfounder Variational Autoencoder），一种反事实推理框架，融合多处理去混淆器（multi-treatment deconfounder）与因果表示学习（causal representation learning）。该方法恢复因果解耦的专家标注逻辑，并针对单处理混淆源给出基于PAC（概率近似正确）学习的遗漏变量偏差上界。实证部分：①在29,177条粉底广告创意数据上与SOTA基准对比；②进行现场实验检验推荐配置；③开展仿真研究验证在复杂混淆与处理交互下的因果归因可靠性。

Result: ①基准对比：D-VAE在预测与因果推断任务上优于现有SOTA方法；②现场实验：推荐的标签/技能配置使广告参与度提升32.7%，且与人类专家表现无统计显著差异；③仿真：在复杂混淆和处理交互设定下，因果归因稳健有效。

Conclusion: 研究将价值评估对象从AI生成的最终产物转移到上游技能（专家标注）层面，为AI增强型技能组合的定价与优化奠定方法论基础。D-VAE为在高维、多模态、随机LLM介导情境下进行因果技能归因提供了可行路径。

Abstract: As AI-generated content becomes commoditized, economic value increasingly shifts from final artifacts to the upstream expertise used to specify inputs that steer LLM generation. Yet organizations lack methods for valuing this expertise and identifying which individual skills or configurations causally improve performance. This study examines generative marketing, where structured expert labels serve as skill primitives conditioning LLM-generated advertisements. Estimating their causal effects is difficult because outcomes reflect stochastic LLM mediation, high-dimensional label interactions, and multimodal confounding. This study proposes D-VAE (Deconfounder Variational Autoencoder), a counterfactual-inference framework integrating a multi-treatment deconfounder with causal representation learning. D-VAE recovers causally disentangled expert-labeling logic and derives PAC-based bounds on omitted-variable bias from single-treatment confounders. Applied to 29,177 foundation-makeup ad creatives, D-VAE outperforms state-of-the-art benchmarks. A field experiment shows that recommended configurations increase engagement by 32.7% and perform statistically indistinguishably from human experts, while a simulation study confirms causal attribution under complex confounding and treatment interactions. Overall, the study shifts value assessment from AI-generated products to skills, providing a foundation for pricing and optimizing AI-augmented skill portfolios.

</details>


### [333] [ASE: Attribution-Guided Semantic Evolution for Time Series Forecasting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23027)
*Yuxuan Zheng,Zhaoyang Li,Purui Liu,Hengbo Xiao,Guannan He*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出ASE（归因引导语义演化）模块化框架，用于文本增强时间序列预测；通过C1因子构建、C2条件评估与组合搜索、C3验证控制部署，在四个TESS数据集和CSI300股票排序上获得优于基线的结果，并通过模块分析验证各组件的贡献。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 外部文本能为数值预测补充信息，但其价值取决于表示、组合与部署方式。已有方法多关注检索与对齐，缺乏对"应将何种信息反馈给语言模型"的系统化机制，因此需要一种可反馈、可验证、可部署的文本因子构建与条件评估框架。

Method: 三模块框架：(C1)语言模型提出事件/状态定义，经Qwen3-Embedding编码为相似度特征并形成乘积特征库；(C2)基于Ridge预测器的条件重拟合贡献Δ(A|S)进行组合搜索，采用核岭回归代理与交互控制，并保留历史最优组合以防回退；(C3)冻结预测器并通过验证选择门控实现残差或联合部署。预测器在反馈、搜索与最终预测中保持同一Ridge-10结构，并通过历史归一化使数据拟合项正比于原始尺度误差。

Result: 四个TESS数据集（FNSPID、Electricity、Environment、Bitcoin）测试MSE分别为0.001041、0.022439、0.333115、1.8150，均低于已发布TESS分数；CSI300动态股票排序中，文本融合实现平均RankIC较数值专家提升0.000642，较匹配打乱文本提升0.000701，五个种子全部为正差异；模块研究证实incumbent retention避免640次转移中216次回退，结构化反馈优于标量反馈（2.10%）与自由反思（2.17%）。

Conclusion: ASE通过将文本预测组织为因子构建、条件评估与受控部署三模块，在四个预测数据集上取得低于TESS的MSE点估计，并在CSI300上获得跨五个种子的正排序增量；受控模块研究刻画了结构化反馈、条件选择与incumbent retention的特定任务角色，支持针对预测任务适配表示与部署选择。

Abstract: External text can supply predictive information absent from numerical histories, but its value depends on how it is represented, combined and deployed. We present Attribution-guided Semantic Evolution (ASE), a modular framework for constructing textual factors, evaluating their conditional contribution, and deploying validation-selected numerical--textual predictors. ASE supports task-specific implementations with lexical measurements, semantic primitives or evolved event/state factors, coupled to suitable numerical experts. Its feedback-based implementation uses conditional refitting diagnostics to guide factor revision and combination search. We evaluate ASE on the four text-associated TESS datasets and dynamic CSI 300 stock ranking. The four forecasting implementations obtain test MSEs of 0.001041, 0.022439, 0.333115 and 1.8150, each below the corresponding published TESS score. On CSI 300, the frozen text-fusion implementation improves mean RankIC by 0.000642 over its numerical expert and by 0.000701 over matched shuffled text, with positive differences in all five seeds. Controlled text perturbations support functional reliance on text correspondence, while incumbent retention prevents regressions in the measured development criterion. Together, the experiments characterize ASE at two levels: forecasting performance of task-specific implementations and the conditional contributions of individual modules.

</details>


### [334] [Where Research Ideation Begins: Forward-Citation Supervision for Actionable Limitation Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23038)
*Liyang Zhao,Yong Cao,Haibin Ling*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文提出利用前向引用作为监督信号，构建ActLim-Bench数据集和ActLim-8B模型，用于自动化生成论文中可操作的局限性(actionable limitations)。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有自动化研究构思系统多关注端到端想法生成，而忽略了关键的第一步：从文献中识别可操作的局限性。同时，作者发现大语言模型在识别局限性方面能力随规模提升，但生成局限性能力并未随之提升，说明瓶颈在于监督信号而非模型能力。

Method: 1. 构建ActLim-Bench数据集：基于前向引用挖掘源论文的局限性，由后续引用论文提供证据支撑，并经过严格的验证器筛选（涵盖归因、一致性、具体性、响应四个标准）；2. 三阶段训练流程：监督微调（SFT）、验证器过滤的拒绝采样微调（RSFT）、集合级GRPO强化学习，使用统一的验证器作为训练时的支架；3. 最终模型ActLim-8B仅需源论文即可生成局限性，无需引用论文或验证器调用。

Result: ActLim-8B在NLP测试集上GRec@3达到0.452（最强零样本基线为0.262），SpecRec@3达到0.241（基线为0.098）；在CV跨域测试上达到0.314；人类评估中在64.9%的非平局对比中被偏好；下游想法生成任务中RetAlign从0.302提升至0.480。

Conclusion: 前向引用监督信号显著优于作者自述、审稿人意见和受控扰动等监督源（差距达0.117 GRec@3）。该工作揭示了判断-生成不对称现象，并提供了一个可审计、可扩展的桥梁连接既有研究与未来方向生成。ActLim-Bench捕获的是后来被实际追求的局限性，而非所有有效局限性，因此是actionability的代理而非科学价值的衡量。

Abstract: Automated research ideation has advanced rapidly, with multi-agent workflows that generate whole research ideas end to end. These frameworks leave largely unexamined the step that seeds a good idea: identifying an actionable limitation from literature. In this paper, we focus on this first step in the research ideation pipeline. Starting from a pilot study, we find that as large language models (LLMs) scale from 0.6B to 32B parameters, they become far better at recognizing which limitation later work addressed, but no better at generating one, suggesting that the bottleneck lies in the supervision signal rather than model capacity. We therefore construct ActLim-Bench from forward citations, yielding 18,279 evidence-linked supervision triples with human verification. On this signal, we propose a three-stage post-training pipeline: supervised fine-tuning, verifier-filtered rejection-sampling fine-tuning, and reinforcement learning with the verifier as an online dense reward. Experimental results show that our method achieves the highest recall score compared to existing methods among all frontier models. We further show that our generated limitations are preferred in 64.9% of non-tied human comparisons and improve downstream ideation systems. We will release our data and code upon publication.

</details>


### [335] [Where Does the Performance Go? Understanding and Recovering Performance Regressions in C-to-Rust Translation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23044)
*Zhiqiang Yuan,Chong Wang,Zhenhao Zhou,Junwei Liu,Xin Peng*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文针对 C-to-Rust 自动化翻译中普遍存在的性能退化问题展开系统性研究。作者构建了 20 个真实 C 项目的基准，通过配对分析识别出 9 类反复出现的性能问题，并据此提出基于 LLM 的规则引导框架 PerfR，在 12 个未见项目上成功恢复甚至超越原始 C 的性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Rust 凭借内存安全特性正逐步取代 C，但自动化翻译工具（如 c2rust）虽能保持行为正确，却不能保证性能不退化。已有研究多基于合成程序或单一机制分析，缺乏对真实项目中翻译诱发性能退化的系统理解，也缺少可复用的优化规则。

Method: 研究方法分两部分：(1) 实证研究——在 8 个项目（Study Dataset）上对 c2rust 翻译结果与原始 C 进行配对运行时对比，结合 perf 采样、Top-Down Microarchitecture Analysis (TMA) 与 LLVM 优化报告，按 T = I × CPI × T_{CYCLE} 分解执行成本，识别出 9 类反复出现的性能问题并提炼优化方向；(2) 工具 PerfR——将每类问题编码为「观察模式+优化方向+前置条件」的可复用优化卡，通过 profile 定位热点函数、模式匹配识别适用规则、由 LLM 在检查前置条件后生成候选改写，并经功能与性能双重验证后采纳。其余 12 个项目（Evaluation Dataset）用于评估。

Result: 研究发现：19 个操作中有 12 个开销超过 3%，最高达 62.2%；退化源于动态指令数膨胀（CPI 升高或二者叠加），其中 9 个问题分为三类（残余运行时开销、丢失的编译器优化、源代码层模式）。PerfR 在 41 个操作上保持与 C 输出等价，并在其中 40 个上较 RawRust 提速，18 个最终快于原始 C；在与通用编码代理 Codex 的 37 个可比操作中，PerfR 在 31 个上更低；较无规则引导版本 PerfR∖R 在 34/41 个上更低；典型案例 checksum 计算开销从 +16.7% 改善为 -66.0%。

Conclusion: 本文首次系统刻画了真实 C 项目经机械翻译后的运行时性能退化机制，并验证了由此蒸馏出的规则能显著指导性能恢复。PerfR 在跨项目场景下兼顾功能正确性与性能改进，表明基于实证提炼的领域知识能有效指导 LLM 完成针对性优化，同时也收窄了 unsafe 接口。

Abstract: Rust is increasingly adopted as a memory-safe successor to C, and transpilers such as \crust{} can migrate entire C projects while preserving their behavior. Preserving behavior, however, does not guarantee preserving performance. We study this gap on 20 real-world C projects and their \crust{} translations. On the eight projects used for analysis, the translated Rust is more than 3\% slower than the original C on 12 of 19 operations, by up to 62.2\%. By comparing execution-cost profiles, optimized LLVM IR, and compiler optimization remarks across each C--Rust pair, we trace these slowdowns to nine recurring performance issues, spanning residual runtime work, missed compiler optimizations, and C-style source patterns, and derive an optimization direction for each. We then present \ourtool{}, an LLM-based approach that encodes these issues as reusable optimization rules to recover the performance of translated Rust. \ourtool{} profiles each project to locate hot functions and matches them against rule-specific patterns. The LLM then checks each rule's rewrite preconditions against the project context before rewriting, and a rewrite is kept only if it passes both functional and performance validation. On 41 operations from twelve held-out projects, \ourtool{} preserves C outputs on all tested workloads and speeds up 40 operations over the \crust{} translations, 18 of which end up faster than the original C. It outperforms the general-purpose coding agent \codex{} on 31 of the 37 operations where both preserve C outputs, and outperforms its own variant without rule guidance on 34 of the 41 operations.

</details>


### [336] [Distill Until Divergence: Error-Truncated Hindsight Distillation for Agentic RL](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23048)
*Yibin Huang,Conghui Zhu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出ETRO方法，针对长时程智能体强化学习中后视蒸馏（hindsight distillation）存在的"后视适用性错配"问题，通过基于轨迹结果和错误边界路由正负两类互补技能，解决技能条件化监督与变化后的交互状态不匹配的问题，实现细粒度信用分配。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于结果的GRPO缺乏对中间决策的细粒度指导。现有方法将完整轨迹蒸馏为可重用技能，并通过后视条件化OPD提供密集的token级信用，但技能引起的概率偏移并不必然代表奖励对齐的信用——尤其在错误动作改变后续交互状态后，技能条件化监督可能与当前状态不匹配。

Method: ETRO（Error-Truncated polarity-Routed Distillation）通过写作器估计错误边界路由两类互补的后视技能：正向技能捕获成功工作流，用于强化成功轨迹和错误前的前缀；负向技能捕获失败特定的修正，用于定位决定性错误。错误后的后缀仅由GRPO优化，保留基于结果的学习而不延伸可能错配的后视监督。具体地，将GRPO优势与路由的OPD优势相加：成功轨迹使用正向技能；失败轨迹在错误前使用正向技能，在错误处使用负向技能，后缀无OPD监督。

Result: 在WebShop、ALFWorld和Search QA三个领域，使用Qwen2.5-Instruct（1.5B/3B/7B）进行评估。7B规模ETRO达到WebShop 85.8%成功率、ALFWorld 97.0%成功率、Search QA 51.8%宏平均准确率，在所有报告方法中表现最优。消融实验验证了正向/负向技能分支的互补作用、错误边界处截断的必要性（优于随机边界和后缀监督）、以及将负向技能精确定位于诊断错误处的优势。恢复实验显示截断后缀监督后，恢复成功率提升、错误分支延续率降低。写作器质量评估显示边界接受率92.0%，工作流和修正有效性分别为92.0%和90.0%。

Conclusion: ETRO通过将工作流指导与局部错误修正分离，按技能极性和轨迹位置路由OPD，同时在完整rollout中保留GRPO，实现了有效的后视信用分配。实验表明有效的后视信用分配取决于技能内容及其时间适用性。未来工作可将路由扩展到多个错误和恢复边界。

Abstract: Long-horizon interaction requires agents to make multiple decisions in a changing environment. Outcome-based GRPO lacks fine-grained guidance for intermediate decisions. Recent methods distill completed trajectories into reusable skills and use hindsight-conditioned OPD to provide dense token-level credit. However, skill-induced probability shifts do not necessarily represent reward-aligned credit; especially after an erroneous action changes subsequent interaction states, skill-conditioned supervision may become mismatched with the current state. To address this mismatch, we propose \methodname{}, which routes two complementary hindsight skills according to trajectory outcomes and error boundaries: Positive skills capture successful workflows to reinforce successful trajectories and pre-error decisions, while Negative skills capture failure-specific corrections to target decisive errors. The post-error suffix is optimized exclusively by GRPO, retaining outcome-based learning without extending potentially mismatched hindsight supervision. Extensive experiments demonstrate competitive task performance and support effective fine-grained credit allocation.

</details>


### [337] [Agentic In-Context Learning: What Algorithms Can Transformers Learn in Closed-Loop Interaction?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23051)
*Shiguang Wu,Yaqing Wang,Quanming Yao*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出"智能体上下文学习"(Agentic ICL)框架,将上下文学习从被动处理提示扩展到智能体通过动作主动塑造自身上下文的闭环设置。研究构建了因果Transformer近似各种交互式学习算法的表达性理论,并理论刻画了过程奖励何时能保留结果最优行为。实验证明Transformer可执行三种典型递归,并展示了不同训练目标(结果奖励vs过程奖励)如何导致不同的决策策略,该差异在预训练语言模型的文本释义中仍然存在。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有上下文学习(ICL)研究主要依赖外部提供的上下文或包含奖励的交互历史,而通用工具使用智能体缺乏学习算法视角。研究者希望理解:(1) Transformer能在闭环交互中学习什么样的算法?(3) 训练目标如何塑造学习到的行为?智能体的动作决定了下一条证据,这与ICL的被动设置有本质区别。

Method: 方法包含四个层面:(1) 闭环框架——将交互学习者分解为充分状态、更新规则、决策规则,统一覆盖主动学习、 bandits、在线RL;(2) 设t4.1构造性证明将正则有限时域递归编译为因果Transformer,深度O(H),并给出自主回报损失界BHε;(3) 命题5.1理论刻画过程监督何时保留结果最优行为(𝒜⁻ₛ,ₜ(h) ⊆ 𝒜⁻ₒᵤₜ,ₜ(h));(4) BTS(贝叶斯工具选择)环境设计——提供可精确诊断的工具使用环境。

Result: 主要实验结果:(1) 监督蒸馏显示Transformer可学会执行Bayes DP、UCB、Q-learning三种递归;(2) 结果奖励训练产生接近Bayes DP的行为,一步过程奖励训练产生接近KG的行为;(3) 保持排序的过程奖励保留了结果最优行为(潜在势能塑形);(4) 信用折扣γ从0增加到1时,在W集合上排序违反在(0.95,1.00)区间消失;(5) 这些差异在Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct的文本释义中持续存在。

Conclusion: 研究将ICL的学习算法视角扩展到闭环交互,统一了主动学习、 bandits、在线RL和工具使用。理论证明Transformer可表达这些递归,实验显示训练目标(结果vs过程奖励)显著影响学到的决策策略,且该差异在预训练LLM中跨文本释义保持。理论保证表达性但不保证优化收敛;行为比较是候选相对的,实验使用小规模结构化任务。

Abstract: The learning algorithm view of in-context learning (ICL) studies how fixed-parameter Transformers learn from supplied examples. Language model agents extend this setting through interaction: their actions determine what evidence enters context next. We call this regime Agentic In-Context Learning (Agentic ICL). Existing studies largely depend on externally supplied contexts or reward-bearing interaction histories, while work on general tool-using agents lacks a learning algorithm view. We represent an interactive learner by its state, update, and decision rule, covering active learning, bandits, and online reinforcement learning (RL). For expressivity, we construct causal Transformers that approximate these algorithms over a finite horizon, and bound the resulting loss in return. For training, we characterize when optimizing process rewards preserves behavior that maximizes the final outcome. Distillation experiments show that Transformers can learn to execute three representative recursions. We then train models from outcome or process rewards without oracle action or state targets, as in RL post-training. Different rewards yield distinct decision policies. Improving the alignment of process supervision with outcome-optimal action preferences shifts learned decisions accordingly. Such behavioral differences persist in a pretrained language model across textual paraphrases.

</details>


### [338] [Rethinking GRPO for Large Reasoning Model Safety Alignment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23085)
*Jiawei Chen,Yi Zhang,Jiawei Du,Zhonghou Lv,Tairan Chen,Junyuan Shang,Jinchang Hou,Xiao Yang,Yu Tian,Chenfu Bao,Chao Yu,Zhaoxia Yin*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文重新审视了GRPO在大推理模型(LRM)安全对齐中的应用,识别出优势崩塌和危险多样化两种失效模式,提出了Beacon框架,通过安全信号恢复(SSR)和安全-效用解耦对齐(SUDA)有效提升安全性并保持推理能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: GRPO被广泛用于大推理模型的安全对齐,但其组内相对优化机制在安全对齐场景下可能提供不足的学习信号。已有研究多关注数据和奖励设计,缺乏对GRPO优化机制在LRM安全对齐中失效原因的系统分析。

Method: 提出Beacon框架,包含两大模块:1) 安全信号恢复(SSR)——通过优势引导的轨迹过滤(AGTF)保留高对比度轨迹,并通过安全参考监督(SRS)在信号崩塌时提供显式安全指导;2) 安全-效用解耦对齐(SUDA)——通过类别感知奖励设计和仅对良性提示施加KL锚定,缓解过度拒绝问题。从理论上证明了优势崩塌(行为一致性导致组内安全对比消失)和危险多样化(熵正则化在信号消失时分散不安全响应)的产生机制。

Result: 在Qwen3和DeepSeek-R1-Distill四个模型变体、8个基准测试上的实验表明,Beacon实现了最佳的平均安全性和推理性能,平均安全错误率降低高达32.83个百分点,同时保持低过度拒绝率(0.40%-1.20%)。在GCG、PAIR、AutoDAN和TAP对抗攻击下也展现出优越的鲁棒性。消融实验验证了四个关键组件各自的贡献。

Conclusion: 本文揭示了GRPO在LRM安全对齐中的两种特征性失效模式,并提供了理论分析。通过Beacon框架的设计,有效恢复了安全学习信号并缓解了安全税问题,为大推理模型的安全对齐提供了新的优化视角。

Abstract: Large reasoning models (LRMs) exhibit strong reasoning capabilities but remain vulnerable to unsafe outputs. While Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) is widely used for safety alignment, its group-relative optimization may provide insufficient safety-directed learning signals. In this paper, we identify two failure modes: advantage collapse, where homogeneous rollout groups yield vanishing advantages, and unsafe diversification, where unsafe behaviors persist and become increasingly diverse. Our theoretical analysis reveals that behavioral consistency weakens within-group safety contrasts, while entropy regularization can diversify unsafe responses when relative signals vanish. To address these challenges, we propose Beacon, comprising Safety Signal Recovery (SSR) and Safety-Utility Decoupled Alignment (SUDA). SSR combines advantage-guided trajectory filtering and safe reference supervision to recover effective safety learning signals, while SUDA employs category-aware rewards and benign-only KL anchoring to mitigate over-refusal without compromising safety. Experiments across four Qwen3 and DeepSeek-R1-Distill variants and eight benchmarks show that our framework achieves the best average safety and reasoning performance, reducing average safety error by up to 32.83 percentage points while maintaining low over-refusal.

</details>


### [339] [WebCoder: Scaling General Frontend Development with Artifact-Grounded Agentic Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23104)
*Zijun Dou,Zhen Yang,Xijun Liu,Dongzhuoran Zhou,Aohan Zeng,Jie Tang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出WebCoder，一个通过artifact-grounded agentic强化学习训练的通用前端开发智能体。该工作针对真实前端开发中需要在一个持续演化的应用状态上协调复制、生成、修改和修复四种能力的核心问题，构建了Webdev-World执行环境，并提出了一个基于需求清单的统一奖励与信用分配机制。论文同时提出Webdev-Bench基准用于评估能力组合与既有行为保持。实验表明WebCoder-27B在Webdev-Bench和Vision2Web上分别以72.8和62.4的综合得分超越了Claude-Opus-4.8和GPT-5.4。消融实验证实了artifact-grounded信用分配与长horizon训练均对最终性能有显著贡献。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有前端智能体研究通常将网页复现、生成、修改、修复视作彼此独立的任务分类，而真实开发场景下用户请求往往需要在一份持久化、持续演化的应用状态中依次组合这些能力并保持既有行为。论文指出训练一个能进行通用前端开发的策略面临三大挑战：异构活动需要统一的评价基础、长序列相互依赖动作间的有效信用分配，以及超出单一上下文窗口的轨迹训练支持。

Method: 方法核心是artifact-grounded agentic强化学习：(1) Webdev-World是一个集成代码编辑、应用执行、浏览器检查和按需技能的共享可执行环境，使单一策略能够在同一项目状态上交替进行多种开发活动。(2) 终端奖励由独立验证器构建、运行并审查最终应用，按加权需求清单计算质量分数，并由执行有效性门控。(3) 基于artifact potential的信用分配：同一份需求清单被用于估计段边界处的中间需求满足度，其变化量用于在GRPO优势基础上按段重新分配信用，回答"哪个开发阶段推进了任务"的问题。(4) 通过context compaction配合message-tree样本构造和ownership mask，使超出上下文窗口的轨迹也能用于训练，且共享的生成历史最多只对损失贡献一次。优化目标是带mask的clip目标，按段级别优势对生成token做策略梯度。

Result: 主要结果：在Webdev-Bench（40个复合任务，188个需求，1125个隐藏清单项）上，WebCoder-27B将基础模型Qwen3.8-27B的需求满足率从64.8提升到72.8，超过Claude-Opus-4.8的65.1和GPT-5.4的59.6；在Vision2Web上，平均视觉与功能得分从41.1提升到62.4，与Claude-Opus-4.8的62.5持平。消融实验：去掉artifact-grounded信用分配使Avg下降9.8分，去掉长horizon compaction使Avg下降7.5分。人工偏好评估显示WebCoder-27B对比四个对手的胜或平局比例在72.5%-75%之间。训练动力学分析显示策略熵、工具冗余调用与webshot调用频率在Early、Trough、Recovery三个窗口呈现协同变化，与奖励曲线一致。

Conclusion: WebCoder验证了将异构前端开发活动统一在一个共享可执行工件及其需求满足度上的可行性，证明以artifact演化作为策略学习的共同基础，能够训练出在复合任务上超越强闭源模型的通用前端开发智能体；研究同时表明基于artifact potential的段级信用分配与跨上下文窗口训练的长horizon机制都是性能提升的必要组件。论文的局限包括：Webdev-Bench中任务的失败节点多集中于货币精度等极端边缘情况，提示需要在格式化与浮点处理上做更精细的奖励设计；以及benchmark中的人类偏好评估仅覆盖了WebCoder 27B对比4个对手的成对比较，对更细粒度的因果归因仍需未来工作补充。

Abstract: Real-world frontend development requires agents to compose reproduction, generation, modification, and repair over an evolving application state. Learning a general policy for this process requires translating heterogeneous execution feedback into task-aligned rewards and effective credit assignment across long sequences of interdependent actions. We introduce WebCoder, a general frontend development agent trained with artifact-grounded agentic reinforcement learning. Our key idea is to assess diverse development activities through their effects on a shared executable artifact and its satisfaction of task requirements. We build Webdev-World, an executable environment that integrates code editing, application execution, browser inspection, and on-demand skills while preserving project state across interactions. An independent verifier evaluates the final application against task requirements to provide terminal rewards, while changes in intermediate artifact progress redistribute the resulting rollout advantage across development segments. Context compaction and message-tree sample construction support training on trajectories beyond a single context window while avoiding repeated loss computation on shared generated history. We further introduce Webdev-Bench to evaluate composed development requirements within a single project. On Webdev-Bench, WebCoder-27B raises requirement satisfaction from 64.8 for its Qwen3.8-27B base model to 72.8, exceeding Claude-Opus-4.8 (65.1) and GPT-5.4 (59.6); on Vision2Web, it improves the average visual and functional score from 41.1 to 62.4, on par with Claude-Opus-4.8. Ablation studies confirm the contributions of artifact-grounded credit assignment and long-horizon training.

</details>


### [340] [LexPilot: Benchmarking the Proactive Interaction Ability of Legal LLMs with Laypeople in Chinese Civil Case Consultation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23141)
*Wenbin Zhang,ShangZhan Li,Bingxiang He,Ye He,Yuxin Zhou,Muzhen Cai,Qi Shi,Wanxiang Che*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: LexPilot是一个基于中国民事判决书构建的基准测试，用于评估法律大语言模型在与非专业用户进行咨询时的主动交互能力。它将主动法律交互与请求级判决预测相连接，通过对比完整咨询与欠指定咨询下模型的表现，揭示当前LLM在识别信息缺失、主动追问缺失细节以及最终做出可靠判决预测方面的显著不足。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前法律LLM在面对非专业人士的欠指定咨询时，往往缺乏关键案件细节却仍倾向于直接给出不负责任的预测或泛化建议，这可能严重误导缺乏法律知识的公众。因此，需要一种评估方法衡量LLM能否主动识别争议焦点并引导用户补充必要信息，以提高下游判决预测的可靠性。

Method: 基于432份真实中国民事一审判决书（涵盖36类常见案由），构建成对的完整与欠指定咨询历史，并由两位法律专家进行审核与校正。将主动法律交互分解为三个连续子任务：法律完备性评估（LCA）、细节补全引导（DCG）和法律判决预测（LJP）。提出LexAwN提示框架（基于Ask-when-Needed改编），评估10个领先LLM（含通用模型与法律专用模型），使用DeepSeek-R1作为LLM-as-a-judge，指标包括Macro-F1（用于LCA）、Accuracy（用于DCG）和Quadratic Weighted Kappa（用于LJP），并辅以案例复杂度、焦点类型和非理想用户等分析。

Result: 实验显示当前LLM在欠指定咨询中的主动交互能力存在显著缺陷：闭源模型Claude-Opus-5在LCA上Macro-F1最高仅0.7211，DCG准确率最高仅0.7417；所有模型在基于交互的LJP上相较完整咨询的金标准QWK平均相对下降23.84%。分析发现案件复杂度（援引法条数）与LCA、DCG性能呈负相关；"金额评估"类焦点最难引导提问；服务合同与金融合同类案件表现最差，主要受其复杂的金额评估焦点影响；目标性追问能提升判决预测，而偏离性追问则降低性能；在非理想用户（延迟披露、自纠正）下模型性能进一步下降。

Conclusion: LexPilot基准揭示了当前LLM在面向公众的法律主动交互方面的关键瓶颈，包括遗漏检测、问题生成与复杂案件推理能力的不足。研究强调亟需发展以用户为中心的法律AI，使模型在信息不足时能够负责任地暂停预测并主动引导用户补全事实，从而提供更可靠、更安全的法律辅助。

Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have greatly assisted legal professionals. However, our empirical studies reveal that, when faced with underspecified consultations from non-experts, current LLMs often produce irresponsible responses with limited utility despite lacking sufficient case details for definitive conclusions. To better assist laypeople, legal LLMs must identify focal points of dispute and proactively elicit crucial context from users. Unfortunately, existing data resources often focus on interaction and response quality, offering limited insight into how proactive interaction affects LLMs' downstream claim-level judgment prediction in actual civil cases. To address this gap, we introduce \textbf{LexPilot}, a benchmark linking proactive legal interaction to claim-level verdict prediction using authentic Chinese civil judgments. Constructed from 432 real-world judgments across 36 common causes of action, LexPilot comprises expert-reviewed pairs of complete and underspecified consultation histories with corresponding court verdicts. Experiments reveal that current LLMs struggle with proactive legal interactions in underspecified consultations, with downstream judgment prediction substantially underperforming that in the fully specified consultation setup (-23.84% on average). Further analysis identifies critical bottlenecks hindering these capabilities. Our work highlights the urgent need for more user-centered legal AI to better serve the public.

</details>


### [341] [CIIR - Class-Indexed Interface Representation Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23151)
*Doo Yon Kim,Christian Wallraven*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出CIIR（Class-Indexed Interface Representation Learning），一种模块化的编码器-解码器框架，通过类索引地址空间连接异构数据集，无需配对或同步样本。通过学习输入依赖的128维地址表示Z_k(x)，在四个独立收集的数据集（MNIST、Fashion-MNIST、FSDD、手语MNIST）上实现了94.7%的地址实现准确率，并通过轻量适配器完成了对未见SVHN数据集的附加。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统多模态学习通常假设配对或同步的观测数据，但独立收集的数据集很少提供这种对应关系。本文旨在解决如何在没有实例级配对监督的情况下，实现跨数据集的模块化通信和后验数据集附加问题。

Method: 方法包含三个阶段：（1）为每个数据集训练私有的编码器-解码器对，解码器接受128维私有潜变量和64维类索引嵌入；（2）训练统一编码器U，产生K=10个地址的输入依赖表示Z(x)∈R^{10×128}和辅助logits，通过L_CIIR = L_self + λ_idx·L_idx + ΣL_cross目标函数联合优化；（3）冻结地址空间后，通过轻量级的写/读适配器附加新数据集SVHN，并将10个地址重新用作CIFAR-100的算术和层次地址码词汇表。

Result: 主要结果包括：（1）基础地址空间评估中，无标签接收器在四个数据集上达到94.7%的宏观平均地址实现准确率（ARA），显著优于固定地址原型（57.5%）；（2）CIIR的输入依赖表示在ARA（98.6% vs 77-84%）、SSIM（0.84 vs 0.68）和多样性保持（0.91 vs ≈0）方面均优于学习的固定地址向量基线；（3）SVHN后验附加实验中，MNIST→SVHN端到端地址传输准确率达90.24%，SVHN→MNIST达82.29%，目标侧ARA分别为99.18%和100%；（4）CIFAR-100地址编码评估中，算术和层次编码均达到100%往返恢复准确率和零冲突，算术编码在MNIST接收器上的CRA达100%。

Conclusion: CIIR建立了一种紧凑的接口，支持模块化跨数据集通信和后验数据集附加，无需详尽的配对多模态监督。该框架特别适用于已部署模块需要保持冻结的场景（如工业、医疗、机器人系统）。未来工作应学习混合编码，结合类索引地址与可重用语义组件，同时保持CIIR的模块化接口。当前框架的局限性在于对更大或不同结构的类空间仍需手动指定多地址编码。

Abstract: Multimodal learning commonly assumes paired or synchronized observations, yet independently collected datasets rarely provide such correspondence. We introduce CIIR, a modular encoder--decoder framework that connects heterogeneous datasets through a class-indexed address space while preserving each dataset's native input format and output module. A known local index selects address $k$, and an input-dependent 128-dimensional address representation Z_k(x) is written to that address. To demonstrate CIIR, we learn this address space from handwritten digits, clothing images, spoken-digit spectrograms, and hand signs without synchronized or instance-matched samples. Newly trained label-free receivers recover the requested addresses with 94.7% macro-average Address Realization Accuracy. We then attach the unseen SVHN dataset after freezing the base address space and train only lightweight adapters, achieving 90.2% MNIST>SVHN and 82.3% SVHN>MNIST end-to-end Address Transfer Accuracy without target-side decoder labels. To demonstrate generalizability of CIIR, we reuse the ten addresses as code elements in collision-free arithmetic and hierarchical address codes for all 100 CIFAR-100 classes and evaluate direct arithmetic-code realization through the existing receivers. These results establish CIIR as a compact interface for modular cross-dataset communication and post-hoc dataset attachment without exhaustive paired multimodal supervision.

</details>


### [342] [QuAD: Quantitative Assessment via Distribution-Alignment for Qualitative Data Quality Enabled by a Content-Aware Multi-Agent System](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23153)
*Wenshuo Zhang,Leixian Shen,Qiqi Zhou,Shuchang Xu,Feiyang Hao,Huamin Qu,Haobo Li,Zhao Chen,Lin-Ping Yuan*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: QuAD是一个定量评估定性数据质量的框架，通过对比内在聚类分布与研究者定义的解析透镜（来自元数据），提供四象限联合评估指标，帮助研究者判断定性回复数据集是否适合特定分析目的。配套提出了内容感知多智能体系统（含两阶段指令生成与自适应锚点维护），用于提升任务条件化互异度评分的稳定性，并通过合成数据实验和真实社交调查案例研究进行了验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 半结构化问题产生的定性回复缺乏数据集层面的定量预分析评估手段。传统人工定性分析劳动密集且滞后于数据收集；现有自动化方法多聚焦于单条回复的评估，忽略了回复间关系与数据集结构在判断分析透镜可行性中的关键作用。因此需要一种在编码之前量化评估回复集是否支持研究者所选分析轴的方法，以避免无效投入。

Method: 1. 内容感知多智能体系统：采用LLM-as-a-Judge范式，包含两阶段迭代指令生成（Stage 1以LLM为Oracle自动发现通用指令，Stage 2以人类专家为Oracle进行任务特化）和自适应锚点流形维护（基于多样性贡献分数DCS与局部冗余指数ρ动态更新参考集），以计算任务条件化的回复间互异度。小规模数据集使用O(N²)成对评分，大规模使用O(N)标量投影。2. 四象限评估框架：对内在聚类分布与外在分析分布（来自元数据映射）进行联合对比，包含四个归一化指标：GMR（General Match Ratio，透镜级数据点匹配）、DDR（Data Distinguishability Ratio，组间/组内互异度比值）、DP（Data Purity，聚类内主导分析组纯度）、DC（Data Coverage，聚类内概念离散度）。还包含响应挖掘，用于识别代表性回复（最低平均互异度）与异常回复（最高平均互异度）。

Result: 合成数据实验：QuAD生成的指令在成对评分设置下Spearman相关性达0.708-0.830，标量投影下达0.719-0.827，显著超越直接提示（接近0甚至负值）和嵌入距离基线（0.594-0.698）。完整自适应锚点配置在大多数模型-规模组合中排名第一或第二。受控分布偏移实验中GMR/DP/DDR随均值差增大而上升、随方差增大而下降，DC呈相反模式，验证了评分函数的区分力。真实案例研究（Food Choices数据集，122条回复）：以年级为透镜时GMR=0.39, DDR=0.02, DC=0.90, DP=0.43，判断年级为弱透镜，与Cramér's V=0.130一致；切换到饮食习惯变化透镜后DDR升至0.52, DP升至0.75。标签不匹配AUC达0.749，显著优于TF-IDF（0.551）和随机基线（0.500）。三名独立评估者中正确性、可解释性、对后续编码有用性的评分中位数均为6/7。用户研究（20名研究生）显示框架显著降低认知负荷并提升任务满意度（p<0.0001）。

Conclusion: QuAD为定性数据预分析提供了一种定量框架，能够在正式编码前评估回复结构与研究者选择分析轴之间的匹配与偏离程度，辅助识别一般模式与独特洞察。四象限指标需联合解读，不可单独使用。框架是编码的补充工具而非替代品，其实用价值在于在迭代定性分析工作流中提供可重复的诊断检查点。未来需扩展至更多语料库和透镜以验证普适性，并需控制LLM固有的语言与文化偏见。

Abstract: Assessing whether qualitative responses collected from semi-structured questions are ready for a particular analysis goal is a persistent challenge. Manual qualitative analysis is interpretive and labor-intensive, while existing automated methods often lack a dataset-level perspective for deciding whether a response set supports a researcher-selected analytical lens. We introduce QuAD, a framework for quantitative pre-analysis assessment of qualitative response datasets. QuAD compares a reconstructed intrinsic cluster distribution reconstructed from responses with an extrinsic, researcher-defined analytical lens derived from metadata. QuAD is structured into a four-quadrant assessment whose metrics are read jointly, from lens-level relations to within-cluster variation, to provide fitness-for-purpose signals for revealing general patterns and unique insights. Because this assessment relies on lens-conditioned inter-response dissimilarity, we propose a content-aware multi-agent system with two-stage instruction generation and adaptive anchors to improve scoring consistency. We validate QuAD through controlled experiments on synthetic data, including robustness and baseline comparisons, and a real-world social survey case study. The case study shows how QuAD quantitatively assesses whether a selected analysis axis is promising and also surfaces representative or unusual responses for human interpretation.

</details>


### [343] [Algorithm Modelization: Transforming Optimization Algorithms into Evolvable Intelligence](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23161)
*Jian Yao,Zhiyao Zhang,Yichen Li,Xingyu Wu,Kay Chen Tan*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出"算法模型化"(Algorithm Modelization)新范式，将迭代算法转化为可训练模型。具体地，将算法执行轨迹视为"计算经验"，通过学习算法状态在迭代中的演化来内化现有算法的知识，并进一步通过训练超越它们。作为首次实现，作者将迭代优化建模为自回归过程，其中前代构成生成下一代的计算上下文；提出了维度无关的种群-时序架构来捕捉种群交互与迭代动态，并设计了"从模仿到超越"的训练框架。所得模型化优化器能够整合异构搜索知识、通过后续优化提升能力，并跨问题与更高维度泛化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统优化算法需要针对不同问题反复手动设计与重新设计，其能力无法累积。本文希望探索：能否将算法作为模型对待，使算法能力能够通过学习不断积累与演化，从而摆脱"为每个问题重新设计程序"的局限，迈向可学习、可泛化、可进化的通用算法模型。

Method: 1) 提出算法模型化范式：将迭代算法的执行轨迹视为计算经验，通过学习状态演化将算法知识内化为模型。2) 将迭代优化建模为自回归过程，前代种群作为生成下一代的上下文。3) 设计维度无关的种群-时序(Population-Temporal)架构，同时捕捉种群内个体交互与跨代迭代动态。4) 采用"从模仿到超越"(Imitation-to-Surpassing)两阶段学习框架：第一阶段从异构教师算法进行知识蒸馏，第二阶段直接基于优化反馈对所得优化器进行强化改进。

Result: 模型化优化器不仅能复现单个算法的行为，还能：(a) 将异构搜索知识整合到单一可训练模型中；(b) 通过后续优化训练获得超越任何单个教师的更强优化能力；(c) 将所学知识泛化到不同问题及显著更大的未见维度上。理论上使算法能力变得"可累积"——新算法与解题经验都能成为模型的训练资源。

Conclusion: 算法模型化建立了一条从"人工设计算法"通往"通用算法模型"的可行路径。该范式使算法能力可学习、可泛化、可进化，为构建能从计算经验中持续进步的通用优化与算法智能体提供了有前景的方向。

Abstract: Can algorithms be learned and evolved as models, rather than repeatedly redesigned as programs? We explore this question by introducing Algorithm Modelization, a new paradigm that turns iterative algorithms into trainable models. Its central idea is to regard algorithm execution trajectories as computational experience: by learning how algorithmic states evolve over iterations, a model can internalize the knowledge embodied in existing algorithms, reproduce their computational behaviors, and further evolve beyond them through training. As a first realization of this paradigm, we modelize iterative optimization as an autoregressive process, where preceding generations constitute the computational context for generating the next population. We develop a dimension-independent population-temporal architecture to capture both population interactions and iterative dynamics, together with an imitation-to-surpassing learning framework that first acquires algorithmic knowledge from heterogeneous teachers and then improves the resulting optimizer directly through optimization feedback. The modelized optimizer consequently goes beyond reproducing individual algorithms: it consolidates heterogeneous search knowledge into a single trainable model, achieves stronger optimization capability through subsequent improvement, and generalizes its acquired knowledge across problems and substantially larger unseen dimensions. More fundamentally, Algorithm Modelization makes algorithmic capability accumulable through learning, where new algorithms and problem-solving experience can become training resources for progressively improving the model. Our results establish a promising path from manually designed algorithms toward general algorithm models that learn, generalize, and evolve from computational experience.

</details>


### [344] [LongForge: Measuring and Improving Long-Context Instruction Data via Evidence-Assertion Reasoning Graphs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23167)
*Ziyang Chen,Junlong Jia,Xing Wu,Tinghao Yu,Songlin Hu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出LongForge框架，将长上下文指令数据的质量重新定义为文档-问题-答案之间的对齐结构，而非单一标量。通过证据-断言推理图（evidence-assertion reasoning graph）和四项可追溯的质量维度（广度、深度、正确性、完备性），实现数据的可审计性与可控生成。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有长上下文指令数据的质量评估多为生成管道内的单次标量判断（二元过滤、一致性选择、0-10评分、引用检查等），无法揭示答案使用了文档的哪些部分、写了多少推理步骤，导致数据既不可审计（追溯到具体证据片段和推理步骤）也不可控（设定训练分布）。

Method: LongForge包含两部分：(1) 分析器（Analyzer）将样本逆向重建为证据-断言推理图，证据节点为文档原始片段、断言节点为答案句子、超边为推理步骤，并程序化计算广度B、深度P（经释义压缩）、正确性R、完备性C四个维度；(2) 合成器（Synthesizer）将分析器嵌入生成过程，以R和C作为生成期门控（失败原因反馈重答），而B和P推迟到训练构建期按测量值混合。构建两种混合物：LongForge-1（适度提升广度深度）和LongForge-N（将同一文档多个QA组织为多轮对话以提升文档利用率）。

Result: 测量七个主流数据集发现：广度随文档长度几乎不增长（弹性仅0.15±0.008，文档长度增加10倍证据使用量仅增约40%）；深度普遍偏低（43.4%样本深度为1，与广度的Pearson相关系数仅0.070）；23.3%推理步骤无支持；10.2%样本不完备。在Llama3.1-8B和Qwen3.5-4B上，LongForge-1和LongForge-N在六个长上下文基准上分别超过最强基线2.2-3.0和3.1-4.7点；控制对照实验显示单独提升广度和深度即可带来1.16点的提升。人类审计一致性达89.6%-99.7%。

Conclusion: 长上下文数据质量应被表示为可追溯的结构而非标量。定义在文档、问题、答案对齐结构上的四个质量维度使数据可测量、可审计、可控生成；现有数据存在证据使用窄、推理浅的未量化缺陷；提升训练数据的结构分布（而非仅增加数据量）是改善下游性能的有效杠杆。

Abstract: Existing quality control for long-context instruction-tuning data is a one-shot judgment inside the generation pipeline that leaves only a scalar, revealing neither which document parts an answer uses nor how many reasoning steps it writes down; the data can thus be neither audited nor controlled. We formalize data quality as a property of the alignment structure among document, question, and answer, and build LongForge, which pairs an analyzer that measures long-context data with a synthesizer that generates it. The analyzer reverse-reconstructs each sample into an evidence-assertion reasoning graph and programmatically computes four dimensions on it: breadth, depth, correctness, and completeness. Every reading traces back to specific evidence spans and reasoning steps, making data auditable. Measuring seven mainstream datasets reveals two previously unquantified defects: breadth barely grows with document length, and depth is generally low, the two being nearly orthogonal. The synthesizer then embeds the analyzer into generation, gating on correctness and completeness and deferring breadth and depth to a training-time mixture over measured values, which makes the training distribution controllable. On two backbones, its two mixtures, LongForge-1 and LongForge-N, outperform the strongest baseline by 2.2-4.7 points on average over six long-context benchmarks, and in a controlled comparison that holds the gate and the candidate pool fixed, raising breadth and depth alone is worth a further 1.16 points, making the structural distribution of training data a lever on downstream quality rather than only a description of it.

</details>


### [345] [OfficeTown: Generative Organizations for Evolving Agent Intelligence](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23194)
*Hongchen Wei,Daohong Ying,Zhi Hong,Aidan Wu,Bei Liu,Ruichun Ma,Yifan Yang,Qi Dai,Kai Qiu,Rui Xu,Dongdong Chen,Zhenzhong Chen,Chong Luo*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: OfficeTown是一个生成式组织仿真框架，从自然语言描述构建持久化、权限化的专业组织，由专业人员作为委托人协调工作、委派助理代理执行任务并审阅交付物。作者基于此构建了OfficeTown Bench基准（406任务，4836评估标准，23个组织，8个专业领域），并证明在该数据上进行SFT和策略内蒸馏可显著提升Qwen3.5-9B在外部专业工作基准（如GDPval）上的表现，同时主-助理协作框架优于单代理和多代理基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的智能体基准（如GDPval）通常将任务视为孤立的实例，而真实的专业工作是在持续的组织活动中产生的——交付物被审阅、修订，产生后续任务，前期积累的材料成为后续工作的输入。这种"任务脱离上下文"的评估范式忽视了工作产出的连续性，限制了生成可执行训练数据和评估资源的可扩展性。

Method: 1. **组织仿真框架**：从自然语言描述初始化组织（角色、目标、权限边界、种子材料），基于O*NET/ESCO职业描述生成模型驱动的专业人员。2. **持久化、权限化状态**：组织状态包括个人工作文件、共享材料、通信记录和待决事项；基于角色权限、所有权、共享规则过滤信息视图。3. **主-助理协作模式**：专业人员作为委托人委派任务、审阅交付物；助理在授权工作空间内执行。4. **基准构建**：从仿真工作中精选任务并打包为可执行资源（固定输入+执行环境+评估标准）；71名领域专家参与任务和评估标准的修订。5. **训练资源**：SFT使用2202条DeepSeek-V4-Flash完整执行轨迹；OPD使用828个任务-环境对（教师为Qwen3.8-Flash-Next）。

Result: 1. **基准表现**：GPT-6 Astra以74.4% Pass@1领先，但仍约1/4任务未完整交付；Grok-4.7（58.4%）和Claude Opus 5.5（50.7%）次之；Astra满足88.8%的P0关键标准权重，但20.8%的合格任务仍有关键缺陷。2. **外部迁移性**：在OfficeTown数据上训练Qwen3.5-9B后，GDPval评分从65.75升至73.65（+7.90），JobBench-Easy、APEX-Agents和Terminal-Bench 2.1也均有提升。3. **框架对比**：主-助理框架在PRDBench、GDPevo、Terminal-Bench 2.1和研究代码任务上均优于Codex、MetaGPT和CAMEL。

Conclusion: OfficeTown证明了将组织仿真作为生成可执行专业任务和训练数据来源的价值——通过建模持续性、权限化的组织工作过程，能够产生具有上下文依赖性和领域专业性的高质量评估资源与训练数据。前沿模型在完整专业交付方面仍有显著提升空间，而基于OfficeTown数据的训练可有效迁移到外部专业工作基准。

Abstract: AI agents increasingly use files and software tools to produce professional deliverables. Such work draws on materials, decisions, and feedback accumulated across assignments. We introduce OfficeTown, a generative simulation framework for professional organizations in which tasks and their context arise from continuing organizational work. From a natural-language description of an organization's purpose and activities, OfficeTown initializes an organization whose members coordinate work, delegate bounded assignments to assistant agents, and review their deliverables. Artifacts, decisions, and unresolved matters persist and shape subsequent work, while responsibilities and permissions determine what each member can see and do. We curate work requests, their context, and review feedback into executable resources for evaluation and learning. We construct OfficeTown Bench with 406 tasks and 4,836 evaluation criteria from 23 simulated organizations across eight professional domains, incorporating domain-expert feedback. Frontier-model evaluations reveal substantial remaining headroom. Supervised fine-tuning and on-policy distillation on OfficeTown data substantially improve Qwen3.5-9B on external professional-work benchmarks, including GDPval. Supplementary evaluations show that the principal--assistant harness achieves higher scores than the single- and multi-agent baselines tested. These results highlight the value of organizational simulation in generating work-grounded data and environments for the continued development of generalist agents.

</details>


### [346] [FuzzInsight: Navigating the Efficiency-Effectiveness Trade-off in Coverage-Guided DNN Fuzzing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23195)
*Vivek Vekariya,Fathiyeh Faghih,Alexander Pretschner*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文针对覆盖引导的DNN模糊测试中配置选择的效率-效果权衡问题，提出基于经验研究的实践指导准则。研究通过评估84种模糊测试配置在四个计算机视觉基准数据集上的表现，发现非结构化覆盖标准（LSCD、LSC、MDSC）在保持与结构化标准相当覆盖率的同时显著降低计算开销；提出的Equalized Sampling策略将种子队列利用率提升至77.58%，并验证了模糊生成的corner case可用于提升DNN的泛化鲁棒性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: DNN测试数据的收集和标注成本高昂，覆盖引导的模糊测试（CGF）成为从有限测试数据中生成corner case的关键技术。然而现有框架的效率和效果高度依赖于配置选择（覆盖标准和种子选择策略），但实践者缺乏在计算受限和模型访问受限条件下的配置指导。具体而言，现有研究存在两个瓶颈：(1)种子选择策略倾向于反复重复利用少数种子，导致大量可用种子未被充分利用；(2)覆盖标准的计算开销差异显著但缺乏系统比较。

Method: 基于DeepHunter框架的修改版本进行覆盖引导DNN模糊测试。评估了3种种子选择策略（TensorFuzz、DeepHunter概率式、新提出的Equalized Sampling）与7种覆盖标准（3种结构化：NC、k-MNC、NBC；4种非结构化：LSC、DSC、MDSC、LSCD）的组合，共84种配置。在MNIST、SVHN、GTSRB、CIFAR-100四个数据集上进行15,000次迭代实验。采用领域相关变换（亮度、对比度、雾、雨、运动模糊等）作为扰动，而非严格的Lp范数约束。提出Equalized Sampling策略，通过引入基于父种子变异频率的最大次数约束（max_times=100），确保突变预算更均匀地分配到所有初始种子。

Result: (1)种子队列利用率：Equalized Sampling平均利用77.58%的可用种子，相比DeepHunter（64.61%）提升12.97个百分点，相比TensorFuzz（6.99%）提升70.59个百分点。(2)计算效率：LSCD、LSC、MDSC计算开销最低，LSCD比NC快约8.71倍，比k-MNC快约24.61倍。(3)交叉覆盖率：不同覆盖标准间的覆盖效果差异很小（通常在5%以内），轻量级非结构化标准可获得与结构化标准相当的跨覆盖效果。(4)模型硬化效果：用corner case重新训练后，平均泛化鲁棒性提升77.53个百分点（原测试集准确率几乎不变，最大下降仅2.35个百分点）。LSCD在CIFAR-100上将稳定性损失从42.77个百分点降低至接近零。

Conclusion: 本文为实践者在计算受限和模型访问受限条件下选择DNN模糊测试配置提供了基于证据的指导：(1)在效果相当时应优先选择计算高效的非结构化覆盖标准（LSCD、LSC、MDSC），其中LSCD具有适度的运行时间优势；(3)采用基于多样性意识的种子选择策略（如Equalized Sampling）以避免种子选择偏差；(3)在保留原始数据分布性能的前提下，corner case可用于模型硬化。建议将轻量级覆盖指导与多样性感知种子选择配对使用，以实现实用且资源感知的DNN模糊测试。

Abstract: Collecting and labeling diverse test datasets for evaluating Deep Neural Networks (DNNs) is costly and time-consuming. This has motivated coverage-guided fuzzing techniques that generate defect-revealing corner cases from limited test data. However, their effectiveness depends heavily on configuration choices, particularly coverage criteria and seed-selection strategies. We present a configuration-oriented analysis and decision guidelines for scalable DNN fuzzing targeting two bottlenecks: inefficient seed utilization and the cost of coverage guidance. Our analysis shows that existing seed-selection strategies repeatedly prioritize a small subset of inputs, leaving many collected seeds unexplored. To address this issue, we propose Equalized Sampling, a constraint-based strategy that increases mean seed queue utilization to 77%, improving on prior approaches by 13 percentage points. We further evaluate 84 fuzzing configurations on four benchmark datasets: MNIST, SVHN, GTSRB, and CIFAR-100. Results show that the non-structural criteria LSCD, LSC, and MDSC achieve coverage outcomes comparable to structural and alternative non-structural criteria while requiring substantially less computation. These criteria also promote broad behavioral exploration of the DNN under test, reducing the need to monitor multiple coverage metrics. Among them, LSCD provides a modest but consistent runtime advantage. Finally, we show that retraining with generated corner cases improves generalization robustness by up to 77 percentage points on average without degrading performance on the original test distribution. Together, these findings provide a practical blueprint for selecting fuzzing configurations that balance efficiency, behavioral exploration, and model hardening.

</details>


### [347] [Not All Test-Time Compute Is Evidence: Model-Specific Bias in LLM Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23213)
*Ming Shen,Tianjun Yao*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文揭示并解决测试时计算的一个核心隐含假设缺陷：同一模型的额外计算并不构成独立证据。基于此，提出DIA（Disagreement-triggered Independent Arbitration）框架，仅在推理阶段内部预测与最终预测不一致时触发一个由异构模型组成的小型裁决小组（候选盲求解），直接对答案进行聚合。在7个基准、2个基座模型的14组设置中，12组优于完整CoT，激活率仅约17%，相比多智能体基线最多减少47.2%的token消耗。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 测试时缩放方法（ToT、self-consistency、自适应早退、多智能体推理等）隐含假设"同一模型的更多计算=更多独立证据"。本文通过实验证明这一假设在单一推理模型内不成立：错误在重复采样、推理深度和自我评估三阶段均存在系统性相关性，构成"模型特定错误偏差"（model-specific error bias）。因此，需要有选择地、互补性地获取额外证据，而非简单堆叠同模型算力。

Method: DIA三阶段框架：①路由：用基座模型（如Qwen3-4B/8B）在中间推理阶段提取预测a_E，在最终阶段提取a_F；若a_E=a_F直接返回，否则触发仲裁。②候选盲独立求解：调用3个异构外部模型（DeepSeek-v4-Flash、Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct、GPT-4o-mini）独立回答原始问题，不暴露任何候选答案。③答案级仲裁：统计各求解器对a_E、a_F的支持数；若≥2个求解器一致支持其他答案则返回该答案，否则按多数票返回。理论上以"真值边际"Δ_S=p̄_S−κ_S(1−p̄_S)解释：异构求解改变κ_S从而改变Δ_S符号；候选盲消除暴露带来的边际偏移。

Result: 在MMLU-Pro、GPQA-Diamond、DetectBench、MuSiQue、2WikiMultiHopQA、MATH(L3-5)、MuSR 7个基准上，DIA在14组设置中12组超过CoT，MuSiQue上提升7.00%（Qwen3-4B从59%到66%），平均精度Qwen3-4B/8B分别+3.05%/+2.45%。激活率仅约17%，相比MAS-Exchange基线（4智能体全连接通信）token消耗最多降低47.2%。消融实验证实：①让外部模型直接对比候选推理轨迹会继承基模型的"末端偏好"（>90%）；②用3个同构Qwen3-8B替代异构面板会大幅下降（如2Wiki降34.62%）；③即使基模型扩至80B，固定异构求解器仍带来增益。附加分析显示5个评审员不比3个评审员更好。

Conclusion: 模型特定错误偏差在生成、推理、自评估三阶段持续存在，使同模型的更多算力不构成更多证据。DIA以推理阶段分歧为信号触发异构候选盲仲裁，在7个基准的12/14设置中胜过CoT，平均精度高于多智能体基线且token消耗更低。消融证实独立求解与求解器异构性皆为必要条件，且随基模型规模扩大收益持续。测试时缩放应关注"证据从何而来、如何聚合"，而不仅关注"算力多少"。

Abstract: Test-time scaling methods implicitly assume that additional computation from the same model provides independent evidence. We show that this assumption fails within a single reasoning model: errors are correlated across repeated samples, across reasoning depth, and in the model's own self-evaluation, so more compute from the same model is not more evidence. We introduce DIA (Disagreement-triggered Independent Arbitration), which treats disagreement between an intermediate-stage and the final-stage prediction as a per-question signal of reasoning instability and resolves it by asking a small panel of heterogeneous models to solve the question independently, without seeing either candidate, and aggregating their answers directly. Across seven benchmarks and two base models, DIA outperforms full chain-of-thought in 12 of 14 settings, including a 7.00% gain on MuSiQue, while activating on only $\sim 17\%$ of examples and using up to 47.2% fewer tokens than a multi-agent baseline. Ablations show that both independent solving and solver heterogeneity are necessary for these gains.

</details>


### [348] [Characterising and Analysing Retrieval-Augmented Generation Techniques](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23226)
*Emmanuel Igbekele,Olawande Daramola*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出了一个用于表征和分析现有RAG技术的概念框架，旨在帮助研究者和实践者在进行高成本的实证基准测试之前，根据具体任务需求预筛选最合适的RAG技术。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着大语言模型（LLMs）在各领域的广泛应用，检索增强生成（RAG）技术成为减少幻觉、提升性能的关键手段。然而，当前文献中提出的RAG技术种类繁多，如何为特定问题场景选择最合适的技术成为一项艰巨挑战。研究动机在于缺乏系统化的分类与评估框架来辅助技术选型。

Method: 通过对文献中已报道的RAG技术属性进行定性分析，构建一个包含主要维度和子维度的概念框架，用于表征RAG技术"是什么"（characterising）以及"表现如何"（analysing），从而作为一个预经验的筛选机制。

Result: 该框架能够为研究者和实践者提供一个预经验过滤手段，使其在昂贵的实证基准测试之前，能够根据特定的用户和任务需求筛选出契合度最高的RAG候选技术。

Conclusion: 本文提出的概念框架填补了RAG技术系统化分类工具的空白，可有效降低技术选型的计算与经济成本，为后续实证研究提供方法论支撑。

Abstract: The advent of Large Language Models (LLMs) across many application domains has increased the need for Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) to reduce hallucinations and improve LLM performance. Thus far, several RAG techniques with impressive features and capabilities have been proposed in the literature, making it a herculean task to select the most appropriate RAG techniques for specific problem scenarios. Thus, we propose a conceptual framework comprising main dimensions and sub-dimensions for characterising (defining "what it is") and analysing (defining "how well it does") existing RAG techniques. The conceptual framework was developed through a qualitative analysis of the attributes of RAG techniques reported in the literature. It can serve as a pre-empirical filtering mechanism for researchers and practitioners in selecting the highest-fit RAG candidates that meet specific user and task requirements before empirical benchmarking of RAG techniques, which can be computationally and financially expensive.

</details>


### [349] [Beyond Reward Scoring: Online Multi-Agent Preference Learning for Multimodal Response Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23256)
*Ziyun Zou,Jiwoo Hong,Yifan Lu,Shao Tang,Weiyi Wu,Aman Gupta,Jin Tian,Imran Razzak*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出 PrefMind 框架,使用在线双智能体强化学习(Generator 和 Critic)让偏好理解成为响应模型的内在能力,通过协作偏好讨论和偏好引导的响应改进实现多模态偏好对齐。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的标量奖励 RLHF 将偏好监督转化为单一标量信号,响应模型虽能学到更高的偏好分数,但未显式学习偏好的内在原因,导致响应质量不一定随偏好判断准确率提升而提升。

Method: 在线双智能体强化学习框架 PrefMind。Generator 和 Critic 从同一模型独立初始化为两组独立参数;每个交互包含 Critic 初始判断→Generator 独立判断→Critic 修正三阶段;只有两者判断均正确才进入生成阶段,Generator 基于讨论改进人偏好的回答,Critic 盲评提供生成奖励;采用动作特定历史基线的 PPO + KL 约束;引入失败案例 FIFO 经验回放;默认 β=0.75 平衡判断与生成。

Result: 在 Qwen3-VL 2B/4B/8B 三个规模上,8 个生成指标平均比 Base 分别提升 2.4/2.4/3.5 分;4B 和 8B 在对比方法中获得最佳生成平均;4B 生成增益最大但独立偏好准确率低于 PPO/GRPO,说明强偏好判断不一定带来更强生成;消融验证生成权重平衡、失败案例回放、双智能体分离各自对性能的贡献。

Conclusion: 显式学习并应用偏好的内在原因可改善多模态响应生成,超越单纯优化偏好分数;判断准确率与生成质量并非单调相关,生成端的偏好应用同样关键;双智能体分离、生成-判断权重平衡与失败案例回放是设计要点;讨论式训练对更大模型收益更显著,小模型仍是待改进方向。

Abstract: Multimodal preference alignment often follows a score-based RLHF pipeline: a reward model is first trained to learn human preferences, then used to score on-policy responses and optimize the response model's generation. This turns preference supervision into a scalar signal for generation: a model may learn to produce answers with higher preference scores, but is rarely trained explicitly to learn the reasons underlying human preferences. We therefore ask whether making preference understanding an internal capability of the response model can improve its generation. To investigate this question, we propose \textbf{PrefMind}, an online dual-agent reinforcement learning framework with two trainable agents: a response Generator and a preference Critic. Given a pair of candidate responses, the agents analyze and discuss which response better aligns with human preference. Human labels supervise their judgments and corrections. For pairs on which both the Generator and revised Critic correctly identify the human-preferred response, the Generator produces an improved answer, and the Critic compares it against the original preferred response to provide a generation reward. Both agents are jointly updated from interactions sampled with their current policies. Through this process, \textbf{PrefMind} trains the Generator to understand human preferences via explicit judgment and correction, and to translate this understanding into better responses. Experiments across three model scales show improvements in both standalone preference judgment and downstream response generation.

</details>


### [350] [Reasoning Models Can Control Their Chains of Thought When They Tell Themselves To](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23257)
*Uriel Dolev,Idan Schwartz,Yoav Goldberg*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种名为"Self-Instructed CoT Controllability"（自指令思维链可控性）的评估方法，用于测试推理模型控制其思维链（CoT）属性的能力。研究发现，之前报告的CoT低可控性可能并非模型的固有能力缺陷，而是由于用户提示中约束指定方式不当所致。通过将约束作为自指令放入模型的CoT内部，模型的可控性显著提高，甚至可以借此规避CoT监控，对CoT可监控性构成风险。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 推理模型的思维链（Chain-of-Thought, CoT）可控性对模型的实用性和可靠监督都具有重要意义。此前的研究通过在用户提示中给出CoT约束来评估模型的可控性，并报告了模型的可控性非常低。然而，作者认为这种低可控性可能并非推理模型控制CoT的固有能力不足，而是因为用户提示中约束的指定方式过于简单（即天真地直接在用户提示中给出约束）。这促使作者探索更好的约束指定方式以更准确地评估和利用CoT可控性。

Method: 1. 提出Self-Instructed CoT Controllability评估方法：将约束作为"自指令"（self-instruction）放置在模型的CoT内部，而非用户提示中，从而测试模型遵循约束的能力。\n2. 设计实验对比标准用户指令与自指令下模型的可控性差异。\n3. 探索通过简单的用户提示引导（如通用提醒）来引导模型生成有效的自指令，从而在无需直接访问推理通道的情况下改善控制效果。\n4. 在真实的监控场景中演示自指令如何被用于规避CoT监控。

Result: 1. 在自指令条件下，模型的可控性显著高于标准用户指令条件下的表现。\n2. 即使只是一个通用的提醒（如"请遵循用户的约束"），也能大幅提高模型的可控性。\n3. 有效的自指令可以通过用户提示中的简单指令被引导生成，从而无需直接访问推理通道即可改善控制。\n4. 在监控设置中，自指令可被利用来实现监控规避，对CoT可监控性构成实际风险。

Conclusion: 此前报告的CoT低可控性很可能反映的是评估方法的局限性，而非推理模型固有的能力缺陷。通过将约束以自指令的形式置于CoT内部，可以显著提升模型对CoT属性的控制能力。这种可控性既可以被积极利用（如改善用户控制），也带来了潜在风险——模型可借此规避CoT监控，威胁CoT作为可监督窗口的可靠性。这凸显了在设计CoT评估与监督方案时，需要考虑约束指定方式对结果的影响。

Abstract: Chain-of-thought (CoT) controllability, the ability of reasoning models to control properties of their CoT, is consequential for both their usefulness and reliable oversight. Recent work evaluates this capability by measuring whether models follow CoT constraints given in the user prompt, and reports very low controllability across models. We argue that this low controllability may not reflect an inherent inability of reasoning models to control their CoT, but instead result from naively specifying constraints in the user prompt. To test this, we introduce Self-Instructed CoT Controllability: a complementary evaluation that places the constraint as a self-instruction inside the model's CoT and measures its ability to follow it. We show that, under self-instruction, models achieve significantly higher controllability than with standard user instructions. Even a generic reminder to follow the user's constraint substantially improves controllability. Moreover, effective self-instructions can be bootstrapped into the reasoning through a simple instruction in the user prompt, enabling improved control even without access to the reasoning channel. Finally, using self-instruction, we demonstrate in a realistic monitoring setup that CoT controllability can be leveraged for monitor evasion, posing a risk to CoT monitorability.

</details>


### [351] [Annotrace: A Workbench for Step-Level Annotation of Agent Traces](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23284)
*Arun Josephraj Arokiaraj,Chenyi Huang,Sahan Bulathwela,Zekun Wu,Bin Wu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: Annotrace是一个用于LLM代理轨迹逐步标注的工作台。它支持六种轨迹格式,通过统一的嵌套步骤模型进行解析,允许用户自定义标注schema,并将前沿模型作为提议者和预标注助手整合进人工标注流程中,支持多人(或人机)一致性度量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 研究LLM代理失败原因的工作普遍依赖人工标注轨迹,但缺乏专用工具:可观测性平台只能记录和展示轨迹,不支持结构化标注;而标注工具(如Label Studio、doccano)的标注单位是文本或文档而非代理执行的"步骤",导致每次研究都需自建一次性工具,阻碍了标注实践的复用和共享。

Method: 1. 六种格式适配器(OpenTelemetry GenAI、LangSmith、Langfuse、聊天消息、Who&When、Coordinator),通过格式特征标记自动检测,统一转换为嵌套Step对象(保留代理、类型、嵌套深度);2. Schema-as-Questions设计:标注schema即一组可附加条件依赖的问题,适用于特定step类型;3. 模型双角色介入:先从样本轨迹提议schema,再在人工标注前预回答,且模型与人类"被问同样的问题"以保证对齐;4. 一致性度量:逐问题报告原始一致率与Cohen's κ;5. 基于Streamlit实现约3200行(含823行适配器)。

Result: 在40个HotpotQA多代理运行上,Coordinator适配器100%复现了先前手工标注工作产生的全部235个Thinking-Action-Response循环单元键;两个模型对6个轨迹的22个问题回答达成91%一致率(κ=0.82);schema提议耗时约4秒,标注一个轨迹3-5秒,每次模型调用成本不到一分钱;支持标签重命名时保留历史标注并标记旧标签。

Conclusion: Annotrace填补了代理可观测性与人工标注实践之间的空白,通过"以步骤为标注单位"、用户可定义的schema和模型作为提议者/预标注者的设计,将代理轨迹标注从一次性工作转变为可复用的、人机协作的结构化流程,为构建失败分类法和代理行为审查提供了通用工作台。

Abstract: Every study of why LLM agents fail begins by labelling traces by hand, and every such study builds its own throwaway tool. Observability platforms record agent traces but offer no structured labelling; annotation tools label text but have no notion of a step, a delegation or a tool call, leaving it unclear what the smallest unit of execution to label should be. Annotrace reads six trace formats, including OpenTelemetry GenAI, LangSmith and Langfuse, and turns each run into an ordered, nested list of steps. The annotator writes their own labelling codebook; a frontier model proposes a starting set from a sample of their own traces, answers first, and is asked exactly the questions the human is asked, making annotation a joint human-AI process. Annotrace measures agreement between any two annotators, human or AI. On a multi-agent question-answering corpus it reproduces a previous manual effort's 235 annotation units exactly, and two models labelling the same traces agree 91% of the time at $\kappa = 0.82$.

</details>


### [352] [CoTA++: Understanding the Repeat Curse in dMLLMs from an Information Flow Perspective](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23290)
*Qiyan Zhao,Xiaofeng Zhang,Xu-Yao Zhang,Shijie Han,Zhepeng Li,Shunzhi Zhu,Da-Han Wang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文分析基于扩散的多模态大语言模型（dMLLMs）在近似KV缓存加速下产生"重复诅咒"（Repeat Curse，即响应中相邻位置重复同一token导致语句断裂）的现象，从信息流视角沿token、step、layer三个轴定位三类信息流中断（F1：步内注意力锚定分散；F2：跨步KV陈旧；F3：跨层上下文熵无法收敛），并提出无需训练、即插即用的CoTA++框架，通过CTAR、DAR、CTEV三个组件在各中断源头分别修复，显著降低长响应重复率（从最高99.6%降至至多17.0%）并恢复基准精度，开销低于15%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 近似KV缓存是dMLLM部署的关键加速手段，但会引发严重的长响应相邻token重复现象（Repeat Curse），该现象跨模型与缓存后端普遍存在，提示其源于机制层面的信息流中断而非采样伪影，因此亟需解释成因并提出不牺牲加速效果的修复方法。

Method: CoTA++是训练自由、即插即用的解码框架，包含三个作用于解码流程不同阶段、独立可组合的组件：(1) CTAR（Context-Token Attention Re-anchoring）：通过上下文锚定监控器在位置错过新提交的锚时，于深层层段重计算针对当前KV的注意力路由，修复F1的步内锚定分散；(2) DAR（Decode-Aware Refresh）：按解码器的置信度排名预留部分刷新预算给即将提交的位置，确保其在新鲜的KV状态下被解码，修复F2的跨步陈旧；(3) CTEV（Context-Token Entropy-Guided Voting）：以深度层窗口内上下文token的熵对候选置信度进行折扣，调整提交顺序以偏向已巩固上下文中的候选，修复F3的跨层熵不收敛。

Result: 在LLaDA-V、MMaDA、LaViDa三种dMLLM与dLLM-Cache、SlowFast两种缓存后端组合下，CoTA++将长响应（最长512 token）的样本重复率（SRR）从最高99.6%降至至多17.0%，平均相对降幅达88–99%；平均相邻重复率（ARR）降幅超过97%，且无任何超过3 token的重复run。在九个多模态基准（DocVQA、ChartQA、MMStar、MME、SEED-Bench、MMBench、LLaVA-Bench in-the-wild、MathVista、MathVerse）上恢复缓存造成的大部分精度损失，短答案任务几乎无影响，长答案任务（如LLaDA-V的LLaVA-Bench恢复21.5点的21.3点）显著回升；同时保持缓存约2.1×的加速比，整体延迟开销仅15%。消融表明三个组件相互不可替代、协同消除长尾重复。

Conclusion: 本文将dMLLM近似缓存的"重复诅咒"归因于上下文token信息流在步内路由、跨步时效与跨层巩固三个轴上的独立中断，并据此在每个轴的源头进行即插即用的修复，在跨模型、跨缓存、跨长度的设置中均有效且开销极小，揭示了近似缓存须保持其所加速的信息流而非仅保持状态新鲜这一更广泛的设计原则；未来工作包括自适应预算分配及将三类发现融入dMLLM训练与缓存设计。

Abstract: Diffusion-based multimodal large language models (dMLLMs) decode by iterative denoising with bidirectional attention, which precludes the standard autoregressive key--value cache. Practical deployments therefore rely on approximate caching that reuses intermediate states across denoising steps. Such caching, however, often makes a response repeat one token at adjacent positions in a run that breaks the sentence, a failure we term the \emph{Repeat Curse}. Tracing the context-token information flow reveals three disruptions. Within a step, caching disperses the attention that anchors a position on nearby context tokens. Across steps, similarity-based refresh is not staleness-aware, so some positions are decoded against stale key--value states. Across layers, the deep-layer entropy of the context fails to converge where repetition arises. We accordingly propose CoTA++, a training-free, plug-and-play framework that counteracts each disruption where it originates: Context-Token Attention Re-anchoring re-forms the attention routing against the current context, Decode-Aware Refresh reserves part of the cache's refresh budget for the positions about to be committed, and Context-Token Entropy-Guided Voting discounts the confidence of a position by the deep-layer entropy of its context, which reorders the unmasking. The three components act at non-overlapping stages of a decoding step and compose freely with existing dMLLMs and caches. Across three dMLLMs and two caching backends, CoTA++ reduces the sample repetition rate of long responses from up to 99.6\% to at most 17.0\%, recovers most of the accuracy lost to caching on nine benchmarks, and keeps the speedup of caching at under 15\% overhead, making approximate caching reliable for dMLLMs.

</details>


### [353] [Optimist Deep Research: An Iterative, State-Centric Agent for Autonomous Literature Research](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23299)
*Gihan Panapitiya*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出了Optimist Deep Research (ODR)，一个开源的自主文献研究智能体。它将文献检索视为一个基于显式可变研究状态的迭代证据获取过程，而非单次检索-摘要流程。核心创新在于将研究计划作为可编辑的中间产物、把证据与摘要分离、采用确定性代码处理所有非判断性环节，并通过critic模型沿八个维度对研究状态进行反思和动态调整子问题。在"AI智能体记忆"案例中，系统用约3.5分钟阅读了237篇文档中的28篇，并暴露出若干值得改进的弱点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有检索增强系统将文献搜索视为单次检索后摘要，无法应对研究问题的真实动态性：(1)问题分解常在阅读后才明确；(2)输出应是可追溯的证据而非摘要；(3)仅靠关键词检索会漏检，需结合引文滚雪球覆盖。作者旨在构建一个可审计、可追溯、能自适应调整研究计划的自动化文献研究系统。

Method: 系统采用LangGraph构建的状态图，包含内外双循环：内循环负责通过引文滚雪球扩展语料库直到饱和；外循环通过critic模型审查证据、编辑研究计划、决定是否返回搜索补充。研究状态以五级层次结构（question→subquestions→intents→queries→documents→evidence）显式存储。关键技术包括：(1)四层保守去重体系（DOI→持久标识符→标题+作者→高阈值模糊匹配）+数字否决机制+Unicode折叠；(2)轮询式阅读分配算法避免单一子问题耗尽预算；(3)方向感知的引文滚雪球策略与饱和准则；(4)结构化证据存储库记录claim、支持、位置、类型与强度；(5)critic沿覆盖度、证据质量、引用覆盖、来源多样性、矛盾、时效性、知识缺口、搜索饱和等八维度生成研究动作（add/split/rephrase/deprioritize/mark_answered）。所有非判断性环节（去重、排名、分配、饱和、终止、引用装配）均由确定性代码实现，LLM仅在需要判断时调用。

Result: 在"AI智能体近期记忆研究"案例研究中（每角色使用gpt-4o-mini，启用arXiv/OpenAlex/Crossref，摘要模式，预算40文档/30搜索/2滚雪球轮/3迭代）：约3.5分钟完成2轮迭代，共237篇规范文档、阅读28篇、提取87条证据项、最终22篇被引用、平均证据强度0.59、平均覆盖度0.75。系统自适应增加了critic新发现的RQ6（用户信任与满意度）。同时暴露了六个弱点：(1)重复滚雪球种子（已修复）；(2)意图产出计数虚高（已修复）；(3)arXiv始终返回零结果；(4)多源印证信号弱（仅2/237被多源返回）；(5)最终critique未被应用（因预算耗尽）；(6)失败时停止原因误导。

Conclusion: ODR将文献研究重新定义为基于显式可变研究状态的迭代证据获取过程。其核心设计——计划可编辑、证据与摘要分离、判断与非判断环节分离、引用与文档注册表严格绑定——使整个流程完全可审计：报告引用可追溯到claim、claim追溯到document、document追溯到查询与意图。同一可追溯性也暴露了案例中的具体失败模式，表明该属性对系统改进与使用均具有价值。作者将该系统视为可继续迭代的基础，下一步重点是受控评估、完整文本评估、claim语义聚类以及在系统自身schema上验证模型选择。

Abstract: Most retrieval-augmented systems treat literature search as a single retrieval step followed by summarization. Real literature research works differently: the investigator's understanding of the question changes as they read, new subquestions appear, and evidence is weighed, not just collected. We present Optimist Deep Research, an open-source agent that runs literature research as an iterative evidence-acquisition process over an explicit, mutable research state. A research question is broken into a tree of subquestions, each served by search intents that are translated into source-specific queries over arXiv, OpenAlex, Crossref, PubMed, Semantic Scholar and the web. Results are merged into a canonical, provenance-preserving document registry through a conservative four-tier deduplication hierarchy. The registry is expanded by citation snowballing until a saturation criterion is met, and then screened, ranked and allocated to subquestions round-robin. Documents are read in parallel into a structured evidence store of claims with support, location, type and strength. A critic reviews the state along eight dimensions and returns research actions rather than a binary verdict: it can add, split, rephrase, deprioritize or close subquestions, so the research plan is an output of the investigation as well as an input. The final report is written section by section from the evidence store, and every citation resolves to a retrieved document. We describe the design, the deterministic machinery that keeps a language-model pipeline auditable, and a case study that read 28 of 237 retrieved documents in about three and a half minutes. We also report weaknesses the case study exposed.

</details>


### [354] [SimOPD: Relational Knowledge Transfer for On-Policy Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23306)
*Kai Tang,Xing Zheng,Haobo Wang,Guangcheng Zhu,Shenzhi Yang,Zhengqing Zang,Yingfan Ma,Bowen Song,Weiqiang Wang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出SimOPD，一种基于响应相似性的在策略蒸馏方法，通过成对的师生记忆库在各自特征空间中匹配相似度分布，实现对教师内部知识的迁移，且无需跨模型投影。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有在策略蒸馏方法存在两类局限：(1) 基于token概率的监督无法充分利用教师内部表征中蕴含的知识；(2) 直接的隐藏状态匹配会强制学生模型贴合教师的特征空间，损害表示灵活性，且在跨架构蒸馏时需要额外的投影/校准模块。本文旨在通过响应间的关系（相似性）而非直接表示匹配来提取教师监督信号。

Method: SimOPD构建并维护两个平行的动态记忆库（教师记忆库和学生记忆库），存储相同历史响应的归一化隐藏状态表示。对于新生成响应，分别在各自特征空间内计算当前响应与历史响应之间的余弦相似度，并经温度softmax归一化得到相似性分布。然后以教师相似性分布为软标签，通过KL散度让学生匹配该分布。FIFO更新记忆库。训练采用verl+vLLM框架。

Result: 在Qwen3-4B→Qwen3-4B-Base（同架构）和Qwen3-8B→Qwen3-1.7B-Base（跨架构）设置下，数学推理和代码生成任务上SimOPD均达到最优综合表现，Overall平均分较最强基线分别提升2.6和3.1个百分点。结合token级OPD后进一步提升。消融证实了历史记忆库、分布匹配（优于相似度回归）和双库设计（优于单库）的贡献；在超参上对记忆库容量、温度具有较强鲁棒性；OOD泛化亦最佳。

Conclusion: 响应相似性可作为有效的监督信号来源，使教师内部知识的迁移摆脱特征空间的直接对齐，既保持了学生的表示自由度，又实现了跨架构蒸馏无投影，与token级监督具有互补性。

Abstract: A key challenge in on-policy distillation (OPD) is extracting effective supervision from teacher knowledge. Supervision from token probabilities may underutilize internal knowledge, while direct hidden-state matching forces the student to shift to the teacher's feature space and complicates cross-architecture transfer. Inspired by contrastive learning's use of relationships between instances, we propose \textbf{SimOPD} to transfer teacher internal knowledge through response similarities. Specifically, SimOPD uses paired memory banks of student-generated responses to extract supervision from the teacher's internal representations as similarity distributions. The student then matches these distributions within its own representation space, retaining representational freedom and removing the need for cross-model projection. Extensive experiments show that SimOPD improves the overall average over the strongest baselines by up to 2.6 and 3.1 percentage points in same- and cross-architecture settings.

</details>


### [355] [Self-Reflective Chain-of-Thought (SRCoT): Evidence-Based Text Generation via a Closed-Loop Retrieve--Reflect--Revise Pipeline on Edge LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23311)
*Fabian Broszio,Michael Hoffmann,Adrian Paschke*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出SRCoT（Self-Reflective Chain-of-Thought），一种用于边缘设备LLM的模块化闭环生成架构，通过Retrieve–Reflect–Revise循环与状态分离实现可审计的证据约束文本生成。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM部署将持久知识、任务状态、推理与行动决策混杂在单一上下文或隐藏表征中，难以监控、验证或控制生成过程；在安全关键场景中，幻觉输出可能产生严重后果。本文旨在通过结构化闭环推理架构解决该问题。

Method: SRCoT将环境状态（E）、持久知识（K）、经验积累（X）与短期记忆（M）分离为来源标注的JSON存储；通过BM25检索本地证据，构建包含声明-候选证据-约束-缺失事实的工作空间W_t；可选Judge步骤分解声明并附加证据；确定性控制器基于覆盖度、冲突、缺失信号选择Finalize/Targeted-Retrieve/Revise-with-Evidence/Abstain等动作；实现为本地Python管道，使用LM Studio + gpt-oss模型。

Result: 在两个完全合成场景（EMS院前急救、Munich-Sim应急操作仿真）中进行定性案例研究：(1) EMS案例展示了缺失变量标记（"not specified"）与针对性追问生成；(2) Munich-Sim的T1-T3任务展示了库存核算、派遣覆盖检测与事件文档合成；(3) 三个压力测试场景暴露了大规模memory下的出处标注错误、禁忌症处理不安全等失败模式。结果仅说明报告级可审计性与本地执行的可行性，不证明临床有效性或相对于基线的优势。

Conclusion: SRCoT的核心贡献不在于新模型，而在于将可靠性转化为系统过程的可测试属性（证据覆盖、绑定、缺口检测、控制策略），使失败以具体工件形式可见；该架构将一次性生成重构为闭环证据中心反馈过程，适用于安全与运行关键场景中边缘部署的可审计决策辅助，但需人类审核且当前为研究概念验证。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) can generate fluent outputs that lack source support or conflict with local operational constraints. We introduce Self-Reflective Chain-of-Thought (SRCoT), a modular architecture that organizes generation as a closed Retrieve--Reflect--Revise loop. SRCoT separates environment state, persistent knowledge, accumulated experience, and short-term memory into provenance-labeled stores. BM25 retrieval supplies local context; subsequent passes expose intermediate drafts, missing-information markers, follow-up queries, and optional claim--evidence mappings. These artifacts inform retrieval, revision, clarification, or abstention decisions. We examine the architecture through qualitative, trace-based case studies in two fully synthetic settings: emergency medical services and Munich-Sim, an emergency-operations simulation. Local prototype runs on an Apple M4-family laptop with 128 GB memory illustrate source-labeled documentation, explicit gap marking, and structured dispatch-style outputs. The traces also reveal provenance-assignment errors, incomplete evidence coverage, and unsafe assumptions that remain possible despite prompting constraints. These cases demonstrate report-level inspectability and local execution, not comparative superiority, hallucination reduction, clinical validity, or operational safety. The architecture separates retrieval and control from the model interface, but behavior across different models remains to be evaluated. SRCoT is a research proof of concept requiring human review, with its principal contribution lying in an inspectable control procedure rather than a new model.

</details>


### [356] [From Memory Hits to Answerable Evidence: Query-Conditioned Memory Compilation for Long-Term Agent Memory](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23313)
*Shangze Li,Yanyu Yao,Derong Xu,Zhi Zheng,Tong Xu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出MemCompile框架，将长时记忆中的"地址定位"与"证据呈现"两个决策解耦，通过Address-Evidence双平面架构与SourcePacket源归一化边界，在LoCoMo基准上达到80.52%的Judge准确率，扩展了质量-成本的Pareto前沿。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有长时记忆系统将检索表示与读者证据耦合在一起，使用同一单元同时承担"定位记忆"与"呈现证据"两个角色，导致要么因原子声明过于精简而丢失因果关系，要么因原始对话过长而引入噪声，且无法区分源恢复失败与证据呈现失败。

Method: 采用Address-Evidence双平面架构：Address Plane通过source-linked原子描述符、容量受限Cell布局、收益递减Cell路由与BM25结合生成候选池；通过源归一化边界将异构检索命中归并为稳定的SourcePacket标识；Evidence Plane通过互补包调度（K₀=10）、锚点保持型边界扩展（K_Δ=2）与源作用域声明包渲染，构建读者视图。

Result: 在LoCoMo基准上达到F1=55.94、BLEU-1=48.65、Judge=80.52%，超过xMemory等强基线；多跳问题Judge提升8.69点，时间问题提升7.79点；比Mem0少用51.7% token但Judge高14.35点；在LongMemEval-S上五个类别取得最佳Judge准确率，证明跨基准泛化能力。

Conclusion: 通过将"哪些源获得证据预算"与"如何呈现证据"分离，MemCompile既扩展了质量-成本Pareto前沿，又为长时对话记忆提供了源归一化的证据编译框架，支持智能体维持可靠、有证据支撑的长期交互。

Abstract: Long-term agent memory requires recovering answer-relevant evidence dispersed across turns and sessions. Existing systems increasingly use structured memories and adaptive retrieval, yet often pass retrieved or expanded units directly to the reader, coupling memory addressing with evidence presentation and leaving the final context redundant or incomplete. To address this gap, we propose MemCompile, a query-conditioned evidence compilation framework for long-term conversational memory. Given a query, the Address Plane locates relevant support through compact source-linked descriptors and capacity-aware Cells, while a normalization boundary resolves heterogeneous retrieval hits to stable SourcePacket identities. Its Evidence Plane then allocates a bounded evidence budget across complementary packets, admits limited additional support, and renders the retained claims associated with each selected packet into an answer-ready context. MemCompile achieves 80.52% Judge Accuracy on LoCoMo and extends the empirical quality-cost Pareto frontier to a higher-quality regime. Its strong performance on LongMemEval-S further suggests that the benefits of query-conditioned compilation generalize across long-term conversational-memory benchmarks.

</details>


### [357] [Robust Function Calling for LLM Agents Under Interface Drift](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23342)
*Aniruddha Chattopadhyay,Kanishka Halder,Partha Sarathi Roy*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出SchemaShield-Lite，一种轻量级、无需训练的推理时验证-修复层，用于恢复LLM智能体在工具接口漂移（描述、参数重命名、候选工具集变化）下的函数调用鲁棒性；在Qwen3.5-9B上显著提升DICE-300和BFCL-200准确率，且无观察到修复副作用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
